//
//  OCRIntegrationTests.swift
//  NotBadTests
//
//  OCR 服务真实场景集成测试
//

import XCTest
import Vision
@testable import NotBad

/// OCR 集成测试
///
/// 使用真实图片测试 OCR 服务
/// 注意：这些测试依赖 Vision 框架，在模拟器上可能较慢
final class OCRIntegrationTests: XCTestCase {
    
    // MARK: - Test Data
    
    /// 创建包含文字的测试图片
    private func createImageWithText(_ text: String, fontSize: CGFloat = 24) -> UIImage {
        let size = CGSize(width: 400, height: 200)
        let renderer = UIGraphicsImageRenderer(size: size)
        
        return renderer.image { context in
            // 白色背景
            UIColor.white.setFill()
            context.fill(CGRect(origin: .zero, size: size))
            
            // 黑色文字
            let paragraphStyle = NSMutableParagraphStyle()
            paragraphStyle.alignment = .center
            
            let attributes: [NSAttributedString.Key: Any] = [
                .font: UIFont.systemFont(ofSize: fontSize, weight: .medium),
                .foregroundColor: UIColor.black,
                .paragraphStyle: paragraphStyle
            ]
            
            let textRect = CGRect(x: 20, y: 80, width: size.width - 40, height: size.height - 80)
            text.draw(in: textRect, withAttributes: attributes)
        }
    }
    
    /// 创建包含数学公式样式文字的图片
    private func createMathImage() -> UIImage {
        let size = CGSize(width: 500, height: 300)
        let renderer = UIGraphicsImageRenderer(size: size)
        
        return renderer.image { context in
            UIColor.white.setFill()
            context.fill(CGRect(origin: .zero, size: size))
            
            // 模拟数学题目
            let title = "已知函数 f(x) = x² + 2x + 1"
            let question = "求 f(x) 的最小值"
            
            let titleAttributes: [NSAttributedString.Key: Any] = [
                .font: UIFont.systemFont(ofSize: 20, weight: .bold),
                .foregroundColor: UIColor.black
            ]
            
            let questionAttributes: [NSAttributedString.Key: Any] = [
                .font: UIFont.systemFont(ofSize: 18),
                .foregroundColor: UIColor.black
            ]
            
            title.draw(at: CGPoint(x: 30, y: 50), withAttributes: titleAttributes)
            question.draw(at: CGPoint(x: 30, y: 100), withAttributes: questionAttributes)
        }
    }
    
    // MARK: - OCR Service Tests
    
    /// 测试基本中文识别
    @MainActor
    func testRecognizeChineseText() async throws {
        let service = OCRService.shared
        let testImage = createImageWithText("测试文字识别")
        
        let result = try await service.recognizeText(from: testImage)
        
        // Vision 识别可能不完全精确，检查是否包含关键字
        XCTAssertFalse(result.isEmpty, "应该识别到文字")
        print("识别结果: \(result)")
    }
    
    /// 测试英文识别
    @MainActor
    func testRecognizeEnglishText() async throws {
        let service = OCRService.shared
        let testImage = createImageWithText("Hello World Test")
        
        let result = try await service.recognizeText(from: testImage)
        
        XCTAssertFalse(result.isEmpty, "应该识别到文字")
        print("识别结果: \(result)")
    }
    
    /// 测试中英混合识别
    @MainActor
    func testRecognizeMixedText() async throws {
        let service = OCRService.shared
        let testImage = createImageWithText("测试 Test 123")
        
        let result = try await service.recognizeText(from: testImage)
        
        XCTAssertFalse(result.isEmpty, "应该识别到文字")
        print("识别结果: \(result)")
    }
    
    /// 测试数学题目识别
    @MainActor
    func testRecognizeMathContent() async throws {
        let service = OCRService.shared
        let testImage = createMathImage()
        
        let result = try await service.recognizeText(from: testImage)
        
        XCTAssertFalse(result.isEmpty, "应该识别到数学内容")
        print("数学题识别结果: \(result)")
    }
    
    /// 测试空白图片处理
    @MainActor
    func testRecognizeBlankImage() async throws {
        let service = OCRService.shared
        let blankImage = TestImageFactory.createImage(size: .medium)
        
        // 空白图片可能抛出 noTextFound 错误，这是预期行为
        do {
            let result = try await service.recognizeText(from: blankImage)
            // 如果没有抛出错误，结果应该为空或很少内容
            print("空白图片识别结果: '\(result)'")
        } catch {
            // noTextFound 是预期的错误
            print("空白图片识别抛出预期错误: \(error)")
            XCTAssertTrue("\(error)".contains("noTextFound") || "\(error)".contains("no text"), 
                         "空白图片应该抛出 noTextFound 错误")
        }
    }
    
    // MARK: - Performance Tests
    
    /// 测试 OCR 识别性能
    @MainActor
    func testOCRPerformance() async {
        let service = OCRService.shared
        let testImage = createImageWithText("性能测试文字")
        
        let startTime = CFAbsoluteTimeGetCurrent()
        
        for _ in 0..<3 {
            _ = try? await service.recognizeText(from: testImage)
        }
        
        let elapsed = CFAbsoluteTimeGetCurrent() - startTime
        let average = elapsed / 3
        
        print("OCR 平均识别时间: \(average * 1000) ms")
        
        // OCR 识别通常较慢，但应该在合理范围内
        XCTAssertLessThan(average, 5.0, "OCR 识别应该在 5 秒内完成")
    }
    
    /// 测试大图片 OCR 性能
    @MainActor
    func testLargeImageOCRPerformance() async throws {
        let service = OCRService.shared
        
        // 创建大图片
        let size = CGSize(width: 2000, height: 1500)
        let renderer = UIGraphicsImageRenderer(size: size)
        let largeImage = renderer.image { context in
            UIColor.white.setFill()
            context.fill(CGRect(origin: .zero, size: size))
            
            // 添加多行文字
            for i in 0..<10 {
                let text = "第\(i + 1)行测试文字 Line \(i + 1) Test"
                let y = CGFloat(50 + i * 50)
                text.draw(at: CGPoint(x: 50, y: y), withAttributes: [
                    .font: UIFont.systemFont(ofSize: 24),
                    .foregroundColor: UIColor.black
                ])
            }
        }
        
        let startTime = CFAbsoluteTimeGetCurrent()
        let result = try await service.recognizeText(from: largeImage)
        let elapsed = CFAbsoluteTimeGetCurrent() - startTime
        
        print("大图片 OCR 耗时: \(elapsed * 1000) ms")
        print("识别到 \(result.count) 个字符")
        
        XCTAssertFalse(result.isEmpty, "应该识别到内容")
    }
    
    // MARK: - Error Handling Tests
    
    /// 测试无效图片处理
    @MainActor
    func testInvalidImageHandling() async {
        let service = OCRService.shared
        
        // 创建一个 1x1 的最小图片
        let renderer = UIGraphicsImageRenderer(size: CGSize(width: 1, height: 1))
        let tinyImage = renderer.image { context in
            UIColor.black.setFill()
            context.fill(CGRect(x: 0, y: 0, width: 1, height: 1))
        }
        
        // 应该能处理而不崩溃
        let result = try? await service.recognizeText(from: tinyImage)
        print("微小图片处理结果: \(result ?? "nil")")
    }
}

// FILE PATH: NotBadTests/TestUtilities/TestImageFactory.swift

//
//  TestImageFactory.swift
//  NotBadTests
//
//  测试图片工厂 - 生成真实尺寸的测试图片
//
//  解决问题：测试中使用 Data([0x00]) 等假数据，无法发现真实性能问题
//

import UIKit

/// 测试图片工厂
///
/// 提供生成真实尺寸测试图片的方法，确保测试数据接近生产环境。
///
/// ## 使用示例
///
/// ```swift
/// // 生成小尺寸测试图片
/// let small = TestImageFactory.small
///
/// // 生成自定义尺寸图片
/// let custom = TestImageFactory.createImage(size: CGSize(width: 500, height: 500))
///
/// // 获取 JPEG 数据
/// let data = TestImageFactory.createJPEGData(size: .medium)
/// ```
public enum TestImageFactory {
    
    // MARK: - Standard Sizes
    
    /// 标准测试尺寸
    public enum Size {
        /// 缩略图尺寸 (140x140)
        case thumbnail
        /// 小图片 (300x300)
        case small
        /// 中等图片 (800x800)
        case medium
        /// 大图片 (1500x1500)
        case large
        /// 全尺寸 (2000x2000) - 模拟相机拍摄
        case fullSize
        /// 自定义尺寸
        case custom(CGSize)
        
        var cgSize: CGSize {
            switch self {
            case .thumbnail: return CGSize(width: 140, height: 140)
            case .small: return CGSize(width: 300, height: 300)
            case .medium: return CGSize(width: 800, height: 800)
            case .large: return CGSize(width: 1500, height: 1500)
            case .fullSize: return CGSize(width: 2000, height: 2000)
            case .custom(let size): return size
            }
        }
    }
    
    // MARK: - Quick Access
    
    /// 缩略图 (140x140)
    public static var thumbnail: UIImage {
        createImage(size: .thumbnail)
    }
    
    /// 小图片 (300x300)
    public static var small: UIImage {
        createImage(size: .small)
    }
    
    /// 中等图片 (800x800)
    public static var medium: UIImage {
        createImage(size: .medium)
    }
    
    /// 大图片 (1500x1500)
    public static var large: UIImage {
        createImage(size: .large)
    }
    
    /// 全尺寸图片 (2000x2000)
    public static var fullSize: UIImage {
        createImage(size: .fullSize)
    }
    
    // MARK: - Image Generation
    
    /// 创建指定尺寸的测试图片
    ///
    /// 生成带有随机内容的图片，模拟真实的题目照片。
    ///
    /// - Parameter size: 图片尺寸
    /// - Returns: 生成的 UIImage
    public static func createImage(size: Size) -> UIImage {
        createImage(cgSize: size.cgSize)
    }
    
    /// 创建指定 CGSize 的测试图片
    ///
    /// - Parameter cgSize: 图片尺寸
    /// - Returns: 生成的 UIImage
    public static func createImage(cgSize: CGSize) -> UIImage {
        let renderer = UIGraphicsImageRenderer(size: cgSize)
        return renderer.image { context in
            // 绘制背景渐变
            let colors = [
                UIColor.systemBackground.cgColor,
                UIColor.secondarySystemBackground.cgColor
            ]
            let gradient = CGGradient(
                colorsSpace: CGColorSpaceCreateDeviceRGB(),
                colors: colors as CFArray,
                locations: [0, 1]
            )!
            context.cgContext.drawLinearGradient(
                gradient,
                start: .zero,
                end: CGPoint(x: cgSize.width, y: cgSize.height),
                options: []
            )
            
            // 绘制模拟文字行（模拟题目内容）
            let lineHeight: CGFloat = cgSize.height / 15
            let margin: CGFloat = cgSize.width * 0.1
            
            for i in 0..<10 {
                let y = margin + CGFloat(i) * lineHeight * 1.5
                let width = cgSize.width * CGFloat.random(in: 0.5...0.8)
                let rect = CGRect(x: margin, y: y, width: width, height: lineHeight * 0.6)
                
                UIColor.label.withAlphaComponent(0.3).setFill()
                UIBezierPath(roundedRect: rect, cornerRadius: 2).fill()
            }
            
            // 添加一些随机"公式"区域
            for _ in 0..<3 {
                let x = CGFloat.random(in: margin...(cgSize.width - margin - 100))
                let y = CGFloat.random(in: margin...(cgSize.height - margin - 50))
                let rect = CGRect(x: x, y: y, width: CGFloat.random(in: 80...150), height: CGFloat.random(in: 30...60))
                
                UIColor.systemBlue.withAlphaComponent(0.1).setFill()
                UIBezierPath(roundedRect: rect, cornerRadius: 4).fill()
            }
        }
    }
    
    // MARK: - Data Generation
    
    /// 创建 JPEG 数据
    ///
    /// - Parameters:
    ///   - size: 图片尺寸
    ///   - quality: JPEG 压缩质量 (0.0 - 1.0)
    /// - Returns: JPEG 格式的 Data
    public static func createJPEGData(size: Size, quality: CGFloat = 0.8) -> Data {
        createImage(size: size).jpegData(compressionQuality: quality) ?? Data()
    }
    
    /// 创建 PNG 数据
    ///
    /// - Parameter size: 图片尺寸
    /// - Returns: PNG 格式的 Data
    public static func createPNGData(size: Size) -> Data {
        createImage(size: size).pngData() ?? Data()
    }
    
    /// 创建指定大小（KB）的 JPEG 数据
    ///
    /// 通过调整压缩质量来接近目标大小。
    ///
    /// - Parameters:
    ///   - targetKB: 目标大小（KB）
    ///   - tolerance: 允许的误差比例 (默认 0.2 = 20%)
    /// - Returns: 接近目标大小的 JPEG Data
    public static func createJPEGData(targetKB: Int, tolerance: Double = 0.2) -> Data {
        // 根据目标大小选择合适的图片尺寸
        let size: Size
        switch targetKB {
        case 0..<50: size = .small
        case 50..<200: size = .medium
        case 200..<500: size = .large
        default: size = .fullSize
        }
        
        let image = createImage(size: size)
        var quality: CGFloat = 0.8
        var data = image.jpegData(compressionQuality: quality) ?? Data()
        
        // 迭代调整质量以接近目标大小
        let targetBytes = targetKB * 1024
        let minBytes = Int(Double(targetBytes) * (1 - tolerance))
        let maxBytes = Int(Double(targetBytes) * (1 + tolerance))
        
        for _ in 0..<5 {
            if data.count < minBytes {
                quality = min(1.0, quality + 0.1)
            } else if data.count > maxBytes {
                quality = max(0.1, quality - 0.1)
            } else {
                break
            }
            data = image.jpegData(compressionQuality: quality) ?? Data()
        }
        
        return data
    }
    
    // MARK: - Batch Generation
    
    /// 创建多张测试图片
    ///
    /// - Parameters:
    ///   - count: 图片数量
    ///   - size: 图片尺寸
    /// - Returns: UIImage 数组
    public static func createImages(count: Int, size: Size = .medium) -> [UIImage] {
        (0..<count).map { _ in createImage(size: size) }
    }
    
    /// 创建多份 JPEG 数据
    ///
    /// - Parameters:
    ///   - count: 数据数量
    ///   - size: 图片尺寸
    /// - Returns: Data 数组
    public static func createJPEGDatas(count: Int, size: Size = .medium) -> [Data] {
        (0..<count).map { _ in createJPEGData(size: size) }
    }
}

// MARK: - Convenience Extensions

public extension TestImageFactory {
    
    /// 打印图片信息（用于调试）
    static func printInfo(for image: UIImage, label: String = "Image") {
        let data = image.jpegData(compressionQuality: 0.8) ?? Data()
        print("[\(label)] Size: \(image.size), Data: \(data.count / 1024) KB")
    }
    
    /// 打印数据信息（用于调试）
    static func printInfo(for data: Data, label: String = "Data") {
        print("[\(label)] Size: \(data.count / 1024) KB (\(data.count) bytes)")
    }
}

//
//  TestReviewItemFactory.swift
//  NotBadTests
//
//  测试 ReviewItem 工厂 - 创建带真实数据的测试对象
//

import Foundation
import UIKit
@testable import NotBad

/// 测试 ReviewItem 工厂
///
/// 提供创建各种测试场景 ReviewItem 的便捷方法。
///
/// ## 使用示例
///
/// ```swift
/// // 创建带真实图片的 ReviewItem
/// let item = TestReviewItemFactory.createWithImage()
///
/// // 创建批量测试数据
/// let items = TestReviewItemFactory.createBatch(count: 100)
///
/// // 创建特定学科的数据
/// let mathItems = TestReviewItemFactory.createBatch(count: 10, subject: .math)
/// ```
public enum TestReviewItemFactory {
    
    // MARK: - Single Item Creation
    
    /// 创建基础 ReviewItem（无图片）
    public static func create(
        title: String = "测试题目",
        subject: Subject = .math,
        grade: Grade = .grade10,
        mastery: MasteryLevel = .partial,
        difficulty: Difficulty = .medium
    ) -> ReviewItem {
        ReviewItem(
            title: title,
            mastery: mastery,
            subject: subject,
            grade: grade,
            difficulty: difficulty
        )
    }
    
    /// 创建带图片的 ReviewItem
    ///
    /// - Parameters:
    ///   - imageSize: 图片尺寸
    ///   - title: 标题
    ///   - subject: 学科
    /// - Returns: 带真实图片数据的 ReviewItem
    public static func createWithImage(
        imageSize: TestImageFactory.Size = .medium,
        title: String = "测试题目",
        subject: Subject = .math,
        grade: Grade = .grade10,
        mastery: MasteryLevel = .partial
    ) -> ReviewItem {
        let imageData = TestImageFactory.createJPEGData(size: imageSize)
        return ReviewItem(
            imageData: imageData,
            title: title,
            mastery: mastery,
            subject: subject,
            grade: grade
        )
    }
    
    /// 创建带大图片的 ReviewItem（性能测试用）
    public static func createWithLargeImage() -> ReviewItem {
        createWithImage(imageSize: .fullSize, title: "大图片测试")
    }
    
    /// 创建需要复习的 ReviewItem
    public static func createNeedingReview(
        subject: Subject = .math,
        mastery: MasteryLevel = .partial
    ) -> ReviewItem {
        let item = create(subject: subject, mastery: mastery)
        item.nextReviewDate = Date().addingTimeInterval(-86400) // 昨天
        return item
    }
    
    /// 创建已掌握的 ReviewItem
    public static func createMastered(subject: Subject = .math) -> ReviewItem {
        let item = create(subject: subject, mastery: .mastered)
        item.nextReviewDate = Date().addingTimeInterval(86400 * 30) // 30天后
        item.reviewCount = 5
        return item
    }
    
    // MARK: - Batch Creation
    
    /// 创建批量 ReviewItem（无图片）
    ///
    /// - Parameters:
    ///   - count: 数量
    ///   - subject: 可选的固定学科
    /// - Returns: ReviewItem 数组
    public static func createBatch(
        count: Int,
        subject: Subject? = nil
    ) -> [ReviewItem] {
        let subjects = Subject.allCases
        return (0..<count).map { index in
            let itemSubject = subject ?? subjects[index % subjects.count]
            let mastery = MasteryLevel.allCases[index % MasteryLevel.allCases.count]
            return create(
                title: "测试题目 #\(index + 1)",
                subject: itemSubject,
                mastery: mastery
            )
        }
    }
    
    /// 创建带图片的批量 ReviewItem
    ///
    /// - Warning: 这会消耗较多内存，建议 count <= 50
    ///
    /// - Parameters:
    ///   - count: 数量
    ///   - imageSize: 图片尺寸
    /// - Returns: ReviewItem 数组
    public static func createBatchWithImages(
        count: Int,
        imageSize: TestImageFactory.Size = .small
    ) -> [ReviewItem] {
        let subjects = Subject.allCases
        return (0..<count).map { index in
            createWithImage(
                imageSize: imageSize,
                title: "带图测试 #\(index + 1)",
                subject: subjects[index % subjects.count]
            )
        }
    }
    
    /// 创建混合的批量数据（部分有图片）
    ///
    /// - Parameters:
    ///   - count: 总数量
    ///   - imageRatio: 带图片的比例 (0.0 - 1.0)
    /// - Returns: ReviewItem 数组
    public static func createMixedBatch(
        count: Int,
        imageRatio: Double = 0.5
    ) -> [ReviewItem] {
        let imageCount = Int(Double(count) * imageRatio)
        let noImageCount = count - imageCount
        
        var items: [ReviewItem] = []
        items.append(contentsOf: createBatchWithImages(count: imageCount, imageSize: .small))
        items.append(contentsOf: createBatch(count: noImageCount))
        
        return items.shuffled()
    }
    
    // MARK: - Specific Scenarios
    
    /// 创建模拟真实使用场景的数据集
    ///
    /// 包含各种学科、掌握度、有无图片的混合数据
    ///
    /// - Parameter count: 总数量
    /// - Returns: 模拟真实场景的 ReviewItem 数组
    public static func createRealisticDataset(count: Int) -> [ReviewItem] {
        var items: [ReviewItem] = []
        
        for i in 0..<count {
            let hasImage = i % 3 == 0 // 1/3 有图片
            let subject = Subject.allCases[i % Subject.allCases.count]
            let mastery = MasteryLevel.allCases[i % MasteryLevel.allCases.count]
            let needsReview = i % 4 == 0 // 1/4 需要复习
            
            let item: ReviewItem
            if hasImage {
                item = createWithImage(
                    imageSize: .small,
                    title: "\(subject.displayName)题目 #\(i + 1)",
                    subject: subject,
                    mastery: mastery
                )
            } else {
                item = create(
                    title: "\(subject.displayName)题目 #\(i + 1)",
                    subject: subject,
                    mastery: mastery
                )
            }
            
            if needsReview {
                item.nextReviewDate = Date().addingTimeInterval(-86400 * Double.random(in: 1...7))
            } else {
                item.nextReviewDate = Date().addingTimeInterval(86400 * Double.random(in: 1...30))
            }
            
            item.reviewCount = Int.random(in: 0...10)
            items.append(item)
        }
        
        return items
    }
}

// MARK: - Convenience Extensions

public extension TestReviewItemFactory {
    
    /// 打印数据集统计信息
    static func printStats(for items: [ReviewItem]) {
        let withImage = items.filter { $0.imageData != nil }.count
        let needsReview = items.filter { $0.needsReview }.count
        let totalImageSize = items.compactMap { $0.imageData?.count }.reduce(0, +)
        
        print("""
        📊 数据集统计:
        - 总数: \(items.count)
        - 带图片: \(withImage) (\(withImage * 100 / max(items.count, 1))%)
        - 需要复习: \(needsReview)
        - 图片总大小: \(totalImageSize / 1024) KB
        """)
    }
}

// FILE PATH: NotBadTests/TestUtilities/PerformanceTestHelpers.swift

//
//  PerformanceTestHelpers.swift
//  NotBadTests
//
//  性能测试辅助工具
//

import XCTest
import Foundation

/// 性能测试辅助工具
///
/// 提供性能测试所需的各种辅助方法。
///
/// ## 使用示例
///
/// ```swift
/// class MyPerformanceTests: XCTestCase {
///     func testSomething() {
///         let result = measureExecutionTime {
///             // 被测试的代码
///         }
///         print("执行时间: \(result.seconds) 秒")
///     }
/// }
/// ```
public enum PerformanceTestHelpers {
    
    // MARK: - Execution Time Measurement
    
    /// 执行时间测量结果
    public struct ExecutionResult<T> {
        public let value: T
        public let nanoseconds: UInt64
        
        public var milliseconds: Double {
            Double(nanoseconds) / 1_000_000
        }
        
        public var seconds: Double {
            Double(nanoseconds) / 1_000_000_000
        }
    }
    
    /// 测量代码块执行时间
    ///
    /// - Parameter block: 要测量的代码块
    /// - Returns: 执行结果和时间
    public static func measureExecutionTime<T>(_ block: () throws -> T) rethrows -> ExecutionResult<T> {
        let start = DispatchTime.now()
        let value = try block()
        let end = DispatchTime.now()
        let nanoseconds = end.uptimeNanoseconds - start.uptimeNanoseconds
        return ExecutionResult(value: value, nanoseconds: nanoseconds)
    }
    
    /// 测量异步代码块执行时间
    ///
    /// - Parameter block: 要测量的异步代码块
    /// - Returns: 执行结果和时间
    public static func measureExecutionTimeAsync<T>(_ block: () async throws -> T) async rethrows -> ExecutionResult<T> {
        let start = DispatchTime.now()
        let value = try await block()
        let end = DispatchTime.now()
        let nanoseconds = end.uptimeNanoseconds - start.uptimeNanoseconds
        return ExecutionResult(value: value, nanoseconds: nanoseconds)
    }
    
    // MARK: - Memory Measurement
    
    /// 内存使用信息
    public struct MemoryInfo {
        public let usedBytes: UInt64
        public let peakBytes: UInt64
        
        public var usedMB: Double {
            Double(usedBytes) / (1024 * 1024)
        }
        
        public var peakMB: Double {
            Double(peakBytes) / (1024 * 1024)
        }
    }
    
    /// 获取当前内存使用量
    public static func currentMemoryUsage() -> UInt64 {
        var info = mach_task_basic_info()
        var count = mach_msg_type_number_t(MemoryLayout<mach_task_basic_info>.size) / 4
        
        let result = withUnsafeMutablePointer(to: &info) {
            $0.withMemoryRebound(to: integer_t.self, capacity: 1) {
                task_info(mach_task_self_, task_flavor_t(MACH_TASK_BASIC_INFO), $0, &count)
            }
        }
        
        guard result == KERN_SUCCESS else {
            return 0
        }
        
        return info.resident_size
    }
    
    /// 测量代码块执行期间的内存增长
    ///
    /// - Parameter block: 要测量的代码块
    /// - Returns: 内存使用信息
    public static func measureMemoryGrowth<T>(_ block: () throws -> T) rethrows -> (value: T, memoryGrowth: UInt64) {
        let beforeMemory = currentMemoryUsage()
        let value = try block()
        let afterMemory = currentMemoryUsage()
        let growth = afterMemory > beforeMemory ? afterMemory - beforeMemory : 0
        return (value, growth)
    }
    
    // MARK: - Thresholds and Assertions
    
    /// 性能阈值
    public struct Threshold: Sendable {
        public let maxMilliseconds: Double
        public let maxMemoryMB: Double
        
        public init(maxMilliseconds: Double = 100, maxMemoryMB: Double = 50) {
            self.maxMilliseconds = maxMilliseconds
            self.maxMemoryMB = maxMemoryMB
        }
        
        public static let fast = Threshold(maxMilliseconds: 16, maxMemoryMB: 10)
        public static let normal = Threshold(maxMilliseconds: 100, maxMemoryMB: 50)
        public static let slow = Threshold(maxMilliseconds: 500, maxMemoryMB: 100)
        public static let heavy = Threshold(maxMilliseconds: 2000, maxMemoryMB: 200)
    }
    
    /// 断言执行时间在阈值内
    public static func assertExecutionTime<T>(
        _ block: () throws -> T,
        within threshold: Threshold,
        file: StaticString = #filePath,
        line: UInt = #line
    ) rethrows -> T {
        let result = try measureExecutionTime(block)
        XCTAssertLessThan(
            result.milliseconds,
            threshold.maxMilliseconds,
            "执行时间 \(result.milliseconds)ms 超过阈值 \(threshold.maxMilliseconds)ms",
            file: file,
            line: line
        )
        return result.value
    }
    
    /// 断言内存增长在阈值内
    public static func assertMemoryGrowth<T>(
        _ block: () throws -> T,
        within threshold: Threshold,
        file: StaticString = #filePath,
        line: UInt = #line
    ) rethrows -> T {
        let result = try measureMemoryGrowth(block)
        let growthMB = Double(result.memoryGrowth) / (1024 * 1024)
        XCTAssertLessThan(
            growthMB,
            threshold.maxMemoryMB,
            "内存增长 \(growthMB)MB 超过阈值 \(threshold.maxMemoryMB)MB",
            file: file,
            line: line
        )
        return result.value
    }
    
    // MARK: - Iteration Helpers
    
    /// 多次执行并取平均值
    ///
    /// - Parameters:
    ///   - iterations: 迭代次数
    ///   - warmup: 预热次数（不计入统计）
    ///   - block: 要执行的代码块
    /// - Returns: 平均执行时间（毫秒）
    public static func averageExecutionTime(
        iterations: Int = 10,
        warmup: Int = 2,
        _ block: () throws -> Void
    ) rethrows -> Double {
        // 预热
        for _ in 0..<warmup {
            try block()
        }
        
        // 正式测量
        var totalNanoseconds: UInt64 = 0
        for _ in 0..<iterations {
            let result = try measureExecutionTime(block)
            totalNanoseconds += result.nanoseconds
        }
        
        return Double(totalNanoseconds) / Double(iterations) / 1_000_000
    }
    
    /// 打印性能报告
    public static func printPerformanceReport(
        name: String,
        executionMs: Double,
        memoryMB: Double? = nil,
        itemCount: Int? = nil
    ) {
        var report = """
        
        ⚡️ 性能报告: \(name)
        ├─ 执行时间: \(String(format: "%.2f", executionMs)) ms
        """
        
        if let memory = memoryMB {
            report += "\n├─ 内存使用: \(String(format: "%.2f", memory)) MB"
        }
        
        if let count = itemCount {
            let perItem = executionMs / Double(count)
            report += "\n├─ 单项耗时: \(String(format: "%.3f", perItem)) ms"
        }
        
        report += "\n└─ 完成"
        print(report)
    }
}

// MARK: - XCTestCase Extension

public extension XCTestCase {
    
    /// 便捷的性能测量方法
    func measureWithResult<T>(
        _ block: () throws -> T
    ) rethrows -> PerformanceTestHelpers.ExecutionResult<T> {
        try PerformanceTestHelpers.measureExecutionTime(block)
    }
    
    /// 断言代码块在指定毫秒内完成
    func assertCompletes<T>(
        withinMilliseconds ms: Double,
        file: StaticString = #file,
        line: UInt = #line,
        _ block: () throws -> T
    ) rethrows -> T {
        let threshold = PerformanceTestHelpers.Threshold(maxMilliseconds: ms, maxMemoryMB: 1000)
        return try PerformanceTestHelpers.assertExecutionTime(block, within: threshold, file: file, line: line)
    }
    
    /// 异步版本的性能测量
    func measureAsyncPerformance(
        iterations: Int = 5,
        _ block: @escaping () async throws -> Void
    ) async throws {
        var times: [Double] = []
        
        for _ in 0..<iterations {
            let result = try await PerformanceTestHelpers.measureExecutionTimeAsync(block)
            times.append(result.milliseconds)
        }
        
        let average = times.reduce(0, +) / Double(times.count)
        let min = times.min() ?? 0
        let max = times.max() ?? 0
        
        print("""
        📊 异步性能测试结果 (\(iterations) 次迭代):
        - 平均: \(String(format: "%.2f", average)) ms
        - 最小: \(String(format: "%.2f", min)) ms
        - 最大: \(String(format: "%.2f", max)) ms
        """)
    }
}

//
//  SearchHistoryManagerTests.swift
//  NotBadTests
//
//  搜索历史管理器测试
//

import Testing
@testable import NotBad

@Suite("SearchHistoryManager 测试")
@MainActor
struct SearchHistoryManagerTests {
    
    // MARK: - Setup
    
    /// 创建隔离的测试实例
    /// 注意：由于 SearchHistoryManager 是单例，这里测试会影响真实数据
    /// 在实际项目中，应该使用依赖注入来避免这个问题
    
    @Test("添加搜索记录")
    func addSearch() {
        let manager = SearchHistoryManager.shared
        let initialCount = manager.searchHistory.count
        
        // 添加新记录
        manager.addSearch("测试搜索")
        
        #expect(manager.searchHistory.contains("测试搜索"))
        
        // 清理
        manager.removeSearch("测试搜索")
    }
    
    @Test("空字符串不添加")
    func emptyStringNotAdded() {
        let manager = SearchHistoryManager.shared
        let initialCount = manager.searchHistory.count
        
        manager.addSearch("")
        manager.addSearch("   ")
        
        #expect(manager.searchHistory.count == initialCount)
    }
    
    @Test("重复搜索移到顶部")
    func duplicateMovesToTop() {
        let manager = SearchHistoryManager.shared
        
        // 添加多个记录
        manager.addSearch("第一个")
        manager.addSearch("第二个")
        manager.addSearch("第三个")
        
        // 重复添加第一个
        manager.addSearch("第一个")
        
        #expect(manager.searchHistory.first == "第一个")
        
        // 清理
        manager.removeSearch("第一个")
        manager.removeSearch("第二个")
        manager.removeSearch("第三个")
    }
    
    @Test("删除搜索记录")
    func removeSearch() {
        let manager = SearchHistoryManager.shared
        
        manager.addSearch("待删除")
        #expect(manager.searchHistory.contains("待删除"))
        
        manager.removeSearch("待删除")
        #expect(!manager.searchHistory.contains("待删除"))
    }
    
    @Test("清空所有历史")
    func clearHistory() {
        let manager = SearchHistoryManager.shared
        
        // 保存当前历史
        let previousHistory = manager.searchHistory
        
        // 添加测试数据
        manager.addSearch("清空测试1")
        manager.addSearch("清空测试2")
        
        // 清空
        manager.clearHistory()
        
        #expect(manager.searchHistory.isEmpty)
        
        // 恢复之前的历史（如果有）
        for item in previousHistory.reversed() {
            manager.addSearch(item)
        }
    }
}

//
//  DataProviderProtocolTests.swift
//  NotBadTests
//
//  测试 ReviewItemDataProviding 协议一致性
//

import Testing
import SwiftData
@testable import NotBad

@Suite("ReviewItemDataProviding 协议一致性测试")
struct DataProviderProtocolTests {
    
    // MARK: - 协议一致性测试
    
    @Test("MockReviewItemProvider 遵循协议")
    @MainActor
    func mockProviderConformsToProtocol() {
        let provider: any ReviewItemDataProviding = MockReviewItemProvider()
        
        #expect(provider is MockReviewItemProvider)
    }
    
    @Test("SwiftDataReviewItemProvider 遵循协议")
    @MainActor
    func swiftDataProviderConformsToProtocol() throws {
        let config = ModelConfiguration(isStoredInMemoryOnly: true)
        let container = try ModelContainer(for: ReviewItem.self, configurations: config)
        let context = container.mainContext
        
        let provider: any ReviewItemDataProviding = SwiftDataReviewItemProvider(modelContext: context)
        
        #expect(provider is SwiftDataReviewItemProvider)
    }
    
    // MARK: - 协议方法测试
    
    @Test("协议定义 items 属性")
    @MainActor
    func protocolDefinesItemsProperty() {
        let provider: any ReviewItemDataProviding = MockReviewItemProvider()
        
        _ = provider.items
        
        #expect(true) // 编译通过即成功
    }
    
    @Test("协议定义 refresh 方法")
    @MainActor
    func protocolDefinesRefreshMethod() {
        let provider: any ReviewItemDataProviding = MockReviewItemProvider()
        
        provider.refresh()
        
        #expect(true)
    }
    
    @Test("协议定义 save 方法")
    @MainActor
    func protocolDefinesSaveMethod() throws {
        let provider: any ReviewItemDataProviding = MockReviewItemProvider()
        let item = ReviewItem(title: "测试", subject: .math)
        
        try provider.save(item)
        
        #expect(true)
    }
    
    @Test("协议定义 delete 方法")
    @MainActor
    func protocolDefinesDeleteMethod() throws {
        let provider = MockReviewItemProvider()
        let item = ReviewItem(title: "测试", subject: .math)
        try provider.save(item)
        
        try (provider as any ReviewItemDataProviding).delete(item)
        
        #expect(true)
    }
    
    @Test("协议定义 search 方法")
    @MainActor
    func protocolDefinesSearchMethod() {
        let provider: any ReviewItemDataProviding = MockReviewItemProvider()
        
        let results = provider.search(query: "test")
        
        #expect(results.isEmpty)
    }
    
    @Test("协议定义 statistics 方法")
    @MainActor
    func protocolDefinesStatisticsMethod() {
        let provider: any ReviewItemDataProviding = MockReviewItemProvider()
        
        let stats = provider.statistics()
        
        #expect(stats.totalCount == 0)
    }
    
    // MARK: - 多态性测试
    
    @Test("可以使用协议类型持有不同实现")
    @MainActor
    func canHoldDifferentImplementations() throws {
        let mockProvider: any ReviewItemDataProviding = MockReviewItemProvider()
        
        let config = ModelConfiguration(isStoredInMemoryOnly: true)
        let container = try ModelContainer(for: ReviewItem.self, configurations: config)
        let swiftDataProvider: any ReviewItemDataProviding = SwiftDataReviewItemProvider(modelContext: container.mainContext)
        
        var providers: [any ReviewItemDataProviding] = []
        providers.append(mockProvider)
        providers.append(swiftDataProvider)
        
        #expect(providers.count == 2)
    }
    
    @Test("函数可以接受协议类型参数")
    @MainActor
    func functionAcceptsProtocolType() {
        func countItems(_ provider: any ReviewItemDataProviding) -> Int {
            return provider.items.count
        }
        
        let provider = MockReviewItemProvider(items: [
            ReviewItem(title: "1", subject: .math),
            ReviewItem(title: "2", subject: .physics)
        ])
        
        let count = countItems(provider)
        
        #expect(count == 2)
    }
}

//
//  ImageCompressionPerformanceTests.swift
//  NotBadTests
//
//  图片压缩服务性能测试
//

import XCTest
@testable import NotBad

/// 图片压缩性能测试
///
/// 测试真实图片压缩服务的性能
final class ImageCompressionPerformanceTests: XCTestCase {
    
    // MARK: - Test Data
    
    /// 创建测试用大图片
    private func createLargeImage(width: Int, height: Int) -> UIImage {
        let size = CGSize(width: width, height: height)
        let renderer = UIGraphicsImageRenderer(size: size)
        return renderer.image { context in
            // 绘制复杂内容以模拟真实照片
            let colors: [UIColor] = [.systemRed, .systemBlue, .systemGreen, .systemYellow]
            
            for i in 0..<100 {
                let color = colors[i % colors.count]
                color.setFill()
                let rect = CGRect(
                    x: CGFloat.random(in: 0..<size.width),
                    y: CGFloat.random(in: 0..<size.height),
                    width: CGFloat.random(in: 50..<300),
                    height: CGFloat.random(in: 50..<300)
                )
                context.fill(rect)
            }
        }
    }
    
    // MARK: - Compression Performance
    
    /// 测试 1000x1000 图片压缩性能
    ///
    /// 预期：< 100ms
    func testCompress1000x1000() {
        let image = createLargeImage(width: 1000, height: 1000)
        
        measure {
            _ = ImageCompressor.compress(image)
        }
    }
    
    /// 测试 2000x2000 图片压缩性能
    ///
    /// 预期：< 300ms
    func testCompress2000x2000() {
        let image = createLargeImage(width: 2000, height: 2000)
        
        measure {
            _ = ImageCompressor.compress(image)
        }
    }
    
    /// 测试 4000x3000 图片压缩性能（模拟相机照片）
    ///
    /// 预期：< 500ms
    func testCompress4000x3000() {
        let image = createLargeImage(width: 4000, height: 3000)
        
        print("原图尺寸: \(image.size)")
        
        measure {
            _ = ImageCompressor.compress(image)
        }
    }
    
    // MARK: - Resize Performance
    
    /// 测试图片缩放性能
    func testResize4000To1000() {
        let image = createLargeImage(width: 4000, height: 3000)
        
        measure {
            _ = ImageCompressor.resize(image, maxDimension: 1000)
        }
    }
    
    /// 测试缩放到缩略图尺寸性能
    func testResizeToThumbnail() {
        let image = createLargeImage(width: 4000, height: 3000)
        
        measure {
            _ = ImageCompressor.resize(image, maxDimension: 140)
        }
    }
    
    // MARK: - Batch Operations
    
    /// 测试批量压缩 5 张图片性能
    func testBatchCompress5Images() {
        let images = (0..<5).map { _ in createLargeImage(width: 2000, height: 1500) }
        
        measure {
            for image in images {
                _ = ImageCompressor.compress(image)
            }
        }
    }
    
    /// 测试并发压缩性能
    func testConcurrentCompress() async {
        let images = (0..<5).map { _ in createLargeImage(width: 2000, height: 1500) }
        
        let startTime = CFAbsoluteTimeGetCurrent()
        
        await withTaskGroup(of: Data?.self) { group in
            for image in images {
                group.addTask {
                    ImageCompressor.compress(image)
                }
            }
        }
        
        let elapsed = CFAbsoluteTimeGetCurrent() - startTime
        print("并发压缩 5 张图片耗时: \(elapsed * 1000) ms")
    }
    
    // MARK: - Quality vs Size Tradeoff
    
    /// 测试不同质量参数对性能和大小的影响
    func testQualityImpact() {
        let image = createLargeImage(width: 2000, height: 1500)
        let qualities: [CGFloat] = [0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.9]
        
        print("\n📊 压缩质量对比:")
        for quality in qualities {
            let startTime = CFAbsoluteTimeGetCurrent()
            let data = ImageCompressor.compress(image, quality: quality)
            let elapsed = CFAbsoluteTimeGetCurrent() - startTime
            
            print("  质量 \(quality): \(data?.count ?? 0 / 1024) KB, 耗时 \(elapsed * 1000) ms")
        }
    }
    
    // MARK: - Memory Impact
    
    /// 测试压缩过程的内存影响
    func testCompressionMemoryImpact() {
        let image = createLargeImage(width: 4000, height: 3000)
        
        let (_, memoryGrowth) = PerformanceTestHelpers.measureMemoryGrowth {
            _ = ImageCompressor.compress(image)
        }
        
        let growthMB = Double(memoryGrowth) / (1024 * 1024)
        print("压缩 4000x3000 图片内存增长: \(growthMB) MB")
        
        // 内存测量在模拟器中不稳定，仅打印日志供参考
        // 真实设备测试更有意义
        XCTAssertTrue(true, "内存测量仅供参考")
    }
}

//
//  LibraryPerformanceTests.swift
//  NotBadTests
//
//  性能测试 - 确保 UI 渲染性能达标
//

import XCTest
@testable import NotBad

/// 题库性能测试
///
/// 这些测试确保关键 UI 操作在性能预算内完成。
/// 使用真实尺寸的图片数据来模拟实际使用场景。
final class LibraryPerformanceTests: XCTestCase {
    
    // MARK: - Test Data
    
    /// 生成模拟的 JPEG 图片数据（约 100KB）
    /// 这比真实图片小，但足以暴露性能问题
    private func generateMockImageData(sizeKB: Int = 100) -> Data {
        // 生成指定大小的随机数据
        var data = Data(count: sizeKB * 1024)
        _ = data.withUnsafeMutableBytes { ptr in
            // 用随机字节填充（模拟压缩图片数据）
            arc4random_buf(ptr.baseAddress!, ptr.count)
        }
        return data
    }
    
    /// 生成真实的 UIImage 并转换为 JPEG
    private func generateRealImageData(size: CGSize = CGSize(width: 1000, height: 1000)) -> Data? {
        let renderer = UIGraphicsImageRenderer(size: size)
        let image = renderer.image { context in
            // 绘制渐变背景
            let colors = [UIColor.systemBlue.cgColor, UIColor.systemPurple.cgColor]
            let gradient = CGGradient(colorsSpace: CGColorSpaceCreateDeviceRGB(),
                                       colors: colors as CFArray,
                                       locations: [0, 1])!
            context.cgContext.drawLinearGradient(
                gradient,
                start: .zero,
                end: CGPoint(x: size.width, y: size.height),
                options: []
            )
            
            // 添加一些随机矩形（模拟题目内容）
            for _ in 0..<10 {
                let rect = CGRect(
                    x: CGFloat.random(in: 0..<size.width),
                    y: CGFloat.random(in: 0..<size.height),
                    width: CGFloat.random(in: 50..<200),
                    height: CGFloat.random(in: 20..<100)
                )
                UIColor.white.withAlphaComponent(0.3).setFill()
                context.fill(rect)
            }
        }
        return image.jpegData(compressionQuality: 0.8)
    }
    
    // MARK: - Performance Tests
    
    /// 测试图片解码性能
    ///
    /// 确保单张图片解码时间 < 50ms
    func testImageDecodingPerformance() throws {
        let imageData = try XCTUnwrap(generateRealImageData())
        print("测试图片大小: \(imageData.count / 1024) KB")
        
        measure {
            // 模拟 ItemRow 中的图片解码
            _ = UIImage(data: imageData)
        }
    }
    
    /// 测试缩略图生成性能
    ///
    /// 确保缩略图生成时间 < 30ms
    func testThumbnailGenerationPerformance() throws {
        let imageData = try XCTUnwrap(generateRealImageData(size: CGSize(width: 2000, height: 2000)))
        let original = try XCTUnwrap(UIImage(data: imageData))
        print("原图大小: \(imageData.count / 1024) KB, 尺寸: \(original.size)")
        
        let targetSize = CGSize(width: 140, height: 140)
        
        measure {
            let renderer = UIGraphicsImageRenderer(size: targetSize)
            _ = renderer.image { _ in
                original.draw(in: CGRect(origin: .zero, size: targetSize))
            }
        }
    }
    
    /// 测试批量图片解码性能
    ///
    /// 模拟列表显示 20 张图片的场景
    func testBatchImageDecodingPerformance() throws {
        // 准备 20 张不同的图片数据
        var imageDatas: [Data] = []
        for i in 0..<20 {
            let size = CGSize(width: 800 + i * 50, height: 600 + i * 50)
            if let data = generateRealImageData(size: size) {
                imageDatas.append(data)
            }
        }
        
        print("准备了 \(imageDatas.count) 张图片，总大小: \(imageDatas.reduce(0) { $0 + $1.count } / 1024) KB")
        
        measure {
            // 同步解码所有图片（模拟之前的问题代码）
            for data in imageDatas {
                _ = UIImage(data: data)
            }
        }
    }
    
    /// 测试异步图片加载性能
    ///
    /// 确保异步加载不阻塞主线程
    func testAsyncImageLoadingDoesNotBlockMainThread() async throws {
        let imageData = try XCTUnwrap(generateRealImageData(size: CGSize(width: 2000, height: 2000)))
        
        // 记录开始时间
        let startTime = CFAbsoluteTimeGetCurrent()
        
        // 模拟优化后的异步加载
        let targetSize = CGSize(width: 140, height: 140)
        
        let _ = await Task.detached(priority: .userInitiated) {
            guard let original = UIImage(data: imageData) else { return nil as UIImage? }
            let renderer = UIGraphicsImageRenderer(size: targetSize)
            return renderer.image { _ in
                original.draw(in: CGRect(origin: .zero, size: targetSize))
            }
        }.value
        
        let elapsed = CFAbsoluteTimeGetCurrent() - startTime
        print("异步加载耗时: \(elapsed * 1000) ms")
        
        // 异步加载应该很快返回（实际解码在后台）
        // 这个测试主要验证 API 正确性
        XCTAssertNotNil(imageData)
    }
    
    // MARK: - Memory Tests
    
    /// 测试缩略图内存占用
    ///
    /// 确保缩略图比原图占用更少内存
    func testThumbnailMemoryUsage() throws {
        let imageData = try XCTUnwrap(generateRealImageData(size: CGSize(width: 2000, height: 2000)))
        let original = try XCTUnwrap(UIImage(data: imageData))
        
        // 原图内存估算 (RGBA, 4 bytes per pixel)
        let originalMemory = Int(original.size.width * original.size.height * 4)
        
        // 生成缩略图
        let targetSize = CGSize(width: 140, height: 140)
        let renderer = UIGraphicsImageRenderer(size: targetSize)
        let thumbnail = renderer.image { _ in
            original.draw(in: CGRect(origin: .zero, size: targetSize))
        }
        
        // 缩略图内存估算
        let thumbnailMemory = Int(thumbnail.size.width * thumbnail.size.height * 4)
        
        print("原图内存: \(originalMemory / 1024) KB")
        print("缩略图内存: \(thumbnailMemory / 1024) KB")
        print("内存节省: \(100 - thumbnailMemory * 100 / originalMemory)%")
        
        // 缩略图应该比原图小很多
        XCTAssertLessThan(thumbnailMemory, originalMemory / 100, "缩略图应该比原图小 100 倍以上")
    }
    
    // MARK: - Scroll Performance Tests
    
    /// 测试模拟列表滚动性能
    ///
    /// 确保滚动时图片加载不会造成卡顿
    /// 目标：单个 cell 渲染 < 16ms (60fps)
    func testScrollSimulationPerformance() throws {
        // 准备 50 条数据（模拟屏幕可见区域 + 预加载）
        var items: [(imageData: Data, title: String)] = []
        for i in 0..<50 {
            if let data = generateRealImageData(size: CGSize(width: 800, height: 600)) {
                items.append((imageData: data, title: "题目 \(i)"))
            }
        }
        
        print("准备了 \(items.count) 条数据用于滚动测试")
        
        measure {
            // 模拟滚动时的 cell 复用和渲染
            for item in items {
                // 模拟 ItemRow 的渲染操作
                _ = UIImage(data: item.imageData)
                _ = item.title.count
            }
        }
    }
    
    /// 测试快速滚动性能（连续滚动场景）
    ///
    /// 模拟用户快速滑动列表时的性能
    func testFastScrollPerformance() throws {
        // 创建 100 条测试数据
        let items = TestReviewItemFactory.createBatch(count: 100)
        
        let startTime = CFAbsoluteTimeGetCurrent()
        
        // 模拟快速滚动：每隔几项渲染一次（跳过中间项）
        for i in stride(from: 0, to: items.count, by: 5) {
            let item = items[i]
            if let data = item.imageData {
                // 只生成缩略图，不做完整解码
                _ = ImageCompressor.resize(UIImage(data: data) ?? UIImage(), maxDimension: 140)
            }
        }
        
        let elapsed = CFAbsoluteTimeGetCurrent() - startTime
        print("快速滚动 100 项（每 5 项渲染）耗时: \(elapsed * 1000) ms")
        
        // 快速滚动应该在 500ms 内完成
        XCTAssertLessThan(elapsed, 0.5, "快速滚动应该在 500ms 内完成")
    }
    
    /// 测试 ItemRow 渲染性能
    ///
    /// 确保单个 ItemRow 渲染时间 < 16ms (60fps 要求)
    func testItemRowRenderPerformance() throws {
        // 创建带真实图片的 ReviewItem
        let item = TestReviewItemFactory.createWithImage(
            imageSize: .medium,
            title: "测试题目：一元二次方程求解步骤",
            subject: .math,
            mastery: .partial
        )
        
        measure {
            // 模拟 ItemRow 渲染的核心操作
            
            // 1. 图片解码和缩放
            if let data = item.imageData, let image = UIImage(data: data) {
                _ = ImageCompressor.resize(image, maxDimension: 140)
            }
            
            // 2. 文字处理
            _ = item.title
            _ = item.subject.displayName
            _ = item.mastery.displayName
            _ = item.difficulty.displayName
            
            // 3. 日期格式化
            let formatter = DateFormatter()
            formatter.dateStyle = .short
            _ = formatter.string(from: item.createdAt)
        }
    }
}

//
//  FilteringPerformanceTests.swift
//  NotBadTests
//
//  筛选和排序性能测试
//

import XCTest
@testable import NotBad

/// 筛选性能测试
///
/// 测试大数据量下筛选和排序操作的性能
final class FilteringPerformanceTests: XCTestCase {
    
    // MARK: - Test Data Generation
    
    /// 生成测试用的 ReviewItem 数组
    private func generateItems(count: Int) -> [ReviewItem] {
        TestReviewItemFactory.createRealisticDataset(count: count)
    }
    
    // MARK: - Filtering Performance Tests
    
    /// 测试 100 条数据的筛选性能
    ///
    /// 预期：< 10ms
    func testFiltering100Items() {
        let items = generateItems(count: 100)
        
        measure {
            // 筛选数学题目
            _ = items.filter { $0.subject == .math }
        }
    }
    
    /// 测试 500 条数据的筛选性能
    ///
    /// 预期：< 50ms
    func testFiltering500Items() {
        let items = generateItems(count: 500)
        
        measure {
            // 筛选需要复习的数学题目
            _ = items.filter { $0.subject == .math && $0.needsReview }
        }
    }
    
    /// 测试 1000 条数据的筛选性能
    ///
    /// 预期：< 100ms
    func testFiltering1000Items() {
        let items = generateItems(count: 1000)
        
        measure {
            // 多条件筛选
            _ = items.filter {
                $0.subject == .math &&
                $0.mastery != .mastered &&
                $0.difficulty == .hard
            }
        }
    }
    
    // MARK: - Sorting Performance Tests
    
    /// 测试 500 条数据的排序性能
    ///
    /// 预期：< 30ms
    func testSorting500Items() {
        let items = generateItems(count: 500)
        
        measure {
            _ = items.sorted { $0.createdAt > $1.createdAt }
        }
    }
    
    /// 测试多字段排序性能
    ///
    /// 预期：< 50ms
    func testMultiFieldSorting500Items() {
        let items = generateItems(count: 500)
        
        measure {
            _ = items.sorted {
                if $0.subject.rawValue != $1.subject.rawValue {
                    return $0.subject.rawValue < $1.subject.rawValue
                }
                return $0.createdAt > $1.createdAt
            }
        }
    }
    
    // MARK: - Combined Operations
    
    /// 测试筛选 + 排序组合操作性能
    ///
    /// 预期：< 80ms
    func testFilterAndSort500Items() {
        let items = generateItems(count: 500)
        
        measure {
            let filtered = items.filter { $0.needsReview }
            _ = filtered.sorted { $0.nextReviewDate < $1.nextReviewDate }
        }
    }
    
    /// 测试搜索性能
    ///
    /// 预期：< 50ms
    func testSearchInItems() {
        let items = generateItems(count: 500)
        let searchText = "数学"
        
        measure {
            _ = items.filter {
                $0.title.localizedCaseInsensitiveContains(searchText) ||
                $0.note.localizedCaseInsensitiveContains(searchText)
            }
        }
    }
    
    // MARK: - Grouping Performance
    
    /// 测试按学科分组性能
    ///
    /// 预期：< 30ms
    func testGroupingBySubject() {
        let items = generateItems(count: 500)
        
        measure {
            _ = Dictionary(grouping: items, by: { $0.subject })
        }
    }
    
    /// 测试按掌握度分组性能
    func testGroupingByMastery() {
        let items = generateItems(count: 500)
        
        measure {
            _ = Dictionary(grouping: items, by: { $0.mastery })
        }
    }
    
    // MARK: - Memory Baseline
    
    /// 记录 1000 条数据的内存基线
    func testMemoryBaseline1000Items() {
        let beforeMemory = PerformanceTestHelpers.currentMemoryUsage()
        
        let items = generateItems(count: 1000)
        
        let afterMemory = PerformanceTestHelpers.currentMemoryUsage()
        let growth = afterMemory > beforeMemory ? afterMemory - beforeMemory : 0
        
        print("📊 1000 条数据内存占用:")
        print("  - 增长: \(growth / 1024) KB")
        print("  - 每条平均: \(growth / 1024 / 1000) KB")
        
        // 保持引用防止被优化掉
        XCTAssertEqual(items.count, 1000)
    }
}

        #expect(Dependencies.shared.modelContext != nil)

        let provider = DataProviderFactory.makeSwiftDataProvider(modelContext: context)

        let context = container.mainContext

        let context = container.mainContext
        
        let provider1 = DataProviderFactory.makeSwiftDataProvider(modelContext: context)

//
//  ImageCompressorTests.swift

//
//  Phase 6: 图片压缩器测试

import Testing
import Foundation
import UIKit
@testable import NotBad

// MARK: - ImageCompressor Tests

@Suite("ImageCompressor 测试")
struct ImageCompressorTests {
    
    // MARK: - 配置测试
    
    @Test("默认配置正确")
    func defaultConfiguration() {
        #expect(ImageCompressor.defaultQuality == 0.7)
        #expect(ImageCompressor.defaultMaxDimension == 2048)
    }
    
    // MARK: - 压缩测试
    
    @Test("compress 压缩图片返回数据")
    func compressReturnsData() {
        // 创建一个简单的测试图片
        let renderer = UIGraphicsImageRenderer(size: CGSize(width: 100, height: 100))
        let image = renderer.image { context in
            UIColor.red.setFill()
            context.fill(CGRect(x: 0, y: 0, width: 100, height: 100))
        }
        
        let data = ImageCompressor.compress(image)
        
        #expect(data != nil)
        #expect(data!.count > 0)
    }
    
    @Test("compress 使用自定义质量")
    func compressWithCustomQuality() {
        let renderer = UIGraphicsImageRenderer(size: CGSize(width: 100, height: 100))
        let image = renderer.image { context in
            UIColor.blue.setFill()
            context.fill(CGRect(x: 0, y: 0, width: 100, height: 100))
        }
        
        let highQuality = ImageCompressor.compress(image, quality: 1.0)
        let lowQuality = ImageCompressor.compress(image, quality: 0.1)
        
        #expect(highQuality != nil)
        #expect(lowQuality != nil)
        // 高质量压缩应该产生更大的数据
        #expect(highQuality!.count >= lowQuality!.count)
    }
    
    // MARK: - 调整大小测试
    
    @Test("resize 调整图片大小")
    func resizeAdjustsImageSize() {
        // 创建大图片
        let renderer = UIGraphicsImageRenderer(size: CGSize(width: 4000, height: 3000))
        let largeImage = renderer.image { context in
            UIColor.green.setFill()
            context.fill(CGRect(x: 0, y: 0, width: 4000, height: 3000))
        }
        
        let resized = ImageCompressor.resize(largeImage, maxDimension: 1000)
        
        // 最大尺寸应该是 1000
        #expect(resized.size.width <= 1000)
        #expect(resized.size.height <= 1000)
    }
    
    @Test("resize 保持宽高比")
    func resizePreservesAspectRatio() {
        let renderer = UIGraphicsImageRenderer(size: CGSize(width: 400, height: 200))
        let image = renderer.image { context in
            UIColor.yellow.setFill()
            context.fill(CGRect(x: 0, y: 0, width: 400, height: 200))
        }
        
        let resized = ImageCompressor.resize(image, maxDimension: 100)
        
        // 应该保持 2:1 的宽高比
        let ratio = resized.size.width / resized.size.height
        #expect(abs(ratio - 2.0) < 0.01)
    }
    
    @Test("resize 小图片不放大")
    func resizeDoesNotEnlargeSmallImages() {
        let renderer = UIGraphicsImageRenderer(size: CGSize(width: 50, height: 50))
        let smallImage = renderer.image { context in
            UIColor.orange.setFill()
            context.fill(CGRect(x: 0, y: 0, width: 50, height: 50))
        }
        
        let resized = ImageCompressor.resize(smallImage, maxDimension: 1000)
        
        // 小图片不应该被放大
        #expect(resized.size.width == 50)
        #expect(resized.size.height == 50)
    }
    
    // MARK: - 大小估算测试
    
    @Test("estimateSize 返回 KB 值")
    func estimateSizeReturnsKB() {
        let renderer = UIGraphicsImageRenderer(size: CGSize(width: 100, height: 100))
        let image = renderer.image { context in
            UIColor.purple.setFill()
            context.fill(CGRect(x: 0, y: 0, width: 100, height: 100))
        }
        
        let size = ImageCompressor.estimateSize(image)
        
        #expect(size >= 0)
    }
}

// MARK: - MockImageCompressor Tests

@Suite("MockImageCompressor 测试")
struct MockImageCompressorTests {
    
    @Test("默认配置与 ImageCompressor 一致")
    func defaultConfigurationMatchesReal() {
        #expect(MockImageCompressor.defaultQuality == ImageCompressor.defaultQuality)
        #expect(MockImageCompressor.defaultMaxDimension == ImageCompressor.defaultMaxDimension)
    }
    
    @Test("compress 返回 Mock 数据")
    func compressReturnsMockData() {
        MockImageCompressor.reset()
        let mockData = Data([0x01, 0x02, 0x03])
        MockImageCompressor.mockCompressedData = mockData
        
        let result = MockImageCompressor.compress(UIImage())
        
        #expect(result == mockData)
        #expect(MockImageCompressor.compressCallCount == 1)
    }
    
    @Test("compress 可以返回 nil")
    func compressCanReturnNil() {
        MockImageCompressor.reset()
        MockImageCompressor.shouldReturnNil = true
        
        let result = MockImageCompressor.compress(UIImage())
        
        #expect(result == nil)
    }
    
    @Test("resize 追踪调用")
    func resizeTracksCall() {
        MockImageCompressor.reset()
        let image = UIImage()
        
        _ = MockImageCompressor.resize(image, maxDimension: 500)
        
        #expect(MockImageCompressor.resizeCallCount == 1)
        #expect(MockImageCompressor.lastMaxDimension == 500)
    }
    
    @Test("estimateSize 返回 Mock 值")
    func estimateSizeReturnsMockValue() {
        MockImageCompressor.reset()
        MockImageCompressor.mockEstimatedSize = 256
        
        let size = MockImageCompressor.estimateSize(UIImage())
        
        #expect(size == 256)
        #expect(MockImageCompressor.estimateSizeCallCount == 1)
    }
    
    @Test("reset 清除所有状态")
    func resetClearsAllState() {
        // 首先重置以确保干净状态
        MockImageCompressor.reset()
        
        // 设置一些状态
        MockImageCompressor.mockCompressedData = Data([0xFF])
        MockImageCompressor.shouldReturnNil = true
        MockImageCompressor.mockEstimatedSize = 999
        _ = MockImageCompressor.compress(UIImage())
        _ = MockImageCompressor.resize(UIImage())
        _ = MockImageCompressor.estimateSize(UIImage())
        
        // 执行 reset
        MockImageCompressor.reset()
        
        // 验证状态被清除
        #expect(MockImageCompressor.compressCallCount == 0)
        #expect(MockImageCompressor.resizeCallCount == 0)
        #expect(MockImageCompressor.estimateSizeCallCount == 0)
        #expect(MockImageCompressor.shouldReturnNil == false)
        #expect(MockImageCompressor.mockEstimatedSize == 100)
    }
}

import Testing
import Foundation
import UIKit
@testable import NotBad

// MARK: - MockOCRService Tests

@Suite("MockOCRService 测试")
@MainActor
struct MockOCRServiceTests {
    
    // MARK: - 初始化测试
    
    @Test("初始状态正确")
    func initialState() {
        let service = MockOCRService()
        
        #expect(service.mockResult == "Mock recognized text")
        #expect(service.shouldThrowError == false)
        #expect(service.recognizeTextCallCount == 0)
        #expect(service.recognizeTextWithConfidenceCallCount == 0)
    }
    
    // MARK: - recognizeText 测试
    
    @Test("recognizeText 返回 Mock 结果")
    func recognizeTextReturnsMockResult() async throws {
        let service = MockOCRService()
        service.mockResult = "自定义识别结果"
        let image = UIImage()
        
        let result = try await service.recognizeText(from: image)
        
        #expect(result == "自定义识别结果")
        #expect(service.recognizeTextCallCount == 1)
        #expect(service.lastImage != nil)
    }
    
    @Test("recognizeText 可以触发错误")
    func recognizeTextCanThrowError() async {
        let service = MockOCRService()
        service.shouldThrowError = true
        service.errorToThrow = .recognitionFailed
        let image = UIImage()
        
        do {
            _ = try await service.recognizeText(from: image)
            Issue.record("应该抛出错误")
        } catch {
            #expect(error is OCRError)
        }
    }
    
    @Test("recognizeText 支持模拟延迟")
    func recognizeTextWithDelay() async throws {
        let service = MockOCRService()
        service.simulatedDelay = 0.1
        let image = UIImage()
        
        let start = Date()
        _ = try await service.recognizeText(from: image)
        let elapsed = Date().timeIntervalSince(start)
        
        #expect(elapsed >= 0.1)
    }
    
    // MARK: - recognizeTextWithConfidence 测试
    
    @Test("recognizeTextWithConfidence 返回 OCRResult")
    func recognizeTextWithConfidenceReturnsResult() async throws {
        let service = MockOCRService()
        let image = UIImage()
        
        let result = try await service.recognizeTextWithConfidence(from: image)
        
        #expect(result.confidence > 0)
        #expect(service.recognizeTextWithConfidenceCallCount == 1)
    }
    
    @Test("recognizeTextWithConfidence 可以自定义结果")
    func recognizeTextWithConfidenceCustomResult() async throws {
        let service = MockOCRService()
        let customResult = OCRResult(
            text: "自定义文本",
            lines: [OCRLine(text: "自定义文本", confidence: 0.99, boundingBox: .zero)],
            confidence: 0.99
        )
        service.mockResultWithConfidence = customResult
        let image = UIImage()
        
        let result = try await service.recognizeTextWithConfidence(from: image)
        
        #expect(result.text == "自定义文本")
        #expect(result.confidence == 0.99)
    }
    
    // MARK: - Reset 测试
    
    @Test("reset 重置所有状态")
    func resetClearsAllState() async throws {
        let service = MockOCRService()
        service.mockResult = "自定义"
        service.shouldThrowError = true
        service.simulatedDelay = 1.0
        
        let image = UIImage()
        service.shouldThrowError = false
        _ = try await service.recognizeText(from: image)
        
        service.reset()
        
        #expect(service.mockResult == "Mock recognized text")
        #expect(service.shouldThrowError == false)
        #expect(service.simulatedDelay == 0)
        #expect(service.recognizeTextCallCount == 0)
        #expect(service.lastImage == nil)
    }
}

// MARK: - OCRServiceProtocol Conformance Tests

    }

    }

import Testing
import Foundation

@testable import NotBad

@Suite("ReviewItem 实体测试")
struct ReviewItemTests {

    // MARK: - 初始化测试

    func defaultInitialization() {
        let item = ReviewItem()

        #expect(item.title == "未命名错题")
        #expect(item.note == "")
        #expect(item.subject == .math)
        #expect(item.grade == .grade10)
        #expect(item.mastery == .none)
        #expect(item.difficulty == .medium)
        #expect(item.reviewCount == 0)
        #expect(item.imageData == nil)
    }

    @Test("自定义初始化正确")
    func customInitialization() {
        let item = ReviewItem(
            title: "二次函数",
            note: "求极值问题",
            subject: .math,
            grade: .grade11,
            difficulty: .hard
        )

        #expect(item.title == "二次函数")
        #expect(item.note == "求极值问题")
        #expect(item.subject == .math)
        #expect(item.grade == .grade11)
        #expect(item.difficulty == .hard)
    }

    @Test("空标题转为默认标题")
    func emptyTitleConvertsToDefault() {
        let item = ReviewItem(title: "")
        #expect(item.title == "未命名错题")

        let item2 = ReviewItem(title: "   ")
        #expect(item2.title == "   ") // 只有完全空才转换
    }

    // MARK: - 值对象访问器测试

    @Test("学科访问器正确")
    func subjectAccessor() {
        let item = ReviewItem(subject: .physics)
        #expect(item.subject == .physics)

        item.subject = .chemistry
        #expect(item.subject == .chemistry)
        #expect(item.subjectRaw == "chemistry")
    }

    @Test("年级访问器正确")
    func gradeAccessor() {
        let item = ReviewItem(grade: .grade7)
        #expect(item.grade == .grade7)

        item.grade = .grade9
        #expect(item.grade == .grade9)
        #expect(item.gradeRaw == "grade_9")
    }

    @Test("掌握程度访问器正确")
    func masteryAccessor() {
        let item = ReviewItem(mastery: .partial)
        #expect(item.mastery == .partial)

        item.mastery = .good
        #expect(item.mastery == .good)
        #expect(item.masteryLevel == MasteryLevel.good.rawValue)
    }

    @Test("知识点访问器正确")
    func knowledgePointsAccessor() {
        let points = KnowledgePoints(from: "二次函数, 极值")
        let item = ReviewItem(knowledgePoints: points)

        #expect(item.knowledgePoints.count == 2)
        #expect(item.knowledgePoints.contains("二次函数"))
        #expect(item.knowledgePoints.contains("极值"))
    }

    // MARK: - 计算属性测试

    @Test("有图片正确判断")
    func hasImageProperty() {
        let item1 = ReviewItem()
        #expect(item1.hasImage == false)

        let item2 = ReviewItem(imageData: TestImageFactory.createJPEGData(size: .thumbnail))
        #expect(item2.hasImage == true)

        let item3 = ReviewItem(imageData: Data())
        #expect(item3.hasImage == false)
    }

    @Test("hasNote 正确判断")
    func hasNoteProperty() {

        #expect(item1.hasNote == false)

        let item2 = ReviewItem(note: "   ")
        #expect(item2.hasNote == false)

        let item3 = ReviewItem(note: "这是笔记")
        #expect(item3.hasNote == true)
    }

    @Test("hasKnowledgePoints 正确判断")
    func hasKnowledgePointsProperty() {

        #expect(item1.hasKnowledgePoints == false)

        let item2 = ReviewItem(knowledgePoints: KnowledgePoints(from: "函数"))
        #expect(item2.hasKnowledgePoints == true)
    }

    @Test("needsReview 正确判断")
    func needsReviewProperty() {

        // 新创建的项目 nextReviewDate == createdAt，应该需要复习
        #expect(item.needsReview == true)
    }

    @Test("isNew 正确判断")
    func isNewProperty() {
        let item = ReviewItem()
        #expect(item.isNew == true)

        item.reviewCount = 1
        #expect(item.isNew == false)
    }

    @Test("isMastered 正确判断")
    func isMasteredProperty() {
        let item = ReviewItem(mastery: .none)
        #expect(item.isMastered == false)

        item.mastery = .partial
        #expect(item.isMastered == false)

        item.mastery = .good
        #expect(item.isMastered == true)

        item.mastery = .mastered
        #expect(item.isMastered == true)
    }

    // MARK: - 显示属性测试

    @Test("displayTitle 正确处理")
    func displayTitleProperty() {
        let item1 = ReviewItem(title: "测试题目")
        #expect(item1.displayTitle == "测试题目")

        // 空白标题应返回默认值
        let item2 = ReviewItem()
        item2.title = "   "
        #expect(item2.displayTitle == "未命名错题")
    }

    @Test("shortDescription 格式正确")
    @MainActor
    func shortDescriptionProperty() {
        let item = ReviewItem(subject: .math, questionType: .calculation)
        let desc = item.shortDescription
        
        // 使用 EducationSystemManager 获取期望的显示名称
        let subjectName = EducationSystemManager.shared.subjectDisplayName(for: item.subjectRaw)
        
        #expect(desc.contains(subjectName))
        #expect(desc.contains(item.questionType.displayName))
    }

    @Test("fullDescription 格式正确")
    @MainActor
    func fullDescriptionProperty() {
        let item = ReviewItem(
            subject: .physics,
            grade: .grade11,
            difficulty: .hard,
            questionType: .calculation
        )
        let desc = item.fullDescription

        // 使用 EducationSystemManager 获取期望的显示名称，以避免测试环境本地化问题
        let subjectName = EducationSystemManager.shared.subjectDisplayName(for: item.subjectRaw)
        let gradeName = EducationSystemManager.shared.gradeDisplayName(for: item.gradeRaw)

        #expect(desc.contains(subjectName))
        #expect(desc.contains(gradeName))
        #expect(desc.contains(item.difficulty.displayName))
        #expect(desc.contains(item.questionType.displayName))
    }

    // MARK: - 复习操作测试

    @Test("recordReview 正确更新状态")
    func recordReviewAction() {
        let item = ReviewItem()
        let originalCount = item.reviewCount

        item.recordReview(newMastery: .partial)

        #expect(item.reviewCount == originalCount + 1)
        #expect(item.mastery == .partial)
        #expect(item.nextReviewDate > Date())
    }

    @Test("resetProgress 正确重置")
    func resetProgressAction() {
        let item = ReviewItem()
        item.recordReview(newMastery: .good)
        item.recordReview(newMastery: .mastered)

        item.resetProgress()

        #expect(item.reviewCount == 0)
        #expect(item.mastery == .none)
    }

    @Test("addKnowledgePoint 正确添加")
    func addKnowledgePointAction() {
        let item = ReviewItem()
        item.addKnowledgePoint("函数")
        item.addKnowledgePoint("极值")

        #expect(item.knowledgePoints.count == 2)
        #expect(item.knowledgePoints.contains("函数"))
        #expect(item.knowledgePoints.contains("极值"))
    }

    @Test("removeKnowledgePoint 正确移除")
    func removeKnowledgePointAction() {
        let item = ReviewItem(knowledgePoints: KnowledgePoints(from: "函数, 极值"))
        item.removeKnowledgePoint("函数")

        #expect(item.knowledgePoints.count == 1)
        #expect(!item.knowledgePoints.contains("函数"))
        #expect(item.knowledgePoints.contains("极值"))
    }

    @Test("updateNote 正确更新")
    func updateNoteAction() {
        let item = ReviewItem()
        let originalDate = item.updatedAt

        // 短暂等待以确保时间差异
        Thread.sleep(forTimeInterval: 0.01)
        item.updateNote("新笔记")

        #expect(item.note == "新笔记")
        #expect(item.updatedAt > originalDate)
    }

    @Test("updateTitle 正确更新")
    func updateTitleAction() {
        let item = ReviewItem()
        item.updateTitle("新标题")
        #expect(item.title == "新标题")

        item.updateTitle("")
        #expect(item.title == "未命名错题")
    }

    // MARK: - 验证测试

    @Test("validate 返回正确结果")
    func validateMethod() {
        let item = ReviewItem(
            imageData: TestImageFactory.createJPEGData(size: .thumbnail),
            title: "测试",
            knowledgePoints: KnowledgePoints(from: "知识点")
        )

        let (isValid, issues) = item.validate()
        #expect(isValid == true)
        #expect(issues.isEmpty)
    }

    @Test("validate 检测缺失内容")
    func validateDetectsMissingContent() {
        let item = ReviewItem(title: "   ")
        let (_, issues) = item.validate()

        #expect(issues.contains { $0.contains("标题") })
    }

    @Test("isComplete 正确判断")
    func isCompleteProperty() {
        let item1 = ReviewItem()
        #expect(item1.isComplete == false)

        // 有图片 + 知识点 = 完整
        let item2 = ReviewItem(
            imageData: TestImageFactory.createJPEGData(size: .thumbnail),
            title: "测试",
            knowledgePoints: KnowledgePoints(from: "知识点")
        )
        #expect(item2.isComplete == true)

        // 有笔记 + 知识点 = 也完整（无需图片）
        let item3 = ReviewItem(
            title: "测试",
            note: "这是笔记内容",
            knowledgePoints: KnowledgePoints(from: "知识点")
        )
        #expect(item3.isComplete == true)

        // 只有知识点，无图片无笔记 = 不完整
        let item4 = ReviewItem(
            title: "测试",
            knowledgePoints: KnowledgePoints(from: "知识点")
        )
        #expect(item4.isComplete == false)
    }

    // MARK: - Comparable 测试

    @Test("Comparable 按 nextReviewDate 排序")
    func comparableConformance() {
        let item1 = ReviewItem()
        item1.nextReviewDate = Date().addingTimeInterval(-3600) // 1小时前

        let item2 = ReviewItem()
        item2.nextReviewDate = Date().addingTimeInterval(3600) // 1小时后

        #expect(item1 < item2)
    }

    // MARK: - 综合难度测试

    @Test("overallDifficultyScore 计算正确")
    func overallDifficultyScoreCalculation() {
        let item = ReviewItem(difficulty: .hard, questionType: .calculation)

        // hard = 3, calculation 是主观题权重 1.5
        let expectedScore = 3.0 * 1.5
        #expect(item.overallDifficultyScore == expectedScore)
    }
}

        #expect(ErrorType.wrongDirection.category == .method)

        #expect(ErrorType.calculation.category == .habit)
        #expect(ErrorType.careless.category == .habit)
        #expect(ErrorType.misread.category == .habit)
        #expect(ErrorType.incomplete.category == .habit)
    }

    @Test("客观类错误归类正确")
    func objectiveTypesCategory() {
        #expect(ErrorType.timeLimit.category == .objective)
    }

    @Test("types(in:) 返回正确数量")
    func typesInCategory() {
        #expect(ErrorType.types(in: .knowledge).count == 2)
        #expect(ErrorType.types(in: .method).count == 2)
        #expect(ErrorType.types(in: .habit).count == 4)
        #expect(ErrorType.types(in: .objective).count == 1)
        #expect(ErrorType.types(in: .other).count == 1)
    }

    // MARK: - 改进建议测试

            #expect(!type.suggestion.isEmpty)
        }

        for category in ErrorCategory.allCases {
            #expect(!category.improvementDirection.isEmpty)
        }
    }

        // 可控错误
        #expect(ErrorType.concept.isControllable == true)
        #expect(ErrorType.calculation.isControllable == true)

        // 不可控错误
        #expect(ErrorType.timeLimit.isControllable == false)
        #expect(ErrorType.other.isControllable == false)

        #expect(!controllable.contains(.other))
        #expect(controllable.contains(.concept))

            #expect(type.severity <= 5)
        }
    }

    @Test("概念和方法错误严重程度最高")

        #expect(ErrorType.method.severity == 5)
    }

        for i in 1..<sorted.count {
            #expect(sorted[i-1].severity >= sorted[i].severity)
        }
    }

    // MARK: - Comparable 测试

    @Test("Comparable 按严重程度排序")
    func comparableBySeverity() {
        #expect(ErrorType.other < ErrorType.concept)
        #expect(ErrorType.careless < ErrorType.method)
    }

    // MARK: - 静态集合测试

    @Test("commonTypes 不包含其他")

    }

        #expect(ErrorType.knowledgeTypes.contains(.forgotten))
        #expect(ErrorType.knowledgeTypes.count == 2)
    }

    @Test("methodTypes 包含正确类型")
    func methodTypesCollection() {
        #expect(ErrorType.methodTypes.contains(.method))
        #expect(ErrorType.methodTypes.contains(.wrongDirection))
        #expect(ErrorType.methodTypes.count == 2)
    }

    @Test("habitTypes 包含正确类型")
    func habitTypesCollection() {
        #expect(ErrorType.habitTypes.count == 4)
        #expect(ErrorType.habitTypes.contains(.calculation))
        #expect(ErrorType.habitTypes.contains(.careless))
    }

    // MARK: - Codable 测试

    @Test("Codable 正确编解码")
    func codableRoundTrip() throws {
        let original = ErrorType.calculation

        let encoder = JSONEncoder()
        let decoder = JSONDecoder()

        let data = try encoder.encode(original)
        let decoded = try decoder.decode(ErrorType.self, from: data)

        #expect(decoded == original)
    }

    // MARK: - 描述测试

    @Test("description 等于 displayName")
    func descriptionEqualsDisplayName() {

            #expect(type.description == type.displayName)
        }
    }
