@testable import NotBad

@Suite("Grade 值对象测试")
struct GradeTests {

    // MARK: - 初始化测试

    @Test("所有年级都有有效的显示名称")
    func allGradesHaveDisplayNames() {
        for grade in Grade.allCases {
            #expect(!grade.displayName.isEmpty)
        }
    }

    @Test("年级数量正确（幼儿园+小学6年+初中3年+高中3年=13）")
    func gradeCount() {
        #expect(Grade.allCases.count == 13)
    }

    // MARK: - 显示属性测试

    @Test("shortLabel 格式正确")
    func shortLabelFormat() {
        #expect(Grade.grade1.shortLabel == "一年级")
        #expect(Grade.grade6.shortLabel == "六年级")
        #expect(Grade.grade7.shortLabel == "初一")
        #expect(Grade.grade9.shortLabel == "初三")
        #expect(Grade.grade10.shortLabel == "高一")
        #expect(Grade.grade12.shortLabel == "高三")
    }

    @Test("所有年级都有图标")
    func allGradesHaveIcons() {
        for grade in Grade.allCases {
            #expect(!grade.icon.isEmpty)
        }
    }

    @Test("所有年级都有颜色")
    func allGradesHaveColors() {
        for grade in Grade.allCases {
            _ = grade.color
        }
    }

    // MARK: - 学段测试

    @Test("小学学段包含正确的年级")
    func primarySchoolGrades() {
        let primary = GradeStage.primary.grades
        #expect(primary.count == 7)
        #expect(primary.contains(.kindergarten))
        #expect(primary.contains(.grade1))
        #expect(primary.contains(.grade6))
        #expect(!primary.contains(.grade7))
    }

    @Test("初中学段包含正确的年级")
    func middleSchoolGrades() {
        let middle = GradeStage.junior.grades
        #expect(middle.count == 3)
        #expect(middle.contains(.grade7))
        #expect(middle.contains(.grade9))
        #expect(!middle.contains(.grade6))
        #expect(!middle.contains(.grade10))
    }

    @Test("高中学段包含正确的年级")
    func highSchoolGrades() {
        let high = GradeStage.senior.grades
        #expect(high.count == 3)
        #expect(high.contains(.grade10))
        #expect(high.contains(.grade12))
        #expect(!high.contains(.grade9))
    }

    @Test("年级 stage 属性正确")
    func gradeStageProperty() {
        #expect(Grade.grade1.stage == .primary)
        #expect(Grade.grade6.stage == .primary)
        #expect(Grade.grade7.stage == .junior)
        #expect(Grade.grade9.stage == .junior)
        #expect(Grade.grade10.stage == .senior)
        #expect(Grade.grade12.stage == .senior)
    }

    // MARK: - 排序测试

    @Test("年级序号正确递增")
    func gradeOrderIncreasing() {
        #expect(Grade.grade1.order == 1)
        #expect(Grade.grade6.order == 6)
        #expect(Grade.grade7.order == 7)
        #expect(Grade.grade9.order == 9)
        #expect(Grade.grade10.order == 10)
        #expect(Grade.grade12.order == 12)

        // 验证递增
        for i in 1..<Grade.allCases.count {
            #expect(Grade.allCases[i].order > Grade.allCases[i-1].order)
        }
    }

    @Test("Comparable 按序号排序")
    func comparableConformance() {
        #expect(Grade.grade1 < Grade.grade2)
        #expect(Grade.grade6 < Grade.grade7)
        #expect(Grade.grade9 < Grade.grade10)
        #expect(Grade.grade12 > Grade.grade1)
    }

    // MARK: - 毕业年级测试

    @Test("isGraduationYear 正确判断")
    func graduationYearProperty() {
        #expect(Grade.grade6.isGraduationYear == true)
        #expect(Grade.grade9.isGraduationYear == true)
        #expect(Grade.grade12.isGraduationYear == true)

        #expect(Grade.grade1.isGraduationYear == false)
        #expect(Grade.grade7.isGraduationYear == false)
        #expect(Grade.grade10.isGraduationYear == false)
    }

    @Test("graduationGrades 静态集合正确")
    func graduationGradesCollection() {
        #expect(Grade.graduationGrades.count == 3)
        #expect(Grade.graduationGrades.contains(.grade6))
        #expect(Grade.graduationGrades.contains(.grade9))
        #expect(Grade.graduationGrades.contains(.grade12))
    }

    // MARK: - 工厂方法测试

    @Test("from(order:) 返回正确年级")
    func fromOrderFactory() {
        #expect(Grade.from(order: 0) == .kindergarten)
        #expect(Grade.from(order: 1) == .grade1)
        #expect(Grade.from(order: 6) == .grade6)
        #expect(Grade.from(order: 7) == .grade7)
        #expect(Grade.from(order: 9) == .grade9)
        #expect(Grade.from(order: 10) == .grade10)
        #expect(Grade.from(order: 12) == .grade12)

        #expect(Grade.from(order: -1) == nil)
        #expect(Grade.from(order: 13) == nil)
    }

    @Test("grades(for:) 返回正确年级")
    func gradesForStage() {
        let primary = Grade.grades(for: .primary)
        #expect(primary.count == 7)

        let junior = Grade.grades(for: .junior)
        #expect(junior.count == 3)

        let senior = Grade.grades(for: .senior)
        #expect(senior.count == 3)
    }

    // MARK: - 静态集合测试

    @Test("primaryGrades 包含正确年级")
    func primaryGradesCollection() {
        #expect(Grade.primaryGrades.count == 7)
        for grade in Grade.primaryGrades {
            #expect(grade.stage == .primary)
        }
    }

    @Test("juniorGrades 包含正确年级")
    func juniorGradesCollection() {
        #expect(Grade.juniorGrades.count == 3)
        for grade in Grade.juniorGrades {
            #expect(grade.stage == .junior)
        }
    }

    @Test("seniorGrades 包含正确年级")
    func seniorGradesCollection() {
        #expect(Grade.seniorGrades.count == 3)
        for grade in Grade.seniorGrades {
            #expect(grade.stage == .senior)
        }
    }

    // MARK: - GradeStage 测试

    @Test("GradeStage 有3个学段")
    func gradeStageCount() {
        #expect(GradeStage.allCases.count == 3)
    }

    @Test("GradeStage 显示属性正确")
    func gradeStageDisplayProperties() {
        #expect(GradeStage.primary.displayName == "小学")
        #expect(GradeStage.junior.displayName == "初中")
        #expect(GradeStage.senior.displayName == "高中")

        #expect(GradeStage.primary.shortLabel == "小")
        #expect(GradeStage.junior.shortLabel == "初")
        #expect(GradeStage.senior.shortLabel == "高")
    }

    @Test("GradeStage 年级范围正确")
    func gradeStageRanges() {
        #expect(GradeStage.primary.gradeRange == "1-6年级")
        #expect(GradeStage.junior.gradeRange == "7-9年级")
        #expect(GradeStage.senior.gradeRange == "10-12年级")

        #expect(GradeStage.primary.gradeCount == 7)
        #expect(GradeStage.junior.gradeCount == 3)
        #expect(GradeStage.senior.gradeCount == 3)
    }

    @Test("GradeStage from(gradeOrder:) 正确")
    func gradeStageFromOrder() {
        #expect(GradeStage.from(gradeOrder: 0) == .primary)
        #expect(GradeStage.from(gradeOrder: 1) == .primary)
        #expect(GradeStage.from(gradeOrder: 6) == .primary)
        #expect(GradeStage.from(gradeOrder: 7) == .junior)
        #expect(GradeStage.from(gradeOrder: 9) == .junior)
        #expect(GradeStage.from(gradeOrder: 10) == .senior)
        #expect(GradeStage.from(gradeOrder: 12) == .senior)

        #expect(GradeStage.from(gradeOrder: 13) == nil)
    }

    @Test("GradeStage contains(gradeOrder:) 正确")
    func gradeStageContainsOrder() {
        #expect(GradeStage.primary.contains(gradeOrder: 1) == true)
        #expect(GradeStage.primary.contains(gradeOrder: 6) == true)
        #expect(GradeStage.primary.contains(gradeOrder: 7) == false)

        #expect(GradeStage.junior.contains(gradeOrder: 7) == true)
        #expect(GradeStage.junior.contains(gradeOrder: 10) == false)
    }

    @Test("GradeStage Comparable 正确")
    func gradeStageComparable() {
        #expect(GradeStage.primary < GradeStage.junior)
        #expect(GradeStage.junior < GradeStage.senior)
    }

    // MARK: - 编码测试

    @Test("年级可正确序列化和反序列化")
    func gradeCodable() throws {
        let grade = Grade.grade10
        let encoder = JSONEncoder()
        let decoder = JSONDecoder()

        let data = try encoder.encode(grade)
        let decoded = try decoder.decode(Grade.self, from: data)

        #expect(decoded == grade)
    }

    @Test("GradeStage Codable 正确")
    func gradeStageCodable() throws {
        let stage = GradeStage.junior
        let encoder = JSONEncoder()
        let decoder = JSONDecoder()

        let data = try encoder.encode(stage)
        let decoded = try decoder.decode(GradeStage.self, from: data)

        #expect(decoded == stage)
    }
}

//
//  SubjectTests.swift
//  NotBadTests
//
//  学科值对象单元测试
//

import Testing
import SwiftUI
import Foundation
@testable import NotBad

@Suite("Subject 值对象测试")
struct SubjectTests {

    // MARK: - 初始化测试

    @Test("所有学科都有有效的显示名称")
    func allSubjectsHaveDisplayNames() {
        for subject in Subject.allCases {
            #expect(!subject.displayName.isEmpty)
        }
    }

    @Test("所有学科都有有效的图标")
    func allSubjectsHaveIcons() {
        for subject in Subject.allCases {
            #expect(!subject.icon.isEmpty)
        }
    }

    @Test("学科数量正确")
    func subjectCount() {
        // 语文、英语、数学、物理、化学、生物、科学、历史、地理、政治、道法、信息、通技、其他 = 14
        #expect(Subject.allCases.count == 14)
    }

    // MARK: - 显示属性测试

    @Test("shortLabel 为单字")
    func shortLabelIsSingleChar() {
        for subject in Subject.allCases {
            #expect(subject.shortLabel.count == 1)
        }

        #expect(Subject.math.shortLabel == "数")
        #expect(Subject.physics.shortLabel == "物")
        #expect(Subject.chinese.shortLabel == "语")
    }

    // MARK: - 分类测试

    @Test("SubjectCategory 有5种分类")
    func categoryCount() {
        #expect(SubjectCategory.allCases.count == 5)
    }

    @Test("SubjectCategory 显示属性正确")
    func categoryDisplayProperties() {
        for category in SubjectCategory.allCases {
            #expect(!category.displayName.isEmpty)
            #expect(!category.icon.isEmpty)
            _ = category.color
        }
    }

    @Test("学科分类正确")
    func subjectCategoryMapping() {
        // 语言类
        #expect(Subject.chinese.category == .language)
        #expect(Subject.english.category == .language)

        // 理科类
        #expect(Subject.math.category == .science)
        #expect(Subject.physics.category == .science)
        #expect(Subject.chemistry.category == .science)
        #expect(Subject.biology.category == .science)
        #expect(Subject.science.category == .science)

        // 人文类
        #expect(Subject.history.category == .humanities)
        #expect(Subject.geography.category == .humanities)
        #expect(Subject.politics.category == .humanities)
        #expect(Subject.ethics.category == .humanities)

        // 技术类
        #expect(Subject.informationTech.category == .technology)
        #expect(Subject.generalTech.category == .technology)

        // 其他
        #expect(Subject.other.category == .other)
    }

    @Test("subjects(in:) 返回正确学科")
    func subjectsInCategory() {
        let language = Subject.subjects(in: .language)
        #expect(language.count == 2)
        #expect(language.contains(.chinese))
        #expect(language.contains(.english))

        let science = Subject.subjects(in: .science)
        #expect(science.count == 5)

        let humanities = Subject.subjects(in: .humanities)
        #expect(humanities.count == 4)
    }

    // MARK: - 学段适用性测试

    @Test("主科适用所有学段")
    func coreSubjectsApplicableAllStages() {
        for subject in Subject.coreSubjects {
            #expect(subject.isApplicable(for: .primary))
            #expect(subject.isApplicable(for: .junior))
            #expect(subject.isApplicable(for: .senior))
        }
    }

    @Test("物理化学适用初中高中")
    func physicsChemistryApplicableJuniorSenior() {
        #expect(Subject.physics.isApplicable(for: .primary) == false)
        #expect(Subject.physics.isApplicable(for: .junior) == true)
        #expect(Subject.physics.isApplicable(for: .senior) == true)

        #expect(Subject.chemistry.isApplicable(for: .primary) == false)
        #expect(Subject.chemistry.isApplicable(for: .junior) == true)
        #expect(Subject.chemistry.isApplicable(for: .senior) == true)
    }

    @Test("生物适用初中高中")
    func biologyJuniorSenior() {
        #expect(Subject.biology.isApplicable(for: .primary) == false)
        #expect(Subject.biology.isApplicable(for: .junior) == true)
        #expect(Subject.biology.isApplicable(for: .senior) == true)
    }

    @Test("科学适用小学初中")
    func scienceApplicablePrimaryJunior() {
        #expect(Subject.science.isApplicable(for: .primary) == true)
        #expect(Subject.science.isApplicable(for: .junior) == true)
        #expect(Subject.science.isApplicable(for: .senior) == false)
    }

    @Test("subjects(for:) 返回正确学科")
    func subjectsForStage() {
        let primary = Subject.subjects(for: .primary)
        #expect(primary.contains(.chinese))
        #expect(primary.contains(.math))
        #expect(primary.contains(.science))
        #expect(!primary.contains(.physics))
        #expect(!primary.contains(.biology))

        let senior = Subject.subjects(for: .senior)
        #expect(senior.contains(.biology))
        #expect(senior.contains(.physics))
        #expect(!senior.contains(.science))
    }

    // MARK: - 静态集合测试

    @Test("主科分类正确")
    func coreSubjects() {
        let core = Subject.coreSubjects
        #expect(core.count == 3)
        #expect(core.contains(.chinese))
        #expect(core.contains(.math))
        #expect(core.contains(.english))
    }

    @Test("初中考试学科分类正确")
    func juniorExamSubjects() {
        let junior = Subject.juniorExamSubjects
        #expect(junior.count == 9)
        #expect(junior.contains(.physics))
        #expect(junior.contains(.chemistry))
        #expect(junior.contains(.biology))
    }

    @Test("高中考试学科分类正确")
    func seniorExamSubjects() {
        let senior = Subject.seniorExamSubjects
        #expect(senior.count == 9)
        #expect(senior.contains(.physics))
        #expect(senior.contains(.chemistry))
        #expect(senior.contains(.biology))
    }

    @Test("理科组合正确")
    func scienceCombo() {
        let combo = Subject.scienceCombo
        #expect(combo.count == 3)
        #expect(combo.contains(.physics))
        #expect(combo.contains(.chemistry))
        #expect(combo.contains(.biology))
    }

    @Test("文科组合正确")
    func artsCombo() {
        let combo = Subject.artsCombo
        #expect(combo.count == 3)
        #expect(combo.contains(.history))
        #expect(combo.contains(.geography))
        #expect(combo.contains(.politics))
    }

    // MARK: - 颜色测试

    @Test("每个学科都有独特的颜色")
    func subjectColors() {
        var colors: [Color] = []
        for subject in Subject.allCases {
            let color = subject.color
            colors.append(color)
        }
        #expect(colors.count == Subject.allCases.count)
    }

    // MARK: - 编码测试

    @Test("学科可正确序列化和反序列化")
    func subjectCodable() throws {
        let subject = Subject.math
        let encoder = JSONEncoder()
        let decoder = JSONDecoder()

        let data = try encoder.encode(subject)
        let decoded = try decoder.decode(Subject.self, from: data)

        #expect(decoded == subject)
    }

    @Test("rawValue 正确（英文ID）")
    func subjectRawValue() {
        #expect(Subject.math.rawValue == "math")
        #expect(Subject.chinese.rawValue == "chinese")
        #expect(Subject(rawValue: "physics") == .physics)
    }

    // MARK: - 描述测试

    @Test("description 等于 displayName")
    func descriptionEqualsDisplayName() {
        for subject in Subject.allCases {
            #expect(subject.description == subject.displayName)
        }
    }
}

//

import Testing
import Foundation
@testable import NotBad

@Suite("ReviewItemType 值对象测试")
struct ReviewItemTypeTests {

    // MARK: - 基础测试

    @Test("ReviewItemType 有15种题型")
    func typeCount() {
        #expect(ReviewItemType.allCases.count == 15)
    }

    @Test("所有题型都有显示名称")
    func allTypesHaveDisplayNames() {
        for type in ReviewItemType.allCases {
            #expect(!type.displayName.isEmpty)
        }
    }

    @Test("所有题型都有简短标签")
    func allTypesHaveShortLabels() {
        for type in ReviewItemType.allCases {
            #expect(!type.shortLabel.isEmpty)
            #expect(type.shortLabel.count == 1) // 单字标签
        }
    }

    @Test("所有题型都有图标")
    func allTypesHaveIcons() {
        for type in ReviewItemType.allCases {
            #expect(!type.icon.isEmpty)
        }
    }

    // MARK: - 分类测试

    @Test("ReviewItemCategory 有4种分类")
    func categoryCount() {
        #expect(ReviewItemCategory.allCases.count == 4)
    }

    @Test("客观题归类正确")
    func objectiveTypesCategory() {
        #expect(ReviewItemType.choice.category == .objective)
        #expect(ReviewItemType.multiChoice.category == .objective)
        #expect(ReviewItemType.judgment.category == .objective)
        #expect(ReviewItemType.fillBlank.category == .objective)
        #expect(ReviewItemType.matching.category == .objective)
    }

    @Test("主观题归类正确")
    func subjectiveTypesCategory() {
        #expect(ReviewItemType.shortAnswer.category == .subjective)
        #expect(ReviewItemType.calculation.category == .subjective)
        #expect(ReviewItemType.proof.category == .subjective)
        #expect(ReviewItemType.drawing.category == .subjective)
        #expect(ReviewItemType.experiment.category == .subjective)
        #expect(ReviewItemType.analysis.category == .subjective)
    }

    @Test("综合题归类正确")
    func comprehensiveTypesCategory() {
        #expect(ReviewItemType.reading.category == .comprehensive)
        #expect(ReviewItemType.writing.category == .comprehensive)
        #expect(ReviewItemType.cloze.category == .comprehensive)
    }

    @Test("types(in:) 返回正确数量")
    func typesInCategory() {
        #expect(ReviewItemType.types(in: .objective).count == 5)
        #expect(ReviewItemType.types(in: .subjective).count == 6)
        #expect(ReviewItemType.types(in: .comprehensive).count == 3)
        #expect(ReviewItemType.types(in: .other).count == 1)
    }

    // MARK: - 分类便捷属性测试

    @Test("isObjective 正确判断")
    func isObjectiveProperty() {
        #expect(ReviewItemType.choice.isObjective == true)
        #expect(ReviewItemType.calculation.isObjective == false)
    }

    @Test("isSubjective 正确判断")
    func isSubjectiveProperty() {
        #expect(ReviewItemType.calculation.isSubjective == true)
        #expect(ReviewItemType.choice.isSubjective == false)
    }

    @Test("isComprehensive 正确判断")
    func isComprehensiveProperty() {
        #expect(ReviewItemType.writing.isComprehensive == true)
        #expect(ReviewItemType.choice.isComprehensive == false)
    }

    // MARK: - 时间和难度测试

    @Test("estimatedMinutes 为正数")
    func estimatedMinutesPositive() {
        for type in ReviewItemType.allCases {
            #expect(type.estimatedMinutes > 0)
        }
    }

    @Test("选择题时间最短")
    func choiceShortestTime() {
        #expect(ReviewItemType.choice.estimatedMinutes == 1)
        #expect(ReviewItemType.judgment.estimatedMinutes == 1)
    }

    @Test("作文时间最长")
    func writingLongestTime() {
        #expect(ReviewItemType.writing.estimatedMinutes == 45)
    }

    @Test("difficultyWeight 根据分类设置")
    func difficultyWeightByCategory() {
        #expect(ReviewItemType.choice.difficultyWeight == 1.0)
        #expect(ReviewItemType.calculation.difficultyWeight == 1.5)
        #expect(ReviewItemType.writing.difficultyWeight == 2.0)
    }

    @Test("estimatedTimeDescription 返回非空字符串")
    func estimatedTimeDescriptionNotEmpty() {
        for type in ReviewItemType.allCases {
            #expect(!type.estimatedTimeDescription.isEmpty)
        }
    }

    // MARK: - 学科适用性测试

    @Test("applicableSubjects 返回非空数组")
    func applicableSubjectsNotEmpty() {
        for type in ReviewItemType.allCases {
            #expect(!type.applicableSubjects.isEmpty)
        }
    }

    @Test("完形填空仅适用于英语")
    func clozeOnlyForEnglish() {
        #expect(ReviewItemType.cloze.applicableSubjects.count == 1)
        #expect(ReviewItemType.cloze.applicableSubjects.first == .english)
    }

    @Test("计算题适用于数学物理化学")
    func calculationForMathPhysicsChemistry() {
        let subjects = ReviewItemType.calculation.applicableSubjects

        #expect(subjects.contains(.math))
        #expect(subjects.contains(.physics))
        #expect(subjects.contains(.chemistry))
    }

    @Test("isApplicable(to:) 正确判断")
    func isApplicableToSubject() {
        #expect(ReviewItemType.cloze.isApplicable(to: .english) == true)
        #expect(ReviewItemType.cloze.isApplicable(to: .math) == false)

        #expect(ReviewItemType.calculation.isApplicable(to: .math) == true)
        #expect(ReviewItemType.calculation.isApplicable(to: .chinese) == false)
    }

    @Test("types(for:) 返回适用题型")
    func typesForSubject() {
        let mathTypes = ReviewItemType.types(for: .math)

        #expect(mathTypes.contains(.calculation))
        #expect(mathTypes.contains(.proof))
        #expect(!mathTypes.contains(.cloze))
    }

    // MARK: - 静态集合测试

    @Test("objectiveTypes 包含正确题型")
    func objectiveTypesCollection() {
        #expect(ReviewItemType.objectiveTypes.count == 5)
        #expect(ReviewItemType.objectiveTypes.contains(.choice))
        #expect(ReviewItemType.objectiveTypes.contains(.multiChoice))
    }

    @Test("subjectiveTypes 包含正确题型")
    func subjectiveTypesCollection() {
        #expect(ReviewItemType.subjectiveTypes.count == 6)
        #expect(ReviewItemType.subjectiveTypes.contains(.calculation))
        #expect(ReviewItemType.subjectiveTypes.contains(.proof))
    }

    @Test("comprehensiveTypes 包含正确题型")
    func comprehensiveTypesCollection() {
        #expect(ReviewItemType.comprehensiveTypes.count == 3)
        #expect(ReviewItemType.comprehensiveTypes.contains(.reading))
        #expect(ReviewItemType.comprehensiveTypes.contains(.writing))
    }

    @Test("sortedByTime 正确排序")
    func sortedByTimeOrder() {
        let sorted = ReviewItemType.sortedByTime

        for i in 1..<sorted.count {
            #expect(sorted[i-1].estimatedMinutes <= sorted[i].estimatedMinutes)
        }
    }

    @Test("sortedByDifficulty 正确排序")
    func sortedByDifficultyOrder() {
        let sorted = ReviewItemType.sortedByDifficulty

        for i in 1..<sorted.count {
            #expect(sorted[i-1].difficultyWeight <= sorted[i].difficultyWeight)
        }
    }

import Testing
import Foundation
import SwiftUI
@testable import NotBad

@Suite("Difficulty 值对象测试")
struct DifficultyTests {

    // MARK: - 初始化测试

    @Test("难度有5个等级")
    func difficultyCount() {
        #expect(Difficulty.allCases.count == 5)
    }

    @Test("所有难度都有显示名称")
    func allDifficultiesHaveDisplayNames() {
        for difficulty in Difficulty.allCases {
            #expect(!difficulty.displayName.isEmpty)
        }
    }

    // MARK: - 数值测试

    @Test("难度值从0到4")
    func difficultyValues() {
        #expect(Difficulty.basic.rawValue == 0)
        #expect(Difficulty.easy.rawValue == 1)
        #expect(Difficulty.medium.rawValue == 2)
        #expect(Difficulty.hard.rawValue == 3)
        #expect(Difficulty.extreme.rawValue == 4)
    }

    @Test("星级显示正确（1-5）")
    func starDisplay() {
        #expect(Difficulty.basic.stars == 1)
        #expect(Difficulty.easy.stars == 2)
        #expect(Difficulty.medium.stars == 3)
        #expect(Difficulty.hard.stars == 4)
        #expect(Difficulty.extreme.stars == 5)
    }

    // MARK: - 显示属性测试

    @Test("shortLabel 为单字")
    func shortLabelIsSingleChar() {
        for difficulty in Difficulty.allCases {
            #expect(difficulty.shortLabel.count == 1)
        }

        #expect(Difficulty.basic.shortLabel == "送")
        #expect(Difficulty.extreme.shortLabel == "压")
    }

    @Test("detailText 描述详细")
    func detailTextNotEmpty() {
        for difficulty in Difficulty.allCases {
            #expect(!difficulty.detailText.isEmpty)
            #expect(difficulty.detailText.count > 5) // 应该是完整句子
        }
    }

    @Test("所有难度都有图标")
    func allDifficultiesHaveIcons() {
        for difficulty in Difficulty.allCases {
            #expect(!difficulty.icon.isEmpty)
        }

        #expect(Difficulty.extreme.icon == "flame.fill")
    }

    @Test("所有难度都有颜色")
    func allDifficultiesHaveColors() {
        // 验证颜色存在且不会崩溃
        for difficulty in Difficulty.allCases {
            _ = difficulty.color
        }

        // 验证颜色渐进：绿 → 红
        #expect(Difficulty.basic.color == .mint)
        #expect(Difficulty.extreme.color == .red)
    }

    // MARK: - 系数和指标测试

    @Test("coefficient 在0-1范围内")
    func coefficientRange() {
        for difficulty in Difficulty.allCases {
            #expect(difficulty.coefficient >= 0.0)
            #expect(difficulty.coefficient <= 1.0)
        }

        #expect(Difficulty.basic.coefficient == 0.0)
        #expect(Difficulty.extreme.coefficient == 1.0)
    }

    @Test("timeMultiplier 合理范围")
    func timeMultiplierValues() {
        #expect(Difficulty.basic.timeMultiplier == 0.5)
        #expect(Difficulty.easy.timeMultiplier == 1.0)
        #expect(Difficulty.medium.timeMultiplier == 1.5)
        #expect(Difficulty.hard.timeMultiplier == 2.0)
        #expect(Difficulty.extreme.timeMultiplier == 3.0)

        // 验证递增
        var previousMultiplier = 0.0
        for difficulty in Difficulty.allCases {
            #expect(difficulty.timeMultiplier > previousMultiplier)
            previousMultiplier = difficulty.timeMultiplier
        }
    }

    // MARK: - 工厂方法测试

    @Test("Difficulty from(stars:) 创建正确")
    func difficultyFromStarsFactory() {
        #expect(Difficulty.from(stars: 1) == .basic)
        #expect(Difficulty.from(stars: 3) == .medium)
        #expect(Difficulty.from(stars: 5) == .extreme)

        #expect(Difficulty.from(stars: 0) == nil)
        #expect(Difficulty.from(stars: 6) == nil)
    }

    @Test("Difficulty from(coefficient:) 创建正确")
    func difficultyFromCoefficientFactory() {
        #expect(Difficulty.from(coefficient: 0.0) == .basic)
        #expect(Difficulty.from(coefficient: 0.5) == .medium)
        #expect(Difficulty.from(coefficient: 1.0) == .extreme)

        // 边界处理
        #expect(Difficulty.from(coefficient: -0.5) == .basic)
        #expect(Difficulty.from(coefficient: 1.5) == .extreme)
    }

    // MARK: - 比较测试

    @Test("Comparable 正确实现")
    func comparableConformance() {
        #expect(Difficulty.basic < Difficulty.easy)
        #expect(Difficulty.easy < Difficulty.medium)
        #expect(Difficulty.medium < Difficulty.hard)
        #expect(Difficulty.hard < Difficulty.extreme)

        #expect(Difficulty.extreme > Difficulty.basic)
    }

    // MARK: - Identifiable 测试

    @Test("id 等于 rawValue")
    func identifiableId() {
        for difficulty in Difficulty.allCases {
            #expect(difficulty.id == difficulty.rawValue)
        }
    }

    // MARK: - 编码测试

    @Test("Codable 正确编解码")
    func codableRoundTrip() throws {
        let original = Difficulty.hard
        let encoder = JSONEncoder()
        let decoder = JSONDecoder()

        let data = try encoder.encode(original)
        let decoded = try decoder.decode(Difficulty.self, from: data)

        #expect(decoded == original)
    }

    // MARK: - 描述测试

    @Test("description 等于 displayName")
    func descriptionEqualsDisplayName() {
        for difficulty in Difficulty.allCases {
            #expect(difficulty.description == difficulty.displayName)
        }
    }
}

//

import Testing
import Foundation
@testable import NotBad

@Suite("ReviewInterval 值对象测试")
struct ReviewIntervalTests {

    // MARK: - 标准间隔序列测试

    @Test("标准间隔序列包含10个值")
    func standardIntervalsCount() {
        #expect(ReviewInterval.standardIntervals.count == 10)
    }

    @Test("标准间隔序列递增")
    func standardIntervalsAreIncreasing() {
        let intervals = ReviewInterval.standardIntervals
        for i in 1..<intervals.count {
            #expect(intervals[i] > intervals[i-1])
        }
    }

    @Test("标准间隔序列从1天开始")
    func standardIntervalsStartWithOne() {
        #expect(ReviewInterval.standardIntervals.first == 1)
    }

    @Test("标准间隔序列以365天结束")
    func standardIntervalsEndWith365() {
        #expect(ReviewInterval.standardIntervals.last == 365)
    }

    // MARK: - 工厂方法测试

    @Test("firstReview 创建正确")
    func firstReviewFactory() {
        let interval = ReviewInterval.firstReview(mastery: .none)

        #expect(interval.reviewCount == 0)
        #expect(interval.mastery == .none)
    }

    @Test("calculate 创建正确")
    func calculateFactory() {
        let interval = ReviewInterval.calculate(reviewCount: 3, mastery: .partial)

        #expect(interval.reviewCount == 3)
        #expect(interval.mastery == .partial)
    }

    @Test("next 递增复习次数")
    func nextFactoryIncrementsCount() {
        let first = ReviewInterval.firstReview(mastery: .none)
        let second = ReviewInterval.next(from: first, newMastery: .partial)

        #expect(second.reviewCount == first.reviewCount + 1)
        #expect(second.mastery == .partial)
    }

    // MARK: - 间隔计算测试

    @Test("intervalDays 根据掌握程度调整")
    func intervalDaysAdjustedByMastery() {
        // 相同复习次数，不同掌握程度
        let none = ReviewInterval.calculate(reviewCount: 1, mastery: .none)
        let partial = ReviewInterval.calculate(reviewCount: 1, mastery: .partial)
        let mastered = ReviewInterval.calculate(reviewCount: 1, mastery: .mastered)

        // 掌握程度越高，间隔越长
        #expect(none.intervalDays < partial.intervalDays)
        #expect(partial.intervalDays < mastered.intervalDays)
    }

    @Test("intervalDays 最小为1天")
    func intervalDaysMinimumIsOne() {
        let interval = ReviewInterval.calculate(reviewCount: 0, mastery: .none)
        #expect(interval.intervalDays >= 1)
    }

    @Test("nextReviewDate 在未来")
    func nextReviewDateIsInFuture() {
        let interval = ReviewInterval.firstReview(mastery: .partial)
        #expect(interval.nextReviewDate > interval.baseDate)
    }

    // MARK: - 时间状态测试

    @Test("daysUntilReview 计算正确")
    func daysUntilReviewCalculation() {
        // 创建一个基于过去日期的间隔
        let pastDate = Calendar.current.date(byAdding: .day, value: -10, to: Date())!
        let interval = ReviewInterval.calculate(
            reviewCount: 0,
            mastery: .partial,
            from: pastDate
        )

        // 1天间隔 × 1.0（partial）= 1天，10天前创建，所以应该已逾期
        #expect(interval.daysUntilReview < 0)
    }

    @Test("isOverdue 正确判断")
    func isOverdueProperty() {
        // 过去创建的间隔应该逾期
        let pastDate = Calendar.current.date(byAdding: .day, value: -30, to: Date())!
        let overdueInterval = ReviewInterval.calculate(
            reviewCount: 0,
            mastery: .none,
            from: pastDate
        )

        #expect(overdueInterval.isOverdue == true)
    }

    @Test("overdueByDays 返回正值或零")
    func overdueByDaysProperty() {
        let interval = ReviewInterval.firstReview(mastery: .mastered)
        #expect(interval.overdueByDays >= 0)
    }

    @Test("isDueToday 包含逾期情况")
    func isDueTodayProperty() {
        // 逾期的间隔也应该返回 true
        let pastDate = Calendar.current.date(byAdding: .day, value: -30, to: Date())!
        let overdueInterval = ReviewInterval.calculate(
            reviewCount: 0,
            mastery: .none,
            from: pastDate
        )

        #expect(overdueInterval.isDueToday == true)
    }

    @Test("isDueThisWeek 正确判断")
    func isDueThisWeekProperty() {
        // 新创建的短间隔应该在本周内
        let interval = ReviewInterval.firstReview(mastery: .none)
        #expect(interval.isDueThisWeek == true)
    }

    // MARK: - 记忆保持率测试

    @Test("estimatedRetention 在0-1范围内")
    func estimatedRetentionRange() {
        let interval = ReviewInterval.firstReview(mastery: .partial)

        #expect(interval.estimatedRetention >= 0.0)
        #expect(interval.estimatedRetention <= 1.0)
    }

    @Test("retentionPercentage 在0-100范围内")
    func retentionPercentageRange() {
        let interval = ReviewInterval.firstReview(mastery: .partial)

        #expect(interval.retentionPercentage >= 0)
        #expect(interval.retentionPercentage <= 100)
    }

    @Test("retentionDescription 返回非空字符串")
    func retentionDescriptionNotEmpty() {
        for mastery in MasteryLevel.allCases {
            let interval = ReviewInterval.calculate(reviewCount: 0, mastery: mastery)
            #expect(!interval.retentionDescription.isEmpty)
        }
    }

    // MARK: - 紧迫程度测试

    @Test("urgencyLevel 在1-5范围内")
    func urgencyLevelRange() {
        // 测试不同情况
        let intervals = [
            ReviewInterval.firstReview(mastery: .mastered),
            ReviewInterval.firstReview(mastery: .none)
        ]

        for interval in intervals {
            #expect(interval.urgencyLevel >= 1)
            #expect(interval.urgencyLevel <= 5)
        }
    }

    @Test("逾期项目 urgencyLevel 为 5")
    func overdueUrgencyLevel() {
        let pastDate = Calendar.current.date(byAdding: .day, value: -30, to: Date())!
        let overdueInterval = ReviewInterval.calculate(
            reviewCount: 0,
            mastery: .none,
            from: pastDate
        )

        #expect(overdueInterval.urgencyLevel == 5)
    }

    @Test("urgencyDescription 返回非空字符串")
    func urgencyDescriptionNotEmpty() {
        let interval = ReviewInterval.firstReview(mastery: .partial)
        #expect(!interval.urgencyDescription.isEmpty)
    }

    @Test("urgencyShortDescription 返回非空字符串")
    func urgencyShortDescriptionNotEmpty() {
        let interval = ReviewInterval.firstReview(mastery: .partial)
        #expect(!interval.urgencyShortDescription.isEmpty)
    }

    @Test("isUrgent 正确判断")
    func isUrgentProperty() {
        // 逾期应该紧急
        let pastDate = Calendar.current.date(byAdding: .day, value: -30, to: Date())!
        let overdueInterval = ReviewInterval.calculate(
            reviewCount: 0,
            mastery: .none,
            from: pastDate
        )

        #expect(overdueInterval.isUrgent == true)
    }

    // MARK: - Comparable 测试

    @Test("Comparable 按紧迫程度排序")
    func comparableByUrgency() {
        let urgent = ReviewInterval.calculate(
            reviewCount: 0,
            mastery: .none,
            from: Calendar.current.date(byAdding: .day, value: -30, to: Date())!
        )
        let relaxed = ReviewInterval.calculate(reviewCount: 5, mastery: .mastered)

        // 更紧急的（daysUntilReview更小）排在前面
        #expect(urgent < relaxed)
    }

    // MARK: - Identifiable 测试

    @Test("id 唯一")
    func identifiableId() {
        let interval1 = ReviewInterval.calculate(reviewCount: 1, mastery: .partial)
        let interval2 = ReviewInterval.calculate(reviewCount: 2, mastery: .good)

        #expect(interval1.id != interval2.id)
    }

    // MARK: - Codable 测试

    @Test("Codable 正确编解码")
    func codableRoundTrip() throws {
        let original = ReviewInterval.calculate(reviewCount: 3, mastery: .good)

        let encoder = JSONEncoder()
        let decoder = JSONDecoder()

        let data = try encoder.encode(original)
        let decoded = try decoder.decode(ReviewInterval.self, from: data)

        #expect(decoded.reviewCount == original.reviewCount)
        #expect(decoded.mastery == original.mastery)
    }

    // MARK: - 描述测试

    @Test("description 格式正确")
    func descriptionFormat() {
        let interval = ReviewInterval.firstReview(mastery: .partial)
        let desc = interval.description

        #expect(desc.contains("保持率"))
        #expect(desc.contains("%"))
    }
}

        }
    }

    @Test("所有等级都有图标")
    func allLevelsHaveIcons() {
        for level in MasteryLevel.allCases {
            #expect(!level.icon.isEmpty)
        }
    }

    @Test("所有等级都有颜色")
    func allLevelsHaveColors() {
        // 验证颜色渐进：品牌错误色 → 品牌成功色
        #expect(MasteryLevel.none.color == Color.brand.error)
        #expect(MasteryLevel.mastered.color == Color.brand.success)

        for level in MasteryLevel.allCases {
            _ = level.color
        }
    }

    @Test("星级从1到5")
    func starRatings() {
        #expect(MasteryLevel.none.stars == 1)
        #expect(MasteryLevel.glimpse.stars == 2)
        #expect(MasteryLevel.partial.stars == 3)
        #expect(MasteryLevel.good.stars == 4)
        #expect(MasteryLevel.mastered.stars == 5)
    }

    // MARK: - 进度值测试

    @Test("进度值在0到1之间")
    func progressValues() {
        #expect(MasteryLevel.none.progress == 0.0)
        #expect(MasteryLevel.mastered.progress == 1.0)

        for level in MasteryLevel.allCases {
            #expect(level.progress >= 0.0)
            #expect(level.progress <= 1.0)
        }
    }

    // MARK: - 复习优先级测试

    @Test("reviewPriority 递减")
    func reviewPriorityDecreasing() {
        // 掌握程度越低，复习优先级越高
        #expect(MasteryLevel.none.reviewPriority > MasteryLevel.mastered.reviewPriority)

        var previousPriority = Int.max
        for level in MasteryLevel.allCases {
            #expect(level.reviewPriority < previousPriority)
            previousPriority = level.reviewPriority
        }
    }

    // MARK: - 状态判断测试

    @Test("needsReview 正确判断")
    func needsReviewFlag() {
        #expect(MasteryLevel.none.needsReview == true)
        #expect(MasteryLevel.glimpse.needsReview == true)
        #expect(MasteryLevel.partial.needsReview == true)
        #expect(MasteryLevel.good.needsReview == false)
        #expect(MasteryLevel.mastered.needsReview == false)
    }

    @Test("isMastered 正确判断")
    func isMasteredFlag() {
        #expect(MasteryLevel.none.isMastered == false)
        #expect(MasteryLevel.glimpse.isMastered == false)
        #expect(MasteryLevel.partial.isMastered == false)
        #expect(MasteryLevel.good.isMastered == true)
        #expect(MasteryLevel.mastered.isMastered == true)
    }

    @Test("isFullyMastered 正确判断")
    func isFullyMasteredFlag() {
        #expect(MasteryLevel.none.isFullyMastered == false)
        #expect(MasteryLevel.good.isFullyMastered == false)
        #expect(MasteryLevel.mastered.isFullyMastered == true)
    }

    @Test("isUnknown 正确判断")
    func isUnknownFlag() {
        #expect(MasteryLevel.none.isUnknown == true)
        #expect(MasteryLevel.glimpse.isUnknown == false)
        #expect(MasteryLevel.mastered.isUnknown == false)
    }

    // MARK: - 工厂方法测试

    @Test("MasteryLevel from(stars:) 正常值创建正确")
    func masteryLevelFromStarsFactoryNormal() {
        // 使用 Optional 比较方式，避免可能的类型推断问题
        let result1: MasteryLevel? = MasteryLevel.from(stars: 1)
        let result2: MasteryLevel? = MasteryLevel.from(stars: 2)
        let result3: MasteryLevel? = MasteryLevel.from(stars: 3)
        let result4: MasteryLevel? = MasteryLevel.from(stars: 4)
        let result5: MasteryLevel? = MasteryLevel.from(stars: 5)

        #expect(result1 != nil)
        #expect(result2 != nil)
        #expect(result3 != nil)
        #expect(result4 != nil)
        #expect(result5 != nil)

        if let r1 = result1 { #expect(r1 == .none) }
        if let r2 = result2 { #expect(r2 == .glimpse) }
        if let r3 = result3 { #expect(r3 == .partial) }
        if let r4 = result4 { #expect(r4 == .good) }
        if let r5 = result5 { #expect(r5 == .mastered) }
    }

    @Test("MasteryLevel from(stars:) 边界值返回 nil")
    func masteryLevelFromStarsFactoryBoundary() {
        #expect(MasteryLevel.from(stars: 0) == nil)
        #expect(MasteryLevel.from(stars: 6) == nil)
        #expect(MasteryLevel.from(stars: -1) == nil)
    }

    @Test("MasteryLevel from(progress:) 创建正确")
    func masteryLevelFromProgressFactory() {
        #expect(MasteryLevel.from(progress: 0.0) == .none)
        #expect(MasteryLevel.from(progress: 0.5) == .partial)
        #expect(MasteryLevel.from(progress: 1.0) == .mastered)

        // 边界处理
        #expect(MasteryLevel.from(progress: -0.5) == .none)
        #expect(MasteryLevel.from(progress: 1.5) == .mastered)
    }

    // MARK: - 静态集合测试

    @Test("reviewNeeded 包含正确等级")
    func reviewNeededCollection() {
        #expect(MasteryLevel.reviewNeeded.count == 3)
        #expect(MasteryLevel.reviewNeeded.contains(.none))
        #expect(MasteryLevel.reviewNeeded.contains(.glimpse))
        #expect(MasteryLevel.reviewNeeded.contains(.partial))
        #expect(!MasteryLevel.reviewNeeded.contains(.good))
    }

    @Test("masteredLevels 包含正确等级")
    func masteredLevelsCollection() {
        #expect(MasteryLevel.masteredLevels.count == 2)
        #expect(MasteryLevel.masteredLevels.contains(.good))
        #expect(MasteryLevel.masteredLevels.contains(.mastered))
    }

    @Test("sortedByReviewPriority 正确排序")
    func sortedByReviewPriorityOrder() {
        let sorted = MasteryLevel.sortedByReviewPriority

        for i in 1..<sorted.count {
            #expect(sorted[i-1].reviewPriority > sorted[i].reviewPriority)
        }
    }

    // MARK: - 比较测试

    @Test("Comparable 正确实现")
    func comparableConformance() {
        #expect(MasteryLevel.none < MasteryLevel.glimpse)
        #expect(MasteryLevel.glimpse < MasteryLevel.partial)
        #expect(MasteryLevel.partial < MasteryLevel.good)
        #expect(MasteryLevel.good < MasteryLevel.mastered)

        #expect(MasteryLevel.mastered > MasteryLevel.none)
    }

    // MARK: - 编码测试

    @Test("Codable 正确编解码")
    func codableRoundTrip() throws {
        let original = MasteryLevel.good
        let encoder = JSONEncoder()
        let decoder = JSONDecoder()

        let data = try encoder.encode(original)
        let decoded = try decoder.decode(MasteryLevel.self, from: data)

        #expect(decoded == original)
    }

    // MARK: - 描述测试

    @Test("description 等于 displayName")
    func descriptionEqualsDisplayName() {
        for level in MasteryLevel.allCases {
            #expect(level.description == level.displayName)
        }
    }
}

//
//  KnowledgePointsTests.swift
//  NotBadTests
//
//  知识点值对象单元测试
//

import Testing
import Foundation
@testable import NotBad

@Suite("KnowledgePoints 值对象测试")
struct KnowledgePointsTests {

    // MARK: - 初始化测试

    @Test("从逗号分隔字符串初始化")
    func initFromCommaSeparatedString() {
        let kp = KnowledgePoints(from: "函数, 导数, 极限")

        #expect(kp.count == 3)
        #expect(kp.contains("函数"))
        #expect(kp.contains("导数"))
        #expect(kp.contains("极限"))
    }

    @Test("从逗号分隔字符串初始化（英文逗号）")
    func initFromChineseCommaSeparatedString() {
        // 注意：只支持英文逗号分隔
        let kp = KnowledgePoints(from: "三角函数,正弦,余弦")

        #expect(kp.count == 3)
        #expect(kp.contains("三角函数"))
    }

    @Test("自动去除空白和空值")
    func trimWhitespaceAndEmpty() {
        let kp = KnowledgePoints(from: "  函数  ,  , 导数 ,   ")

        #expect(kp.count == 2)
        #expect(kp.contains("函数"))
        #expect(kp.contains("导数"))
    }

    @Test("从数组初始化")
    func initFromArray() {
        let kp = KnowledgePoints(["圆锥曲线", "椭圆", "抛物线"])

        #expect(kp.count == 3)
    }

    @Test("空字符串生成空知识点")
    func emptyStringCreatesEmpty() {
        let kp = KnowledgePoints(from: "")

        #expect(kp.isEmpty)
        #expect(kp.count == 0)
    }

    // MARK: - 集合操作测试

    @Test("支持 Sequence 协议")
    func sequenceConformance() {
        let kp = KnowledgePoints(["A", "B", "C"])

        var items: [String] = []
        for item in kp {
            items.append(item)
        }

        #expect(items.count == 3)
    }

    @Test("支持下标访问")
    func subscriptAccess() {
        let kp = KnowledgePoints(["第一", "第二", "第三"])

        #expect(kp[0] == "第一")
        #expect(kp[1] == "第二")
        #expect(kp[2] == "第三")
    }

    @Test("添加知识点")
    func addingPoint() {
        let kp = KnowledgePoints(["A", "B"])
        let newKp = kp.adding("C")

        #expect(newKp.count == 3)
        #expect(newKp.contains("C"))
        // 原值不变
        #expect(kp.count == 2)
    }

    @Test("添加重复知识点不会增加")
    func addingDuplicatePoint() {
        let kp = KnowledgePoints(["A", "B"])
        let newKp = kp.adding("A")

        #expect(newKp.count == 2)
    }

    @Test("移除知识点")
    func removingPoint() {
        let kp = KnowledgePoints(["A", "B", "C"])
        let newKp = kp.removing("B")

        #expect(newKp.count == 2)
        #expect(!newKp.contains("B"))
    }

    // MARK: - 搜索匹配测试

    @Test("精确匹配")
    func exactMatch() {
        let kp = KnowledgePoints(["函数", "导数", "极限"])

        #expect(kp.matches("函数"))
        #expect(kp.matches("导数"))
        #expect(!kp.matches("积分"))
    }

    @Test("部分匹配")
    func partialMatch() {
        let kp = KnowledgePoints(["三角函数", "反三角函数", "幂函数"])

        #expect(kp.matches("函数"))  // 部分匹配
        #expect(kp.matches("三角"))  // 部分匹配
    }

    @Test("大小写不敏感匹配")
    func caseInsensitiveMatch() {
        let kp = KnowledgePoints(["DNA", "RNA", "Protein"])

        #expect(kp.matches("dna"))
        #expect(kp.matches("rna"))
        #expect(kp.matches("protein"))
    }

    // MARK: - rawValue 测试

    @Test("rawValue 正确序列化")
    func rawValueSerialization() {
        let kp = KnowledgePoints(["A", "B", "C"])

        // rawValue 使用 ", " (带空格) 分隔
        #expect(kp.rawValue == "A, B, C")
    }

    @Test("空知识点 rawValue 为空字符串")
    func emptyRawValue() {
        let kp = KnowledgePoints.empty

        #expect(kp.rawValue == "")
    }

    // MARK: - 编码测试

    @Test("Codable 正确编解码")
    func codableRoundTrip() throws {
        let original = KnowledgePoints(["导数", "积分", "微分"])
        let encoder = JSONEncoder()
        let decoder = JSONDecoder()

        let data = try encoder.encode(original)
        let decoded = try decoder.decode(KnowledgePoints.self, from: data)

        #expect(decoded == original)
    }
}

import WidgetKit
import SwiftUI
import SwiftData

// MARK: - ReviewEntry

/// 复习数据条目
struct ReviewEntry: TimelineEntry {
    let date: Date
    let pendingCount: Int
    let overdueCount: Int
    let masteryRate: Double
    let recentSubjects: [String]
    let configuration: ConfigurationAppIntent
}

// MARK: - Provider

/// 小组件数据提供者
struct Provider: AppIntentTimelineProvider {

    func placeholder(in context: Context) -> ReviewEntry {
        ReviewEntry(
            date: Date(),
            pendingCount: 5,
            overdueCount: 2,
            masteryRate: 0.65,
            recentSubjects: ["数学", "英语", "物理"],
            configuration: ConfigurationAppIntent()
        )
    }

    func snapshot(for configuration: ConfigurationAppIntent, in context: Context) async -> ReviewEntry {
        await getEntry(for: configuration)
    }

    func timeline(for configuration: ConfigurationAppIntent, in context: Context) async -> Timeline<ReviewEntry> {
        let entry = await getEntry(for: configuration)

        // 每30分钟更新一次
        let nextUpdate = Calendar.current.date(byAdding: .minute, value: 30, to: Date())!
        return Timeline(entries: [entry], policy: .after(nextUpdate))
    }

    private func getEntry(for configuration: ConfigurationAppIntent) async -> ReviewEntry {
        // 使用 App Group 共享数据
        let pendingCount = UserDefaults(suiteName: "group.com.notbad.app")?.integer(forKey: "pendingReviewCount") ?? 0
        let overdueCount = UserDefaults(suiteName: "group.com.notbad.app")?.integer(forKey: "overdueCount") ?? 0
        let masteryRate = UserDefaults(suiteName: "group.com.notbad.app")?.double(forKey: "masteryRate") ?? 0
        let recentSubjects = UserDefaults(suiteName: "group.com.notbad.app")?.stringArray(forKey: "recentSubjects") ?? []

        return ReviewEntry(
            date: Date(),
            pendingCount: pendingCount,
            overdueCount: overdueCount,
            masteryRate: masteryRate,
            recentSubjects: recentSubjects,
            configuration: configuration
        )
    }
}

// MARK: - ConfigurationAppIntent

import AppIntents

struct ConfigurationAppIntent: WidgetConfigurationIntent {
    static var title: LocalizedStringResource { "错题本小组件" }
    static var description: IntentDescription { "显示复习进度和统计信息" }

    @Parameter(title: "显示样式", default: .compact)
    var displayStyle: WidgetDisplayStyle
}

enum WidgetDisplayStyle: String, AppEnum {
    case compact = "紧凑"
    case detailed = "详细"

    static var typeDisplayRepresentation: TypeDisplayRepresentation {
        "显示样式"
    }

    static var caseDisplayRepresentations: [WidgetDisplayStyle: DisplayRepresentation] {
        [
            .compact: "紧凑",
            .detailed: "详细"
        ]
    }
}

//
//  NotBadApp.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  Created for NotBad K12 错题本
//

import SwiftUI
import SwiftData
import TipKit
import OSLog

// MARK: - NotBadApp

/// NotBad K12 错题本应用主入口
@main
struct NotBadApp: App {

    /// 模型容器（带迁移计划）
    let modelContainer: ModelContainer

    /// Deep Link 导航状态
    @State private var selectedTab: Int = 0

    /// 是否显示 Onboarding
    @State private var showOnboarding: Bool = false

    /// 用户选择的颜色模式
    @AppStorage("colorScheme") private var colorSchemeOption = "system"

    /// 计算实际的 ColorScheme
    private var preferredColorScheme: ColorScheme? {
        switch colorSchemeOption {
        case "light": return .light
        case "dark": return .dark
        default: return nil
        }
    }

    init() {
        // 配置 TipKit
        TipsConfiguration.configure()
        
        do {
            let schema = Schema([ReviewItem.self])
            let config = ModelConfiguration(schema: schema)
            modelContainer = try ModelContainer(
                for: schema,
                migrationPlan: ReviewItemMigrationPlan.self,
                configurations: [config]
            )
        } catch {
            // 如果迁移失败，尝试删除旧数据库重建
            Logger.app.error("❌ ModelContainer 初始化失败: \(error.localizedDescription)")
            Logger.app.warning("⚠️ 尝试删除旧数据库...")

            // 删除旧数据库文件
            let url = URL.applicationSupportDirectory.appending(path: "default.store")
            try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: url)
            try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: url.appendingPathExtension("shm"))
            try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: url.appendingPathExtension("wal"))

            // 重新创建容器
            do {
                let schema = Schema([ReviewItem.self])
                let config = ModelConfiguration(schema: schema)
                modelContainer = try ModelContainer(for: schema, configurations: [config])
                Logger.app.info("✅ 重建数据库成功")
            } catch {
                fatalError("❌ [App] 无法创建 ModelContainer: \(error)")
            }
        }
    }

    var body: some Scene {
        WindowGroup {
            AdaptiveNavigationView(selectedTab: $selectedTab)
                .preferredColorScheme(preferredColorScheme)
                .fullScreenCover(isPresented: $showOnboarding) {
                    OnboardingView {
                        showOnboarding = false
                    }
                }
                .onAppear {
                    checkOnboardingStatus()
                }
                .onOpenURL { url in
                    handleDeepLink(url)
                }
                // Handoff Restoration
                .onContinueUserActivity(UserActivityType.viewDashboard) { _ in selectedTab = 0 }
                .onContinueUserActivity(UserActivityType.viewLibrary) { _ in selectedTab = 1 }
                .onContinueUserActivity(UserActivityType.captureItem) { _ in selectedTab = 2 }
                .onContinueUserActivity(UserActivityType.reviewSession) { _ in selectedTab = 3 }
                .onContinueUserActivity(UserActivityType.viewProfile) { _ in selectedTab = 4 }
                .task {
                    await syncWidgetData()
                }
                .onReceive(NotificationCenter.default.publisher(for: .reviewItemsDidChange)) { _ in
                    Task {
                        await syncWidgetData()
                    }
                }
        }
        .modelContainer(modelContainer)
    }

    // MARK: - Onboarding

    /// 检查是否需要显示 Onboarding
    private func checkOnboardingStatus() {
        let hasCompleted = UserDefaults.standard.bool(forKey: "has_completed_onboarding")
        if !hasCompleted {
            showOnboarding = true
        }
    }

    // MARK: - Deep Link Handling

    /// 处理来自 Widget 的 Deep Link
    private func handleDeepLink(_ url: URL) {
        guard url.scheme == "notbad" else { return }

        switch url.host {
        case "review":
            // 导航到复习页面
            selectedTab = 1
        case "library":
            // 导航到错题库
            selectedTab = 2
        case "capture":
            // 导航到拍照
            selectedTab = 0
        default:
            break
        }

        Logger.app.debug("Deep link handled: \(url.absoluteString)")
    }

    // MARK: - Widget Data Sync

    /// 同步数据到 Widget
    @MainActor
    private func syncWidgetData() async {
        let context = modelContainer.mainContext
        let descriptor = FetchDescriptor<ReviewItem>()

        do {
            let items = try context.fetch(descriptor)
            items.syncToWidget()
        } catch {
            Logger.widget.error("Failed to sync widget data: \(error.localizedDescription)")
        }
    }
}

//
//  Dependencies.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  依赖容器 - 管理应用的依赖注入
//

import Foundation
import SwiftData

// MARK: - Dependencies

/// 依赖容器
///
/// 提供应用级别的依赖管理，支持在生产环境和测试环境中切换实现。
///
/// ## 使用示例
///
/// ```swift
/// // 生产环境
/// let repository = Dependencies.shared.reviewItemRepository
///
/// // 测试环境
/// Dependencies.shared.reviewItemRepository = MockReviewItemRepository()
/// ```
///
/// - Note: 使用单例模式，通过 `.shared` 访问
/// - Important: 测试完成后记得重置依赖
@MainActor
final class Dependencies {
    
    // MARK: - Singleton
    
    /// 共享实例
    static let shared = Dependencies()
    
    // MARK: - Private Init
    
    private init() {}
    
    // MARK: - Model Context
    
    /// SwiftData 模型上下文
    /// 由 App 入口设置
    var modelContext: ModelContext?
    
    // MARK: - Repository
    
    /// 错题仓库
    /// 默认使用 SwiftData 实现，测试时可替换为 Mock
    private var _reviewItemRepository: ReviewItemRepositoryProtocol?
    
    var reviewItemRepository: ReviewItemRepositoryProtocol {
        get {
            if let repo = _reviewItemRepository {
                return repo
            }
            guard let context = modelContext else {
                fatalError("ModelContext not configured. Call Dependencies.shared.configure(modelContext:) first.")
            }
            let repo = ReviewItemRepository(modelContext: context)
            _reviewItemRepository = repo
            return repo
        }
        set {
            _reviewItemRepository = newValue
        }
    }
    
    // MARK: - Services
    
    /// OCR 服务
    private var _ocrService: (any OCRServiceProtocol)?
    
    var ocrService: any OCRServiceProtocol {
        get {
            if let service = _ocrService {
                return service
            }
            let service = OCRService.shared
            _ocrService = service
            return service
        }
        set {
            _ocrService = newValue
        }
    }
    
    /// PDF 导出服务
    private var _pdfExportService: (any PDFExportServiceProtocol)?
    
    var pdfExportService: any PDFExportServiceProtocol {
        get {
            if let service = _pdfExportService {
                return service
            }
            let service = PDFExportService.shared
            _pdfExportService = service
            return service
        }
        set {
            _pdfExportService = newValue
        }
    }
    
    /// 埋点服务
    private var _analyticsService: (any AnalyticsServiceProtocol)?
    
    var analyticsService: any AnalyticsServiceProtocol {
        get {
            if let service = _analyticsService {
                return service
            }
            let service = LocalAnalyticsService.shared
            _analyticsService = service
            return service
        }
        set {
            _analyticsService = newValue
        }
    }
    
    // MARK: - Configuration
    
    /// 配置依赖容器
    ///
    /// - Parameter modelContext: SwiftData 模型上下文
    func configure(modelContext: ModelContext) {
        self.modelContext = modelContext
    }
    
    // MARK: - Reset
    
    /// 重置所有依赖到默认状态
    ///
    /// 主要用于测试清理
    func reset() {
        _reviewItemRepository = nil
        _ocrService = nil
        _pdfExportService = nil
        _analyticsService = nil
    }
}

// MARK: - Convenience Extensions

extension Dependencies {
    
    /// 使用 Mock Repository 进行测试
    ///
    /// - Parameter mock: Mock 仓库实例
    /// - Returns: 返回 mock 以便链式调用
    @discardableResult
    func useMockRepository(_ mock: ReviewItemRepositoryProtocol) -> ReviewItemRepositoryProtocol {
        self.reviewItemRepository = mock
        return mock
    }
}

//
//  EnvironmentKeys.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  SwiftUI 环境键定义
//  Phase 5: View 层环境注入
//

import SwiftUI
import SwiftData

// MARK: - DataProvider Environment Key

/// ReviewItemDataProviding 环境键
///
/// 用于通过 SwiftUI Environment 注入数据提供者
private struct DataProviderKey: EnvironmentKey {
    static let defaultValue: (any ReviewItemDataProviding)? = nil
}

extension EnvironmentValues {
    /// 错题数据提供者
    ///
    /// 使用示例:
    /// ```swift
    /// // 注入
    /// ContentView()
    ///     .environment(\.dataProvider, provider)
    ///
    /// // 读取
    /// @Environment(\.dataProvider) var dataProvider
    /// ```
    var dataProvider: (any ReviewItemDataProviding)? {
        get { self[DataProviderKey.self] }
        set { self[DataProviderKey.self] = newValue }
    }
}

// MARK: - OCR Service Environment Key

/// OCRServiceProtocol 环境键
private struct OCRServiceKey: EnvironmentKey {
    static let defaultValue: (any OCRServiceProtocol)? = nil
}

extension EnvironmentValues {
    /// OCR 服务
    ///
    /// 使用示例:
    /// ```swift
    /// // 注入 Mock
    /// CaptureView()
    ///     .environment(\.ocrService, MockOCRService())
    ///
    /// // 读取
    /// @Environment(\.ocrService) var ocrService
    /// ```
    var ocrService: (any OCRServiceProtocol)? {
        get { self[OCRServiceKey.self] }
        set { self[OCRServiceKey.self] = newValue }
    }
}

// MARK: - PDF Export Service Environment Key

/// PDFExportServiceProtocol 环境键
private struct PDFExportServiceKey: EnvironmentKey {
    static let defaultValue: (any PDFExportServiceProtocol)? = nil
}

extension EnvironmentValues {
    /// PDF 导出服务
    ///
    /// 使用示例:
    /// ```swift
    /// // 注入 Mock
    /// ExportView()
    ///     .environment(\.pdfExportService, MockPDFExportService())
    ///
    /// // 读取
    /// @Environment(\.pdfExportService) var pdfExportService
    /// ```
    var pdfExportService: (any PDFExportServiceProtocol)? {
        get { self[PDFExportServiceKey.self] }
        set { self[PDFExportServiceKey.self] = newValue }
    }
}

// MARK: - Repository Environment Key

/// ReviewItemRepositoryProtocol 环境键
private struct RepositoryKey: EnvironmentKey {
    static let defaultValue: (any ReviewItemRepositoryProtocol)? = nil
}

extension EnvironmentValues {
    /// 错题仓库
    ///
    /// 使用示例:
    /// ```swift
    /// // 注入
    /// ContentView()
    ///     .environment(\.repository, repository)
    ///
    /// // 读取
    /// @Environment(\.repository) var repository
    /// ```
    var repository: (any ReviewItemRepositoryProtocol)? {
        get { self[RepositoryKey.self] }
        set { self[RepositoryKey.self] = newValue }
    }
}

// MARK: - Analytics Service Environment Key

/// AnalyticsServiceProtocol 环境键
private struct AnalyticsServiceKey: EnvironmentKey {
    static let defaultValue: (any AnalyticsServiceProtocol)? = nil
}

extension EnvironmentValues {
    /// 埋点服务
    ///
    /// 使用示例:
    /// ```swift
    /// // 注入 Mock
    /// ContentView()
    ///     .environment(\.analyticsService, MockAnalyticsService())
    ///
    /// // 读取
    /// @Environment(\.analyticsService) var analytics
    /// ```
    var analyticsService: (any AnalyticsServiceProtocol)? {
        get { self[AnalyticsServiceKey.self] }
        set { self[AnalyticsServiceKey.self] = newValue }
    }
}

// MARK: - View Modifiers for Convenience

extension View {
    /// 注入数据提供者
    ///
    /// - Parameter provider: 数据提供者实例
    /// - Returns: 修改后的视图
    func dataProvider(_ provider: any ReviewItemDataProviding) -> some View {
        environment(\.dataProvider, provider)
    }
    
    /// 注入 OCR 服务
    ///
    /// - Parameter service: OCR 服务实例
    /// - Returns: 修改后的视图
    func ocrService(_ service: any OCRServiceProtocol) -> some View {
        environment(\.ocrService, service)
    }
    
    /// 注入 PDF 导出服务
    ///
    /// - Parameter service: PDF 导出服务实例
    /// - Returns: 修改后的视图
    func pdfExportService(_ service: any PDFExportServiceProtocol) -> some View {
        environment(\.pdfExportService, service)
    }
    
    /// 注入错题仓库
    ///
    /// - Parameter repository: 仓库实例
    /// - Returns: 修改后的视图
    func repository(_ repository: any ReviewItemRepositoryProtocol) -> some View {
        environment(\.repository, repository)
    }
    
    /// 注入埋点服务
    ///
    /// - Parameter service: 埋点服务实例
    /// - Returns: 修改后的视图
    func analyticsService(_ service: any AnalyticsServiceProtocol) -> some View {
        environment(\.analyticsService, service)
    }
}

// MARK: - Dependencies Container View Modifier

/// 依赖容器视图修饰器
///
/// 一次性注入所有依赖，简化应用入口配置
struct DependenciesModifier: ViewModifier {
    let dataProvider: (any ReviewItemDataProviding)?
    let ocrService: (any OCRServiceProtocol)?
    let pdfExportService: (any PDFExportServiceProtocol)?
    let repository: (any ReviewItemRepositoryProtocol)?
    
    func body(content: Content) -> some View {
        var result = AnyView(content)
        
        if let provider = dataProvider {
            result = AnyView(result.environment(\.dataProvider, provider))
        }
        if let ocr = ocrService {
            result = AnyView(result.environment(\.ocrService, ocr))
        }
        if let pdf = pdfExportService {
            result = AnyView(result.environment(\.pdfExportService, pdf))
        }
        if let repo = repository {
            result = AnyView(result.environment(\.repository, repo))
        }
        
        return result
    }
}

extension View {
    /// 注入所有依赖
    ///
    /// - Parameters:
    ///   - dataProvider: 数据提供者（可选）
    ///   - ocrService: OCR 服务（可选）
    ///   - pdfExportService: PDF 导出服务（可选）
    ///   - repository: 仓库（可选）
    /// - Returns: 修改后的视图
    func withDependencies(
        dataProvider: (any ReviewItemDataProviding)? = nil,
        ocrService: (any OCRServiceProtocol)? = nil,
        pdfExportService: (any PDFExportServiceProtocol)? = nil,
        repository: (any ReviewItemRepositoryProtocol)? = nil
    ) -> some View {
        modifier(DependenciesModifier(
            dataProvider: dataProvider,
            ocrService: ocrService,
            pdfExportService: pdfExportService,
            repository: repository
        ))
    }
}

//
//  DataProviderFactory.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  DataProvider 工厂
//  Phase 5: 简化 DataProvider 创建

import SwiftData

// MARK: - DataProviderFactory

/// DataProvider 工厂
///
/// 提供创建 DataProvider 的便捷方法，支持生产环境和测试环境。
///
/// ## 使用示例
///
/// ```swift
/// // 生产环境
/// let provider = DataProviderFactory.makeSwiftDataProvider(modelContext: context)
///
/// // 测试环境
/// let mock = DataProviderFactory.makeMockProvider()
/// ```
@MainActor
enum DataProviderFactory {
    
    // MARK: - Production
    
    /// 创建 SwiftData 数据提供者
    ///
    /// - Parameter modelContext: SwiftData 模型上下文
    /// - Returns: SwiftData 实现的数据提供者
    static func makeSwiftDataProvider(modelContext: ModelContext) -> SwiftDataReviewItemProvider {
        SwiftDataReviewItemProvider(modelContext: modelContext)
    }
    
    /// 使用 Dependencies 容器中的 ModelContext 创建数据提供者
    ///
    /// - Returns: SwiftData 实现的数据提供者，如果 ModelContext 未配置则返回 nil
    static func makeSwiftDataProvider() -> SwiftDataReviewItemProvider? {
        guard let context = Dependencies.shared.modelContext else {
            return nil
        }
        return SwiftDataReviewItemProvider(modelContext: context)
    }
}

// MARK: - Environment Helper

extension DataProviderFactory {
    
    /// 为 View 创建适当的 DataProvider
    ///
    /// 如果环境中已有 DataProvider，返回 nil（使用环境中的）
    /// 否则尝试创建新的 SwiftDataProvider
    ///
    /// - Parameter environment: 环境中现有的 DataProvider
    /// - Parameter modelContext: SwiftData 模型上下文
    /// - Returns: 新创建的 DataProvider 或 nil
    static func resolveProvider(
        from environment: (any ReviewItemDataProviding)?,
        modelContext: ModelContext
    ) -> SwiftDataReviewItemProvider? {
        // 如果环境中已有 provider，直接使用
        if environment != nil {
            return nil
        }
        // 否则创建新的
        return makeSwiftDataProvider(modelContext: modelContext)
    }
}

//
//  WidgetDataSync.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  同步数据到 Widget
//

import Foundation
import WidgetKit
import OSLog

/// Widget 数据同步服务
@MainActor
final class WidgetDataSync {

    // MARK: - Singleton

    static let shared = WidgetDataSync()

    private init() {}

    // MARK: - App Group

    private let appGroupIdentifier = "group.com.notbad.app"

    private var sharedDefaults: UserDefaults? {
        UserDefaults(suiteName: appGroupIdentifier)
    }

    // MARK: - Keys

    private enum Keys {
        static let pendingReviewCount = "pendingReviewCount"
        static let overdueCount = "overdueCount"
        static let masteryRate = "masteryRate"
        static let recentSubjects = "recentSubjects"
        static let lastUpdated = "lastUpdated"
    }

    // MARK: - Sync Methods

    /// 同步复习统计数据
    func syncReviewStats(
        pendingCount: Int,
        overdueCount: Int,
        masteryRate: Double,
        recentSubjects: [String]
    ) {
        guard let defaults = sharedDefaults else {
            Logger.widget.error("Failed to access shared UserDefaults")
            return
        }

        defaults.set(pendingCount, forKey: Keys.pendingReviewCount)
        defaults.set(overdueCount, forKey: Keys.overdueCount)
        defaults.set(masteryRate, forKey: Keys.masteryRate)
        defaults.set(Array(recentSubjects.prefix(5)), forKey: Keys.recentSubjects)
        defaults.set(Date(), forKey: Keys.lastUpdated)

        // 刷新 Widget
        reloadWidgets()

        Logger.widget.debug("Synced stats: pending=\(pendingCount), overdue=\(overdueCount), mastery=\(masteryRate)")
    }

    /// 更新待复习数量
    func updatePendingCount(_ count: Int) {
        sharedDefaults?.set(count, forKey: Keys.pendingReviewCount)
        reloadWidgets()
    }

    /// 更新逾期数量
    func updateOverdueCount(_ count: Int) {
        sharedDefaults?.set(count, forKey: Keys.overdueCount)
        reloadWidgets()
    }

    /// 更新掌握率
    func updateMasteryRate(_ rate: Double) {
        sharedDefaults?.set(rate, forKey: Keys.masteryRate)
        reloadWidgets()
    }

    /// 更新最近学科
    func updateRecentSubjects(_ subjects: [String]) {
        sharedDefaults?.set(Array(subjects.prefix(5)), forKey: Keys.recentSubjects)
        reloadWidgets()
    }

    // MARK: - Widget Reload

    /// 刷新所有 Widget
    func reloadWidgets() {
        WidgetCenter.shared.reloadAllTimelines()
    }

    /// 刷新特定 Widget
    func reloadWidget(kind: String = "NotBadWidget") {
        WidgetCenter.shared.reloadTimelines(ofKind: kind)
    }
}

// MARK: - ReviewItem Collection Extension

extension Array where Element == ReviewItem {

    /// 同步数据到 Widget
    @MainActor
    func syncToWidget() {
        // 计算待复习数量
        let pendingCount = self.filter { $0.needsReview }.count

        // 计算逾期数量
        let overdueCount = self.filter { $0.isOverdue }.count

        // 计算掌握率
        let totalItems = self.count
        let masteredCount = self.filter { $0.isMastered }.count
        let masteryRate = totalItems > 0 ? Double(masteredCount) / Double(totalItems) : 0

        // 获取最近学科
        var subjectSet = Set<String>()
        for item in self {
            subjectSet.insert(item.subject.displayName)
        }
        var recentSubjects: [String] = []
        for (index, subject) in subjectSet.enumerated() {
            if index >= 5 { break }
            recentSubjects.append(subject)
        }

        WidgetDataSync.shared.syncReviewStats(
            pendingCount: pendingCount,
            overdueCount: overdueCount,
            masteryRate: masteryRate,
            recentSubjects: recentSubjects
        )
    }
}

//
//  ImagePicker.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  Created for NotBad K12 错题本
//

import SwiftUI
import UIKit

// MARK: - ImagePicker

/// 相机/相册图片选择器
///
/// 封装 `UIImagePickerController`，提供 SwiftUI 友好的接口。
///
/// ## 使用示例
///
/// ```swift
/// struct ContentView: View {
///     @State private var showCamera = false
///     @State private var selectedImage: UIImage?
///
///     var body: some View {
///         Button("拍照") {
///             showCamera = true
///         }
///         .sheet(isPresented: $showCamera) {
///             ImagePicker(sourceType: .camera) { image in
///                 selectedImage = image
///             }
///         }
///     }
/// }
/// ```
///
/// - Note: 使用相机需要在 Info.plist 添加 `NSCameraUsageDescription`
struct ImagePicker: UIViewControllerRepresentable {

    // MARK: - Environment

    @Environment(\.dismiss) private var dismiss

    // MARK: - Properties

    /// 图片来源类型
    let sourceType: UIImagePickerController.SourceType

    /// 是否允许编辑
    var allowsEditing: Bool = false

    /// 图片选择回调
    let onImagePicked: (UIImage) -> Void

    /// 取消回调（可选）
    var onCancel: (() -> Void)?

    // MARK: - UIViewControllerRepresentable

    func makeUIViewController(context: Context) -> UIImagePickerController {
        let picker = UIImagePickerController()
        picker.sourceType = sourceType
        picker.delegate = context.coordinator
        picker.allowsEditing = allowsEditing

        // 相机模式下的额外配置
        if sourceType == .camera {
            picker.cameraCaptureMode = .photo
            picker.cameraFlashMode = .auto
        }

        return picker
    }

    func updateUIViewController(_ uiViewController: UIImagePickerController, context: Context) {
        // 无需更新
    }

    func makeCoordinator() -> Coordinator {
        Coordinator(self)
    }

    // MARK: - Coordinator

    /// 协调器，处理 UIImagePickerController 的代理回调
    final class Coordinator: NSObject, UIImagePickerControllerDelegate, UINavigationControllerDelegate {

        private let parent: ImagePicker

        init(_ parent: ImagePicker) {
            self.parent = parent
        }

        func imagePickerController(
            _ picker: UIImagePickerController,
            didFinishPickingMediaWithInfo info: [UIImagePickerController.InfoKey: Any]
        ) {
            // 根据是否允许编辑选择图片
            let key: UIImagePickerController.InfoKey = parent.allowsEditing ? .editedImage : .originalImage

            if let image = info[key] as? UIImage {
                // 修正图片方向
                let correctedImage = image.fixedOrientation()
                parent.onImagePicked(correctedImage)
            }

            parent.dismiss()
        }

        func imagePickerControllerDidCancel(_ picker: UIImagePickerController) {
            parent.onCancel?()
            parent.dismiss()
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - ImagePicker Convenience Initializers

extension ImagePicker {

    /// 创建相机选择器
    ///
    /// - Parameters:
    ///   - allowsEditing: 是否允许编辑
    ///   - onImagePicked: 图片选择回调
    /// - Returns: 配置好的 ImagePicker
    static func camera(
        allowsEditing: Bool = false,
        onImagePicked: @escaping (UIImage) -> Void
    ) -> ImagePicker {
        ImagePicker(
            sourceType: .camera,
            allowsEditing: allowsEditing,
            onImagePicked: onImagePicked
        )
    }

    /// 创建相册选择器
    ///
    /// - Parameters:
    ///   - allowsEditing: 是否允许编辑
    ///   - onImagePicked: 图片选择回调
    /// - Returns: 配置好的 ImagePicker
    static func photoLibrary(
        allowsEditing: Bool = false,
        onImagePicked: @escaping (UIImage) -> Void
    ) -> ImagePicker {
        ImagePicker(
            sourceType: .photoLibrary,
            allowsEditing: allowsEditing,
            onImagePicked: onImagePicked
        )
    }
}

// MARK: - ImagePicker Availability

extension ImagePicker {

    /// 检查相机是否可用
    static var isCameraAvailable: Bool {
        UIImagePickerController.isSourceTypeAvailable(.camera)
    }

    /// 检查相册是否可用
    static var isPhotoLibraryAvailable: Bool {
        UIImagePickerController.isSourceTypeAvailable(.photoLibrary)
    }
}

// MARK: - UIImage Extension

private extension UIImage {

    /// 修正图片方向
    ///
    /// 相机拍摄的图片可能带有方向元数据，此方法将其转换为正确方向。
    func fixedOrientation() -> UIImage {
        guard imageOrientation != .up else { return self }

        UIGraphicsBeginImageContextWithOptions(size, false, scale)
        draw(in: CGRect(origin: .zero, size: size))
        let normalizedImage = UIGraphicsGetImageFromCurrentImageContext()
        UIGraphicsEndImageContext()

        return normalizedImage ?? self
    }
}

// FILE PATH: NotBad/Infrastructure/OCR/OCRService.swift
================================================================================

//
//  OCRService.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  Created for NotBad K12 错题本
//

import UIKit
import Vision

// MARK: - OCRService

/// OCR 文字识别服务
///
/// 基于 Apple Vision 框架实现的文字识别服务，支持中英文混合识别。
///
/// ## 功能特性
///
/// - 支持中文简体、繁体和英文识别
/// - 精确识别模式，适合印刷体和手写体
/// - 语言校正，提高识别准确率
/// - 返回置信度信息
///
/// ## 使用示例
///
/// ```swift
/// let service = OCRService.shared
///
/// do {
///     let result = try await service.recognizeText(from: image)
///     print("识别文本: \(result.text)")
///     print("置信度: \(result.confidence)")
/// } catch {
///     print("识别失败: \(error)")
/// }
/// ```
///
/// - Note: 使用单例模式，通过 `.shared` 访问
/// - Important: 识别是异步操作，可能需要数秒时间
@MainActor
final class OCRService: OCRServiceProtocol {

    // MARK: - Singleton

    /// 共享实例
    static let shared = OCRService()

    // MARK: - Configuration

    /// 识别级别
    private let recognitionLevel: VNRequestTextRecognitionLevel = .accurate

    /// 支持的语言
    private let recognitionLanguages = ["zh-Hans", "zh-Hant", "en-US"]

    /// 是否使用语言校正
    private let usesLanguageCorrection = true

    // MARK: - Initialization

    private init() {}

    // MARK: - Recognition

    /// 从图片中识别文字
    ///
    /// 使用 Vision 框架进行文字识别，支持中英文混合内容。
    ///
    /// - Parameter image: 要识别的图片
    /// - Returns: 识别结果，包含文本和置信度
    /// - Throws: `OCRError` 当识别失败时
    func recognizeText(from image: UIImage) async throws -> String {
        let result = try await recognizeTextWithConfidence(from: image)
        return result.text
    }

    /// 从图片中识别文字（带置信度）
    ///
    /// - Parameter image: 要识别的图片
    /// - Returns: 识别结果，包含文本和置信度
    /// - Throws: `OCRError` 当识别失败时
    func recognizeTextWithConfidence(from image: UIImage) async throws -> OCRResult {
        guard let cgImage = image.cgImage else {
            throw OCRError.invalidImage
        }

        return try await withCheckedThrowingContinuation { continuation in
            let requestHandler = VNImageRequestHandler(cgImage: cgImage, options: [:])

            let request = VNRecognizeTextRequest { [weak self] request, error in
                if let error {
                    continuation.resume(throwing: error)
                    return
                }

                guard let observations = request.results as? [VNRecognizedTextObservation] else {
                    continuation.resume(throwing: OCRError.recognitionFailed)
                    return
                }

                let result = self?.processObservations(observations) ?? OCRResult.empty

                if result.text.isEmpty {
                    continuation.resume(throwing: OCRError.noTextFound)
                } else {
                    continuation.resume(returning: result)
                }
            }

            // 配置识别参数
            request.recognitionLevel = recognitionLevel
            request.recognitionLanguages = recognitionLanguages
            request.usesLanguageCorrection = usesLanguageCorrection

            do {
                try requestHandler.perform([request])
            } catch {
                continuation.resume(throwing: error)
            }
        }
    }

    /// 处理识别结果
    private func processObservations(_ observations: [VNRecognizedTextObservation]) -> OCRResult {
        var lines: [OCRLine] = []
        var totalConfidence: Float = 0

        for observation in observations {
            guard let candidate = observation.topCandidates(1).first else { continue }

            let line = OCRLine(
                text: candidate.string,
                confidence: candidate.confidence,
                boundingBox: observation.boundingBox
            )
            lines.append(line)
            totalConfidence += candidate.confidence
        }

        let averageConfidence = lines.isEmpty ? 0 : totalConfidence / Float(lines.count)
        let fullText = lines.map { $0.text }.joined(separator: "\n")

        return OCRResult(
            text: fullText,
            lines: lines,
            confidence: Double(averageConfidence)
        )
    }

    // MARK: - Text Extraction

    /// 从识别的文字中提取标题
    ///
    /// 提取第一行文字作为标题，最多 50 个字符。
    ///
    /// - Parameter text: 完整识别文本
    /// - Returns: 提取的标题
    func extractTitle(from text: String) -> String {
        let firstLine = text.components(separatedBy: .newlines).first ?? text
        let trimmed = firstLine.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
        let title = String(trimmed.prefix(50))
        return title.isEmpty ? "未命名错题" : title
    }

    /// 提取题目中的数学公式（简单识别）
    ///
    /// - Parameter text: 完整识别文本
    /// - Returns: 识别到的数学表达式列表
    func extractMathExpressions(from text: String) -> [String] {
        // 简单的数学表达式模式匹配
        let patterns = [
            "[0-9]+[+\\-×÷*/=][0-9]+",  // 基本运算
            "[a-zA-Z]\\^[0-9]+",         // 幂运算
            "√[0-9]+",                    // 根号
            "[0-9]+/[0-9]+"              // 分数
        ]

        var expressions: [String] = []

        for pattern in patterns {
            if let regex = try? NSRegularExpression(pattern: pattern) {
                let range = NSRange(text.startIndex..., in: text)
                let matches = regex.matches(in: text, range: range)

                for match in matches {
                    if let range = Range(match.range, in: text) {
                        expressions.append(String(text[range]))
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        return expressions
    }
}

// MARK: - OCRResult

/// OCR 识别结果
struct OCRResult: Sendable, Equatable {
    /// 完整识别文本
    let text: String

    /// 按行分割的识别结果
    let lines: [OCRLine]

    /// 平均置信度（0.0 - 1.0）
    let confidence: Double

    /// 空结果
    static let empty = OCRResult(text: "", lines: [], confidence: 0)

    /// 置信度描述
    var confidenceDescription: String {
        switch confidence {
        case 0.9...: "识别置信度很高"
        case 0.7..<0.9: "识别置信度良好"
        case 0.5..<0.7: "识别置信度一般"
        default: "识别置信度较低，建议检查"
        }
    }

    /// 是否高置信度
    var isHighConfidence: Bool {
        confidence >= 0.8
    }
}

// MARK: - OCRLine

/// OCR 识别的单行结果
struct OCRLine: Sendable, Equatable {
    /// 文本内容
    let text: String

    /// 置信度（0.0 - 1.0）
    let confidence: Float

    /// 边界框（归一化坐标）
    let boundingBox: CGRect
}

// MARK: - OCRError

/// OCR 识别错误
enum OCRError: LocalizedError, Sendable {
    /// 图片格式无效
    case invalidImage

    /// 识别处理失败
    case recognitionFailed

    /// 未识别到文字
    case noTextFound

    /// 超时
    case timeout

    var errorDescription: String? {
        switch self {
        case .invalidImage: "图片格式无效，请重新选择"
        case .recognitionFailed: "文字识别失败，请重试"
        case .noTextFound: "未识别到文字，请确保图片清晰"
        case .timeout: "识别超时，请重试"
        }
    }

    var recoverySuggestion: String? {
        switch self {
        case .invalidImage: "请选择 JPEG 或 PNG 格式的图片"
        case .recognitionFailed: "请确保图片清晰，光线充足"
        case .noTextFound: "请确保图片中包含文字内容"
        case .timeout: "图片过大或设备负载较高，请稍后重试"
        }
    }
}

//
