import Foundation
import SwiftUI

// MARK: - UserProfileManager

/// 用户个人资料管理器
///
/// 管理用户的昵称、头像等个人设置，支持本地存储和 iCloud 同步。
@MainActor
final class UserProfileManager: ObservableObject {
    
    // MARK: - Singleton
    
    static let shared = UserProfileManager()
    
    // MARK: - Keys
    
    private enum Keys {
        static let nickname = "user_nickname"
        static let avatar = "user_avatar"
        static let gradientIndex = "user_gradient_index"
        static let enabledSubjects = "user_enabled_subjects"
        static let customSubjects = "user_custom_subjects"
        static let enabledCustomSubjectIds = "user_enabled_custom_subject_ids"
    }
    
    // MARK: - Published Properties
    
    @Published var nickname: String {
        didSet {
            saveToLocal(nickname, forKey: Keys.nickname)
            syncToCloud(nickname, forKey: Keys.nickname)
        }
    }
    
    @Published var avatar: String {
        didSet {
            saveToLocal(avatar, forKey: Keys.avatar)
            syncToCloud(avatar, forKey: Keys.avatar)
        }
    }
    
    @Published var gradientIndex: Int {
        didSet {
            saveToLocal(gradientIndex, forKey: Keys.gradientIndex)
            syncToCloud(gradientIndex, forKey: Keys.gradientIndex)
        }
    }
    
    /// 用户启用的学科列表
    /// 默认启用：语文、数学、英语、物理、化学
    @Published var enabledSubjects: Set<Subject> {
        didSet {
            let rawValues = enabledSubjects.map { $0.rawValue }
            saveToLocal(rawValues, forKey: Keys.enabledSubjects)
            syncToCloud(rawValues, forKey: Keys.enabledSubjects)
        }
    }
    
    /// 用户自定义的学科列表
    @Published var customSubjects: [CustomSubject] {
        didSet {
            saveCustomSubjects()
        }
    }
    
    /// 用户启用的自定义学科ID列表
    @Published var enabledCustomSubjectIds: Set<UUID> {
        didSet {
            let idStrings = enabledCustomSubjectIds.map { $0.uuidString }
            saveToLocal(idStrings, forKey: Keys.enabledCustomSubjectIds)
            syncToCloud(idStrings, forKey: Keys.enabledCustomSubjectIds)
        }
    }
    
    // MARK: - Gradient Colors
    
    /// 头像背景渐变色选项
    var gradientColors: [Color] {
        let options: [[Color]] = [
            [Color.brand.primary, Color.brand.secondary],
            [.purple, .pink],
            [.orange, .red],
            [.green, .mint],
            [.blue, .cyan],
            [.indigo, .purple]
        ]
        let index = min(gradientIndex, options.count - 1)
        return options[max(0, index)]
    }
    
    // MARK: - Initialization
    
    private init() {
        // 优先从 iCloud 加载，否则从本地加载
        self.nickname = Self.loadFromCloud(forKey: Keys.nickname) 
            ?? Self.loadFromLocal(forKey: Keys.nickname) 
            ?? String(localized: "profile_nickname")
        
        self.avatar = Self.loadFromCloud(forKey: Keys.avatar) 
            ?? Self.loadFromLocal(forKey: Keys.avatar) 
            ?? "person.fill"
        
        self.gradientIndex = Self.loadFromCloud(forKey: Keys.gradientIndex) 
            ?? Self.loadFromLocal(forKey: Keys.gradientIndex) 
            ?? 0
        
        // 加载学科偏好（如果用户还没设置过，默认为空集合，会在 Onboarding 中设置）
        if let savedRawValues: [String] = Self.loadFromCloud(forKey: Keys.enabledSubjects)
            ?? Self.loadFromLocal(forKey: Keys.enabledSubjects) {
            self.enabledSubjects = Set(savedRawValues.compactMap { Subject(rawValue: $0) })
        } else {
            // 首次使用时为空，在 Onboarding 中由用户选择
            self.enabledSubjects = []
        }
        
        // 加载自定义学科
        self.customSubjects = Self.loadCustomSubjects()
        
        // 加载启用的自定义学科ID
        if let idStrings: [String] = Self.loadFromCloud(forKey: Keys.enabledCustomSubjectIds)
            ?? Self.loadFromLocal(forKey: Keys.enabledCustomSubjectIds) {
            self.enabledCustomSubjectIds = Set(idStrings.compactMap { UUID(uuidString: $0) })
        } else {
            self.enabledCustomSubjectIds = []
        }
        
        // 监听 iCloud 变更
        setupCloudObserver()
    }
    
    // MARK: - Local Storage
    
    private func saveToLocal<T>(_ value: T, forKey key: String) {
        UserDefaults.standard.set(value, forKey: key)
    }
    
    private static func loadFromLocal<T>(forKey key: String) -> T? {
        UserDefaults.standard.object(forKey: key) as? T
    }
    
    // MARK: - iCloud Storage
    
    private func syncToCloud<T>(_ value: T, forKey key: String) {
        NSUbiquitousKeyValueStore.default.set(value, forKey: key)
        NSUbiquitousKeyValueStore.default.synchronize()
    }
    
    private static func loadFromCloud<T>(forKey key: String) -> T? {
        NSUbiquitousKeyValueStore.default.object(forKey: key) as? T
    }
    
    private func setupCloudObserver() {
        NotificationCenter.default.addObserver(
            forName: NSUbiquitousKeyValueStore.didChangeExternallyNotification,
            object: NSUbiquitousKeyValueStore.default,
            queue: .main
        ) { [weak self] _ in
            // 直接从 iCloud 重新读取数据，避免 Sendable 问题
            Task { @MainActor in
                self?.reloadFromCloud()
            }
        }
        
        // 初始同步
        NSUbiquitousKeyValueStore.default.synchronize()
    }
    
    private func reloadFromCloud() {
        if let value: String = Self.loadFromCloud(forKey: Keys.nickname) {
            self.nickname = value
        }
        if let value: String = Self.loadFromCloud(forKey: Keys.avatar) {
            self.avatar = value
        }
        if let value: Int = Self.loadFromCloud(forKey: Keys.gradientIndex) {
            self.gradientIndex = value
        }
        if let rawValues: [String] = Self.loadFromCloud(forKey: Keys.enabledSubjects) {
            self.enabledSubjects = Set(rawValues.compactMap { Subject(rawValue: $0) })
        }
        // 重新加载自定义学科
        self.customSubjects = Self.loadCustomSubjects()
        if let idStrings: [String] = Self.loadFromCloud(forKey: Keys.enabledCustomSubjectIds) {
            self.enabledCustomSubjectIds = Set(idStrings.compactMap { UUID(uuidString: $0) })
        }
    }
    
    // MARK: - Custom Subject Storage
    
    private func saveCustomSubjects() {
        if let data = try? JSONEncoder().encode(customSubjects) {
            saveToLocal(data, forKey: Keys.customSubjects)
            syncToCloud(data, forKey: Keys.customSubjects)
        }
    }
    
    private static func loadCustomSubjects() -> [CustomSubject] {
        let data: Data? = loadFromCloud(forKey: Keys.customSubjects)
            ?? loadFromLocal(forKey: Keys.customSubjects)
        guard let data = data,
              let subjects = try? JSONDecoder().decode([CustomSubject].self, from: data) else {
            return []
        }
        return subjects.sorted { $0.sortOrder < $1.sortOrder }
    }
    
    // MARK: - Subject Management
    
    /// 切换学科启用状态
    func toggleSubject(_ subject: Subject) {
        if enabledSubjects.contains(subject) {
            // 至少保留一个学科
            if enabledSubjects.count > 1 {
                enabledSubjects.remove(subject)
            }
        } else {
            enabledSubjects.insert(subject)
        }
    }
    
    /// 检查学科是否启用
    func isSubjectEnabled(_ subject: Subject) -> Bool {
        enabledSubjects.contains(subject)
    }
    
    /// 重置为默认学科
    func resetToDefaultSubjects() {
        enabledSubjects = [.chinese, .math, .english, .physics, .chemistry]
    }
    
    // MARK: - Custom Subject Management
    
    /// 添加自定义学科
    func addCustomSubject(_ subject: CustomSubject) {
        var newSubject = subject
        // 设置排序顺序为当前最大值 + 1
        newSubject.sortOrder = (customSubjects.map { $0.sortOrder }.max() ?? -1) + 1
        customSubjects.append(newSubject)
        // 默认启用新添加的学科
        enabledCustomSubjectIds.insert(newSubject.id)
    }
    
    /// 更新自定义学科
    func updateCustomSubject(_ subject: CustomSubject) {
        if let index = customSubjects.firstIndex(where: { $0.id == subject.id }) {
            var updatedSubject = subject
            updatedSubject.updatedAt = Date()
            customSubjects[index] = updatedSubject
        }
    }
    
    /// 删除自定义学科
    func deleteCustomSubject(id: UUID) {
        customSubjects.removeAll { $0.id == id }
        enabledCustomSubjectIds.remove(id)
    }
    
    /// 切换自定义学科启用状态
    func toggleCustomSubject(_ subject: CustomSubject) {
        if enabledCustomSubjectIds.contains(subject.id) {
            enabledCustomSubjectIds.remove(subject.id)
        } else {
            enabledCustomSubjectIds.insert(subject.id)
        }
    }
    
    /// 检查自定义学科是否启用
    func isCustomSubjectEnabled(_ subject: CustomSubject) -> Bool {
        enabledCustomSubjectIds.contains(subject.id)
    }
    
    /// 获取所有启用的自定义学科
    func enabledCustomSubjects() -> [CustomSubject] {
        customSubjects.filter { enabledCustomSubjectIds.contains($0.id) }
    }
    
    /// 重新排序自定义学科
    func reorderCustomSubjects(_ subjects: [CustomSubject]) {
        var reorderedSubjects = subjects
        for (index, _) in reorderedSubjects.enumerated() {
            reorderedSubjects[index].sortOrder = index
        }
        customSubjects = reorderedSubjects
    }
}

// FILE PATH: NotBad/Infrastructure/Utils/ExportCacheManager.swift

//
//  ExportCacheManager.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  导出文件缓存管理器
//
//  解决问题：用户筛选导出后，取消分享想换个应用分享时，文件丢失需要重新生成
//
//  解决方案：
//  1. 将导出文件保存到持久化目录而非临时目录
//  2. 缓存最近导出的文件（最多保留 5 个）
//  3. 提供"最近导出"列表，用户可以再次分享
//  4. 定期清理过期文件（超过 7 天）
//

import Foundation

// MARK: - Export Cache Manager

/// 导出文件缓存管理器
final class ExportCacheManager: @unchecked Sendable {
    
    // MARK: - Singleton
    
    static let shared = ExportCacheManager()
    
    private init() {
        // 启动时清理过期文件
        cleanupExpiredFiles()
    }
    
    // MARK: - Constants
    
    /// 最大缓存文件数
    private let maxCachedFiles = 5
    
    /// 文件过期天数
    private let expirationDays = 7
    
    /// 缓存目录名
    private let cacheDirectoryName = "ExportCache"
    
    // MARK: - Properties
    
    /// 缓存目录 URL
    private var cacheDirectory: URL {
        let documentsPath = FileManager.default.urls(for: .documentDirectory, in: .userDomainMask).first!
        let cachePath = documentsPath.appendingPathComponent(cacheDirectoryName)
        
        // 确保目录存在
        if !FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: cachePath.path) {
            try? FileManager.default.createDirectory(at: cachePath, withIntermediateDirectories: true)
        }
        
        return cachePath
    }
    
    // MARK: - Public Methods
    
    /// 保存导出文件到缓存
    /// - Parameters:
    ///   - data: 文件数据
    ///   - fileName: 文件名
    /// - Returns: 缓存文件的 URL
    func cacheExportFile(data: Data, fileName: String) throws -> URL {
        let fileURL = cacheDirectory.appendingPathComponent(fileName)
        
        // 如果同名文件已存在，先删除
        if FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: fileURL.path) {
            try FileManager.default.removeItem(at: fileURL)
        }
        
        // 写入文件
        try data.write(to: fileURL)
        
        // 清理多余的缓存文件
        cleanupExcessFiles()
        
        return fileURL
    }
    
    /// 获取所有缓存的导出文件
    /// - Returns: 缓存文件信息列表，按修改时间倒序排列
    func getCachedFiles() -> [CachedExportFile] {
        guard let files = try? FileManager.default.contentsOfDirectory(
            at: cacheDirectory,
            includingPropertiesForKeys: [.contentModificationDateKey, .fileSizeKey],
            options: .skipsHiddenFiles
        ) else {
            return []
        }
        
        return files.compactMap { url -> CachedExportFile? in
            guard let attributes = try? FileManager.default.attributesOfItem(atPath: url.path),
                  let modificationDate = attributes[.modificationDate] as? Date,
                  let fileSize = attributes[.size] as? Int64 else {
                return nil
            }
            
            return CachedExportFile(
                url: url,
                fileName: url.lastPathComponent,
                fileType: url.pathExtension.uppercased(),
                createdAt: modificationDate,
                fileSize: fileSize
            )
        }
        .sorted { $0.createdAt > $1.createdAt }
    }
    
    /// 删除指定的缓存文件
    func deleteFile(_ file: CachedExportFile) {
        try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: file.url)
    }
    
    /// 删除所有缓存文件
    func deleteAllFiles() {
        let files = getCachedFiles()
        for file in files {
            try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: file.url)
        }
    }
    
    /// 获取缓存目录总大小
    func getCacheSize() -> Int64 {
        getCachedFiles().reduce(0) { $0 + $1.fileSize }
    }
    
    // MARK: - Private Methods
    
    /// 清理过期文件
    private func cleanupExpiredFiles() {
        let files = getCachedFiles()
        let expirationDate = Calendar.current.date(byAdding: .day, value: -expirationDays, to: Date())!
        
        for file in files where file.createdAt < expirationDate {
            try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: file.url)
        }
    }
    
    /// 清理多余的缓存文件（保留最新的 maxCachedFiles 个）
    private func cleanupExcessFiles() {
        let files = getCachedFiles()
        
        if files.count > maxCachedFiles {
            let filesToDelete = files.suffix(from: maxCachedFiles)
            for file in filesToDelete {
                try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: file.url)
            }
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Cached Export File

/// 缓存的导出文件信息
struct CachedExportFile: Identifiable {
    let url: URL
    let fileName: String
    let fileType: String
    let createdAt: Date
    let fileSize: Int64
    
    var id: URL { url }
    
    /// 格式化的文件大小
    var formattedSize: String {
        ByteCountFormatter.string(fromByteCount: fileSize, countStyle: .file)
    }
    
    /// 格式化的创建时间
    var formattedDate: String {
        let formatter = RelativeDateTimeFormatter()
        formatter.unitsStyle = .abbreviated
        return formatter.localizedString(for: createdAt, relativeTo: Date())
    }
    
    /// 文件类型图标
    var icon: String {
        switch fileType.lowercased() {
        case "pdf":
            return "doc.richtext.fill"
        case "csv":
            return "tablecells.fill"
        case "json":
            return "curlybraces"
        case "zip":
            return "archivebox.fill"
        default:
            return "doc.fill"
        }
    }
    
    /// 文件类型颜色
    var color: String {
        switch fileType.lowercased() {
        case "pdf":
            return "primary"
        case "csv":
            return "success"
        case "json":
            return "secondary"
        case "zip":
            return "warning"
        default:
            return "secondary"
        }
    }
}

//
//  ImageCompressor.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  图片压缩工具
//

import UIKit

// MARK: - ImageCompressor

/// 图片压缩工具
///
/// 提供图片压缩和缩放功能，用于优化存储空间。
///
/// ## 使用示例
///
/// ```swift
/// let image = UIImage(named: "photo")!
/// if let data = ImageCompressor.compress(image) {
///     // 使用压缩后的数据
/// }
/// ```
///
/// ## 压缩策略
///
/// 1. **尺寸限制**：超过最大尺寸时等比缩放
/// 2. **质量压缩**：使用 JPEG 压缩，默认质量 0.7
///
/// - Note: 使用 `enum` 实现单例模式，避免实例化
enum ImageCompressor: ImageCompressorProtocol {

    // MARK: - Configuration

    /// 默认压缩质量（0.0-1.0）
    static let defaultQuality: CGFloat = 0.7

    /// 默认最大尺寸（像素）
    static let defaultMaxDimension: CGFloat = 2048

    // MARK: - Public API

    /// 压缩图片
    ///
    /// 如果图片尺寸超过最大限制，会先等比缩放再压缩。
    ///
    /// - Parameters:
    ///   - image: 原始图片
    ///   - quality: JPEG 压缩质量，默认 0.7
    ///   - maxDimension: 最大边长（像素），默认 2048
    /// - Returns: 压缩后的 JPEG 数据，失败返回 nil
    static func compress(
        _ image: UIImage,
        quality: CGFloat = defaultQuality,
        maxDimension: CGFloat = defaultMaxDimension
    ) -> Data? {
        let resized = resize(image, maxDimension: maxDimension)
        return resized.jpegData(compressionQuality: quality)
    }

    /// 仅缩放图片（不压缩）
    ///
    /// - Parameters:
    ///   - image: 原始图片
    ///   - maxDimension: 最大边长（像素）
    /// - Returns: 缩放后的图片
    static func resize(_ image: UIImage, maxDimension: CGFloat) -> UIImage {
        let size = image.size

        // 如果尺寸已在限制内，直接返回
        guard size.width > maxDimension || size.height > maxDimension else {
            return image
        }

        // 计算缩放比例
        let scale = min(maxDimension / size.width, maxDimension / size.height)
        let newSize = CGSize(
            width: size.width * scale,
            height: size.height * scale
        )

        // 使用现代 API 绘制
        let renderer = UIGraphicsImageRenderer(size: newSize)
        return renderer.image { _ in
            image.draw(in: CGRect(origin: .zero, size: newSize))
        }
    }

    /// 估算压缩后的文件大小（KB）
    ///
    /// - Parameters:
    ///   - image: 图片
    ///   - quality: 压缩质量
    /// - Returns: 估算的文件大小（KB）
    static func estimateSize(_ image: UIImage, quality: CGFloat = defaultQuality) -> Int {
        guard let data = image.jpegData(compressionQuality: quality) else { return 0 }
        return data.count / 1024
    }
}

//
//  Logger+Extensions.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  统一日志记录
//

import OSLog

// MARK: - Logger Extensions

extension Logger {
    
    /// 日志子系统
    private static let subsystem = Bundle.main.bundleIdentifier ?? "com.notbad.app"
    
    // MARK: - Categories
    
    /// 应用生命周期日志
    static let app = Logger(subsystem: subsystem, category: "App")
    
    /// 数据操作日志
    static let data = Logger(subsystem: subsystem, category: "Data")
    
    /// UI 交互日志
    static let ui = Logger(subsystem: subsystem, category: "UI")
    
    /// 网络请求日志
    static let network = Logger(subsystem: subsystem, category: "Network")
    
    /// 相机/扫描日志
    static let camera = Logger(subsystem: subsystem, category: "Camera")
    
    /// OCR 识别日志
    static let ocr = Logger(subsystem: subsystem, category: "OCR")
    
    /// 导出功能日志
    static let export = Logger(subsystem: subsystem, category: "Export")
    
    /// Widget 日志
    static let widget = Logger(subsystem: subsystem, category: "Widget")
    
    /// iCloud 同步日志
    static let sync = Logger(subsystem: subsystem, category: "Sync")
    
    /// AI 分析日志
    static let ai = Logger(subsystem: subsystem, category: "AI")
}

// MARK: - Convenience Methods

extension Logger {
    
    /// 记录操作开始
    func operationStarted(_ operation: String) {
        self.info("▶️ \(operation, privacy: .public) started")
    }
    
    /// 记录操作完成
    func operationCompleted(_ operation: String, duration: TimeInterval? = nil) {
        if let duration = duration {
            self.info("✅ \(operation, privacy: .public) completed in \(String(format: "%.2f", duration))s")
        } else {
            self.info("✅ \(operation, privacy: .public) completed")
        }
    }
    
    /// 记录操作失败
    func operationFailed(_ operation: String, error: Error) {
        self.error("❌ \(operation, privacy: .public) failed: \(error.localizedDescription, privacy: .public)")
    }
    
    /// 记录用户操作
    func userAction(_ action: String) {
        self.info("👆 User: \(action, privacy: .public)")
    }
    
    /// 记录数据变更
    func dataChanged(_ description: String, count: Int? = nil) {
        if let count = count {
            self.info("📊 Data: \(description, privacy: .public) (count: \(count))")
        } else {
            self.info("📊 Data: \(description, privacy: .public)")
        }
    }
}

            ["诗词", "鉴赏", "意象"],
            ["阅读", "理解", "分析"],
            ["写作", "议论文"]
        ],
        .english: [
            ["语法", "时态"],
            ["阅读", "理解"],
            ["写作", "表达"],
            ["词汇", "辨析"]
        ],
        .physics: [
            ["力学", "牛顿定律"],
            ["电学", "电场"],
            ["磁学", "电磁感应"],
            ["光学", "干涉"]
        ],
        .chemistry: [
            ["有机", "反应类型"],
            ["无机", "元素"],
            ["电化学", "原电池"]
        ]
    ]
    
    /// 笔记样本
    private static let noteSamples = [
        "注意审题，看清条件",
        "这类题目容易忘记讨论特殊情况",
        "公式要记牢，推导过程要熟练",
        "计算要仔细，避免粗心错误",
        "解题思路：先分析，再计算",
        "易错点：符号容易搞错",
        "关键步骤不能省略",
        "画图辅助理解",
        "",
        ""
    ]
    
    // MARK: - Generation
    
    /// 生成测试数据
    /// - Parameters:
    ///   - count: 生成数量
    ///   - context: SwiftData 上下文
    static func generate(count: Int, in context: ModelContext) {
        let subjects: [Subject] = [.math, .chinese, .english, .physics, .chemistry]
        let grades: [Grade] = [.grade7, .grade8, .grade9, .grade10, .grade11, .grade12]
        let difficulties = Difficulty.allCases
        let sources = Source.allCases
        let errorTypes = ErrorType.allCases
        let questionTypes = ReviewItemType.allCases
        let masteryLevels = MasteryLevel.allCases
        
        for i in 0..<count {
            let subject = subjects.randomElement()!
            let grade = grades.randomElement()!
            let difficulty = difficulties.randomElement()!
            let source = sources.randomElement()!
            let errorType = errorTypes.randomElement()!
            let questionType = questionTypes.randomElement()!
            let mastery = masteryLevels.randomElement()!
            
            // 根据学科选择标题
            let title = titleFor(subject: subject, index: i)
            
            // 随机知识点
            let knowledgePoints = knowledgePointsFor(subject: subject)
            
            // 随机笔记
            let note = noteSamples.randomElement()!
            
            // 随机创建时间（过去 180 天内）
            let daysAgo = Int.random(in: 0...180)
            let createdAt = Calendar.current.date(byAdding: .day, value: -daysAgo, to: Date())!
            
            // 随机复习次数
            let reviewCount = Int.random(in: 0...10)
            
            let item = ReviewItem(
                imageData: nil,
                title: title,
                note: note,
                createdAt: createdAt,
                mastery: mastery,
                subject: subject,
                grade: grade,
                knowledgePoints: knowledgePoints,
                difficulty: difficulty,
                errorType: errorType,
                source: source,
                questionType: questionType
            )
            
            // 设置复习次数
            item.reviewCount = reviewCount
            
            // 设置下次复习时间
            let nextReviewDays = Int.random(in: -7...30)
            item.nextReviewDate = Calendar.current.date(byAdding: .day, value: nextReviewDays, to: Date())!
            
            context.insert(item)
            
            // 每 500 条保存一次，避免内存压力
            if i % 500 == 0 && i > 0 {
                try? context.save()
                print("Generated \(i) items...")
            }
        }
        
        try? context.save()
        print("✅ Generated \(count) test items")
    }
    
    /// 根据学科获取标题
    private static func titleFor(subject: Subject, index: Int) -> String {
        let titles: [String]
        switch subject {
        case .math:
            titles = mathTitles
        case .chinese:
            titles = chineseTitles
        case .english:
            titles = englishTitles
        case .physics:
            titles = physicsTitles
        case .chemistry:
            titles = chemistryTitles
        default:
            titles = mathTitles
        }
        
        let baseTitle = titles[index % titles.count]
        let variant = index / titles.count + 1
        return variant > 1 ? "\(baseTitle) (\(variant))" : baseTitle
    }
    
    /// 根据学科获取知识点
    private static func knowledgePointsFor(subject: Subject) -> KnowledgePoints {
        if let samples = knowledgePointSamples[subject] {
            let points = samples.randomElement() ?? []
            return KnowledgePoints(points)
        }
        return .empty
    }
    
    /// 清除所有测试数据
    static func clearAll(in context: ModelContext) {
        do {
            try context.delete(model: ReviewItem.self)
            try context.save()
            print("✅ Cleared all test data")
        } catch {
            print("❌ Failed to clear data: \(error)")
        }
    }
}

#endif

//
//  SearchHistoryManager.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  搜索历史管理器
//

import SwiftUI
import Observation

// MARK: - SearchHistoryManager

/// 搜索历史管理器
///
/// 负责管理用户的搜索历史记录，支持添加、删除和清空操作。
///
/// ## 功能特性
///
/// - 最多保存 10 条搜索历史
/// - 自动去重（相同关键词不重复添加）
/// - 新搜索置顶
/// - 数据持久化到 UserDefaults
///
/// ## 使用示例
///
/// ```swift
/// // 添加搜索记录
/// SearchHistoryManager.shared.addSearch("数学")
///
/// // 获取历史记录
/// let history = SearchHistoryManager.shared.searchHistory
///
/// // 删除单条记录
/// SearchHistoryManager.shared.removeSearch("数学")
///
/// // 清空所有记录
/// SearchHistoryManager.shared.clearHistory()
/// ```
@MainActor
@Observable
final class SearchHistoryManager {
    
    // MARK: - Singleton
    
    /// 单例实例
    static let shared = SearchHistoryManager()
    
    // MARK: - Constants
    
    /// 最大历史记录数量
    private let maxHistoryCount = 10
    
    /// UserDefaults 键
    private let historyKey = "search_history"
    
    // MARK: - Properties
    
    /// 搜索历史记录
    private(set) var searchHistory: [String] = []
    
    // MARK: - Initialization
    
    private init() {
        loadHistory()
    }
    
    // MARK: - Public Methods
    
    /// 添加搜索记录
    ///
    /// - Parameter query: 搜索关键词
    ///
    /// 自动去重，相同关键词会移到顶部而不是重复添加。
    /// 超过最大数量时自动删除最旧的记录。
    func addSearch(_ query: String) {
        let trimmed = query.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
        guard !trimmed.isEmpty else { return }
        
        // 移除已存在的相同记录
        searchHistory.removeAll { $0 == trimmed }
        
        // 添加到顶部
        searchHistory.insert(trimmed, at: 0)
        
        // 限制数量
        if searchHistory.count > maxHistoryCount {
            searchHistory = Array(searchHistory.prefix(maxHistoryCount))
        }
        
        saveHistory()
    }
    
    /// 删除搜索记录
    ///
    /// - Parameter query: 要删除的关键词
    func removeSearch(_ query: String) {
        searchHistory.removeAll { $0 == query }
        saveHistory()
    }
    
    /// 清空所有搜索历史
    func clearHistory() {
        searchHistory.removeAll()
        saveHistory()
    }
    
    // MARK: - Private Methods
    
    /// 加载历史记录
    private func loadHistory() {
        if let history = UserDefaults.standard.stringArray(forKey: historyKey) {
            searchHistory = history
        }
    }
    
    /// 保存历史记录
    private func saveHistory() {
        UserDefaults.standard.set(searchHistory, forKey: historyKey)
    }
}

//
//  SmartAnalysisService.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  使用 Apple Intelligence 进行智能分析
//

import Foundation
import FoundationModels

// MARK: - SmartAnalysisResult

/// 智能分析结果
struct SmartAnalysisResult: Sendable {
    /// 建议的标题
    let suggestedTitle: String
    
    /// 建议的科目
    let suggestedSubject: Subject
    
    /// 分析置信度 (0-1)
    let confidence: Double
    
    /// 是否需要用户确认
    var needsConfirmation: Bool {
        confidence < 0.8
    }
}

// MARK: - SubjectAnalysisSchema

/// 科目分析结果的结构化输出
@Generable
struct SubjectAnalysisSchema {
    /// 建议的科目代码
    @Guide(description: "根据题目内容分析最可能的科目。必须是以下之一：chinese（语文）、english（英语）、math（数学）、physics（物理）、chemistry（化学）、biology（生物）、science（科学）、history（历史）、geography（地理）、politics（政治）、ethics（道德与法治）、information_tech（信息技术）、general_tech（通用技术）、other（其他）")
    var subjectCode: String
    
    /// 建议的标题（简洁概括题目要点，不超过30字）
    @Guide(description: "根据题目内容生成一个简洁的标题，概括题目的核心知识点或主题，不超过30个字符")
    var suggestedTitle: String
    
    /// 置信度 (0-100)
    @Guide(description: "对科目判断的置信度，0-100之间的整数")
    var confidencePercent: Int
}

// MARK: - SmartAnalysisService

/// 智能分析服务
///
/// 使用 Apple Intelligence Foundation Models 进行端侧智能分析：
/// - 自动识别题目所属科目
/// - 生成简洁的题目标题
///
/// ## 功能特性
///
/// - 完全端侧处理，保护隐私
/// - 支持中文题目分析
/// - 结构化输出，便于直接使用
///
/// ## 使用示例
///
/// ```swift
/// let service = SmartAnalysisService.shared
///
/// if await service.isAvailable {
///     let result = try await service.analyze(text: "求证：勾股定理...")
///     print("建议科目: \(result.suggestedSubject.displayName)")
///     print("建议标题: \(result.suggestedTitle)")
/// }
/// ```
@MainActor
final class SmartAnalysisService {
    
    // MARK: - Singleton
    
    /// 共享实例
    static let shared = SmartAnalysisService()
    
    // MARK: - Properties
    
    /// 系统语言模型
    private let model = SystemLanguageModel.default
    
    /// 语言模型会话
    private var session: LanguageModelSession?
    
    // MARK: - Initialization
    
    private init() {}
    
    // MARK: - Availability
    
    /// 检查服务是否可用
    var isAvailable: Bool {
        model.isAvailable
    }
    
    /// 可用性状态
    var availability: SystemLanguageModel.Availability {
        model.availability
    }
    
    /// 不可用的原因
    var unavailableReason: String? {
        switch model.availability {
        case .available:
            return nil
        case .unavailable(.deviceNotEligible):
            return String(localized: "smart_analysis_unavailable_device")
        case .unavailable(.appleIntelligenceNotEnabled):
            return String(localized: "smart_analysis_unavailable_not_enabled")
        case .unavailable(.modelNotReady):
            return String(localized: "smart_analysis_unavailable_not_ready")
        case .unavailable:
            return String(localized: "smart_analysis_error_unavailable")
        }
    }
    
    // MARK: - Analysis
    
    /// 分析题目内容
    ///
    /// - Parameter text: 题目文本内容
    /// - Returns: 分析结果，包含建议的科目和标题
    /// - Throws: 分析失败时抛出错误
    func analyze(text: String) async throws -> SmartAnalysisResult {
        guard isAvailable else {
            throw SmartAnalysisError.serviceUnavailable
        }
        
        // 创建新的会话
        let instructions = Instructions {
            "你是一个教育领域的专家助手，专门帮助分析学生的作业和试题。"
            "你需要根据题目内容判断它属于哪个学科，并生成简洁的标题。"
            "请始终用中文回复。"
        }
        
        let session = LanguageModelSession(instructions: instructions)
        
        // 截取前500字符进行分析，避免过长
        let analysisText = String(text.prefix(500))
        
        let prompt = """
        请分析以下学生作业题目，判断它属于哪个学科，并生成一个简洁的标题。
        
        题目内容：
        \(analysisText)
        
        请根据题目的专业术语、公式、问题类型等特征进行判断。
        """
        
        let response = try await session.respond(
            to: prompt,
            generating: SubjectAnalysisSchema.self
        )
        
        // 从响应中获取内容
        let content = response.content
        
        // 解析科目
        let subject = Subject(rawValue: content.subjectCode) ?? .other
        
        // 清理标题
        let cleanTitle = content.suggestedTitle
            .trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
            .prefix(50)
        
        return SmartAnalysisResult(
            suggestedTitle: String(cleanTitle),
            suggestedSubject: subject,
            confidence: Double(content.confidencePercent) / 100.0
        )
    }
    
    /// 仅分析科目
    ///
    /// - Parameter text: 题目文本内容
    /// - Returns: 建议的科目
    func analyzeSubject(text: String) async throws -> Subject {
        let result = try await analyze(text: text)
        return result.suggestedSubject
    }
    
    /// 仅生成标题
    ///
    /// - Parameter text: 题目文本内容
    /// - Returns: 建议的标题
    func generateTitle(text: String) async throws -> String {
        let result = try await analyze(text: text)
        return result.suggestedTitle
    }
}

// MARK: - SmartAnalysisError

/// 智能分析错误
enum SmartAnalysisError: LocalizedError {
    case serviceUnavailable
    case sessionCreationFailed
    case analysisTimeout
    case invalidResponse
    
    var errorDescription: String? {
        switch self {
        case .serviceUnavailable:
            return String(localized: "smart_analysis_error_unavailable")
        case .sessionCreationFailed:
            return String(localized: "smart_analysis_error_session")
        case .analysisTimeout:
            return String(localized: "smart_analysis_error_timeout")
        case .invalidResponse:
            return String(localized: "smart_analysis_error_invalid")
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Add Review Item Intent

///
/// 返回今日的复习统计信息。

    static let title: LocalizedStringResource = "shortcut_today_stats_intent_title"
    static let description: IntentDescription = "shortcut_today_stats_intent_description"
    
    func perform() async throws -> some IntentResult & ReturnsValue<String> {
        // 从 UserDefaults 获取 Widget 共享数据
        let sharedDefaults = UserDefaults(suiteName: "group.com.notbad.app")
        
        let totalCount = sharedDefaults?.integer(forKey: "widget_total_count") ?? 0
        let masteredCount = sharedDefaults?.integer(forKey: "widget_mastered_count") ?? 0
        let pendingCount = sharedDefaults?.integer(forKey: "widget_pending_count") ?? 0
        let todayReviewedCount = sharedDefaults?.integer(forKey: "widget_today_reviewed") ?? 0
        
        let stats = String(format: String(localized: "shortcut_stats_result"),
                          totalCount, masteredCount, pendingCount, todayReviewedCount)
        
        return .result(value: stats)
    }
}

// FILE PATH: NotBad/Infrastructure/Export/PDFExportService.swift

//
//  PDFExportService.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  Created for NotBad K12 错题本
//

import UIKit
import PDFKit

// MARK: - PDFExportService

/// PDF 导出服务
///
/// 将错题导出为学校试卷风格的可打印 PDF 文件。
@MainActor
final class PDFExportService: PDFExportServiceProtocol {
    
    // MARK: - Singleton
    
    static let shared = PDFExportService()
    private init() {}
    
    // MARK: - Configuration
    
    /// PDF 页面尺寸 (A4)
    private let pageSize = CGSize(width: 595.2, height: 841.8) // A4 at 72 DPI
    
    /// 页面边距
    private let margin: CGFloat = 50
    
    /// 内容区域
    private var contentRect: CGRect {
        CGRect(
            x: margin,
            y: margin + 30, // 留出页眉空间
            width: pageSize.width - margin * 2,
            height: pageSize.height - margin * 2 - 50 // 留出页脚空间
        )
    }
    
    /// 当前页码
    private var currentPageNumber = 0
    
    /// 学科序号映射
    private var subjectIndexMap: [String: Int] = [:]
    
    // MARK: - Export Methods
    
    /// 导出错题为 PDF（学校试卷风格）
    /// - Parameters:
    ///   - items: 要导出的错题列表
    ///   - title: PDF 标题
    ///   - includeImages: 是否包含图片
    ///   - includeNotes: 是否包含笔记
    ///   - showAnswerArea: 是否显示答题区域
    /// - Returns: PDF 数据
    func exportToPDF(
        items: [ReviewItem],
        title: String = "错题集",
        includeImages: Bool = true,
        includeNotes: Bool = false,
        showAnswerArea: Bool = true
    ) -> Data {
        currentPageNumber = 0
        subjectIndexMap = [:]
        
        let renderer = UIGraphicsPDFRenderer(bounds: CGRect(origin: .zero, size: pageSize))
        
        let data = renderer.pdfData { context in
            var currentY: CGFloat = 0
            
            // 开始第一页
            beginNewPage(context: context, cgContext: context.cgContext)
            currentY = drawExamHeader(context: context.cgContext, title: title, itemCount: items.count)
            
            // 按学科分组
            let groupedItems = Dictionary(grouping: items) { $0.subject.displayName }
            let sortedSubjects = groupedItems.keys.sorted()
            
            // 建立学科序号映射
            for (index, subject) in sortedSubjects.enumerated() {
                subjectIndexMap[subject] = index
            }
            
            var globalIndex = 1
            
            for subject in sortedSubjects {
                guard let subjectItems = groupedItems[subject] else { continue }
                
                // 学科大题标题
                if currentY + 80 > contentRect.maxY {
                    beginNewPage(context: context, cgContext: context.cgContext)
                    currentY = contentRect.minY
                }
                currentY = drawSectionHeader(context: context.cgContext, subject: subject, y: currentY)
                
                // 错题内容
                for item in subjectItems {
                    let estimatedHeight = estimateItemHeight(item, includeImages: includeImages, includeNotes: includeNotes, showAnswerArea: showAnswerArea)
                    
                    if currentY + estimatedHeight > contentRect.maxY {
                        beginNewPage(context: context, cgContext: context.cgContext)
                        currentY = contentRect.minY
                    }
                    
                    currentY = drawExamItem(
                        context: context.cgContext,
                        item: item,
                        index: globalIndex,
                        y: currentY,
                        includeImages: includeImages,
                        includeNotes: includeNotes,
                        showAnswerArea: showAnswerArea
                    )
                    globalIndex += 1
                }
                
                currentY += 15
            }
        }
        
        return data
    }
    
    // MARK: - Page Management
    
    /// 开始新页面
    private func beginNewPage(context: UIGraphicsPDFRendererContext, cgContext: CGContext) {
        context.beginPage()
        currentPageNumber += 1
        drawPageBorder(context: cgContext)
        drawPageFooter(context: cgContext)
    }
    
    /// 绘制页面边框（试卷风格）
    private func drawPageBorder(context: CGContext) {
        // 外边框
        context.setStrokeColor(UIColor.black.cgColor)
        context.setLineWidth(2)
        let outerRect = CGRect(x: 30, y: 30, width: pageSize.width - 60, height: pageSize.height - 60)
        context.stroke(outerRect)
        
        // 装订线提示（左侧）
        let bindingAttributes: [NSAttributedString.Key: Any] = [
            .font: UIFont.systemFont(ofSize: 8, weight: .light),
            .foregroundColor: UIColor.gray
        ]
        let bindingText = "← 装订线 →"
        let bindingString = NSAttributedString(string: bindingText, attributes: bindingAttributes)
        
        // 旋转绘制装订线文字
        context.saveGState()
        context.translateBy(x: 18, y: pageSize.height / 2 + 30)
        context.rotate(by: -.pi / 2)
        bindingString.draw(at: .zero)
        context.restoreGState()
    }
    
    /// 绘制页脚
    private func drawPageFooter(context: CGContext) {
        let footerY = pageSize.height - 40
        
        // 页码
        let pageAttributes: [NSAttributedString.Key: Any] = [
            .font: UIFont.systemFont(ofSize: 10, weight: .regular),
            .foregroundColor: UIColor.darkGray
        ]
        let pageText = "第 \(currentPageNumber) 页"
        let pageString = NSAttributedString(string: pageText, attributes: pageAttributes)
        let pageTextSize = pageString.size()
        let pageX = (self.pageSize.width - pageTextSize.width) / 2
        pageString.draw(at: CGPoint(x: pageX, y: footerY))
        
        // 底部提示
        let tipText = "NotBad 错题本 · 智能复习，高效学习"
        let tipAttributes: [NSAttributedString.Key: Any] = [
            .font: UIFont.systemFont(ofSize: 8, weight: .light),
            .foregroundColor: UIColor.lightGray
        ]
        let tipString = NSAttributedString(string: tipText, attributes: tipAttributes)
        tipString.draw(at: CGPoint(x: margin, y: footerY))
    }
    
    // MARK: - Drawing Methods
    
    /// 绘制试卷头部
    private func drawExamHeader(context: CGContext, title: String, itemCount: Int) -> CGFloat {
        var y = contentRect.minY
        
        // 学校名称区域（虚线框）
        context.setStrokeColor(UIColor.lightGray.cgColor)
        context.setLineWidth(0.5)
        context.setLineDash(phase: 0, lengths: [3, 3])
        let schoolRect = CGRect(x: margin, y: y, width: 200, height: 25)
        context.stroke(schoolRect)
        context.setLineDash(phase: 0, lengths: [])
        
        let schoolHintAttributes: [NSAttributedString.Key: Any] = [
            .font: UIFont.systemFont(ofSize: 9, weight: .light),
            .foregroundColor: UIColor.lightGray
        ]
        let schoolHint = NSAttributedString(string: "学校：________________", attributes: schoolHintAttributes)
        schoolHint.draw(at: CGPoint(x: margin + 5, y: y + 5))
        
        // 班级姓名区域
        let nameHint = NSAttributedString(string: "班级：_______ 姓名：_______", attributes: schoolHintAttributes)
        nameHint.draw(at: CGPoint(x: pageSize.width - margin - 180, y: y + 5))
        
        y += 40
        
        // 试卷标题（大号加粗居中）
        let titleAttributes: [NSAttributedString.Key: Any] = [
            .font: UIFont.systemFont(ofSize: 24, weight: .bold),
            .foregroundColor: UIColor.black
        ]
        let titleString = NSAttributedString(string: title, attributes: titleAttributes)
        let titleSize = titleString.size()
        let titleX = (pageSize.width - titleSize.width) / 2
        titleString.draw(at: CGPoint(x: titleX, y: y))
        y += 35
        
        // 副标题
        let dateFormatter = DateFormatter()
        dateFormatter.dateFormat = "yyyy年MM月dd日"
        let dateString = dateFormatter.string(from: Date())
        
        let subtitleAttributes: [NSAttributedString.Key: Any] = [
            .font: UIFont.systemFont(ofSize: 11, weight: .regular),
            .foregroundColor: UIColor.darkGray
        ]
        let subtitle = "（共 \(itemCount) 题）"
        let subtitleString = NSAttributedString(string: subtitle, attributes: subtitleAttributes)
        let subtitleSize = subtitleString.size()
        let subtitleX = (pageSize.width - subtitleSize.width) / 2
        subtitleString.draw(at: CGPoint(x: subtitleX, y: y))
        y += 25
        
        // 日期（右对齐）
        let dateAttr = NSAttributedString(string: dateString, attributes: [
            .font: UIFont.systemFont(ofSize: 10, weight: .light),
            .foregroundColor: UIColor.gray
        ])
        let dateSize = dateAttr.size()
        dateAttr.draw(at: CGPoint(x: pageSize.width - margin - dateSize.width, y: y - 20))
        
        // 注意事项框
        y += 5
        context.setStrokeColor(UIColor.black.cgColor)
        context.setLineWidth(1)
        let noticeRect = CGRect(x: margin, y: y, width: contentRect.width, height: 45)
        context.stroke(noticeRect)
        
        let noticeTitle: [NSAttributedString.Key: Any] = [
            .font: UIFont.systemFont(ofSize: 10, weight: .semibold),
            .foregroundColor: UIColor.black
        ]
        let noticeHeader = NSAttributedString(string: "【注意事项】", attributes: noticeTitle)
        noticeHeader.draw(at: CGPoint(x: margin + 8, y: y + 5))
        
        let noticeContent: [NSAttributedString.Key: Any] = [
            .font: UIFont.systemFont(ofSize: 9, weight: .regular),
            .foregroundColor: UIColor.darkGray
        ]
        let notice = NSAttributedString(string: "1. 请认真审题，仔细作答。  2. 本试卷为错题巩固练习，请独立完成。  3. 答题时请保持卷面整洁。", attributes: noticeContent)
        notice.draw(at: CGPoint(x: margin + 8, y: y + 22))
        
        y += 55
        
        // 双横线分隔
        context.setStrokeColor(UIColor.black.cgColor)
        context.setLineWidth(1.5)
        context.move(to: CGPoint(x: margin, y: y))
        context.addLine(to: CGPoint(x: pageSize.width - margin, y: y))
        context.strokePath()
        
        context.setLineWidth(0.5)
        context.move(to: CGPoint(x: margin, y: y + 3))
        context.addLine(to: CGPoint(x: pageSize.width - margin, y: y + 3))
        context.strokePath()
        
        y += 15
        
        return y
    }
    
    /// 绘制学科分类标题（大题样式）
    private func drawSectionHeader(context: CGContext, subject: String, y: CGFloat) -> CGFloat {
        var currentY = y + 10
        
        // 大题标题（如：一、数学）
        let sectionNumbers = ["一", "二", "三", "四", "五", "六", "七", "八", "九", "十"]
        let sectionIndex = subjectIndexMap[subject] ?? 0
        let sectionNumber = sectionIndex < sectionNumbers.count ? sectionNumbers[sectionIndex] : "\(sectionIndex + 1)"
        
        let headerAttributes: [NSAttributedString.Key: Any] = [
            .font: UIFont.systemFont(ofSize: 14, weight: .bold),
            .foregroundColor: UIColor.black
        ]
        let headerText = "\(sectionNumber)、\(subject)"
        let headerString = NSAttributedString(string: headerText, attributes: headerAttributes)
        headerString.draw(at: CGPoint(x: margin, y: currentY))
        
        currentY += 28
        return currentY
    }
    
    /// 估算错题高度
    private func estimateItemHeight(_ item: ReviewItem, includeImages: Bool, includeNotes: Bool, showAnswerArea: Bool) -> CGFloat {
        var height: CGFloat = 45 // 基础高度（题号 + 难度标签）
        
        // 题目内容高度
        let contentHeight = estimateTextHeight(item.title, width: contentRect.width - 40, fontSize: 11)
        height += min(contentHeight, 80) + 10
        
        // 图片高度
        if includeImages && item.imageData != nil {
            height += 100
        }
        
        // 笔记高度
        if includeNotes && !item.note.isEmpty {
            let notesHeight = estimateTextHeight(item.note, width: contentRect.width - 60, fontSize: 10)
            height += min(notesHeight, 50) + 25
        }
        
        // 答题区域
        if showAnswerArea {
            height += 80
        }
        
        return height + 15
    }
    
    /// 绘制单个错题（试卷题目样式）
    private func drawExamItem(
        context: CGContext,
        item: ReviewItem,
        index: Int,
        y: CGFloat,
        includeImages: Bool,
        includeNotes: Bool,
        showAnswerArea: Bool
    ) -> CGFloat {
        var currentY = y
        
        // 题号（加粗）+ 难度标签
        let indexAttributes: [NSAttributedString.Key: Any] = [
            .font: UIFont.systemFont(ofSize: 12, weight: .bold),
            .foregroundColor: UIColor.black
        ]
        let indexString = NSAttributedString(string: "\(index). ", attributes: indexAttributes)
        indexString.draw(at: CGPoint(x: margin, y: currentY))
        
        // 难度星级
        let difficultyStars = String(repeating: "★", count: item.difficulty.rawValue + 1) + String(repeating: "☆", count: 4 - item.difficulty.rawValue)
        let difficultyAttributes: [NSAttributedString.Key: Any] = [
            .font: UIFont.systemFont(ofSize: 9, weight: .regular),
            .foregroundColor: UIColor.orange
        ]
        let difficultyString = NSAttributedString(string: "难度: \(difficultyStars)", attributes: difficultyAttributes)
        difficultyString.draw(at: CGPoint(x: pageSize.width - margin - 80, y: currentY + 2))
        
        currentY += 18
        
        // 题目内容（带缩进）
        let contentAttributes: [NSAttributedString.Key: Any] = [
            .font: UIFont.systemFont(ofSize: 11, weight: .regular),
            .foregroundColor: UIColor.black
        ]
        let contentText = item.title.isEmpty ? "（请查看图片）" : item.title
        let contentString = NSAttributedString(string: contentText, attributes: contentAttributes)
        let textContentRect = CGRect(x: margin + 20, y: currentY, width: self.contentRect.width - 40, height: 80)
        contentString.draw(with: textContentRect, options: [.usesLineFragmentOrigin, .truncatesLastVisibleLine], context: nil)
        let contentHeight = min(estimateTextHeight(contentText, width: self.contentRect.width - 40, fontSize: 11), 80)
        currentY += contentHeight + 8
        
        // 知识点标签（如果有）
        if !item.knowledgePoints.isEmpty {
            let tagText = "【知识点】" + item.knowledgePoints.prefix(3).joined(separator: "、")
            let tagAttributes: [NSAttributedString.Key: Any] = [
                .font: UIFont.systemFont(ofSize: 9, weight: .regular),
                .foregroundColor: UIColor.darkGray
            ]
            let tagString = NSAttributedString(string: tagText, attributes: tagAttributes)
            tagString.draw(at: CGPoint(x: margin + 20, y: currentY))
            currentY += 15
        }
        
        // 图片（缩小显示）
        if includeImages, let imageData = item.imageData, let image = UIImage(data: imageData) {
            let maxWidth = self.contentRect.width - 60
            let maxHeight: CGFloat = 85
            let aspectRatio = image.size.width / image.size.height
            var imageWidth = min(maxWidth, 280)
            var imageHeight = imageWidth / aspectRatio
            
            if imageHeight > maxHeight {
                imageHeight = maxHeight
                imageWidth = imageHeight * aspectRatio
            }
            
            // 图片边框
            let imageRect = CGRect(x: margin + 25, y: currentY, width: imageWidth, height: imageHeight)
            context.setStrokeColor(UIColor.lightGray.cgColor)
            context.setLineWidth(0.5)
            context.stroke(imageRect)
            
            image.draw(in: imageRect)
            currentY += imageHeight + 10
        }
        
        // 笔记/解析提示
        if includeNotes && !item.note.isEmpty {
            // 解析标题
            let hintAttributes: [NSAttributedString.Key: Any] = [
                .font: UIFont.systemFont(ofSize: 10, weight: .semibold),
                .foregroundColor: UIColor.systemBlue
            ]
            let hintString = NSAttributedString(string: "【解析提示】", attributes: hintAttributes)
            hintString.draw(at: CGPoint(x: margin + 20, y: currentY))
            currentY += 14
            
            // 解析内容
            let noteAttributes: [NSAttributedString.Key: Any] = [
                .font: UIFont.systemFont(ofSize: 10, weight: .regular),
                .foregroundColor: UIColor.darkGray
            ]
            let noteString = NSAttributedString(string: item.note, attributes: noteAttributes)
            let noteRect = CGRect(x: margin + 20, y: currentY, width: self.contentRect.width - 60, height: 50)
            noteString.draw(with: noteRect, options: [.usesLineFragmentOrigin, .truncatesLastVisibleLine], context: nil)
            let noteHeight = min(estimateTextHeight(item.note, width: self.contentRect.width - 60, fontSize: 10), 50)
            currentY += noteHeight + 8
        }
        
        // 答题区域（带横线）
        if showAnswerArea {
            currentY += 5
            
            let answerLabel: [NSAttributedString.Key: Any] = [
                .font: UIFont.systemFont(ofSize: 10, weight: .medium),
                .foregroundColor: UIColor.gray
            ]
            let answerString = NSAttributedString(string: "答：", attributes: answerLabel)
            answerString.draw(at: CGPoint(x: margin + 20, y: currentY))
            
            // 答题横线
            context.setStrokeColor(UIColor.lightGray.cgColor)
            context.setLineWidth(0.5)
            
            let lineStartX = margin + 45
            let lineEndX = pageSize.width - margin - 20
            
            for i in 0..<3 {
                let lineY = currentY + CGFloat(i) * 22 + 18
                context.move(to: CGPoint(x: lineStartX, y: lineY))
                context.addLine(to: CGPoint(x: lineEndX, y: lineY))
            }
            context.strokePath()
            
            currentY += 70
        }
        
        // 题目分隔（浅色虚线）
        currentY += 5
        context.setStrokeColor(UIColor.lightGray.cgColor)
        context.setLineWidth(0.3)
        context.setLineDash(phase: 0, lengths: [2, 2])
        context.move(to: CGPoint(x: margin + 20, y: currentY))
        context.addLine(to: CGPoint(x: pageSize.width - margin - 20, y: currentY))
        context.strokePath()
        context.setLineDash(phase: 0, lengths: [])
        
        currentY += 12
        
        return currentY
    }
    
    /// 估算文本高度
    private func estimateTextHeight(_ text: String, width: CGFloat, fontSize: CGFloat) -> CGFloat {
        let font = UIFont.systemFont(ofSize: fontSize)
        let attributes: [NSAttributedString.Key: Any] = [.font: font]
        let boundingRect = (text as NSString).boundingRect(
            with: CGSize(width: width, height: .greatestFiniteMagnitude),
            options: [.usesLineFragmentOrigin, .usesFontLeading],
            attributes: attributes,
            context: nil
        )
        return ceil(boundingRect.height)
    }
}

// FILE PATH: NotBad/Infrastructure/Scanner/LiveTextScannerView.swift

//
//  LiveTextScannerView.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  Created for NotBad K12 错题本
//

import SwiftUI
import VisionKit
import OSLog

// MARK: - LiveTextScannerView

/// 实时文字扫描视图
///
/// 基于 VisionKit `DataScannerViewController` 的实时文字扫描功能。
///
/// ## 功能特性
///
/// - 实时文字识别与高亮显示
/// - 支持多文本区域识别
/// - 捏合缩放支持
/// - 引导提示
/// - 完成时自动截取画面保存
///
/// ## 使用示例
///
/// ```swift
/// LiveTextScannerContainer(
///     onResult: { text, imageData in
///         print("识别结果: \(text)")
///     },
///     onCancel: {
///         print("用户取消")
///     }
/// )
/// ```
///
/// - Important: 使用前应通过 `isSupported` 检查设备支持
/// - Note: 需要相机权限
struct LiveTextScannerView: UIViewControllerRepresentable {

    // MARK: - Callbacks

    /// 扫描完成回调（累计文本 + 截图数据）
    let onFinish: (String, Data?) -> Void

    /// 用户取消回调
    let onCancel: () -> Void

    // MARK: - Configuration

    /// 扫描配置
    var configuration: ScannerConfiguration = .default

    // MARK: - UIViewControllerRepresentable

    func makeUIViewController(context: Context) -> DataScannerViewController {
        let scanner = DataScannerViewController(
            recognizedDataTypes: configuration.recognizedDataTypes,
            qualityLevel: configuration.qualityLevel,
            recognizesMultipleItems: configuration.recognizesMultipleItems,
            isHighFrameRateTrackingEnabled: configuration.isHighFrameRateTrackingEnabled,
            isPinchToZoomEnabled: configuration.isPinchToZoomEnabled,
            isGuidanceEnabled: configuration.isGuidanceEnabled,
            isHighlightingEnabled: configuration.isHighlightingEnabled
        )
        scanner.delegate = context.coordinator
        
        // 保存引用到 coordinator
        context.coordinator.scanner = scanner
        
        return scanner
    }

    func updateUIViewController(_ uiViewController: DataScannerViewController, context: Context) {
        // 安全启动扫描
        if !uiViewController.isScanning {
            do {
                try uiViewController.startScanning()
            } catch {
                Logger.camera.error("扫描启动失败: \(error.localizedDescription)")
            }
        }
    }

    func makeCoordinator() -> Coordinator {
        Coordinator(parent: self)
    }

    // MARK: - Coordinator

    /// 协调器，处理 DataScannerViewController 的代理回调
    @MainActor
    final class Coordinator: NSObject, DataScannerViewControllerDelegate {

        private let parent: LiveTextScannerView
        
        /// 使用 item ID 作为 key 存储最新的识别文本，避免重复
        private var recognizedTexts: [RecognizedItem.ID: String] = [:]
        
        var scanner: DataScannerViewController?

        /// 通知观察者令牌
        /// - Note: 标记为 nonisolated(unsafe) 以允许 deinit 访问
        nonisolated(unsafe) private var notificationToken: Any?

        init(parent: LiveTextScannerView) {
            self.parent = parent
            super.init()

            // 监听完成通知 - 使用自身保存的 scanner 引用
            notificationToken = NotificationCenter.default.addObserver(
                forName: .liveScannerFinishRequest,
                object: nil,
                queue: .main
            ) { [weak self] _ in
                MainActor.assumeIsolated {
                    if let scanner = self?.scanner {
                        self?.finishWithCapture(scanner: scanner)
                    } else {
                        self?.finish(imageData: nil)
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        deinit {
            if let token = notificationToken {
                NotificationCenter.default.removeObserver(token)
            }
        }

        // MARK: - DataScannerViewControllerDelegate

        func dataScanner(
            _ dataScanner: DataScannerViewController,
            didAdd addedItems: [RecognizedItem],
            allItems: [RecognizedItem]
        ) {
            processItems(addedItems)
        }

        func dataScanner(
            _ dataScanner: DataScannerViewController,
            didUpdate updatedItems: [RecognizedItem],
            allItems: [RecognizedItem]
        ) {
            // 更新已识别项目的文本（用最新的版本替换）
            processItems(updatedItems)
        }

        func dataScanner(
            _ dataScanner: DataScannerViewController,
            didRemove removedItems: [RecognizedItem],
            allItems: [RecognizedItem]
        ) {
            // 移除不再识别的项目
            for item in removedItems {
                recognizedTexts.removeValue(forKey: item.id)
            }
        }

        func dataScanner(
            _ dataScanner: DataScannerViewController,
            becameUnavailableWithError error: DataScannerViewController.ScanningUnavailable
        ) {
            Logger.camera.error("扫描器不可用: \(error.localizedDescription)")
        }

        // MARK: - Processing

        private func processItems(_ items: [RecognizedItem]) {
            for item in items {
                if case let .text(textItem) = item {
                    let transcript = textItem.transcript.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
                    guard !transcript.isEmpty else { continue }
                    // 使用 item.id 作为 key，同一 ID 的文本会被更新而不是重复添加
                    recognizedTexts[item.id] = transcript
                }
            }
        }

        /// 完成扫描并截取画面
        func finishWithCapture(scanner: DataScannerViewController) {
            // 使用 capturePhoto API 获取相机画面
            Task {
                do {
                    let photo = try await scanner.capturePhoto()
                    let imageData = photo.jpegData(compressionQuality: 0.8)
                    await MainActor.run {
                        finish(imageData: imageData)
                    }
                } catch {
                    Logger.camera.error("截图失败: \(error)")
                    await MainActor.run {
                        finish(imageData: nil)
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        /// 完成扫描并返回结果
        func finish(imageData: Data?) {
            // 合并所有唯一的识别文本
            let uniqueTexts = Array(Set(recognizedTexts.values))
            let merged = uniqueTexts.sorted().joined(separator: "\n")
            
            // 只通过通知返回结果，避免重复回调
            NotificationCenter.default.post(
                name: .liveScannerFinishResponse,
                object: ScannerResult(text: merged, imageData: imageData)
            )
        }

        /// 当前已识别的文本数量
        var collectedCount: Int {
            recognizedTexts.count
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Availability

extension LiveTextScannerView {

    /// 检查设备是否支持实时文字扫描
    static var isSupported: Bool {
        DataScannerViewController.isSupported && DataScannerViewController.isAvailable
    }

    /// 获取不支持的原因
    static var unsupportedReason: String? {
        if !DataScannerViewController.isSupported {
            return String(localized: "scanner_unsupported_device")
        }
        if !DataScannerViewController.isAvailable {
            return String(localized: "scanner_unavailable_permission")
        }
        return nil
    }
}

//
//  ScannerConfiguration.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  扫描器配置模型
//

import VisionKit

// MARK: - ScannerConfiguration

/// 扫描器配置
///
/// 配置实时文字扫描的参数。
///
/// - Note: 由于 `RecognizedDataType` 不是 Sendable，使用 `@unchecked Sendable`
struct ScannerConfiguration: @unchecked Sendable {
    
    /// 识别的数据类型
    let recognizedDataTypes: Set<DataScannerViewController.RecognizedDataType>

    /// 识别质量级别
    let qualityLevel: DataScannerViewController.QualityLevel

    /// 是否识别多个项目
    let recognizesMultipleItems: Bool

    /// 是否启用高帧率追踪
    let isHighFrameRateTrackingEnabled: Bool

    /// 是否启用捏合缩放
    let isPinchToZoomEnabled: Bool

    /// 是否启用引导提示
    let isGuidanceEnabled: Bool

    /// 是否启用高亮显示
    let isHighlightingEnabled: Bool

    /// 默认配置
    static let `default` = ScannerConfiguration(
        recognizedDataTypes: [.text()],
        qualityLevel: .balanced,
        recognizesMultipleItems: true,
        isHighFrameRateTrackingEnabled: false,
        isPinchToZoomEnabled: true,
        isGuidanceEnabled: false,  // 禁用引导，避免自动调整视角
        isHighlightingEnabled: true
    )

    /// 精确配置
    static let accurate = ScannerConfiguration(
        recognizedDataTypes: [.text()],
        qualityLevel: .accurate,
        recognizesMultipleItems: true,
        isHighFrameRateTrackingEnabled: true,
        isPinchToZoomEnabled: true,
        isGuidanceEnabled: true,
        isHighlightingEnabled: true
    )

    /// 快速配置
    static let fast = ScannerConfiguration(
        recognizedDataTypes: [.text()],
        qualityLevel: .fast,
        recognizesMultipleItems: false,
        isHighFrameRateTrackingEnabled: false,
        isPinchToZoomEnabled: true,
        isGuidanceEnabled: false,
        isHighlightingEnabled: true
    )
}

// MARK: - ScannerResult

/// 扫描结果
///
/// 包含识别的文本和截图数据。
struct ScannerResult {
    /// 识别的文本
    let text: String
    
    /// 截图数据（JPEG 格式）
    let imageData: Data?
}

//
//  LiveTextScannerContainer.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  实时扫描容器视图
//

import SwiftUI

// MARK: - LiveTextScannerContainer

/// 实时扫描容器视图
///
/// 封装 `LiveTextScannerView` 并提供控制栏 UI。
///
/// ## 功能特性
///
/// - 扫描状态指示
/// - 完成/取消按钮
/// - 错误提示
///
/// ## 使用示例
///
/// ```swift
/// LiveTextScannerContainer(
///     onResult: { text, imageData in
///         print("识别结果: \(text)")
///     },
///     onCancel: {
///         print("用户取消")
///     }
/// )
/// ```
struct LiveTextScannerContainer: View {

    // MARK: - Environment

    @Environment(\.dismiss) private var dismiss

    // MARK: - Callbacks

    /// 扫描结果回调（文本 + 图片数据）
    let onResult: (String, Data?) -> Void

    /// 取消回调
    let onCancel: () -> Void

    // MARK: - State

    @State private var isSessionStarted = false
    @State private var errorMessage: String?
    @State private var recognizedCount = 0

    // MARK: - Body

    var body: some View {
        ZStack(alignment: .bottom) {
            scannerView
            controlBar
        }
        .alert(
            "scanner_error_title",
            isPresented: Binding(
                get: { errorMessage != nil },
                set: { if !$0 { errorMessage = nil } }
            )
        ) {
            Button("common_confirm") { dismiss() }
        } message: {
            Text(errorMessage ?? "")
        }
        .onReceive(NotificationCenter.default.publisher(for: .liveScannerFinishResponse)) { notification in
            if let result = notification.object as? ScannerResult {
                onResult(result.text, result.imageData)
                dismiss()
            }
        }
    }

    // MARK: - Scanner View

    @ViewBuilder
    private var scannerView: some View {
        LiveTextScannerView(
            onFinish: { _, _ in
                // 结果通过 liveScannerFinishResponse 通知返回，这里不需要处理
            },
            onCancel: {
                onCancel()
                dismiss()
            }
        )
        .ignoresSafeArea()
        .onAppear(perform: startSessionIfPossible)
    }

    // MARK: - Control Bar

    @ViewBuilder
    private var controlBar: some View {
        VStack(spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.md) {
            // 错误提示
            if let errorMessage {
                errorBanner(errorMessage)
            }

            // 识别状态
            statusIndicator

            // 操作按钮
            actionButtons
        }
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
        .padding(.bottom)
    }

    private func errorBanner(_ message: String) -> some View {
        Text(message)
            .font(.caption)
            .foregroundStyle(.white)
            .padding(.horizontal, DesignTokens.Spacing.lg)
            .padding(.vertical, DesignTokens.Spacing.sm)
            .background(Color.brand.error.opacity(0.8), in: Capsule())
    }

    private var statusIndicator: some View {
        HStack(spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.sm) {
            Image(systemName: "text.viewfinder")
                .symbolEffect(.pulse)
            Text("scanner_aim_prompt")
        }
        .font(.subheadline)
        .foregroundStyle(.white)
        .padding(.horizontal, DesignTokens.Spacing.lg)
        .padding(.vertical, DesignTokens.Spacing.sm)
        .background(.black.opacity(0.5), in: Capsule())
    }

    private var actionButtons: some View {
        // 完成按钮（取消按钮已移至导航栏）
        Button {
            requestFinish()
        } label: {
            Label("scanner_finish", systemImage: "checkmark.circle.fill")
                .font(.headline)
                .padding(.horizontal, DesignTokens.Spacing.xl)
                .padding(.vertical, DesignTokens.Spacing.md + 2)
                .background(Color.brand.primary.gradient, in: Capsule())
                .foregroundStyle(.white)
        }
    }

    // MARK: - Actions

    private func startSessionIfPossible() {
        guard !isSessionStarted else { return }
        isSessionStarted = true

        Task { @MainActor in
            guard LiveTextScannerView.isSupported else {
                errorMessage = LiveTextScannerView.unsupportedReason ?? String(localized: "scanner_unsupported_device")
                return
            }
        }
    }

    private func requestFinish() {
        // 发送完成请求，coordinator 会使用自己保存的 scanner 引用截图
        NotificationCenter.default.post(name: .liveScannerFinishRequest, object: nil)
    }
}

// MARK: - Preview

#Preview("扫描器容器") {
    if LiveTextScannerView.isSupported {
        LiveTextScannerContainer(
            onResult: { text, imageData in
                print("识别结果: \(text), 图片: \(imageData?.count ?? 0) bytes")
            },
            onCancel: {
                print("用户取消")
            }
        )
    } else {
        ContentUnavailableView(
            "设备不支持",
            systemImage: "text.viewfinder",
            description: Text(LiveTextScannerView.unsupportedReason ?? "未知原因")
        )
    }
}

        let formatted = Int(value * 100)
        return "\(formatted)%"
    }

    /// 格式化复习进度
    static func reviewProgress(current: Int, total: Int) -> String {
        "\(current)/\(total)"
    }

    /// 格式化天数
    static func daysUntil(_ days: Int) -> String {
        if days == 0 {
            return "今天"
        } else if days == 1 {
            return "明天"
        } else if days < 0 {
            return "已逾期 \(-days) 天"
        } else {
            return "\(days) 天后"
        }
    }
}

//
//  AnalyticsServiceProtocol.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  用户行为埋点服务协议
//  支持未来接入 Firebase Analytics / Mixpanel / 自建后端
//

import Foundation

// MARK: - Analytics Event

/// 埋点事件
public struct AnalyticsEvent: Sendable {
    /// 事件名称
    public let name: String
    /// 事件参数
    public let parameters: [String: String]
    /// 事件时间
    public let timestamp: Date
    
    public init(name: String, parameters: [String: String] = [:]) {
        self.name = name
        self.parameters = parameters
        self.timestamp = Date()
    }
}

// MARK: - Predefined Events

/// 预定义事件名称
public enum AnalyticsEventName {
    // MARK: - 采集相关
    static let captureStarted = "capture_started"
    static let captureCompleted = "capture_completed"
    static let captureOCRUsed = "capture_ocr_used"
    static let captureLiveScanUsed = "capture_live_scan_used"
    
    // MARK: - 题库相关
    static let libraryViewed = "library_viewed"
    static let librarySearched = "library_searched"
    static let libraryFiltered = "library_filtered"
    static let itemViewed = "item_viewed"
    static let itemEdited = "item_edited"
    static let itemDeleted = "item_deleted"
    
    // MARK: - 复习相关
    static let reviewStarted = "review_started"
    static let reviewCompleted = "review_completed"
    static let reviewItemMarked = "review_item_marked"
    static let reviewSkipped = "review_skipped"
    
    // MARK: - 导出相关
    static let exportPDF = "export_pdf"
    static let exportJSON = "export_json"
    static let importData = "import_data"
    
    // MARK: - 应用生命周期
    static let appLaunched = "app_launched"
    static let appBackgrounded = "app_backgrounded"
    static let onboardingCompleted = "onboarding_completed"
}

// MARK: - Analytics Service Protocol

/// 埋点服务协议
/// 遵循协议的服务可以是本地日志、Firebase、Mixpanel 等
@MainActor
public protocol AnalyticsServiceProtocol: Sendable {
    /// 记录事件
    func track(_ event: AnalyticsEvent)
    
    /// 记录事件（便捷方法）
    func track(_ name: String, parameters: [String: String])
    
    /// 设置用户属性
    func setUserProperty(_ value: String, forName name: String)
    
    /// 设置用户 ID（可选，隐私优先可不设置）
    func setUserId(_ userId: String?)
}

// MARK: - Default Implementation

public extension AnalyticsServiceProtocol {
    func track(_ name: String, parameters: [String: String] = [:]) {
        track(AnalyticsEvent(name: name, parameters: parameters))
    }
}

// FILE PATH: NotBad/Infrastructure/Analytics/LocalAnalyticsService.swift
================================================================================

//
//  LocalAnalyticsService.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  本地埋点服务实现
//  将事件记录到 OSLog，用于调试和本地分析
//  未来可替换为 Firebase/Mixpanel 实现
//

import Foundation
import OSLog

// MARK: - Local Analytics Service

/// 本地埋点服务
/// 使用 OSLog 记录事件，便于调试和 Console.app 查看
@MainActor
public final class LocalAnalyticsService: AnalyticsServiceProtocol, @unchecked Sendable {
    
    // MARK: - Singleton
    
    public static let shared = LocalAnalyticsService()
    
    // MARK: - Properties
    
    private let logger = Logger(
        subsystem: Bundle.main.bundleIdentifier ?? "com.notbad.app",
        category: "Analytics"
    )
    
    /// 事件缓存（用于调试查看最近事件）
    private var recentEvents: [AnalyticsEvent] = []
    private let maxRecentEvents = 100
    
    // MARK: - Init
    
    private init() {}
    
    // MARK: - AnalyticsServiceProtocol
    
    public func track(_ event: AnalyticsEvent) {
        // 记录到 OSLog
        let paramsString = event.parameters.isEmpty 
            ? "" 
            : " | \(event.parameters.map { "\($0.key)=\($0.value)" }.joined(separator: ", "))"
        
        logger.info("📈 [\(event.name, privacy: .public)]\(paramsString, privacy: .public)")
        
        // 缓存最近事件
        recentEvents.append(event)
        if recentEvents.count > maxRecentEvents {
            recentEvents.removeFirst()
        }
        
        #if DEBUG
        // Debug 模式下打印到控制台
        print("📈 Analytics: \(event.name)\(paramsString)")
        #endif
    }
    
    public func setUserProperty(_ value: String, forName name: String) {
        logger.info("👤 UserProperty: \(name, privacy: .public) = \(value, privacy: .private)")
    }
    
    public func setUserId(_ userId: String?) {
        if let userId = userId {
            logger.info("👤 UserId set: \(userId, privacy: .private(mask: .hash))")
        } else {
            logger.info("👤 UserId cleared")
        }
    }
    
    // MARK: - Debug Helpers
    
    #if DEBUG
    /// 获取最近事件（仅调试用）
    public var debugRecentEvents: [AnalyticsEvent] {
        recentEvents
    }
    
    /// 清除事件缓存
    public func clearEvents() {
        recentEvents.removeAll()
    }
    #endif
}

// MARK: - Convenience Extensions

public extension LocalAnalyticsService {
    
    // MARK: - 采集事件
    
    func trackCaptureStarted(source: String) {
        track(AnalyticsEventName.captureStarted, parameters: ["source": source])
    }
    
    func trackCaptureCompleted(hasImage: Bool, hasOCR: Bool, subject: String) {
        track(AnalyticsEventName.captureCompleted, parameters: [
            "has_image": String(hasImage),
            "has_ocr": String(hasOCR),
            "subject": subject
        ])
    }
    
    // MARK: - 复习事件
    
    func trackReviewStarted(itemCount: Int) {
        track(AnalyticsEventName.reviewStarted, parameters: ["item_count": String(itemCount)])
    }
    
    func trackReviewCompleted(reviewedCount: Int, duration: TimeInterval) {
        track(AnalyticsEventName.reviewCompleted, parameters: [
            "reviewed_count": String(reviewedCount),
            "duration_seconds": String(Int(duration))
        ])
    }
    
    func trackReviewItemMarked(mastery: String) {
        track(AnalyticsEventName.reviewItemMarked, parameters: ["mastery": mastery])
    }
    
    // MARK: - 题库事件
    
    func trackLibrarySearched(query: String, resultCount: Int) {
        track(AnalyticsEventName.librarySearched, parameters: [
            "query_length": String(query.count),
            "result_count": String(resultCount)
        ])
    }
    
    func trackLibraryFiltered(subject: String?, mastery: String?) {
        var params: [String: String] = [:]
        if let subject = subject { params["subject"] = subject }
        if let mastery = mastery { params["mastery"] = mastery }
        track(AnalyticsEventName.libraryFiltered, parameters: params)
    }
    
    // MARK: - 导出事件
    
    func trackExportPDF(itemCount: Int) {
        track(AnalyticsEventName.exportPDF, parameters: ["item_count": String(itemCount)])
    }
}

//
//  ReviewItemMigrationPlan.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  Created for NotBad K12 错题本
//

import SwiftData
import Foundation

// MARK: - ReviewItemMigrationPlan

/// ReviewItem 数据迁移计划
///
/// 负责管理不同版本之间的 SwiftData 数据迁移，确保用户升级时数据不丢失。
///
/// ## 迁移策略
///
/// SwiftData 提供三种迁移类型：
/// - **轻量级迁移**：自动处理简单的模型变更（添加可选字段、重命名等）
/// - **自定义迁移**：需要手动编写迁移逻辑（复杂的数据转换）
/// - **阶段迁移**：将复杂迁移拆分为多个阶段
///
/// ## 版本历史
///
/// | 版本 | 说明 | 日期 |
/// |------|------|------|
/// | V1 (1.0.0) | 初始版本 | 2025-11 |
///
/// ## 添加新版本的步骤
///
/// 1. 创建新的 `VersionedSchema` 枚举（如 `ReviewItemSchemaV2`）
/// 2. 更新 `schemas` 数组，添加新版本
/// 3. 创建 `MigrationStage`，定义迁移逻辑
/// 4. 将迁移阶段添加到 `stages` 数组
///
/// ## 使用示例
///
/// ```swift
/// // 在 App 入口配置 ModelContainer
/// let container = try ModelContainer(
///     for: ReviewItem.self,
///     migrationPlan: ReviewItemMigrationPlan.self
/// )
/// ```
///
/// - Note: 迁移计划在 App 启动时自动执行
/// - Important: 测试迁移时请使用测试数据，避免损坏生产数据
enum ReviewItemMigrationPlan: SchemaMigrationPlan {

    // MARK: - Schema Versions

    /// 所有版本的 Schema
    ///
    /// 按版本顺序排列，从旧到新。
    /// SwiftData 会根据此数组确定迁移路径。
    static var schemas: [VersionedSchema.Type] {
        [
            ReviewItemSchemaV1.self
            // 未来版本在此添加：
            // ReviewItemSchemaV2.self,
            // ReviewItemSchemaV3.self
        ]
    }

    // MARK: - Migration Stages

    /// 迁移阶段
    ///
    /// 定义版本之间的迁移逻辑。
    /// 空数组表示所有迁移都是轻量级迁移。
    static var stages: [MigrationStage] {
        [
            // 未来添加迁移逻辑：
            // migrateV1toV2
        ]
    }
}

// MARK: - ReviewItemMigrationPlan Future Migrations

extension ReviewItemMigrationPlan {

    // MARK: - Migration Templates

    /*
    /// V1 到 V2 的迁移
    ///
    /// 示例：添加新字段、修改数据格式
    static let migrateV1toV2 = MigrationStage.custom(
        fromVersion: ReviewItemSchemaV1.self,
        toVersion: ReviewItemSchemaV2.self,
        willMigrate: { context in
            // 迁移前的准备工作
            print("📦 准备从 V1 迁移到 V2...")
            
            // 可以在这里备份数据或进行预处理
        },
        didMigrate: { context in
            // 迁移后的清理工作
            print("✅ V1 → V2 迁移完成")
            
            // 可以在这里进行数据验证或后处理
            // 例如：设置新字段的默认值
        }
    )
    */

    /*
    /// V2 到 V3 的轻量级迁移
    ///
    /// 轻量级迁移不需要自定义逻辑
    static let migrateV2toV3 = MigrationStage.lightweight(
        fromVersion: ReviewItemSchemaV2.self,
        toVersion: ReviewItemSchemaV3.self
    )
    */
}

// MARK: - ReviewItemSchemaV1

/// ReviewItem Schema V1
///
/// 初始版本的数据模型定义。
///
/// ## 包含的模型
///
/// - `ReviewItem`：错题实体
///
/// ## 字段列表
///
/// | 字段 | 类型 | 说明 |
/// |------|------|------|
/// | id | UUID | 唯一标识符 |
/// | imageData | Data? | 错题图片 |
/// | title | String | 标题 |
/// | note | String | 笔记 |
/// | createdAt | Date | 创建时间 |
/// | updatedAt | Date | 更新时间 |
/// | masteryLevel | Int | 掌握程度 |
/// | nextReviewDate | Date | 下次复习时间 |
/// | reviewCount | Int | 复习次数 |
/// | subjectRaw | String | 学科 |
/// | gradeRaw | String | 年级 |
/// | knowledgePointsRaw | String | 知识点 |
/// | difficultyRaw | Int | 难度 |
/// | errorTypeRaw | String | 错误类型 |
/// | sourceRaw | String | 来源 |
/// | questionTypeRaw | String | 题型 |
enum ReviewItemSchemaV1: VersionedSchema {

    /// 版本标识符
    ///
    /// 格式：(主版本, 次版本, 修订版本)
    /// 使用 `nonisolated(unsafe)` 以兼容 Swift 6.2 严格并发
    nonisolated(unsafe) static var versionIdentifier = Schema.Version(1, 0, 0)

    /// 此版本包含的持久化模型
    static var models: [any PersistentModel.Type] {
        [ReviewItem.self]
    }
}

// FILE PATH: NotBad/Data/Repository/ReviewItemRepository.swift
