//
//  ReviewItemRepository.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  Created for NotBad K12 错题本
//

import Foundation
import SwiftData

// MARK: - ReviewItemRepository

/// 错题仓库实现
///
/// 基于 SwiftData 的具体存储实现。
///
/// ## 职责
///
/// - 封装 SwiftData 的 `ModelContext` 操作
/// - 实现 `ReviewItemRepositoryProtocol` 定义的所有方法
/// - 提供高效的查询和统计功能
///
/// ## 使用示例
///
/// ```swift
/// // 创建仓库实例
/// let repository = ReviewItemRepository(modelContext: modelContext)
///
/// // 获取需要复习的错题
/// let reviewItems = repository.fetchForReview()
///
/// // 保存新错题
/// let newItem = ReviewItem(title: "新错题", subject: .math)
/// try repository.save(newItem)
/// ```
///
/// - Note: 所有操作都在 `@MainActor` 上下文中执行
/// - Important: 确保 `modelContext` 的生命周期正确管理
@MainActor
final class ReviewItemRepository: ReviewItemRepositoryProtocol {

    // MARK: - Properties

    /// SwiftData 模型上下文
    private let modelContext: ModelContext

    // MARK: - Initialization

    /// 创建仓库实例
    ///
    /// - Parameter modelContext: SwiftData 模型上下文
    init(modelContext: ModelContext) {
        self.modelContext = modelContext
    }

    // MARK: - Fetch All

    /// 获取所有错题
    ///
    /// 按创建时间降序排列（最新的在前）。
    func fetchAll() -> [ReviewItem] {
        let descriptor = FetchDescriptor<ReviewItem>(
            sortBy: [SortDescriptor(\.createdAt, order: .reverse)]
        )
        return (try? modelContext.fetch(descriptor)) ?? []
    }

    // MARK: - Filtered Fetch

    /// 根据条件筛选错题
    ///
    /// 使用 SwiftData Predicate 进行数据库级查询。
    ///
    /// - Parameters:
    ///   - subject: 学科筛选，为 nil 时不筛选
    ///   - mastery: 掌握程度筛选，为 nil 时不筛选
    ///   - limit: 返回数量限制，默认 200
    /// - Returns: 筛选后的错题列表
    func fetch(subject: Subject?, mastery: MasteryLevel?, limit: Int = 200) -> [ReviewItem] {
        // 根据不同的筛选条件构建 Predicate
        var descriptor: FetchDescriptor<ReviewItem>
        
        if let subject, let mastery {
            let subjectValue = subject.rawValue
            let masteryValue = mastery.rawValue
            let predicate = #Predicate<ReviewItem> { item in
                item.subjectRaw == subjectValue && item.masteryLevel == masteryValue
            }
            descriptor = FetchDescriptor(predicate: predicate, sortBy: [SortDescriptor(\ReviewItem.createdAt, order: .reverse)])
        } else if let subject {
            let subjectValue = subject.rawValue
            let predicate = #Predicate<ReviewItem> { item in
                item.subjectRaw == subjectValue
            }
            descriptor = FetchDescriptor(predicate: predicate, sortBy: [SortDescriptor(\ReviewItem.createdAt, order: .reverse)])
        } else if let mastery {
            let masteryValue = mastery.rawValue
            let predicate = #Predicate<ReviewItem> { item in
                item.masteryLevel == masteryValue
            }
            descriptor = FetchDescriptor(predicate: predicate, sortBy: [SortDescriptor(\ReviewItem.createdAt, order: .reverse)])
        } else {
            descriptor = FetchDescriptor(sortBy: [SortDescriptor(\ReviewItem.createdAt, order: .reverse)])
        }
        
        descriptor.fetchLimit = limit
        return (try? modelContext.fetch(descriptor)) ?? []
    }

    // MARK: - Review Fetch

    /// 获取需要复习的错题
    ///
    /// 使用 SwiftData Predicate 进行数据库级查询。
    ///
    /// 排序规则：
    /// 1. 已逾期的优先（逾期天数多的在前）
    /// 2. 掌握程度低的优先
    /// 3. 复习次数少的优先
    ///
    /// - Parameter limit: 返回数量限制，默认 100
    /// - Returns: 需要复习的错题列表
    func fetchForReview(limit: Int = 100) -> [ReviewItem] {
        let now = Date()
        
        // 使用 Predicate 查询到期需要复习的项目
        let predicate = #Predicate<ReviewItem> { item in
            item.nextReviewDate <= now
        }
        
        // 按复习日期升序（最早到期的在前），然后按掌握程度升序
        var descriptor = FetchDescriptor(
            predicate: predicate,
            sortBy: [
                SortDescriptor(\ReviewItem.nextReviewDate, order: .forward),
                SortDescriptor(\ReviewItem.masteryLevel, order: .forward),
                SortDescriptor(\ReviewItem.reviewCount, order: .forward)
            ]
        )
        descriptor.fetchLimit = limit
        
        let items = (try? modelContext.fetch(descriptor)) ?? []
        
        // 进一步按逾期天数排序（需要计算属性，在内存中处理）
        return items.sorted { item1, item2 in
            let overdue1 = item1.reviewInterval.overdueByDays
            let overdue2 = item2.reviewInterval.overdueByDays
            if overdue1 != overdue2 {
                return overdue1 > overdue2
            }
            if item1.masteryLevel != item2.masteryLevel {
                return item1.masteryLevel < item2.masteryLevel
            }
            return item1.reviewCount < item2.reviewCount
        }
    }

    // MARK: - Search

    /// 搜索错题
    ///
    /// 使用 SwiftData Predicate 进行数据库级搜索，避免内存遍历。
    /// 在标题、笔记、知识点中搜索，不区分大小写。
    ///
    /// - Parameter query: 搜索关键词
    /// - Parameter limit: 最大返回数量，默认 100
    /// - Returns: 匹配的错题列表
    func search(query: String, limit: Int = 100) -> [ReviewItem] {
        let trimmedQuery = query.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
        
        // 空查询返回最近记录，而不是全量
        guard !trimmedQuery.isEmpty else {
            return fetchRecent(limit: limit)
        }

        // 使用 SwiftData Predicate 进行数据库级搜索
        let predicate = #Predicate<ReviewItem> { item in
            item.title.localizedStandardContains(trimmedQuery) ||
            item.note.localizedStandardContains(trimmedQuery) ||
            item.knowledgePointsRaw.localizedStandardContains(trimmedQuery) ||
            item.subjectRaw.localizedStandardContains(trimmedQuery)
        }
        
        var descriptor = FetchDescriptor(predicate: predicate, sortBy: [SortDescriptor(\ReviewItem.createdAt, order: .reverse)])
        descriptor.fetchLimit = limit
        
        return (try? modelContext.fetch(descriptor)) ?? []
    }

    // MARK: - Save Operations

    /// 保存错题
    ///
    /// 如果是新对象会插入，已存在则更新。
    /// 具备幂等性，重复调用不会重复插入。
    func save(_ item: ReviewItem) throws {
        // 只有新对象才需要 insert
        if item.modelContext == nil {
            modelContext.insert(item)
        }
        try modelContext.save()
    }

    // MARK: - Delete Operations

    /// 删除错题
    ///
    /// - Parameter item: 要删除的错题
    /// - Throws: 删除失败时抛出错误
    /// - Note: 安全处理已删除或僵尸对象
    func delete(_ item: ReviewItem) throws {
        // 检查 item 是否已被删除或不在 context 中
        guard !item.isDeleted, let context = item.modelContext else {
            // item 已被删除或不在任何 context 中，跳过
            return
        }
        context.delete(item)
        try context.save()
    }

    /// 批量删除错题
    ///
    /// - Parameter items: 要删除的错题列表
    /// - Returns: 实际删除的数量
    /// - Throws: 删除失败时抛出错误
    @discardableResult
    func delete(_ items: [ReviewItem]) throws -> Int {
        var deletedCount = 0
        for item in items {
            if item.modelContext != nil {
                modelContext.delete(item)
                deletedCount += 1
            }
        }
        if deletedCount > 0 {
            try modelContext.save()
        }
        return deletedCount
    }

    /// 删除所有错题
    ///
    /// - Returns: 删除的错题数量
    /// - Warning: 此操作不可逆
    @discardableResult
    func deleteAll() throws -> Int {
        let items = fetchAll()
        let count = items.count
        
        guard count > 0 else { return 0 }
        
        for item in items {
            modelContext.delete(item)
        }
        try modelContext.save()
        
        return count
    }

    // MARK: - Statistics

    /// 获取完整统计数据
    ///
    /// ⚠️ 此方法会加载所有数据计算统计信息，适合在后台调用或数据量较小时使用。
    /// 对于仅需要计数的场景，请使用 `quickStatistics()` 获取轻量级统计。
    ///
    /// - Returns: 完整统计信息
    func statistics() -> ReviewStatistics {
        ReviewStatistics(from: fetchAll())
    }
    
    /// 获取轻量级统计数据
    ///
    /// 使用 fetchCount 进行高效计数，避免加载全部实体。
    /// 适合首页等需要快速显示统计的场景。
    ///
    /// - Returns: 快速统计信息（总数、待复习数、掌握数）
    func quickStatistics() -> (total: Int, pendingReview: Int, mastered: Int) {
        let total = count()
        
        // 待复习数量
        let now = Date()
        let pendingPredicate = #Predicate<ReviewItem> { item in
            item.nextReviewDate <= now
        }
        let pendingDescriptor = FetchDescriptor(predicate: pendingPredicate)
        let pendingReview = (try? modelContext.fetchCount(pendingDescriptor)) ?? 0
        
        // 已掌握数量 (mastery >= 3, 即 .good 或 .mastered)
        let masteredPredicate = #Predicate<ReviewItem> { item in
            item.masteryLevel >= 3
        }
        let masteredDescriptor = FetchDescriptor(predicate: masteredPredicate)
        let mastered = (try? modelContext.fetchCount(masteredDescriptor)) ?? 0
        
        return (total, pendingReview, mastered)
    }
}

// MARK: - ReviewItemRepository Convenience Methods

extension ReviewItemRepository {

    /// 获取指定 ID 的错题
    ///
    /// 使用 Predicate 进行数据库级查询，避免全量加载。
    ///
    /// - Parameter id: 错题 ID
    /// - Returns: 匹配的错题，如果不存在返回 `nil`
    func fetch(byId id: UUID) -> ReviewItem? {
        let predicate = #Predicate<ReviewItem> { item in
            item.id == id
        }
        var descriptor = FetchDescriptor(predicate: predicate)
        descriptor.fetchLimit = 1
        return try? modelContext.fetch(descriptor).first
    }

    /// 获取最近添加的错题
    ///
    /// 使用 fetchLimit 进行数据库级分页，避免全量加载。
    ///
    /// - Parameter limit: 返回数量限制，默认 50
    /// - Returns: 最近添加的错题列表
    func fetchRecent(limit: Int = 50) -> [ReviewItem] {
        var descriptor = FetchDescriptor<ReviewItem>(
            sortBy: [SortDescriptor(\.createdAt, order: .reverse)]
        )
        descriptor.fetchLimit = limit
        return (try? modelContext.fetch(descriptor)) ?? []
    }

    /// 获取指定学科的错题
    ///
    /// - Parameter subject: 学科
    /// - Parameter limit: 返回数量限制，默认 100
    /// - Returns: 该学科的错题
    func fetch(subject: Subject, limit: Int = 100) -> [ReviewItem] {
        let subjectValue = subject.rawValue
        let predicate = #Predicate<ReviewItem> { item in
            item.subjectRaw == subjectValue
        }
        var descriptor = FetchDescriptor(predicate: predicate, sortBy: [SortDescriptor(\ReviewItem.createdAt, order: .reverse)])
        descriptor.fetchLimit = limit
        return (try? modelContext.fetch(descriptor)) ?? []
    }

    /// 获取指定难度的错题
    ///
    /// - Parameter difficulty: 难度等级
    /// - Parameter limit: 返回数量限制，默认 100
    /// - Returns: 该难度的错题
    func fetch(difficulty: Difficulty, limit: Int = 100) -> [ReviewItem] {
        let difficultyValue = difficulty.rawValue
        let predicate = #Predicate<ReviewItem> { item in
            item.difficultyRaw == difficultyValue
        }
        var descriptor = FetchDescriptor(predicate: predicate, sortBy: [SortDescriptor(\ReviewItem.createdAt, order: .reverse)])
        descriptor.fetchLimit = limit
        return (try? modelContext.fetch(descriptor)) ?? []
    }

    /// 获取指定来源的错题
    ///
    /// - Parameter source: 题目来源
    /// - Parameter limit: 返回数量限制，默认 100
    /// - Returns: 该来源的错题
    func fetch(source: Source, limit: Int = 100) -> [ReviewItem] {
        let sourceValue = source.rawValue
        let predicate = #Predicate<ReviewItem> { item in
            item.sourceRaw == sourceValue
        }
        var descriptor = FetchDescriptor(predicate: predicate, sortBy: [SortDescriptor(\ReviewItem.createdAt, order: .reverse)])
        descriptor.fetchLimit = limit
        return (try? modelContext.fetch(descriptor)) ?? []
    }

    /// 获取高优先级复习项
    ///
    /// 逾期或今天需要复习的错题。
    ///
    /// - Parameter limit: 返回数量限制
    /// - Returns: 高优先级错题列表
    func fetchHighPriority(limit: Int = 20) -> [ReviewItem] {
        Array(fetchForReview().filter { $0.reviewInterval.isUrgent }.prefix(limit))
    }

    /// 判断是否存在指定 ID 的错题
    ///
    /// 使用 Predicate 进行数据库级查询。
    ///
    /// - Parameter id: 错题 ID
    /// - Returns: 是否存在
    func exists(id: UUID) -> Bool {
        fetch(byId: id) != nil
    }
    
    /// 获取错题总数
    ///
    /// 使用 fetchCount 进行高效计数，无需加载实体。
    ///
    /// - Returns: 错题总数
    func count() -> Int {
        let descriptor = FetchDescriptor<ReviewItem>()
        return (try? modelContext.fetchCount(descriptor)) ?? 0
    }
}

//
//  SwiftDataReviewItemProvider.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  Created for NotBad K12 错题本
//  Phase 2: Data Layer Abstraction
//

import Foundation
import SwiftData
import Observation

// MARK: - SwiftDataReviewItemProvider

/// SwiftData 数据提供者实现
///
/// 基于 SwiftData 的 `ReviewItemDataProviding` 具体实现，
/// 为 View 层提供响应式的错题数据访问。
///
/// ## 功能特性
///
/// - 自动从 SwiftData 加载数据
/// - 支持手动刷新
/// - 支持增删改操作
/// - 提供统计信息
///
/// ## 使用示例
///
/// ```swift
/// // 创建实例
/// let provider = SwiftDataReviewItemProvider(modelContext: modelContext)
///
/// // 在 View 中使用
/// struct LibraryView: View {
///     @State private var provider: SwiftDataReviewItemProvider
///
///     var body: some View {
///         List(provider.items) { item in
///             Text(item.title)
///         }
///         .onAppear {
///             provider.refresh()
///         }
///     }
/// }
/// ```
///
/// ## 线程安全
///
/// 所有操作都在 `@MainActor` 上下文中执行，确保与 SwiftUI 的线程一致性。
///
/// - Note: 实例应该在应用启动时创建，并通过环境注入到 View 层
@MainActor
@Observable
final class SwiftDataReviewItemProvider: ReviewItemDataProviding {

    // MARK: - Observable Properties

    /// 所有错题数据（按创建时间倒序）
    private(set) var items: [ReviewItem] = []

    /// 是否正在加载数据
    private(set) var isLoading = false

    /// 最后一次刷新时间
    private(set) var lastRefreshDate: Date?

    // MARK: - Private Properties

    /// SwiftData 模型上下文
    private let modelContext: ModelContext

    /// 底层仓库（复用现有逻辑）
    private let repository: ReviewItemRepository

    // MARK: - Initialization

    /// 创建数据提供者实例
    ///
    /// - Parameter modelContext: SwiftData 模型上下文
    init(modelContext: ModelContext) {
        self.modelContext = modelContext
        self.repository = ReviewItemRepository(modelContext: modelContext)

        // 初始加载数据
        refresh()
    }

    // MARK: - Configuration
    
    /// 默认加载数量限制
    ///
    /// 避免一次性加载过多数据导致内存问题。
    /// 对于 K12 错题本，用户可能积累 2-3 年数据。
    private let defaultFetchLimit = 200
    
    // MARK: - Data Operations

    /// 刷新数据
    ///
    /// 加载最近的错题数据，默认限制 200 条以优化性能。
    /// 如需加载更多，请使用 `loadMore()` 或通过 `@Query` 直接查询。
    ///
    /// - Parameter limit: 加载数量限制，默认 200
    func refresh(limit: Int? = nil) {
        isLoading = true
        defer {
            isLoading = false
            lastRefreshDate = Date()
        }

        items = repository.fetchRecent(limit: limit ?? defaultFetchLimit)
    }

    /// 保存错题
    ///
    /// - Parameter item: 要保存的错题
    /// - Throws: 保存失败时抛出错误
    func save(_ item: ReviewItem) throws {
        try repository.save(item)
        refresh()
    }

    /// 删除错题
    ///
    /// - Parameter item: 要删除的错题
    /// - Throws: 删除失败时抛出错误
    func delete(_ item: ReviewItem) throws {
        try repository.delete(item)
        refresh()
    }

    // MARK: - Query Operations

    /// 获取需要复习的错题
    ///
    /// - Returns: 需要复习的错题列表，按紧迫程度排序
    func fetchForReview() -> [ReviewItem] {
        repository.fetchForReview()
    }

    /// 搜索错题
    ///
    /// - Parameter query: 搜索关键词
    /// - Returns: 匹配的错题列表
    func search(query: String) -> [ReviewItem] {
        repository.search(query: query)
    }

    // MARK: - Statistics

    /// 获取完整统计数据
    ///
    /// ⚠️ 此方法会加载所有数据，适合设置页面等非频繁调用场景。
    ///
    /// - Returns: 完整错题统计信息
    func statistics() -> ReviewStatistics {
        repository.statistics()
    }
    
    /// 获取轻量级统计数据
    ///
    /// 使用 fetchCount 高效计数，适合首页等需要快速显示的场景。
    ///
    /// - Returns: 快速统计信息（总数、待复习数、已掌握数）
    func quickStatistics() -> (total: Int, pendingReview: Int, mastered: Int) {
        repository.quickStatistics()
    }
}

// MARK: - SwiftDataReviewItemProvider Convenience Methods

extension SwiftDataReviewItemProvider {

    /// 获取指定 ID 的错题
    ///
    /// - Parameter id: 错题 ID
    /// - Returns: 匹配的错题，如果不存在返回 `nil`
    func fetch(byId id: UUID) -> ReviewItem? {
        items.first { $0.id == id }
    }

    /// 获取最近添加的错题
    ///
    /// - Parameter limit: 返回数量限制
    /// - Returns: 最近添加的错题列表
    func fetchRecent(limit: Int = 10) -> [ReviewItem] {
        Array(items.prefix(limit))
    }

    /// 获取高优先级复习项
    ///
    /// - Parameter limit: 返回数量限制
    /// - Returns: 高优先级错题列表
    func fetchHighPriority(limit: Int = 20) -> [ReviewItem] {
        Array(fetchForReview().filter { $0.reviewInterval.isUrgent }.prefix(limit))
    }

    /// 获取已逾期的错题
    ///
    /// - Returns: 已逾期的错题列表
    func fetchOverdue() -> [ReviewItem] {
        fetchForReview()
            .filter { $0.isOverdue }
            .sorted { $0.reviewInterval.overdueByDays > $1.reviewInterval.overdueByDays }
    }

    /// 获取本周需要复习的错题
    ///
    /// - Returns: 本周到期的错题列表
    func fetchDueThisWeek() -> [ReviewItem] {
        items.filter { $0.reviewInterval.isDueThisWeek }
    }
}

//
//  Notification+Names.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  Created for NotBad K12 错题本
//

import Foundation

// MARK: - Notification Names

/// 应用通知名称定义
///
/// 集中管理应用内的通知名称，避免字符串硬编码。
///
/// ## 使用示例
///
/// ```swift
/// // 发送通知
/// NotificationCenter.default.post(name: .reviewItemAdded, object: newItem)
///
/// // 监听通知
/// NotificationCenter.default.addObserver(
///     forName: .reviewItemAdded,
///     object: nil,
///     queue: .main
/// ) { notification in
///     // 处理通知
/// }
/// ```
extension Notification.Name {

    // MARK: - App Lifecycle

    /// 应用进入后台
    static let appDidEnterBackground = Notification.Name("notbad.app.didEnterBackground")

    /// 应用进入前台
    static let appDidBecomeActive = Notification.Name("notbad.app.didBecomeActive")

    /// 应用即将终止
    static let appWillTerminate = Notification.Name("notbad.app.willTerminate")

    // MARK: - Review Item Events

    /// 错题已添加
    ///
    /// `object` 为新添加的 `ReviewItem`
    static let reviewItemAdded = Notification.Name("notbad.reviewItem.added")

    /// 错题已更新
    ///
    /// `object` 为更新后的 `ReviewItem`
    static let reviewItemUpdated = Notification.Name("notbad.reviewItem.updated")

    /// 错题已删除
    ///
    /// `object` 为被删除的 `ReviewItem` 的 ID (UUID)
    static let reviewItemDeleted = Notification.Name("notbad.reviewItem.deleted")

    /// 错题批量删除完成
    ///
    /// `userInfo` 包含 `count` (Int) 表示删除数量
    static let reviewItemsBatchDeleted = Notification.Name("notbad.reviewItem.batchDeleted")

    /// 错题数据已变更（用于 Widget 同步）
    ///
    /// 触发 Widget 数据刷新
    static let reviewItemsDidChange = Notification.Name("notbad.reviewItem.didChange")

    // MARK: - Review Session Events

    /// 复习会话开始
    static let reviewSessionStarted = Notification.Name("notbad.review.sessionStarted")

    /// 复习会话完成
    ///
    /// `userInfo` 包含 `statistics` (ReviewSessionStatistics)
    static let reviewSessionCompleted = Notification.Name("notbad.review.sessionCompleted")

    /// 复习会话取消
    static let reviewSessionCancelled = Notification.Name("notbad.review.sessionCancelled")

    // MARK: - Live Scanner Events

    /// 实时扫描完成请求
    static let liveScannerFinishRequest = Notification.Name("notbad.scanner.finishRequest")

    /// 实时扫描完成响应
    ///
    /// `object` 为识别的文本 (String)
    static let liveScannerFinishResponse = Notification.Name("notbad.scanner.finishResponse")

    // MARK: - Data Sync Events

    /// 数据同步开始
    static let dataSyncStarted = Notification.Name("notbad.sync.started")

    /// 数据同步完成
    static let dataSyncCompleted = Notification.Name("notbad.sync.completed")

    /// 数据同步失败
    ///
    /// `userInfo` 包含 `error` (Error)
    static let dataSyncFailed = Notification.Name("notbad.sync.failed")

    // MARK: - Settings Events

    /// 设置已更改
    ///
    /// `userInfo` 包含 `key` (String) 和 `value` (Any)
    static let settingsChanged = Notification.Name("notbad.settings.changed")

    /// 主题已更改
    static let themeChanged = Notification.Name("notbad.settings.themeChanged")
    
    // MARK: - Navigation Events
    
    /// 切换到录入页面
    ///
    /// 从其他页面触发，导航到 Capture Tab
    static let switchToCapture = Notification.Name("notbad.navigation.switchToCapture")
    
    /// 切换到复习页面
    static let switchToReview = Notification.Name("notbad.navigation.switchToReview")
    
    /// 切换到题库页面
    static let switchToLibrary = Notification.Name("notbad.navigation.switchToLibrary")
}

// FILE PATH: NotBad/Domain/Education/EducationSystem.swift

//
//  EducationSystem.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  教育体系抽象协议 - 支持多国K12教育体系
//
//  不同国家的K12教育体系差异：
//  - 中国：小学6年 + 初中3年 + 高中3年 (6-3-3)
//  - 美国：Elementary K-5 + Middle 6-8 + High 9-12 (6-3-4)
//  - 日本：小学校6年 + 中学校3年 + 高等学校3年 (6-3-3)
//  - 韩国：초등학교6年 + 중학교3年 + 고등학교3年 (6-3-3)
//  - 英国：Primary 1-6 + Secondary 7-11 + Sixth Form 12-13 (6-5-2)
//

import Foundation
import SwiftUI

// MARK: - EducationRegion

/// 教育地区
///
/// 定义支持的教育体系地区，每个地区有独特的学制结构。
///
/// ## 支持的地区
/// - ``china``: 中国大陆 (6-3-3学制)
/// - ``usa``: 美国 (K-5, 6-8, 9-12)
/// - ``japan``: 日本 (6-3-3学制)
/// - ``korea``: 韩国 (6-3-3学制)
/// - ``uk``: 英国 (6-5-2学制)
/// - ``singapore``: 新加坡教育体系
/// - ``international``: 国际通用体系
/// - ``custom``: 自定义配置
public enum EducationRegion: String, Sendable, CaseIterable, Codable, Hashable, Identifiable {
    case china = "CN"
    case japan = "JP"
    case korea = "KR"
    case singapore = "SG"
    case international = "INTL"
    case usa = "US"
    case uk = "GB"
    case custom = "CUSTOM"

    public var id: String { rawValue }

    /// 本地化显示名称
    public var displayName: String {
        String(localized: localizationKey)
    }

    private var localizationKey: String.LocalizationValue {
        switch self {
        case .china: "education_region_china"
        case .japan: "education_region_japan"
        case .korea: "education_region_korea"
        case .singapore: "education_region_singapore"
        case .international: "education_region_international"
        case .usa: "education_region_usa"
        case .uk: "education_region_uk"
        case .custom: "education_region_custom"
        }
    }

    /// 地区旗帜 emoji
    public var flag: String {
        switch self {
        case .china: "🇨🇳"
        case .japan: "🇯🇵"
        case .korea: "🇰🇷"
        case .singapore: "🇸🇬"
        case .international: "🌍"
        case .usa: "🇺🇸"
        case .uk: "🇬🇧"
        case .custom: "⚙️"
        }
    }

    /// 应用内置支持的地区（用于 Onboarding 选择）
    public static var builtInRegions: [EducationRegion] {
        [.china, .japan, .korea, .singapore, .international]
    }

    /// 根据设备地区自动检测
    public static func detectFromLocale() -> EducationRegion {
        let regionCode = Locale.current.region?.identifier ?? "CN"
        // 尝试匹配内置地区
        if let matched = EducationRegion(rawValue: regionCode),
           builtInRegions.contains(matched) {
            return matched
        }
        // 未匹配的地区使用国际通用体系
        return .international
    }
}

// MARK: - SchoolLevel

/// 学段/学校级别
///
/// 通用的学段定义，不同教育体系映射到这些通用学段。
public enum SchoolLevel: String, Sendable, CaseIterable, Codable, Hashable, Identifiable {
    /// 小学/Elementary
    case primary
    /// 初中/Middle School
    case middle
    /// 高中/High School
    case high

    public var id: String { rawValue }
}

// MARK: - GradeLevel Protocol

/// 年级协议
///
/// 定义年级必须实现的属性和方法。
public protocol GradeLevelProtocol: Sendable, Hashable, Identifiable, CaseIterable {
    /// 年级唯一标识符
    var id: String { get }
    /// 年级序号（从1开始）
    var order: Int { get }
    /// 所属学段
    var schoolLevel: SchoolLevel { get }
    /// 本地化显示名称
    var displayName: String { get }
    /// 简短标签
    var shortLabel: String { get }
    /// 图标
    var icon: String { get }
    /// 主题颜色
    var color: Color { get }
}

// MARK: - SubjectProtocol

/// 学科协议
///
/// 定义学科必须实现的属性和方法。
public protocol SubjectProtocol: Sendable, Hashable, Identifiable, CaseIterable {
    /// 学科唯一标识符
    var id: String { get }
    /// 本地化显示名称
    var displayName: String { get }
    /// 简短标签
    var shortLabel: String { get }
    /// 学科分类
    var category: any SubjectCategoryProtocol { get }
    /// 适用的学段
    var applicableLevels: [SchoolLevel] { get }
    /// 图标
    var icon: String { get }
    /// 主题颜色
    var color: Color { get }

    /// 是否适用于指定学段
    func isApplicable(for level: SchoolLevel) -> Bool
}

extension SubjectProtocol {
    public func isApplicable(for level: SchoolLevel) -> Bool {
        applicableLevels.contains(level)
    }
}

// MARK: - SubjectCategoryProtocol

/// 学科分类协议
public protocol SubjectCategoryProtocol: Sendable, Hashable, Identifiable {
    var id: String { get }
    var displayName: String { get }
    var icon: String { get }
    var color: Color { get }
}

// MARK: - EducationSystemProtocol

/// 教育体系协议
///
/// 定义完整教育体系必须提供的配置。
///
/// ## 实现示例
/// ```swift
/// struct ChinaEducationSystem: EducationSystemProtocol {
///     let region = EducationRegion.china
///     let grades = ChinaGrade.allCases
///     let subjects = ChinaSubject.allCases
///     // ...
/// }
/// ```
public protocol EducationSystemProtocol: Sendable {
    /// 关联的年级类型
    associatedtype GradeType: GradeLevelProtocol
    /// 关联的学科类型
    associatedtype SubjectType: SubjectProtocol

    /// 教育地区
    var region: EducationRegion { get }

    /// 体系名称
    var name: String { get }

    /// 所有年级
    var grades: [GradeType] { get }

    /// 所有学科
    var subjects: [SubjectType] { get }

    /// 学段配置
    var schoolLevels: [SchoolLevelConfiguration] { get }

    /// 获取指定学段的年级
    func grades(for level: SchoolLevel) -> [GradeType]

    /// 获取指定学段的学科
    func subjects(for level: SchoolLevel) -> [SubjectType]
}

extension EducationSystemProtocol {
    public func grades(for level: SchoolLevel) -> [GradeType] {
        grades.filter { $0.schoolLevel == level }
    }

    public func subjects(for level: SchoolLevel) -> [SubjectType] {
        subjects.filter { $0.isApplicable(for: level) }
    }
}

// MARK: - SchoolLevelConfiguration

/// 学段配置
///
/// 定义每个学段的具体参数。
public struct SchoolLevelConfiguration: Sendable, Hashable, Identifiable {
    public let id: SchoolLevel
    /// 学段名称键（用于本地化）
    public let nameKey: String
    /// 年级起始序号
    public let startGrade: Int
    /// 年级结束序号
    public let endGrade: Int
    /// 年级数量
    public let gradeCount: Int
    /// 图标
    public let icon: String
    /// 颜色
    public let color: Color

    public init(
        level: SchoolLevel,
        nameKey: String,
        startGrade: Int,
        endGrade: Int,
        icon: String,
        color: Color
    ) {
        self.id = level
        self.nameKey = nameKey
        self.startGrade = startGrade
        self.endGrade = endGrade
        self.gradeCount = endGrade - startGrade + 1
        self.icon = icon
        self.color = color
    }

    /// 本地化名称
    public var displayName: String {
        String(localized: String.LocalizationValue(stringLiteral: nameKey))
    }

    /// 年级范围描述
    public var gradeRange: String {
        "\(startGrade)-\(endGrade)"
    }
}

// MARK: - EducationSystemError

/// 教育体系错误
public enum EducationSystemError: Error, LocalizedError {
    case unsupportedRegion(EducationRegion)
    case invalidGradeOrder(Int)
    case subjectNotApplicable(String, SchoolLevel)

    public var errorDescription: String? {
        switch self {
        case .unsupportedRegion(let region):
            return "Unsupported education region: \(region.displayName)"
        case .invalidGradeOrder(let order):
            return "Invalid grade order: \(order)"
        case .subjectNotApplicable(let subject, let level):
            return "Subject '\(subject)' is not applicable for \(level)"
        }
    }
}

        case .grade3: "cn_grade_3_short"

        case .grade5: "cn_grade_5_short"
        case .grade6: "cn_grade_6_short"
        case .grade7: "cn_grade_7_short"
        case .grade8: "cn_grade_8_short"
        case .grade9: "cn_grade_9_short"
        case .grade10: "cn_grade_10_short"
        case .grade11: "cn_grade_11_short"
        case .grade12: "cn_grade_12_short"
        }
    }

    public var icon: String {
        switch self {
        case .grade1, .grade2:
            "figure.child"
        case .grade3, .grade4, .grade5, .grade6:
            "figure.child.and.lock"
        case .grade7, .grade8, .grade9:
            "figure.stand"
        case .grade10, .grade11, .grade12:
            "graduationcap"
        }
    }

    public var color: Color {
        switch self {
        // 小学：绿色系渐变
        case .grade1: .mint
        case .grade2: .green
        case .grade3: .teal
        case .grade4: .cyan
        case .grade5: .blue
        case .grade6: .indigo
        // 初中：暖色系
        case .grade7: .yellow
        case .grade8: .orange
        case .grade9: .red
        // 高中：紫色系
        case .grade10: .pink
        case .grade11: .purple
        case .grade12: Color(red: 0.5, green: 0, blue: 0.5)
        }
    }

    /// 是否为毕业年级
    public var isGraduationYear: Bool {
        switch self {
        case .grade6, .grade9, .grade12: true
        default: false
        }
    }

    /// 根据序号创建年级
    public static func from(order: Int) -> ChinaGrade? {
        allCases.first { $0.order == order }
    }
}

//
//  EducationSystemManager.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  教育体系管理器
//
//  负责管理和切换不同国家的教育体系配置。
//  使用类型擦除实现对不同教育体系的统一访问。
//

import Foundation
import SwiftUI
import Observation

// MARK: - AnyEducationSystem

/// 类型擦除的教育体系
///
/// 允许在运行时存储和切换不同类型的教育体系。
public struct AnyEducationSystem: Sendable {
    public let region: EducationRegion
    public let name: String

    private let _schoolLevels: @Sendable () -> [SchoolLevelConfiguration]
    private let _gradeCount: @Sendable () -> Int
    private let _subjectCount: @Sendable () -> Int
    private let _gradeDisplayName: @Sendable (Int) -> String?
    private let _gradeShortLabel: @Sendable (Int) -> String?
    private let _gradeSchoolLevel: @Sendable (Int) -> SchoolLevel?
    private let _gradeIcon: @Sendable (Int) -> String?
    private let _gradeColor: @Sendable (Int) -> Color?

    private let _gradeIds: @Sendable () -> [String]
    private let _subjectIds: @Sendable () -> [String]

    // ID-based lookups
    private let _gradeDisplayNameById: @Sendable (String) -> String?
    private let _gradeShortLabelById: @Sendable (String) -> String?
    private let _gradeSchoolLevelById: @Sendable (String) -> SchoolLevel?
    private let _gradeIconById: @Sendable (String) -> String?
    private let _gradeColorById: @Sendable (String) -> Color?

    private let _subjectDisplayNameById: @Sendable (String) -> String?
    private let _subjectShortLabelById: @Sendable (String) -> String?
    private let _subjectIconById: @Sendable (String) -> String?
    private let _subjectColorById: @Sendable (String) -> Color?

    public init<T: EducationSystemProtocol>(_ system: T) {
        self.region = system.region
        self.name = system.name

        let grades = system.grades
        let subjects = system.subjects

        self._schoolLevels = { system.schoolLevels }
        self._gradeCount = { grades.count }
        self._subjectCount = { subjects.count }

        self._gradeIds = { grades.map(\.id) }
        self._subjectIds = { subjects.map(\.id) }

        // Order-based lookups
        self._gradeDisplayName = { order in
            grades.first { $0.order == order }?.displayName
        }
        self._gradeShortLabel = { order in
            grades.first { $0.order == order }?.shortLabel
        }
        self._gradeSchoolLevel = { order in
            grades.first { $0.order == order }?.schoolLevel
        }
        self._gradeIcon = { order in
            grades.first { $0.order == order }?.icon
        }
        self._gradeColor = { order in
            grades.first { $0.order == order }?.color
        }

        // ID-based lookups
        self._gradeDisplayNameById = { id in
            grades.first { $0.id == id }?.displayName
        }
        self._gradeShortLabelById = { id in
            grades.first { $0.id == id }?.shortLabel
        }
        self._gradeSchoolLevelById = { id in
            grades.first { $0.id == id }?.schoolLevel
        }
        self._gradeIconById = { id in
            grades.first { $0.id == id }?.icon
        }
        self._gradeColorById = { id in
            grades.first { $0.id == id }?.color
        }

        self._subjectDisplayNameById = { id in
            subjects.first { $0.id == id }?.displayName
        }
        self._subjectShortLabelById = { id in
            subjects.first { $0.id == id }?.shortLabel
        }
        self._subjectIconById = { id in
            subjects.first { $0.id == id }?.icon
        }
        self._subjectColorById = { id in
            subjects.first { $0.id == id }?.color
        }
    }

    public var schoolLevels: [SchoolLevelConfiguration] { _schoolLevels() }
    public var gradeCount: Int { _gradeCount() }
    public var subjectCount: Int { _subjectCount() }

    public var gradeIds: [String] { _gradeIds() }
    public var subjectIds: [String] { _subjectIds() }

    public func gradeDisplayName(for order: Int) -> String? { _gradeDisplayName(order) }
    public func gradeShortLabel(for order: Int) -> String? { _gradeShortLabel(order) }
    public func gradeSchoolLevel(for order: Int) -> SchoolLevel? { _gradeSchoolLevel(order) }
    public func gradeIcon(for order: Int) -> String? { _gradeIcon(order) }
    public func gradeColor(for order: Int) -> Color? { _gradeColor(order) }

    public func gradeDisplayName(for id: String) -> String? { _gradeDisplayNameById(id) }
    public func gradeShortLabel(for id: String) -> String? { _gradeShortLabelById(id) }
    public func gradeSchoolLevel(for id: String) -> SchoolLevel? { _gradeSchoolLevelById(id) }
    public func gradeIcon(for id: String) -> String? { _gradeIconById(id) }
    public func gradeColor(for id: String) -> Color? { _gradeColorById(id) }

    public func subjectDisplayName(for id: String) -> String? { _subjectDisplayNameById(id) }
    public func subjectShortLabel(for id: String) -> String? { _subjectShortLabelById(id) }
    public func subjectIcon(for id: String) -> String? { _subjectIconById(id) }
    public func subjectColor(for id: String) -> Color? { _subjectColorById(id) }
}

// MARK: - EducationSystemManager

/// 教育体系管理器
///
/// 全局单例，负责管理当前使用的教育体系。
///
/// ## 使用示例
/// ```swift
/// // 获取当前教育体系
/// let current = EducationSystemManager.shared.currentSystem
///
/// // 切换到美国教育体系
/// EducationSystemManager.shared.switchTo(.usa)
///
/// // 获取当前年级显示名称
/// let gradeName = EducationSystemManager.shared.gradeDisplayName(for: 9)
/// ```
@MainActor
@Observable
public final class EducationSystemManager {

    // MARK: - Singleton

    public static let shared = EducationSystemManager()

    // MARK: - Properties

    /// 当前教育地区
    public private(set) var currentRegion: EducationRegion {
        didSet {
            UserDefaults.standard.set(currentRegion.rawValue, forKey: Keys.educationRegion)
            updateCurrentSystem()
        }
    }

    /// 当前教育体系（类型擦除）
    public private(set) var currentSystem: AnyEducationSystem

    /// 中国教育体系实例
    public let chinaSystem = ChinaEducationSystem()

    /// 日本教育体系实例
    public let japanSystem = JapanEducationSystem()

    /// 韩国教育体系实例
    public let koreaSystem = KoreaEducationSystem()

    /// 新加坡教育体系实例
    public let singaporeSystem = SingaporeEducationSystem()

    /// 国际通用教育体系实例
    public let internationalSystem = InternationalEducationSystem()

    /// 美国教育体系实例（保留但不在内置选项中）
    public let usSystem = USEducationSystem()

    // MARK: - Keys

    private enum Keys {
        static let educationRegion = "education_region"
    }

    // MARK: - Initialization

    private init() {
        // 从 UserDefaults 读取保存的地区，默认根据设备地区自动检测
        let savedRegion = UserDefaults.standard.string(forKey: Keys.educationRegion)
        let region = savedRegion.flatMap { EducationRegion(rawValue: $0) }
            ?? EducationRegion.detectFromLocale()

        self.currentRegion = region
        self.currentSystem = Self.createSystem(for: region)
    }

    // MARK: - Public Methods

    /// 切换到指定地区的教育体系
    /// - Parameter region: 目标教育地区
    public func switchTo(_ region: EducationRegion) {
        guard region != currentRegion else { return }
        currentRegion = region
    }

    /// 重置为自动检测的地区
    public func resetToAutoDetect() {
        let detectedRegion = EducationRegion.detectFromLocale()
        switchTo(detectedRegion)
    }

    /// 获取所有支持的教育体系（内置）
    public var supportedSystems: [AnyEducationSystem] {
        [
            AnyEducationSystem(chinaSystem),
            AnyEducationSystem(japanSystem),
            AnyEducationSystem(koreaSystem),
            AnyEducationSystem(singaporeSystem),
            AnyEducationSystem(internationalSystem)
        ]
    }

    /// 获取指定地区的教育体系
    public func system(for region: EducationRegion) -> AnyEducationSystem? {
        switch region {
        case .china:
            return AnyEducationSystem(chinaSystem)
        case .japan:
            return AnyEducationSystem(japanSystem)
        case .korea:
            return AnyEducationSystem(koreaSystem)
        case .singapore:
            return AnyEducationSystem(singaporeSystem)
        case .international:
            return AnyEducationSystem(internationalSystem)
        case .usa:
            return AnyEducationSystem(usSystem)
        default:
            return nil
        }
    }

    // MARK: - Convenience Accessors

    /// 当前学段配置
    public var schoolLevels: [SchoolLevelConfiguration] {
        currentSystem.schoolLevels
    }

    /// 获取年级显示名称
    public func gradeDisplayName(for order: Int) -> String {
        currentSystem.gradeDisplayName(for: order) ?? "Grade \(order)"
    }

    /// 获取年级简短标签
    public func gradeShortLabel(for order: Int) -> String {
        currentSystem.gradeShortLabel(for: order) ?? "\(order)"
    }

    /// 获取年级所属学段
    public func gradeSchoolLevel(for order: Int) -> SchoolLevel? {
        currentSystem.gradeSchoolLevel(for: order)
    }

    /// 获取年级图标
    public func gradeIcon(for order: Int) -> String {
        currentSystem.gradeIcon(for: order) ?? "graduationcap"
    }

    /// 获取年级颜色
    public func gradeColor(for order: Int) -> Color {
        currentSystem.gradeColor(for: order) ?? .secondary
    }

    // MARK: - ID-based Accessors

    /// 获取年级显示名称 (ID)
    public func gradeDisplayName(for id: String) -> String {
        currentSystem.gradeDisplayName(for: id) ?? id
    }

    /// 获取年级简短标签 (ID)
    public func gradeShortLabel(for id: String) -> String {
        currentSystem.gradeShortLabel(for: id) ?? id
    }

    /// 获取年级所属学段 (ID)
    public func gradeSchoolLevel(for id: String) -> SchoolLevel? {
        currentSystem.gradeSchoolLevel(for: id)
    }

    /// 获取年级图标 (ID)
    public func gradeIcon(for id: String) -> String {
        currentSystem.gradeIcon(for: id) ?? "graduationcap"
    }

    /// 获取年级颜色 (ID)
    public func gradeColor(for id: String) -> Color {
        currentSystem.gradeColor(for: id) ?? .secondary
    }

    /// 获取学科显示名称 (ID)
    public func subjectDisplayName(for id: String) -> String {
        currentSystem.subjectDisplayName(for: id) ?? id
    }

    /// 获取学科简短标签 (ID)
    public func subjectShortLabel(for id: String) -> String {
        currentSystem.subjectShortLabel(for: id) ?? id
    }

    /// 获取学科图标 (ID)
    public func subjectIcon(for id: String) -> String {
        currentSystem.subjectIcon(for: id) ?? "book"
    }

    /// 获取学科颜色 (ID)
    public func subjectColor(for id: String) -> Color {
        currentSystem.subjectColor(for: id) ?? .secondary
    }

    // MARK: - Private Methods

    private func updateCurrentSystem() {
        currentSystem = Self.createSystem(for: currentRegion)
    }

    private static func createSystem(for region: EducationRegion) -> AnyEducationSystem {
        switch region {
        case .china:
            return AnyEducationSystem(ChinaEducationSystem())
        case .japan:
            return AnyEducationSystem(JapanEducationSystem())
        case .korea:
            return AnyEducationSystem(KoreaEducationSystem())
        case .singapore:
            return AnyEducationSystem(SingaporeEducationSystem())
        case .international:
            return AnyEducationSystem(InternationalEducationSystem())
        case .usa:
            return AnyEducationSystem(USEducationSystem())
        default:
            // 默认使用国际通用体系
            return AnyEducationSystem(InternationalEducationSystem())
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - SwiftUI Environment

/// 教育体系环境键
private struct EducationSystemKey: EnvironmentKey {
    static var defaultValue: EducationSystemManager {
        MainActor.assumeIsolated {
            EducationSystemManager.shared
        }
    }
}

extension EnvironmentValues {
    /// 当前教育体系管理器
    public var educationSystem: EducationSystemManager {
        get { self[EducationSystemKey.self] }
        set { self[EducationSystemKey.self] = newValue }
    }
}

// MARK: - Preview Support

extension EducationSystemManager {
    /// 用于预览的中国教育体系
    @MainActor
    public static var previewChina: EducationSystemManager {
        let manager = EducationSystemManager.shared
        manager.switchTo(.china)
        return manager
    }

    /// 用于预览的美国教育体系
    @MainActor
    public static var previewUSA: EducationSystemManager {
        let manager = EducationSystemManager.shared
        manager.switchTo(.usa)
        return manager
    }
}

                level: .middle,
                nameKey: "intl_school_middle",
                startGrade: 7,
                endGrade: 9,
                icon: "book",
                color: .blue

            SchoolLevelConfiguration(
                level: .high,
                nameKey: "intl_school_high",
                startGrade: 10,
                endGrade: 12,
                icon: "graduationcap",
                color: .purple
            )
        ]
    }

    public init() {}
}

    case grade7 = "grade_7"
    case grade8 = "grade_8"

    case grade9 = "grade_9"   // Freshman
    case grade10 = "grade_10" // Sophomore
    case grade11 = "grade_11" // Junior
    case grade12 = "grade_12" // Senior

        }
    }

    }

// FILE PATH: NotBad/Domain/Queries/ReviewItemQueries.swift

//
//  ReviewItemQueries.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  Predicate 工厂 - CQRS 架构的 Query 层
//
//  将复杂的查询逻辑从 View 中抽离，保持 View 的清爽，
//  同时让查询逻辑可测试、可复用。
//

import Foundation
import SwiftData

// MARK: - ReviewItemQueries

/// ReviewItem 查询谓词工厂
///
/// 提供标准化的查询谓词，供 `@Query` 使用。
///
/// ## 设计原则
///
/// - **Single Responsibility**：每个方法只负责一种查询场景
/// - **Composable**：谓词可以组合使用
/// - **Testable**：逻辑集中，便于单元测试
///
/// ## 使用示例
///
/// ```swift
/// struct LibraryView: View {
///     @Query(filter: ReviewItemQueries.needsReview())
///     private var itemsToReview: [ReviewItem]
/// }
/// ```
enum ReviewItemQueries {
    
    // MARK: - Basic Predicates
    
    /// 需要复习的错题
    ///
    /// 筛选 `nextReviewDate <= 今天` 且未完全掌握的错题
    static func needsReview() -> Predicate<ReviewItem> {
        let today = Calendar.current.startOfDay(for: Date())
        let masteredLevel = MasteryLevel.mastered.rawValue
        return #Predicate<ReviewItem> { item in
            item.nextReviewDate <= today && item.masteryLevel < masteredLevel
        }
    }
    
    /// 已逾期的错题
    ///
    /// 筛选 `nextReviewDate < 今天` 的错题
    static func overdue() -> Predicate<ReviewItem> {
        let today = Calendar.current.startOfDay(for: Date())
        return #Predicate<ReviewItem> { item in
            item.nextReviewDate < today
        }
    }
    
    /// 已掌握的错题
    static func mastered() -> Predicate<ReviewItem> {
        let masteredLevel = MasteryLevel.mastered.rawValue
        return #Predicate<ReviewItem> { item in
            item.masteryLevel == masteredLevel
        }
    }
    
    /// 需要重点关注的错题（掌握度低）
    static func needsAttention() -> Predicate<ReviewItem> {
        let threshold = MasteryLevel.partial.rawValue
        return #Predicate<ReviewItem> { item in
            item.masteryLevel <= threshold
        }
    }
    
    // MARK: - Subject Filters
    
    /// 按学科筛选
    ///
    /// - Parameter subjectRaw: 学科的原始值
    /// - Returns: 匹配指定学科的谓词
    static func bySubject(_ subjectRaw: String) -> Predicate<ReviewItem> {
        #Predicate<ReviewItem> { item in
            item.subjectRaw == subjectRaw
        }
    }
    
    /// 按年级筛选
    ///
    /// - Parameter gradeRaw: 年级的原始值
    /// - Returns: 匹配指定年级的谓词
    static func byGrade(_ gradeRaw: String) -> Predicate<ReviewItem> {
        #Predicate<ReviewItem> { item in
            item.gradeRaw == gradeRaw
        }
    }
    
    // MARK: - Search Predicates
    
    /// 搜索标题
    ///
    /// - Parameter keyword: 搜索关键词
    /// - Returns: 标题包含关键词的谓词
    static func searchByTitle(_ keyword: String) -> Predicate<ReviewItem> {
        #Predicate<ReviewItem> { item in
            item.title.localizedStandardContains(keyword)
        }
    }
    
    // MARK: - Time-based Predicates
    
    /// 最近添加的错题
    ///
    /// - Parameter days: 最近几天内
    /// - Returns: 创建时间在指定天数内的谓词
    static func recentlyAdded(days: Int = 7) -> Predicate<ReviewItem> {
        let cutoffDate = Calendar.current.date(byAdding: .day, value: -days, to: Date()) ?? Date()
        return #Predicate<ReviewItem> { item in
            item.createdAt >= cutoffDate
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Sort Descriptors

/// ReviewItem 排序描述符工厂
enum ReviewItemSortDescriptors {
    
    /// 按创建时间排序（最新优先）
    static var byCreatedAt: [SortDescriptor<ReviewItem>] {
        [SortDescriptor(\.createdAt, order: .reverse)]
    }
    
    /// 按下次复习时间排序（最近优先）
    static var byNextReviewDate: [SortDescriptor<ReviewItem>] {
        [SortDescriptor(\.nextReviewDate, order: .forward)]
    }
    
    /// 按掌握度排序（最低优先，便于复习薄弱项）
    static var byMastery: [SortDescriptor<ReviewItem>] {
        [SortDescriptor(\.masteryLevel, order: .forward)]
    }
    
    /// 按更新时间排序（最近优先）
    static var byUpdatedAt: [SortDescriptor<ReviewItem>] {
        [SortDescriptor(\.updatedAt, order: .reverse)]
    }
    
    /// 复习优先级排序（逾期 > 今天 > 低掌握度）
    static var byReviewPriority: [SortDescriptor<ReviewItem>] {
        [
            SortDescriptor(\.nextReviewDate, order: .forward),
            SortDescriptor(\.masteryLevel, order: .forward)
        ]
    }
}

//
//  AppError.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  统一错误类型定义
//

import Foundation

// MARK: - AppError

/// 应用统一错误类型
///
/// 定义应用中所有可能出现的错误，提供用户友好的错误消息。
///
/// ## 使用示例
///
/// ```swift
/// throw AppError.saveFailed(reason: "数据库写入失败")
///
/// do {
///     try await saveItem()
/// } catch let error as AppError {
///     showToast(.error(error.userMessage))
/// }
/// ```
enum AppError: LocalizedError, Sendable {
    
    // MARK: - Data Errors
    
    /// 保存失败
    case saveFailed(reason: String? = nil)
    
    /// 删除失败
    case deleteFailed(reason: String? = nil)
    
    /// 数据加载失败
    case loadFailed(reason: String? = nil)
    
    /// 数据不存在
    case notFound
    
    // MARK: - Image Errors
    
    /// 图片处理失败
    case imageProcessingFailed
    
    /// 图片格式不支持
    case unsupportedImageFormat
    
    /// 图片太大
    case imageTooLarge(maxSize: Int)
    
    // MARK: - OCR Errors
    
    /// OCR 识别失败
    case ocrFailed(reason: String? = nil)
    
    /// 设备不支持 OCR
    case ocrNotSupported
    
    // MARK: - Export Errors
    
    /// 导出失败
    case exportFailed(format: String)
    
    /// 分享失败
    case shareFailed
    
    // MARK: - Network Errors
    
    /// 网络不可用
    case networkUnavailable
    
    /// 同步失败
    case syncFailed(reason: String? = nil)
    
    // MARK: - Permission Errors
    
    /// 相机权限被拒绝
    case cameraPermissionDenied
    
    /// 相册权限被拒绝
    case photoLibraryPermissionDenied
    
    /// 通知权限被拒绝
    case notificationPermissionDenied
    
    // MARK: - Validation Errors
    
    /// 验证失败
    case validationFailed(field: String, reason: String)
    
    /// 输入无效
    case invalidInput(description: String)
    
    // MARK: - Unknown Error
    
    /// 未知错误
    case unknown(underlying: Error? = nil)
    
    // MARK: - User Message
    
    /// 用户友好的错误消息
    var userMessage: String {
        switch self {
        case .saveFailed(let reason):
            if let reason = reason {
                return String(format: String(localized: "error_save_failed_reason"), reason)
            }
            return String(localized: "error_save_failed")
            
        case .deleteFailed(let reason):
            if let reason = reason {
                return String(format: String(localized: "error_delete_failed_reason"), reason)
            }
            return String(localized: "error_delete_failed")
            
        case .loadFailed(let reason):
            if let reason = reason {
                return String(format: String(localized: "error_load_failed_reason"), reason)
            }
            return String(localized: "error_load_failed")
            
        case .notFound:
            return String(localized: "error_not_found")
            
        case .imageProcessingFailed:
            return String(localized: "error_image_processing")
            
        case .unsupportedImageFormat:
            return String(localized: "error_unsupported_image")
            
        case .imageTooLarge(let maxSize):
            return String(format: String(localized: "error_image_too_large"), maxSize)
            
        case .ocrFailed(let reason):
            if let reason = reason {
                return String(format: String(localized: "error_ocr_failed_reason"), reason)
            }
            return String(localized: "error_ocr_failed")
            
        case .ocrNotSupported:
            return String(localized: "error_ocr_not_supported")
            
        case .exportFailed(let format):
            return String(format: String(localized: "error_export_failed"), format)
            
        case .shareFailed:
            return String(localized: "error_share_failed")
            
        case .networkUnavailable:
            return String(localized: "error_network_unavailable")
            
        case .syncFailed(let reason):
            if let reason = reason {
                return String(format: String(localized: "error_sync_failed_reason"), reason)
            }
            return String(localized: "error_sync_failed")
            
        case .cameraPermissionDenied:
            return String(localized: "error_camera_permission")
            
        case .photoLibraryPermissionDenied:
            return String(localized: "error_photo_permission")
            
        case .notificationPermissionDenied:
            return String(localized: "error_notification_permission")
            
        case .validationFailed(let field, let reason):
            return String(format: String(localized: "error_validation_failed"), field, reason)
            
        case .invalidInput(let description):
            return String(format: String(localized: "error_invalid_input"), description)
            
        case .unknown:
            return String(localized: "error_unknown")
        }
    }
    
    // MARK: - LocalizedError
    
    var errorDescription: String? {
        userMessage
    }
    
    // MARK: - Recovery Suggestion
    
    /// 恢复建议
    var recoverySuggestion: String? {
        switch self {
        case .saveFailed, .deleteFailed, .loadFailed:
            return String(localized: "error_suggestion_retry")
            
        case .networkUnavailable:
            return String(localized: "error_suggestion_check_network")
            
        case .cameraPermissionDenied, .photoLibraryPermissionDenied, .notificationPermissionDenied:
            return String(localized: "error_suggestion_settings")
            
        case .imageTooLarge:
            return String(localized: "error_suggestion_smaller_image")
            
        default:
            return nil
        }
    }
    
    // MARK: - Icon
    
    /// 错误图标
    var icon: String {
        switch self {
        case .networkUnavailable, .syncFailed:
            return "wifi.slash"
        case .cameraPermissionDenied:
            return "camera.fill"
        case .photoLibraryPermissionDenied:
            return "photo.fill"
        case .notificationPermissionDenied:
            return "bell.slash.fill"
        case .imageProcessingFailed, .unsupportedImageFormat, .imageTooLarge:
            return "photo.badge.exclamationmark"
        case .ocrFailed, .ocrNotSupported:
            return "text.viewfinder"
        case .exportFailed, .shareFailed:
            return "square.and.arrow.up.trianglebadge.exclamationmark"
        default:
            return "exclamationmark.triangle.fill"
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Error Conversion

extension Error {
    /// 转换为 AppError
    var asAppError: AppError {
        if let appError = self as? AppError {
            return appError
        }
        return .unknown(underlying: self)
    }
}

import Foundation
import SwiftData

// MARK: - PDFExportServiceProtocol

/// PDF 导出服务协议
///
/// 定义 PDF 导出功能的抽象接口，支持依赖注入和测试。
///
/// ## 设计目的
///
/// 1. **解耦**：ViewModel 依赖协议而非具体实现
/// 2. **可测试**：可以注入 Mock 实现进行单元测试
/// 3. **可替换**：未来可以替换为其他 PDF 生成库
///
/// ## 使用示例
///
/// ```swift
/// // 生产环境
/// let service: PDFExportServiceProtocol = PDFExportService.shared
/// let data = service.exportToPDF(items: items, title: "我的错题集")
///
/// // 测试环境
/// let mockService = MockPDFExportService()
/// let data = mockService.exportToPDF(items: items, title: "测试")
/// ```
@MainActor
protocol PDFExportServiceProtocol: AnyObject, Sendable {

    /// 导出错题为 PDF
    ///
    /// 将错题列表导出为学校试卷风格的可打印 PDF 文件。
    ///
    /// - Parameters:
    ///   - items: 要导出的错题列表
    ///   - title: PDF 标题，默认为 "错题集"
    ///   - includeImages: 是否包含错题图片，默认 true
    ///   - includeNotes: 是否包含笔记，默认 false
    ///   - showAnswerArea: 是否显示答题区域，默认 true
    /// - Returns: PDF 数据
    func exportToPDF(
        items: [ReviewItem],
        title: String,
        includeImages: Bool,
        includeNotes: Bool,
        showAnswerArea: Bool
    ) -> Data
}

//
//  ImageCompressorProtocol.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  Created by Architecture Improvement on 2025.
//

import UIKit

// MARK: - Image Compressor Protocol

/// 图片压缩服务协议
///
/// 该协议定义了图片压缩和调整大小的标准接口，用于：
/// - 解耦 ViewModel 和具体图片压缩实现
/// - 支持依赖注入和单元测试
/// - 提供可替换的图片处理策略
protocol ImageCompressorProtocol {
    /// 默认压缩质量
    static var defaultQuality: CGFloat { get }
    
    /// 默认最大尺寸
    static var defaultMaxDimension: CGFloat { get }
    
    /// 压缩图片
    ///
    /// - Parameters:
    ///   - image: 需要压缩的图片
    ///   - quality: 压缩质量 (0.0-1.0)
    ///   - maxDimension: 最大尺寸（宽或高的最大值）
    /// - Returns: 压缩后的图片数据，压缩失败返回 nil
    static func compress(
        _ image: UIImage,
        quality: CGFloat,
        maxDimension: CGFloat
    ) -> Data?
    
    /// 调整图片大小
    ///
    /// - Parameters:
    ///   - image: 需要调整大小的图片
    ///   - maxDimension: 最大尺寸
    /// - Returns: 调整大小后的图片
    static func resize(_ image: UIImage, maxDimension: CGFloat) -> UIImage
    
    /// 估算压缩后的文件大小（KB）
    ///
    /// - Parameters:
    ///   - image: 图片
    ///   - quality: 压缩质量
    /// - Returns: 估算的文件大小（KB）
    static func estimateSize(_ image: UIImage, quality: CGFloat) -> Int
}

// MARK: - Default Parameter Values Extension

extension ImageCompressorProtocol {
    /// 使用默认参数的压缩方法
    static func compress(_ image: UIImage) -> Data? {
        compress(image, quality: defaultQuality, maxDimension: defaultMaxDimension)
    }
    
    /// 使用默认质量的压缩方法
    static func compress(_ image: UIImage, maxDimension: CGFloat) -> Data? {
        compress(image, quality: defaultQuality, maxDimension: maxDimension)
    }
    
    /// 使用默认尺寸的压缩方法
    static func compress(_ image: UIImage, quality: CGFloat) -> Data? {
        compress(image, quality: quality, maxDimension: defaultMaxDimension)
    }
    
    /// 使用默认参数的调整大小方法
    static func resize(_ image: UIImage) -> UIImage {
        resize(image, maxDimension: defaultMaxDimension)
    }
    
    /// 使用默认质量的大小估算方法
    static func estimateSize(_ image: UIImage) -> Int {
        estimateSize(image, quality: defaultQuality)
    }
}

//
//  ReviewItemRepositoryProtocol.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  Created for NotBad K12 错题本
//

import Foundation

// MARK: - ReviewItemRepositoryProtocol

/// 错题仓库协议
///
/// 定义错题数据的 CRUD 操作接口。
///
/// ## 设计原则
///
/// - **依赖倒置**：上层模块依赖此抽象接口，而非具体实现
/// - **可测试性**：可以注入 Mock 实现进行单元测试
/// - **可替换性**：未来可以替换底层存储方案（SwiftData → Core Data → SQLite）
///
/// ## 使用示例
///
/// ```swift
/// // 依赖注入
/// class ReviewViewModel {
///     private let repository: ReviewItemRepositoryProtocol
///
///     init(repository: ReviewItemRepositoryProtocol) {
///         self.repository = repository
///     }
///
///     func loadItems() {
///         let items = repository.fetchForReview()
///     }
/// }
/// ```
///
/// - Note: 所有方法都在 `@MainActor` 上下文中执行
/// - Important: 实现类需要处理 SwiftData 的并发限制
@MainActor
protocol ReviewItemRepositoryProtocol: AnyObject, Sendable {

    // MARK: - Fetch Operations

    /// 获取所有错题
    ///
    /// - Returns: 所有错题列表，按创建时间降序排列
    func fetchAll() -> [ReviewItem]

    /// 根据条件筛选错题
    ///
    /// 支持组合筛选，参数为 `nil` 时忽略该条件。
    ///
    /// - Parameters:
    ///   - subject: 学科筛选，`nil` 表示不限
    ///   - mastery: 掌握程度筛选，`nil` 表示不限
    /// - Returns: 符合条件的错题列表
    func fetch(subject: Subject?, mastery: MasteryLevel?) -> [ReviewItem]

    /// 获取需要复习的错题
    ///
    /// 返回 `nextReviewDate <= 当前时间` 的错题，按紧迫程度排序。
    ///
    /// - Returns: 需要复习的错题列表，越紧急的排在前面
    func fetchForReview() -> [ReviewItem]

    /// 获取指定学科需要复习的错题
    ///
    /// - Parameter subject: 学科
    /// - Returns: 该学科需要复习的错题列表
    func fetchForReview(subject: Subject) -> [ReviewItem]

    /// 获取今日需要复习的错题
    ///
    /// - Returns: 今日到期的错题列表
    func fetchDueToday() -> [ReviewItem]

    /// 获取本周需要复习的错题
    ///
    /// - Returns: 本周到期的错题列表
    func fetchDueThisWeek() -> [ReviewItem]

    /// 获取已逾期的错题
    ///
    /// - Returns: 已逾期的错题列表，按逾期天数降序排列
    func fetchOverdue() -> [ReviewItem]

    // MARK: - Search Operations

    /// 搜索错题
    ///
    /// 在标题、笔记、知识点中搜索关键词。
    ///
    /// - Parameter query: 搜索关键词
    /// - Returns: 匹配的错题列表
    func search(query: String) -> [ReviewItem]

    /// 按知识点搜索
    ///
    /// - Parameter knowledgePoint: 知识点关键词
    /// - Returns: 包含该知识点的错题列表
    func search(byKnowledgePoint knowledgePoint: String) -> [ReviewItem]

    // MARK: - CRUD Operations

    /// 保存错题
    ///
    /// 新增或更新错题记录。
    ///
    /// - Parameter item: 要保存的错题
    /// - Throws: 保存失败时抛出错误
    func save(_ item: ReviewItem) throws

    /// 批量保存错题
    ///
    /// - Parameter items: 要保存的错题列表
    /// - Throws: 保存失败时抛出错误
    func save(_ items: [ReviewItem]) throws

    /// 删除错题
    ///
    /// - Parameter item: 要删除的错题
    /// - Throws: 删除失败时抛出错误
    func delete(_ item: ReviewItem) throws

    /// 批量删除错题
    ///
    /// - Parameter items: 要删除的错题列表
    /// - Throws: 删除失败时抛出错误
    func delete(_ items: [ReviewItem]) throws

    /// 删除所有错题
    ///
    /// - Warning: 此操作不可逆，请谨慎使用
    /// - Throws: 删除失败时抛出错误
    func deleteAll() throws

    // MARK: - Statistics

    /// 获取统计数据
    ///
    /// - Returns: 错题统计信息
    func statistics() -> ReviewStatistics

    /// 获取指定学科的统计数据
    ///
    /// - Parameter subject: 学科
    /// - Returns: 该学科的统计信息
    func statistics(for subject: Subject) -> ReviewStatistics

    // MARK: - Count Operations

    /// 获取错题总数
    ///
    /// - Returns: 错题总数
    func count() -> Int

    /// 获取需要复习的错题数量
    ///
    /// - Returns: 需要复习的数量
    func countForReview() -> Int

    /// 获取指定学科的错题数量
    ///
    /// - Parameter subject: 学科
    /// - Returns: 该学科的错题数量
    func count(for subject: Subject) -> Int
}

// MARK: - ReviewItemRepositoryProtocol Default Implementations

extension ReviewItemRepositoryProtocol {

    /// 获取指定学科需要复习的错题（默认实现）
    func fetchForReview(subject: Subject) -> [ReviewItem] {
        fetchForReview().filter { $0.subject == subject }
    }

    /// 获取今日需要复习的错题（默认实现）
    func fetchDueToday() -> [ReviewItem] {
        fetchForReview().filter { $0.reviewInterval.isDueToday }
    }

    /// 获取本周需要复习的错题（默认实现）
    func fetchDueThisWeek() -> [ReviewItem] {
        fetchAll().filter { $0.reviewInterval.isDueThisWeek }
    }

    /// 获取已逾期的错题（默认实现）
    func fetchOverdue() -> [ReviewItem] {
        fetchForReview()
            .filter { $0.isOverdue }
            .sorted { $0.reviewInterval.overdueByDays > $1.reviewInterval.overdueByDays }
    }

    /// 按知识点搜索（默认实现）
    func search(byKnowledgePoint knowledgePoint: String) -> [ReviewItem] {
        fetchAll().filter { $0.knowledgePoints.contains(knowledgePoint) }
    }

    /// 批量保存（默认实现）
    func save(_ items: [ReviewItem]) throws {
        for item in items {
            try save(item)
        }
    }

    /// 获取指定学科的统计数据（默认实现）
    func statistics(for subject: Subject) -> ReviewStatistics {
        let items = fetch(subject: subject, mastery: nil)
        return ReviewStatistics(from: items)
    }

    /// 获取错题总数（默认实现）
    func count() -> Int {
        fetchAll().count
    }

    /// 获取需要复习的错题数量（默认实现）
    func countForReview() -> Int {
        fetchForReview().count
    }

    /// 获取指定学科的错题数量（默认实现）
    func count(for subject: Subject) -> Int {
        fetch(subject: subject, mastery: nil).count
    }
}

// MARK: - ReviewStatistics

/// 错题统计数据
///
/// 包含错题的各维度统计信息。
///
/// ## 统计维度
///
/// - 总数与完成情况
/// - 掌握程度分布
/// - 学科分布
/// - 时间相关统计
struct ReviewStatistics: Sendable, Equatable {

    // MARK: - Count Statistics

    /// 错题总数
    let totalCount: Int

    /// 已掌握数量（掌握程度 >= good）
    let masteredCount: Int

    /// 本周新增数量
    let weeklyNewCount: Int

    /// 累计复习次数
    let totalReviewCount: Int

    /// 需要复习的数量
    let pendingReviewCount: Int

    /// 已逾期数量
    let overdueCount: Int

    // MARK: - Distribution Statistics

    /// 各掌握程度分布
    let masteryDistribution: [MasteryLevel: Int]

    /// 各学科分布
    let subjectDistribution: [Subject: Int]

    /// 各难度分布
    let difficultyDistribution: [Difficulty: Int]

    // MARK: - Computed Properties

    /// 掌握率（0.0 - 1.0）
    nonisolated var masteryRate: Double {
        guard totalCount > 0 else { return 0 }
        return Double(masteredCount) / Double(totalCount)
    }

    /// 掌握率百分比
    nonisolated var masteryPercentage: Int {
        Int(masteryRate * 100)
    }

    /// 完成率描述
    nonisolated var masteryDescription: String {
        "\(masteredCount)/\(totalCount) 已掌握 (\(masteryPercentage)%)"
    }

    /// 是否有待复习
    nonisolated var hasPendingReview: Bool {
        pendingReviewCount > 0
    }

    /// 是否有逾期
    nonisolated var hasOverdue: Bool {
        overdueCount > 0
    }

    /// 主要学科（错题最多的学科）
    nonisolated var primarySubject: Subject? {
        subjectDistribution.max(by: { $0.value < $1.value })?.key
    }

    /// 主要薄弱点（掌握程度最低的比例最高）
    nonisolated var weakestMastery: MasteryLevel? {
        masteryDistribution
            .filter { $0.key != .mastered && $0.key != .good }
            .max(by: { $0.value < $1.value })?.key
    }
}

// MARK: - ReviewStatistics Initialization

extension ReviewStatistics {

    /// 空统计数据
    static let empty = ReviewStatistics(
        totalCount: 0,
        masteredCount: 0,
        weeklyNewCount: 0,
        totalReviewCount: 0,
        pendingReviewCount: 0,
        overdueCount: 0,
        masteryDistribution: [:],
        subjectDistribution: [:],
        difficultyDistribution: [:]
    )

    /// 从错题列表创建统计数据
    ///
    /// - Parameter items: 错题列表
    init(from items: [ReviewItem]) {
        let now = Date()
        let weekAgo = Calendar.current.date(byAdding: .day, value: -7, to: now) ?? now

        self.totalCount = items.count
        self.masteredCount = items.filter { $0.isMastered }.count
        self.weeklyNewCount = items.filter { $0.createdAt >= weekAgo }.count
        self.totalReviewCount = items.reduce(0) { $0 + $1.reviewCount }
        self.pendingReviewCount = items.filter { $0.needsReview }.count
        self.overdueCount = items.filter { $0.isOverdue }.count

        // 掌握程度分布
        var masteryDist: [MasteryLevel: Int] = [:]
        for level in MasteryLevel.allCases {
            masteryDist[level] = items.filter { $0.mastery == level }.count
        }
        self.masteryDistribution = masteryDist

        // 学科分布
        var subjectDist: [Subject: Int] = [:]
        for subject in Subject.allCases {
            let count = items.filter { $0.subject == subject }.count
            if count > 0 {
                subjectDist[subject] = count
            }
        }
        self.subjectDistribution = subjectDist

        // 难度分布
        var difficultyDist: [Difficulty: Int] = [:]
        for difficulty in Difficulty.allCases {
            difficultyDist[difficulty] = items.filter { $0.difficulty == difficulty }.count
        }
        self.difficultyDistribution = difficultyDist
    }
}

//
//  OCRServiceProtocol.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  Created for NotBad K12 错题本
//  Phase 4: Service Layer Abstraction
//

import UIKit

// MARK: - OCRServiceProtocol

/// OCR 文字识别服务协议
///
/// 定义文字识别服务的抽象接口，支持依赖注入和测试。
///
/// ## 设计目的
///
/// 1. **解耦**：ViewModel 依赖协议而非具体实现
/// 2. **可测试**：可以注入 Mock 实现进行单元测试
/// 3. **可替换**：未来可以替换为其他 OCR 引擎
///
/// ## 使用示例
///
/// ```swift
/// // 生产环境
/// let service: OCRServiceProtocol = OCRService.shared
/// let result = try await service.recognizeText(from: image)
///
/// // 测试环境
/// let mockService = MockOCRService()
/// mockService.mockResult = "测试文本"
/// let result = try await mockService.recognizeText(from: image)
/// ```
///
/// - Note: 所有方法都是异步的，可能需要数秒时间
/// - Important: 实现类应标记为 `@MainActor` 以确保线程安全
@MainActor
protocol OCRServiceProtocol: AnyObject, Sendable {

    /// 从图片中识别文字
    ///
    /// - Parameter image: 要识别的图片
    /// - Returns: 识别出的文本字符串
    /// - Throws: 识别失败时抛出错误
    func recognizeText(from image: UIImage) async throws -> String

    /// 从图片中识别文字（带置信度）
    ///
    /// - Parameter image: 要识别的图片
    /// - Returns: 识别结果，包含文本、置信度和边界框信息
    /// - Throws: 识别失败时抛出错误
    func recognizeTextWithConfidence(from image: UIImage) async throws -> OCRResult
}

// MARK: - Default Implementation

extension OCRServiceProtocol {
    /// 默认实现：从带置信度的结果中提取纯文本
    func recognizeText(from image: UIImage) async throws -> String {
        let result = try await recognizeTextWithConfidence(from: image)
        return result.text
    }
}

//
//  ReviewItemDataProviding.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  Created for NotBad K12 错题本
//  Phase 2: Data Layer Abstraction
//

import Foundation

// MARK: - ReviewItemDataProviding

/// 错题数据提供协议
///
/// 为 View 层提供响应式数据访问的抽象接口，替代直接使用 `@Query`。
///
/// ## 设计目的
///
/// 1. **解耦 View 与 SwiftData**：View 不再直接依赖 `@Query`
/// 2. **提高可测试性**：可以注入 Mock 实现进行单元测试
/// 3. **统一数据访问**：所有数据访问通过此协议进行
///
/// ## 使用示例
///
/// ```swift
/// // 生产环境
/// let provider = SwiftDataReviewItemProvider(modelContext: context)
///
/// // 测试环境
/// let mockProvider = MockReviewItemProvider()
/// mockProvider.items = [ReviewItem.mock()]
///
/// // ViewModel 使用
/// let viewModel = LibraryViewModel(dataProvider: provider)
/// ```
///
/// ## 与 ReviewItemRepositoryProtocol 的区别
///
/// - `ReviewItemRepositoryProtocol`：面向领域层，提供 CRUD 操作
/// - `ReviewItemDataProviding`：面向展示层，提供响应式数据绑定
///
/// - Note: 实现类应为 `@Observable`，以支持 SwiftUI 自动更新
/// - Important: 所有方法都在 `@MainActor` 上下文中执行
@MainActor
protocol ReviewItemDataProviding: AnyObject, Sendable {

    // MARK: - Observable Properties

    /// 所有错题数据
    ///
    /// 实现类应将此属性标记为 `@Observable` 可观察属性，
    /// 以便 SwiftUI 视图能够自动响应数据变化。
    var items: [ReviewItem] { get }

    /// 是否正在加载数据
    var isLoading: Bool { get }

    /// 最后一次刷新时间
    var lastRefreshDate: Date? { get }

    // MARK: - Data Operations

    /// 刷新数据
    ///
    /// 从底层存储重新加载所有数据。
    /// 调用后 `items` 属性将更新为最新数据。
    func refresh()

    /// 保存错题
    ///
    /// - Parameter item: 要保存的错题
    /// - Throws: 保存失败时抛出错误
    func save(_ item: ReviewItem) throws

    /// 批量保存错题
    ///
    /// - Parameter items: 要保存的错题列表
    /// - Throws: 保存失败时抛出错误
    func save(_ items: [ReviewItem]) throws

    /// 删除错题
    ///
    /// - Parameter item: 要删除的错题
    /// - Throws: 删除失败时抛出错误
    func delete(_ item: ReviewItem) throws

    /// 批量删除错题
    ///
    /// - Parameter items: 要删除的错题列表
    /// - Throws: 删除失败时抛出错误
    func delete(_ items: [ReviewItem]) throws

    // MARK: - Query Operations

    /// 获取需要复习的错题
    ///
    /// - Returns: 需要复习的错题列表，按紧迫程度排序
    func fetchForReview() -> [ReviewItem]

    /// 获取今日需要复习的错题
    ///
    /// - Returns: 今日到期的错题列表
    func fetchDueToday() -> [ReviewItem]

    /// 获取指定学科的错题
    ///
    /// - Parameter subject: 学科
    /// - Returns: 该学科的所有错题
    func fetch(subject: Subject) -> [ReviewItem]

    /// 搜索错题
    ///
    /// - Parameter query: 搜索关键词
    /// - Returns: 匹配的错题列表
    func search(query: String) -> [ReviewItem]

    // MARK: - Statistics

    /// 获取统计数据
    ///
    /// - Returns: 错题统计信息
    func statistics() -> ReviewStatistics
}

// MARK: - ReviewItemDataProviding Default Implementations

extension ReviewItemDataProviding {

    /// 批量保存（默认实现）
    func save(_ items: [ReviewItem]) throws {
        for item in items {
            try save(item)
        }
    }

    /// 批量删除（默认实现）
    func delete(_ items: [ReviewItem]) throws {
        for item in items {
            try delete(item)
        }
    }

    /// 获取今日需要复习的错题（默认实现）
    func fetchDueToday() -> [ReviewItem] {
        fetchForReview().filter { $0.reviewInterval.isDueToday }
    }

    /// 获取指定学科的错题（默认实现）
    func fetch(subject: Subject) -> [ReviewItem] {
        items.filter { $0.subject == subject }
    }

    /// 搜索错题（默认实现）
    func search(query: String) -> [ReviewItem] {
        let trimmedQuery = query.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
        guard !trimmedQuery.isEmpty else { return items }

        let lowercasedQuery = trimmedQuery.lowercased()
        return items.filter { item in
            item.title.lowercased().contains(lowercasedQuery) ||
            item.knowledgePoints.matches(trimmedQuery) ||
            item.note.lowercased().contains(lowercasedQuery) ||
            item.subject.displayName.contains(trimmedQuery) ||
            item.questionType.displayName.contains(trimmedQuery)
        }
    }

    /// 获取统计数据（默认实现）
    func statistics() -> ReviewStatistics {
        ReviewStatistics(from: items)
    }
}

// FILE PATH: NotBad/Domain/Entities/ReviewItem+Display.swift

//
//  ReviewItem+Display.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  显示属性扩展
//

import Foundation

// MARK: - ReviewItem Display Properties

extension ReviewItem {

    /// 显示标题
    ///
    /// 如果标题为空或仅空白，返回默认标题。
    var displayTitle: String {
        let trimmed = title.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
        return trimmed.isEmpty ? String(localized: "untitled_review_item") : trimmed
    }

    /// 简短描述
    ///
    /// 格式：「学科 · 题型」
    @MainActor
    var shortDescription: String {
        let subjectName = EducationSystemManager.shared.subjectDisplayName(for: subjectRaw)
        return "\(subjectName) · \(questionType.displayName)"
    }

    /// 完整描述
    ///
    /// 格式：「学科 · 年级 · 题型 · 难度」
    @MainActor
    var fullDescription: String {
        let subjectName = EducationSystemManager.shared.subjectDisplayName(for: subjectRaw)
        let gradeName = EducationSystemManager.shared.gradeDisplayName(for: gradeRaw)
        return "\(subjectName) · \(gradeName) · \(questionType.displayName) · \(difficulty.displayName)"
    }

    /// 复习状态描述
    var reviewStatusDescription: String {
        if isNew {
            return "新录入，尚未复习"
        } else if needsReview {
            return isOverdue ? "已逾期 \(reviewInterval.overdueByDays) 天" : "今天需要复习"
        } else {
            return "\(daysUntilReview) 天后复习"
        }
    }

    /// 掌握状态描述
    var masteryStatusDescription: String {
        "\(mastery.displayName) · 已复习 \(reviewCount) 次"
    }
}

// MARK: - ReviewItem CustomStringConvertible

extension ReviewItem: CustomStringConvertible {

    /// 调试描述
    nonisolated var description: String {
        "ReviewItem(\(displayTitle), \(subjectRaw), \(gradeRaw), \(masteryLevel))"
    }
}

// FILE PATH: NotBad/Domain/Entities/ReviewItem+Computed.swift
================================================================================

//
//  ReviewItem+Computed.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  计算属性扩展
//

import Foundation

// MARK: - ReviewItem Computed Properties

extension ReviewItem {

    /// 复习间隔计算器
    ///
    /// 基于当前复习次数和掌握程度计算。
    var reviewInterval: ReviewInterval {
        ReviewInterval.calculate(reviewCount: reviewCount, mastery: mastery)
    }

    /// 是否有图片
    var hasImage: Bool {
        imageData != nil && !(imageData?.isEmpty ?? true)
    }

    /// 是否有笔记
    var hasNote: Bool {
        !note.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines).isEmpty
    }

    /// 是否有知识点
    var hasKnowledgePoints: Bool {
        !knowledgePoints.isEmpty
    }

    /// 是否需要复习
    ///
    /// 基于下次复习日期判断。
    var needsReview: Bool {
        nextReviewDate <= Date()
    }

    /// 是否已逾期
    ///
    /// 直接基于 `nextReviewDate` 判断，避免重新计算间隔导致不一致。
    var isOverdue: Bool {
        nextReviewDate < Calendar.current.startOfDay(for: Date())
    }

    /// 是否已掌握
    ///
    /// 掌握程度达到 `.good` 或以上。
    var isMastered: Bool {
        mastery.isMastered
    }

    /// 是否为新录入（从未复习）
    var isNew: Bool {
        reviewCount == 0
    }

    /// 距离下次复习的天数
    var daysUntilReview: Int {
        reviewInterval.daysUntilReview
    }

    /// 估算记忆保持率
    var estimatedRetention: Double {
        reviewInterval.estimatedRetention
    }

    /// 复习紧迫程度（1-5）
    var urgencyLevel: Int {
        reviewInterval.urgencyLevel
    }

    /// 创建至今的天数
    var daysSinceCreation: Int {
        Calendar.current.dateComponents([.day], from: createdAt, to: Date()).day ?? 0
    }

    /// 综合难度分数
    ///
    /// 结合题型权重和难度等级计算。
    var overallDifficultyScore: Double {
        Double(difficulty.rawValue) * questionType.difficultyWeight
    }
}

// FILE PATH: NotBad/Domain/Entities/ReviewItem+Accessors.swift

//
//  ReviewItem+Accessors.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  值对象访问器扩展
//

import Foundation

// MARK: - ReviewItem Value Object Accessors

extension ReviewItem {

    /// 学科
    var subject: Subject {
        get { Subject(rawValue: subjectRaw) ?? .other }
        set {
            subjectRaw = newValue.rawValue
            markAsUpdated()
        }
    }

    /// 年级
    var grade: Grade {
        get { Grade(rawValue: gradeRaw) ?? .grade10 }
        set {
            gradeRaw = newValue.rawValue
            markAsUpdated()
        }
    }

    /// 掌握程度
    var mastery: MasteryLevel {
        get { MasteryLevel(rawValue: masteryLevel) ?? .none }
        set {
            masteryLevel = newValue.rawValue
            markAsUpdated()
        }
    }

    /// 知识点
    var knowledgePoints: KnowledgePoints {
        get { KnowledgePoints(from: knowledgePointsRaw) }
        set {
            knowledgePointsRaw = newValue.rawValue
            markAsUpdated()
        }
    }

    /// 难度等级
    var difficulty: Difficulty {
        get { Difficulty(rawValue: difficultyRaw) ?? .medium }
        set {
            difficultyRaw = newValue.rawValue
            markAsUpdated()
        }
    }

    /// 错误类型
    var errorType: ErrorType {
        get { ErrorType(rawValue: errorTypeRaw) ?? .other }
        set {
            errorTypeRaw = newValue.rawValue
            markAsUpdated()
        }
    }

    /// 题目来源
    var source: Source {
        get { Source(rawValue: sourceRaw) ?? .other }
        set {
            sourceRaw = newValue.rawValue
            markAsUpdated()
        }
    }

    /// 题目类型
    var questionType: ReviewItemType {
        get { ReviewItemType(rawValue: questionTypeRaw) ?? .other }
        set {
            questionTypeRaw = newValue.rawValue
            markAsUpdated()
        }
    }
}

// FILE PATH: NotBad/Domain/Entities/ReviewItem+Actions.swift
================================================================================

//
//  ReviewItem+Actions.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  行为方法扩展
//

import Foundation

// MARK: - ReviewItem Actions

extension ReviewItem {

    /// 记录一次复习
    ///
    /// 更新掌握程度、复习次数和下次复习日期。
    ///
    /// - Parameter newMastery: 本次复习后的掌握程度
    func recordReview(newMastery: MasteryLevel) {
        mastery = newMastery
        reviewCount += 1

        // 计算下次复习日期
        let interval = ReviewInterval.calculate(
            reviewCount: reviewCount,
            mastery: newMastery
        )
        nextReviewDate = interval.nextReviewDate

        markAsUpdated()
    }

    /// 重置复习进度
    ///
    /// 将复习次数清零，掌握程度重置为初始状态。
    func resetProgress() {
        reviewCount = 0
        mastery = .none
        nextReviewDate = Date()
        markAsUpdated()
    }

    /// 添加知识点
    ///
    /// - Parameter point: 要添加的知识点
    func addKnowledgePoint(_ point: String) {
        var current = knowledgePoints
        current = current.adding(point)
        knowledgePoints = current
    }

    /// 移除知识点
    ///
    /// - Parameter point: 要移除的知识点
    func removeKnowledgePoint(_ point: String) {
        var current = knowledgePoints
        current = current.removing(point)
        knowledgePoints = current
    }

    /// 更新笔记
    ///
    /// - Parameter newNote: 新的笔记内容
    func updateNote(_ newNote: String) {
        note = newNote
        markAsUpdated()
    }

    /// 更新标题
    ///
    /// - Parameter newTitle: 新的标题
    func updateTitle(_ newTitle: String) {
        title = newTitle.isEmpty ? "未命名错题" : newTitle
        markAsUpdated()
    }
}

// MARK: - ReviewItem Validation

extension ReviewItem {

    /// 验证数据完整性
    ///
    /// - Returns: 验证结果和问题列表
    func validate() -> (isValid: Bool, issues: [String]) {
        var issues: [String] = []

        if title.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines).isEmpty {
            issues.append("标题不能为空")
        }

        if imageData == nil && note.isEmpty {
            issues.append("建议添加图片或笔记")
        }

        if knowledgePoints.isEmpty {
            issues.append("建议添加知识点标签")
        }

        return (issues.isEmpty, issues)
    }

    /// 是否数据完整
    ///
    /// 要求：
    /// - 有图片或笔记（至少一项）
    /// - 有知识点标签
    /// - 标题非空
    var isComplete: Bool {
        (hasImage || hasNote) && hasKnowledgePoints && !title.isEmpty
    }
}

// MARK: - ReviewItem Comparable

extension ReviewItem: Comparable {

    /// 按紧迫程度排序
    ///
    /// 越需要复习的排在前面。
    static func < (lhs: ReviewItem, rhs: ReviewItem) -> Bool {
        lhs.nextReviewDate < rhs.nextReviewDate
    }
}
