//
//  ReviewItem.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  Created for NotBad K12 错题本
//

import Foundation
import SwiftData

// MARK: - ReviewItem

/// 复习项实体
///
/// 代表一个具体的错题或需要复习的知识点。
/// 使用 SwiftData 进行持久化存储。
///
/// ## 数据模型设计
///
/// 为了与 SwiftData 兼容，值对象（Value Objects）通过 `rawValue` 形式存储：
/// - 枚举类型：存储 `String` 或 `Int` 类型的 `rawValue`
/// - 复合类型：存储序列化后的字符串
///
/// ## 扩展文件
///
/// - `ReviewItem+Accessors.swift`: 值对象访问器
/// - `ReviewItem+Computed.swift`: 计算属性
/// - `ReviewItem+Display.swift`: 显示属性
/// - `ReviewItem+Actions.swift`: 行为方法
///
/// ## 使用示例
///
/// ```swift
/// // 创建新错题
/// let item = ReviewItem(
///     title: "二次函数求极值",
///     subject: .math,
///     grade: .grade10,
///     difficulty: .hard
/// )
///
/// // 记录复习
/// item.recordReview(newMastery: .partial)
///
/// // 检查是否需要复习
/// if item.needsReview {
///     print("该复习了！")
/// }
/// ```
@Model
final class ReviewItem {

    // MARK: - Core Properties

    /// 唯一标识符
    var id: UUID

    /// 错题图片数据
    ///
    /// 使用 `.externalStorage` 优化大数据存储，
    /// 图片数据将存储在外部文件中。
    @Attribute(.externalStorage)
    var imageData: Data?

    /// 标题
    ///
    /// 通常是 OCR 识别出的首行文字或用户自定义标题。
    /// 创建时如果为空，默认设置为「未命名错题」。
    var title: String

    /// 用户备注/笔记
    ///
    /// 用于记录解题思路、易错点等补充信息。
    var note: String

    // MARK: - Timestamp Properties

    /// 创建时间
    var createdAt: Date

    /// 更新时间
    ///
    /// 每次修改时应更新此字段。
    var updatedAt: Date

    // MARK: - Review Properties

    /// 掌握程度原始值
    ///
    /// 存储 `MasteryLevel` 的 `rawValue`。
    /// 请通过 `mastery` 访问器使用。
    var masteryLevel: Int

    /// 下次复习时间
    ///
    /// 基于艾宾浩斯遗忘曲线算法计算。
    var nextReviewDate: Date

    /// 复习次数
    ///
    /// 记录已完成的复习次数，影响复习间隔计算。
    var reviewCount: Int

    // MARK: - Value Object Raw Storage

    /// 学科原始值
    var subjectRaw: String

    /// 年级原始值
    var gradeRaw: String

    /// 知识点原始值（逗号分隔）
    var knowledgePointsRaw: String

    /// 难度等级原始值
    var difficultyRaw: Int

    /// 错误类型原始值
    var errorTypeRaw: String

    /// 题目来源原始值
    var sourceRaw: String

    /// 题目类型原始值
    var questionTypeRaw: String

    // MARK: - Initialization

    /// 创建新的复习项
    ///
    /// - Parameters:
    ///   - id: 唯一标识符，默认自动生成
    ///   - imageData: 错题图片数据
    ///   - title: 标题，为空时默认「未命名错题」
    ///   - note: 用户笔记
    ///   - createdAt: 创建时间，默认当前时间
    ///   - mastery: 初始掌握程度，默认 `.none`
    ///   - subject: 学科，默认数学
    ///   - grade: 年级，默认高一
    ///   - knowledgePoints: 知识点列表
    ///   - difficulty: 难度等级，默认中等
    ///   - errorType: 错误类型
    ///   - source: 题目来源
    ///   - questionType: 题目类型
    init(
        id: UUID = UUID(),
        imageData: Data? = nil,
        title: String = "",
        note: String = "",
        createdAt: Date = Date(),
        mastery: MasteryLevel = .none,
        subject: Subject = .math,
        grade: Grade = .grade10,
        knowledgePoints: KnowledgePoints = .empty,
        difficulty: Difficulty = .medium,
        errorType: ErrorType = .other,
        source: Source = .other,
        questionType: ReviewItemType = .other
    ) {
        self.id = id
        self.imageData = imageData
        self.title = title.isEmpty ? String(localized: "untitled_review_item") : title
        self.note = note
        self.createdAt = createdAt
        self.updatedAt = createdAt
        self.masteryLevel = mastery.rawValue
        self.nextReviewDate = createdAt
        self.reviewCount = 0
        self.subjectRaw = subject.rawValue
        self.gradeRaw = grade.rawValue
        self.knowledgePointsRaw = knowledgePoints.rawValue
        self.difficultyRaw = difficulty.rawValue
        self.errorTypeRaw = errorType.rawValue
        self.sourceRaw = source.rawValue
        self.questionTypeRaw = questionType.rawValue
    }

    // MARK: - Internal Helpers

    /// 标记为已更新
    ///
    /// 更新 `updatedAt` 时间戳。
    /// 供扩展文件中的方法调用。
    func markAsUpdated() {
        updatedAt = Date()
    }
}

//
//  Source.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  题目来源值对象
//

import SwiftUI

// MARK: - Source

/// 题目来源
///
/// K12 教育中常见的题目来源，按分类组织。
///
/// ## 来源分布
///
/// ### 官方来源（2种）
/// - 课本、历年真题
///
/// ### 学校来源（3种）
/// - 考试、模拟考、作业
///
/// ### 课外来源（3种）
/// - 练习册、辅导班、竞赛
///
/// ### 其他来源（3种）
/// - 网络、自测、其他
///
/// ## 使用示例
///
/// ```swift
/// let source = Source.pastExam
/// print(source.displayName)     // "历年真题"
/// print(source.importance)      // 5
/// print(source.isAuthoritative) // true
///
/// // 获取高重要性来源
/// let important = Source.highImportanceSources
/// ```
enum Source: String, Sendable, CaseIterable, Codable, Hashable, Identifiable {

    // MARK: - Official Sources (官方)

    /// 课本
    ///
    /// 教材教辅，官方权威。
    case textbook = "课本"

    /// 历年真题
    ///
    /// 中考、高考等正式考试真题。
    case pastExam = "历年真题"

    // MARK: - School Sources (学校)

    /// 考试
    ///
    /// 校内正式考试（期中、期末等）。
    case exam = "考试"

    /// 模拟考
    ///
    /// 模拟考试，仿真度较高。
    case mock = "模拟考"

    /// 作业
    ///
    /// 日常作业、课后练习。
    case homework = "作业"

    // MARK: - Extra Sources (课外)

    /// 练习册
    ///
    /// 市售练习册、习题集。
    case workbook = "练习册"

    /// 辅导班
    ///
    /// 课外辅导机构资料。
    case tutor = "辅导班"

    /// 竞赛
    ///
    /// 学科竞赛、奥赛等。
    case competition = "竞赛"

    // MARK: - Other Sources (其他)

    /// 网络
    ///
    /// 网络资源、在线题库。
    case online = "网络"

    /// 自测
    ///
    /// 自主测试、自我检验。
    case selfTest = "自测"

    /// 其他
    ///
    /// 其他来源。
    case other = "其他"

    // MARK: - Identifiable

    /// 唯一标识符
    nonisolated var id: String { rawValue }
}

// MARK: - Source Display Properties

extension Source {

    /// 显示名称
    nonisolated var displayName: String {
        String(localized: localizationKey)
    }

    /// 本地化键值
    private var localizationKey: String.LocalizationValue {
        switch self {
        case .textbook: "source_textbook"
        case .pastExam: "source_past_exam"
        case .exam: "source_exam"
        case .mock: "source_mock"
        case .homework: "source_homework"
        case .workbook: "source_workbook"
        case .tutor: "source_tutor"
        case .competition: "source_competition"
        case .online: "source_online"
        case .selfTest: "source_self_test"
        case .other: "source_other"
        }
    }

    /// 简短标签
    ///
    /// 用于空间有限的 UI 展示。
    nonisolated var shortLabel: String {
        String(localized: shortLabelKey)
    }

    /// 简短标签本地化键值
    private var shortLabelKey: String.LocalizationValue {
        switch self {
        case .textbook: "source_textbook_short"
        case .pastExam: "source_past_exam_short"
        case .exam: "source_exam_short"
        case .mock: "source_mock_short"
        case .homework: "source_homework_short"
        case .workbook: "source_workbook_short"
        case .tutor: "source_tutor_short"
        case .competition: "source_competition_short"
        case .online: "source_online_short"
        case .selfTest: "source_self_test_short"
        case .other: "source_other_short"
        }
    }

    /// SF Symbol 图标名称
    nonisolated var icon: String {
        switch self {
        case .textbook: "book.closed"
        case .pastExam: "doc.badge.clock"
        case .exam: "doc.text.fill"
        case .mock: "doc.text"
        case .homework: "pencil.and.list.clipboard"
        case .workbook: "book"

        case .competition: "trophy"
        case .online: "globe"
        case .selfTest: "person.crop.circle.badge.questionmark"
        case .other: "ellipsis.circle"
        }
    }

    /// 主题颜色
    nonisolated var color: Color {
        switch self {
        case .textbook: .blue
        case .pastExam: .red
        case .exam: .red
        case .mock: .orange
        case .homework: .green
        case .workbook: .cyan
        case .tutor: .purple
        case .competition: .yellow
        case .online: .indigo
        case .selfTest: .mint
        case .other: .gray
        }
    }

// MARK: - Source Category

extension Source {

    /// 来源分类
    nonisolated var category: SourceCategory {
        switch self {
        case .textbook, .pastExam:
            .official
        case .exam, .mock, .homework:
            .school
        case .workbook, .tutor, .competition:
            .extra
        case .online, .selfTest, .other:
            .other
        }
    }

    /// 是否为官方来源
    nonisolated var isOfficial: Bool { category == .official }

    /// 是否为学校来源
    nonisolated var isSchool: Bool { category == .school }

    /// 是否为课外来源
    nonisolated var isExtra: Bool { category == .extra }
}

// MARK: - Source Importance

extension Source {

    /// 重要程度
    ///
    /// 1-5 分，数字越大越重要：
    /// - 5：历年真题、正式考试
    /// - 4：竞赛、模拟考、课本
    /// - 3：辅导班、练习册
    /// - 2：作业、网络
    /// - 1：自测、其他
    nonisolated var importance: Int {
        switch self {
        case .pastExam: 5
        case .exam: 5
        case .textbook: 5
        case .competition: 4
        case .mock: 4
        case .tutor: 3
        case .workbook: 3
        case .homework: 3
        case .online: 2
        case .selfTest: 1
        case .other: 1
        }
    }

    /// 重要程度描述
    nonisolated var importanceDescription: String {
        switch importance {
        case 5: "非常重要"
        case 4: "重要"
        case 3: "一般"
        case 2: "次要"
        default: "低"
        }
    }

    /// 是否为高重要性来源
    ///
    /// 重要程度 >= 4 视为高重要性。
    nonisolated var isHighImportance: Bool { importance >= 4 }

    /// 是否为中等重要性来源
    ///
    /// 重要程度 >= 3 且 < 4。
    nonisolated var isMediumImportance: Bool { importance == 3 }

    /// 是否为低重要性来源
    ///
    /// 重要程度 < 3。
    nonisolated var isLowImportance: Bool { importance < 3 }
}

// MARK: - Source Authority & Exam

extension Source {

    /// 是否为高权威来源
    ///
    /// 官方来源或正式考试视为高权威。
    nonisolated var isAuthoritative: Bool {
        category == .official || self == .exam
    }

    /// 是否为考试相关
    ///
    /// 包括历年真题、正式考试、模拟考。
    nonisolated var isExamRelated: Bool {
        [.pastExam, .exam, .mock].contains(self)
    }

    /// 是否为提升类来源
    ///
    /// 竞赛、辅导班等提升类来源。
    nonisolated var isAdvanced: Bool {
        [.competition, .tutor].contains(self)
    }
}

// MARK: - Source Static Collections

extension Source {

    /// 所有官方来源
    nonisolated static var officialSources: [Source] {
        [.textbook, .pastExam]
    }

    /// 所有学校来源
    nonisolated static var schoolSources: [Source] {
        [.exam, .mock, .homework]
    }

    /// 所有课外来源
    nonisolated static var extraSources: [Source] {
        [.workbook, .tutor, .competition]
    }

    /// 所有考试相关来源
    nonisolated static var examRelatedSources: [Source] {
        [.pastExam, .exam, .mock]
    }

    /// 高重要性来源
    ///
    /// 重要程度 >= 4 的所有来源。
    nonisolated static var highImportanceSources: [Source] {
        allCases.filter { $0.importance >= 4 }
    }

    /// 高权威来源
    nonisolated static var authoritativeSources: [Source] {
        allCases.filter { $0.isAuthoritative }
    }
}

// MARK: - Source Query Methods

extension Source {

    /// 获取某分类下的所有来源
    ///
    /// - Parameter category: 来源分类
    /// - Returns: 该分类下的所有来源
    nonisolated static func sources(in category: SourceCategory) -> [Source] {
        allCases.filter { $0.category == category }
    }

    /// 获取指定重要程度的所有来源
    ///
    /// - Parameter level: 重要程度（1-5）
    /// - Returns: 该重要程度的所有来源
    nonisolated static func sources(withImportance level: Int) -> [Source] {
        allCases.filter { $0.importance == level }
    }

    /// 获取重要程度大于等于指定值的所有来源
    ///
    /// - Parameter minLevel: 最低重要程度
    /// - Returns: 符合条件的所有来源
    nonisolated static func sources(withMinImportance minLevel: Int) -> [Source] {
        allCases.filter { $0.importance >= minLevel }
    }

    /// 按重要程度排序的所有来源
    ///
    /// 从高到低排序。
    nonisolated static var sortedByImportance: [Source] {
        allCases.sorted { $0.importance > $1.importance }
    }
}

import SwiftUI

// MARK: - Grade

/// 年级（K12：小学到高中共12个年级）
///
/// 完整覆盖 K12 教育体系的所有年级。
///
/// ## 年级列表
///
/// ### 小学（Primary）
/// - ``grade1`` ~ ``grade6``: 一年级到六年级
///
/// ### 初中（Junior）
/// - ``grade7`` ~ ``grade9``: 七年级到九年级
///
/// ### 高中（Senior）
/// - ``grade10`` ~ ``grade12``: 高一到高三
///
/// ## 使用示例
/// ```swift
/// let grade = Grade.grade9
/// print(grade.displayName)  // "九年级"
/// print(grade.shortLabel)   // "初三"
/// print(grade.stage)        // .junior
/// print(grade.order)        // 9
/// ```
enum Grade: String, Sendable, CaseIterable, Codable, Hashable, Identifiable {
    // 幼儿园
    case kindergarten = "kindergarten"

    // 小学 (6年)
    /// 一年级
    case grade1 = "grade_1"
    /// 二年级
    case grade2 = "grade_2"
    /// 三年级
    case grade3 = "grade_3"
    /// 四年级
    case grade4 = "grade_4"
    /// 五年级
    case grade5 = "grade_5"
    /// 六年级
    case grade6 = "grade_6"

    // 初中 (3年)
    /// 七年级（初一）
    case grade7 = "grade_7"
    /// 八年级（初二）
    case grade8 = "grade_8"
    /// 九年级（初三）
    case grade9 = "grade_9"

    // 高中 (3年)
    /// 高一（十年级）
    case grade10 = "grade_10"
    /// 高二（十一年级）
    case grade11 = "grade_11"
    /// 高三（十二年级）
    case grade12 = "grade_12"

    // MARK: Identifiable

    nonisolated var id: String { rawValue }
}

// MARK: - Grade Display Properties

extension Grade {
    /// 显示名称
    nonisolated var displayName: String {
        String(localized: localizationKey)
    }

    /// 本地化键值
    private var localizationKey: String.LocalizationValue {
        switch self {
        case .kindergarten: "grade_k"
        case .grade1: "grade_1"
        case .grade2: "grade_2"
        case .grade3: "grade_3"
        case .grade4: "grade_4"
        case .grade5: "grade_5"
        case .grade6: "grade_6"
        case .grade7: "grade_7"
        case .grade8: "grade_8"
        case .grade9: "grade_9"
        case .grade10: "grade_10"
        case .grade11: "grade_11"
        case .grade12: "grade_12"
        }
    }

    /// 简短标签
    nonisolated var shortLabel: String {
        String(localized: shortLabelKey)
    }

    /// 简短标签本地化键值
    private var shortLabelKey: String.LocalizationValue {
        switch self {
        case .kindergarten: "grade_k_short"
        case .grade1: "grade_1_short"
        case .grade2: "grade_2_short"
        case .grade3: "grade_3_short"
        case .grade4: "grade_4_short"
        case .grade5: "grade_5_short"
        case .grade6: "grade_6_short"
        case .grade7: "grade_7_short"
        case .grade8: "grade_8_short"
        case .grade9: "grade_9_short"
        case .grade10: "grade_10_short"
        case .grade11: "grade_11_short"
        case .grade12: "grade_12_short"
        }
    }

    /// SF Symbol 图标名称
    nonisolated var icon: String {
        switch self {
        case .kindergarten, .grade1, .grade2:
            "figure.child"
        case .grade3, .grade4, .grade5, .grade6:
            "figure.child.and.lock"
        case .grade7, .grade8, .grade9:
            "figure.stand"
        case .grade10, .grade11, .grade12:
            "graduationcap"
        }
    }

    /// 主题颜色（同学段渐变）
    nonisolated var color: Color {
        switch self {
        // 幼儿园：粉色系
        case .kindergarten: .pink
        // 小学：绿色系
        case .grade1: .mint
        case .grade2: .green
        case .grade3: .teal
        case .grade4: .cyan
        case .grade5: .blue
        case .grade6: .indigo
        // 初中：暖色系
        case .grade7: .yellow
        case .grade8: .orange
        case .grade9: .red
        // 高中：紫色系
        case .grade10: .pink
        case .grade11: .purple
        case .grade12: Color(red: 0.5, green: 0, blue: 0.5)
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Grade Classification

extension Grade {
    /// 学段分组
    nonisolated var stage: GradeStage {
        switch self {
        case .kindergarten, .grade1, .grade2, .grade3, .grade4, .grade5, .grade6:
            .primary
        case .grade7, .grade8, .grade9:
            .junior
        case .grade10, .grade11, .grade12:
            .senior
        }
    }

    /// 年级序号（0-12）
    nonisolated var order: Int {
        switch self {
        case .kindergarten: 0
        case .grade1: 1
        case .grade2: 2
        case .grade3: 3
        case .grade4: 4
        case .grade5: 5
        case .grade6: 6
        case .grade7: 7
        case .grade8: 8
        case .grade9: 9
        case .grade10: 10
        case .grade11: 11
        case .grade12: 12
        }
    }

    /// 是否为毕业年级（六年级、九年级、高三）
    nonisolated var isGraduationYear: Bool {
        switch self {
        case .grade6, .grade9, .grade12: true
        default: false
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Grade Factory Methods

extension Grade {
    /// 根据年级序号创建年级
    /// - Parameter order: 年级序号（1-12）
    /// - Returns: 对应的年级，无效序号返回 nil
    static func from(order: Int) -> Grade? {
        allCases.first { $0.order == order }
    }

    /// 获取指定学段的年级列表
    /// - Parameter stage: 学段
    /// - Returns: 该学段下的年级数组
    static func grades(for stage: GradeStage) -> [Grade] {
        allCases.filter { $0.stage == stage }
    }
}

// MARK: - Grade Comparable

extension Grade: Comparable {
    nonisolated static func < (lhs: Grade, rhs: Grade) -> Bool {
        lhs.order < rhs.order
    }
}

// MARK: - Grade CustomStringConvertible

extension Grade: CustomStringConvertible {
    nonisolated var description: String { displayName }
}

// MARK: - Grade Collections

extension Grade {
    /// 小学年级
    static let primaryGrades: [Grade] = [.kindergarten, .grade1, .grade2, .grade3, .grade4, .grade5, .grade6]

    /// 初中年级
    static let juniorGrades: [Grade] = [.grade7, .grade8, .grade9]

    /// 高中年级
    static let seniorGrades: [Grade] = [.grade10, .grade11, .grade12]

    /// 毕业年级
    static let graduationGrades: [Grade] = [.grade6, .grade9, .grade12]
}

//
//  GradeStage.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  学段值对象（小学/初中/高中）
//

import SwiftUI

// MARK: - GradeStage

/// 学段（小学/初中/高中）
///
/// 表示 K12 教育的三个主要学段，用于筛选学科和题目。
///
/// ## 学段说明
/// - ``primary``: 小学（1-6年级）
/// - ``junior``: 初中（7-9年级）
/// - ``senior``: 高中（10-12年级）
///
/// ## 使用示例
/// ```swift
/// let stage = GradeStage.junior
/// print(stage.displayName)     // "初中"
/// print(stage.gradeRange)      // "7-9年级"
/// print(stage.grades)          // [.grade7, .grade8, .grade9]
/// ```
enum GradeStage: String, Sendable, CaseIterable, Codable, Hashable, Identifiable {
    /// 小学（1-6年级）
    case primary = "primary"

    /// 初中（7-9年级）
    case junior = "junior"

    /// 高中（10-12年级）
    case senior = "senior"

    // MARK: Identifiable

    nonisolated var id: String { rawValue }
}

// MARK: - GradeStage Display Properties

extension GradeStage {
    /// 显示名称
    nonisolated var displayName: String {
        String(localized: localizationKey)
    }

    /// 本地化键值
    private var localizationKey: String.LocalizationValue {
        switch self {
        case .primary: "grade_stage_primary"
        case .junior: "grade_stage_junior"
        case .senior: "grade_stage_senior"
        }
    }

    /// 简短标签
    nonisolated var shortLabel: String {
        String(localized: shortLabelKey)
    }

    /// 简短标签本地化键值
    private var shortLabelKey: String.LocalizationValue {
        switch self {
        case .primary: "grade_stage_primary_short"
        case .junior: "grade_stage_junior_short"
        case .senior: "grade_stage_senior_short"
        }
    }

    /// SF Symbol 图标名称
    nonisolated var icon: String {
        switch self {
        case .primary: "figure.child"
        case .junior: "figure.stand"
        case .senior: "graduationcap"
        }
    }

    /// 主题颜色
    nonisolated var color: Color {
        switch self {
        case .primary: .green
        case .junior: .orange
        case .senior: .purple
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - GradeStage Grade Information

extension GradeStage {
    /// 年级范围描述
    nonisolated var gradeRange: String {
        String(localized: gradeRangeKey)
    }

    /// 年级范围本地化键值
    private var gradeRangeKey: String.LocalizationValue {
        switch self {
        case .primary: "grade_stage_primary_range"
        case .junior: "grade_stage_junior_range"
        case .senior: "grade_stage_senior_range"
        }
    }

    /// 该学段包含的年级
    nonisolated var grades: [Grade] {
        Grade.allCases.filter { $0.stage == self }
    }

    /// 年级数量
    nonisolated var gradeCount: Int {
        switch self {
        case .primary: 7 // 包含幼儿园
        case .junior: 3
        case .senior: 3
        }
    }

    /// 起始年级序号
    nonisolated var firstGradeOrder: Int {
        switch self {
        case .primary: 0 // 包含幼儿园
        case .junior: 7
        case .senior: 10
        }
    }

    /// 结束年级序号
    nonisolated var lastGradeOrder: Int {
        switch self {
        case .primary: 6
        case .junior: 9
        case .senior: 12
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - GradeStage Factory Methods

extension GradeStage {
    /// 根据年级序号获取学段
    /// - Parameter order: 年级序号（0-12）
    /// - Returns: 对应的学段，无效序号返回 nil
    static func from(gradeOrder order: Int) -> GradeStage? {
        switch order {
        case 0...6: .primary
        case 7...9: .junior
        case 10...12: .senior
        default: nil
        }
    }

    /// 检查年级序号是否属于此学段
    /// - Parameter order: 年级序号
    /// - Returns: 是否属于此学段
    nonisolated func contains(gradeOrder order: Int) -> Bool {
        order >= firstGradeOrder && order <= lastGradeOrder
    }
}

// MARK: - GradeStage Comparable

extension GradeStage: Comparable {
    nonisolated static func < (lhs: GradeStage, rhs: GradeStage) -> Bool {
        lhs.firstGradeOrder < rhs.firstGradeOrder
    }
}

// MARK: - GradeStage CustomStringConvertible

extension GradeStage: CustomStringConvertible {
    nonisolated var description: String { displayName }
}

//
//  ReviewItemCategory.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  题型分类值对象
//

import SwiftUI

// MARK: - ReviewItemCategory

/// 题型分类
///
/// 将各种题型按评分方式和答案特点分为四大类。
///
/// ## 分类标准
///
/// - **客观题**：答案唯一，对错分明
/// - **主观题**：答案开放，按步给分
/// - **综合题**：综合能力，整体评分
/// - **其他**：不便分类的特殊题型
///
/// ## 使用示例
///
/// ```swift
/// let category = ReviewItemCategory.objective
/// print(category.displayName)  // "客观题"
/// print(category.gradingCharacteristic)  // "答案唯一，对错分明"
/// ```
enum ReviewItemCategory: String, Sendable, CaseIterable, Codable, Hashable, Identifiable {

    /// 客观题
    ///
    /// 包括选择、多选、判断、填空、连线等题型。
    /// 答案唯一，评分标准明确。
    case objective = "客观题"

    /// 主观题
    ///
    /// 包括简答、计算、证明、作图、实验、材料分析等题型。
    /// 答案开放，通常按步骤给分。
    case subjective = "主观题"

    /// 综合题
    ///
    /// 包括阅读理解、作文、完形填空等题型。
    /// 考察综合能力，整体评分。
    case comprehensive = "综合题"

    /// 其他
    ///
    /// 不便分类的特殊题型。
    case other = "其他"

    // MARK: - Identifiable

    /// 唯一标识符
    nonisolated var id: String { rawValue }
}

// MARK: - ReviewItemCategory Display Properties

extension ReviewItemCategory {

    /// 显示名称
    nonisolated var displayName: String {
        String(localized: localizationKey)
    }

    /// 本地化键值
    private var localizationKey: String.LocalizationValue {
        switch self {
        case .objective: "item_category_objective"
        case .subjective: "item_category_subjective"
        case .comprehensive: "item_category_comprehensive"
        case .other: "item_category_other"
        }
    }

    /// 简短标签
    nonisolated var shortLabel: String {
        String(localized: shortLabelKey)
    }

    /// 简短标签本地化键值
    private var shortLabelKey: String.LocalizationValue {
        switch self {
        case .objective: "item_category_objective_short"
        case .subjective: "item_category_subjective_short"
        case .comprehensive: "item_category_comprehensive_short"
        case .other: "item_category_other_short"
        }
    }

    /// SF Symbol 图标名称
    nonisolated var icon: String {
        switch self {
        case .objective: "checkmark.square"
        case .subjective: "pencil"
        case .comprehensive: "doc.text"
        case .other: "ellipsis.circle"
        }
    }

    /// 主题颜色
    nonisolated var color: Color {
        switch self {
        case .objective: .blue
        case .subjective: .orange
        case .comprehensive: .purple
        case .other: .gray
        }
    }

    /// 评分特点描述
    nonisolated var gradingCharacteristic: String {
        String(localized: gradingCharacteristicKey)
    }

    /// 评分特点本地化键值
    private var gradingCharacteristicKey: String.LocalizationValue {
        switch self {
        case .objective: "item_category_objective_grading"
        case .subjective: "item_category_subjective_grading"
        case .comprehensive: "item_category_comprehensive_grading"
        case .other: "item_category_other_grading"
        }
    }
}

import Foundation

// MARK: - ReviewInterval

/// 复习间隔计算器
///
/// 基于艾宾浩斯遗忘曲线，结合掌握程度动态调整复习间隔。
/// 遵循值对象原则：完全不可变，相同输入产生相同输出。
///
/// ## 遗忘曲线原理
///
/// 艾宾浩斯遗忘曲线表明，记忆随时间呈指数衰减：
/// - 20分钟后：遗忘 42%
/// - 1小时后：遗忘 56%
/// - 1天后：遗忘 74%
/// - 1周后：遗忘 77%
/// - 1个月后：遗忘 79%
///
/// ## 间隔重复策略
///
/// 通过在最佳时机复习，可以将遗忘曲线"重置"：
/// ```
/// 标准间隔序列：1, 2, 4, 7, 15, 30, 60, 120, 180, 365 天
/// ```
///
/// ## 使用示例
///
/// ```swift
/// // 创建首次复习间隔
/// let firstInterval = ReviewInterval.firstReview(mastery: .none)
///
/// // 计算下次复习日期
/// let nextDate = firstInterval.nextReviewDate
///
/// // 检查紧迫程度
/// if firstInterval.isDueToday {
///     print("今天需要复习")
/// }
///
/// // 创建后续复习间隔
/// let nextInterval = ReviewInterval.next(from: firstInterval, newMastery: .partial)
/// ```
///
/// - Note: 此值对象是不可变的，所有属性都是 `let` 声明
/// - Important: 记忆保持率计算基于科学研究，但仅供参考
struct ReviewInterval: Sendable, Equatable, Codable, Hashable, Identifiable {

    // MARK: - Properties

    /// 复习次数
    ///
    /// 从 0 开始计数，表示已完成的复习次数。
    /// 影响标准间隔的选择。
    let reviewCount: Int

    /// 掌握程度
    ///
    /// 影响复习间隔的调整系数：
    /// - 掌握程度越高，间隔越长
    /// - 掌握程度越低，间隔越短
    let mastery: MasteryLevel

    /// 基准日期
    ///
    /// 用于计算下次复习日期的起始日期。
    /// 通常为上次复习日期或录入日期。
    let baseDate: Date

    // MARK: - Identifiable

    /// 唯一标识符
    ///
    /// 组合复习次数、掌握程度和基准日期生成。
    nonisolated var id: String {
        "\(reviewCount)-\(mastery.rawValue)-\(baseDate.timeIntervalSince1970)"
    }
}

// MARK: - ReviewInterval Ebbinghaus Constants

extension ReviewInterval {

    /// 标准复习间隔序列（天）
    ///
    /// 基于艾宾浩斯遗忘曲线的最佳复习时机：
    /// - 第1次：1天后
    /// - 第2次：2天后
    /// - 第3次：4天后
    /// - 第4次：1周后
    /// - 第5次：2周后
    /// - 第6次：1个月后
    /// - 第7次：2个月后
    /// - 第8次：4个月后
    /// - 第9次：半年后
    /// - 第10次：1年后
    nonisolated static var standardIntervals: [Int] {
        [1, 2, 4, 7, 15, 30, 60, 120, 180, 365]
    }

    /// 遗忘曲线稳定性系数
    ///
    /// 用于记忆保持率计算。此值基于 SuperMemo SM-2 算法的简化版本，
    /// 结合艾宾浩斯遗忘曲线的研究调整。
    ///
    /// - Note: 原始艾宾浩斯研究使用无意义音节，实际学习效果会更好。
    ///   此系数经过调整以适应 K12 教育场景中的有意义学习材料。
    /// - SeeAlso: Pimsleur, P. (1967). A memory schedule.
    nonisolated static var stabilityCoefficient: Double { 1.84 }
}

// MARK: - ReviewInterval Interval Calculation

extension ReviewInterval {

    /// 计算下次复习间隔天数
    ///
    /// 根据复习次数获取基础间隔，再根据掌握程度调整：
    /// - 完全掌握：间隔 × 2.0
    /// - 基本掌握：间隔 × 1.5
    /// - 部分掌握：间隔 × 1.0
    /// - 一知半解：间隔 × 0.5
    /// - 完全不会：间隔 × 0.25
    ///
    /// - Returns: 调整后的复习间隔天数，最小为 1 天
    nonisolated var intervalDays: Int {
        let baseInterval = Self.standardIntervals[safe: reviewCount] ?? 365
        let multiplier = mastery.intervalMultiplier
        return max(1, Int(Double(baseInterval) * multiplier))
    }

    /// 计算下次复习日期
    ///
    /// 基于 `baseDate` 加上 `intervalDays` 计算。
    ///
    /// - Returns: 下次应该复习的日期
    nonisolated var nextReviewDate: Date {
        Calendar.current.date(byAdding: .day, value: intervalDays, to: baseDate) ?? baseDate
    }
}

// MARK: - ReviewInterval Time Status

extension ReviewInterval {

    /// 距离下次复习的天数
    ///
    /// - 正数：还有几天需要复习
    /// - 零：今天需要复习
    /// - 负数：已逾期几天
    nonisolated var daysUntilReview: Int {
        let calendar = Calendar.current
        let today = calendar.startOfDay(for: Date())
        let reviewDay = calendar.startOfDay(for: nextReviewDate)
        return calendar.dateComponents([.day], from: today, to: reviewDay).day ?? 0
    }

    /// 是否已逾期
    nonisolated var isOverdue: Bool { daysUntilReview < 0 }

    /// 逾期天数
    ///
    /// 如果未逾期返回 0。
    nonisolated var overdueByDays: Int { max(0, -daysUntilReview) }

    /// 是否今天需要复习
    ///
    /// 包括已逾期的情况。
    nonisolated var isDueToday: Bool { daysUntilReview <= 0 }

    /// 是否本周内需要复习
    nonisolated var isDueThisWeek: Bool { daysUntilReview <= 7 }

    /// 是否本月内需要复习
    nonisolated var isDueThisMonth: Bool { daysUntilReview <= 30 }
}

// MARK: - ReviewInterval Memory Retention

extension ReviewInterval {

    /// 估算当前记忆保持率
    ///
    /// 基于简化的遗忘曲线模型：R = e^(-t / (S × M))
    /// 其中：
    /// - R：记忆保持率（0.0 - 1.0）
    /// - t：距离上次学习的天数
    /// - S：基础稳定性系数（`stabilityCoefficient`）
    /// - M：掌握程度调整因子（`masteryStabilityFactor`）
    ///
    /// 与标准艾宾浩斯公式 R = e^(-t/S) 的区别：
    /// 本实现添加了掌握程度因子，使得掌握越好衰减越慢。
    ///
    /// - Returns: 0.0 到 1.0 之间的保持率
    nonisolated var estimatedRetention: Double {
        let daysSinceBase = max(0, -daysUntilReview + intervalDays)
        guard daysSinceBase > 0 else { return 1.0 }

        let adjustedStability = Self.stabilityCoefficient * masteryStabilityFactor
        let retention = exp(-Double(daysSinceBase) / adjustedStability)
        return min(1.0, max(0.0, retention))
    }

    /// 掌握程度对记忆稳定性的影响因子
    ///
    /// 掌握程度越高，记忆越稳定，衰减越慢。
    nonisolated private var masteryStabilityFactor: Double {
        mastery.stabilityFactor
    }

    /// 记忆保持率百分比
    nonisolated var retentionPercentage: Int {
        Int(estimatedRetention * 100)
    }

    /// 记忆保持率描述
    nonisolated var retentionDescription: String {
        switch retentionPercentage {
        case 90...100: "记忆清晰"
        case 70..<90: "记忆良好"
        case 50..<70: "记忆模糊"
        case 30..<50: "即将遗忘"
        default: "可能已遗忘"
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - ReviewInterval Urgency

extension ReviewInterval {

    /// 复习紧迫程度等级
    ///
    /// 1-5 级，数字越大越紧急：
    /// - 5：已逾期
    /// - 4：今天
    /// - 3：近期（1-3天）
    /// - 2：本周（4-7天）
    /// - 1：较远（7天以上）
    nonisolated var urgencyLevel: Int {
        switch daysUntilReview {
        case ..<0: 5
        case 0: 4
        case 1...3: 3
        case 4...7: 2
        default: 1
        }
    }

    /// 复习紧迫程度描述
    nonisolated var urgencyDescription: String {
        switch daysUntilReview {
        case ..<(-7): "严重逾期"
        case (-7)..<0: "已逾期"
        case 0: "今天复习"
        case 1: "明天复习"
        case 2...3: "近期复习"
        case 4...7: "本周复习"
        case 8...30: "本月复习"
        default: "已掌握"
        }
    }

    /// 复习紧迫程度简短描述
    nonisolated var urgencyShortDescription: String {
        switch daysUntilReview {
        case ..<0: "逾期\(overdueByDays)天"
        case 0: "今天"
        case 1: "明天"
        default: "\(daysUntilReview)天后"
        }
    }

    /// 是否紧急（需要立即关注）
    nonisolated var isUrgent: Bool { urgencyLevel >= 4 }
}

// MARK: - ReviewInterval Factory Methods

extension ReviewInterval {

    /// 创建首次复习间隔
    ///
    /// 用于新录入的错题，复习次数为 0。
    ///
    /// - Parameter mastery: 初始掌握程度，默认为 `.none`
    /// - Returns: 首次复习间隔实例
    nonisolated static func firstReview(mastery: MasteryLevel = .none) -> ReviewInterval {
        ReviewInterval(reviewCount: 0, mastery: mastery, baseDate: Date())
    }

    /// 根据复习历史计算间隔
    ///
    /// - Parameters:
    ///   - reviewCount: 已完成的复习次数
    ///   - mastery: 当前掌握程度
    /// - Returns: 计算后的复习间隔实例
    nonisolated static func calculate(reviewCount: Int, mastery: MasteryLevel) -> ReviewInterval {
        ReviewInterval(reviewCount: reviewCount, mastery: mastery, baseDate: Date())
    }

    /// 根据复习历史和指定日期计算间隔
    ///
    /// 主要用于测试或历史数据导入。
    ///
    /// - Parameters:
    ///   - reviewCount: 已完成的复习次数
    ///   - mastery: 当前掌握程度
    ///   - date: 基准日期
    /// - Returns: 计算后的复习间隔实例
    nonisolated static func calculate(
        reviewCount: Int,
        mastery: MasteryLevel,
        from date: Date
    ) -> ReviewInterval {
        ReviewInterval(reviewCount: reviewCount, mastery: mastery, baseDate: date)
    }

    /// 从上次复习记录创建下一次复习间隔
    ///
    /// 自动递增复习次数，更新基准日期为当前时间。
    ///
    /// - Parameters:
    ///   - previous: 上次复习间隔
    ///   - newMastery: 新的掌握程度
    /// - Returns: 下一次复习间隔实例
    nonisolated static func next(
        from previous: ReviewInterval,
        newMastery: MasteryLevel
    ) -> ReviewInterval {
        ReviewInterval(
            reviewCount: previous.reviewCount + 1,
            mastery: newMastery,
            baseDate: Date()
        )
    }
}

// MARK: - ReviewInterval Comparable

extension ReviewInterval: Comparable {

    /// 按紧迫程度排序
    ///
    /// 越紧急（daysUntilReview 越小）越靠前。
    nonisolated static func < (lhs: ReviewInterval, rhs: ReviewInterval) -> Bool {
        lhs.daysUntilReview < rhs.daysUntilReview
    }
}

// MARK: - ReviewInterval CustomStringConvertible

extension ReviewInterval: CustomStringConvertible {

    /// 调试描述
    nonisolated var description: String {
        "\(urgencyDescription) (保持率: \(retentionPercentage)%)"
    }
}

// MARK: - MasteryLevel Interval Extensions

private extension MasteryLevel {

    /// 间隔调整倍数
    nonisolated var intervalMultiplier: Double {
        switch self {
        case .mastered: 2.0
        case .good: 1.5
        case .partial: 1.0
        case .glimpse: 0.5
        case .none: 0.25
        }
    }

    /// 记忆稳定性因子
    nonisolated var stabilityFactor: Double {
        switch self {
        case .mastered: 2.0
        case .good: 1.5
        case .partial: 1.0
        case .glimpse: 0.7
        case .none: 0.5
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Array Safe Access

private extension Array {

    /// 安全下标访问
    ///
    /// 避免数组越界崩溃。
    ///
    /// - Parameter index: 要访问的索引
    /// - Returns: 索引对应的元素，如果越界则返回 `nil`
    subscript(safe index: Int) -> Element? {
        indices.contains(index) ? self[index] : nil
    }
}

//
//  SourceCategory.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  来源分类值对象
//

import SwiftUI

// MARK: - SourceCategory

/// 来源分类
///
/// 将题目来源按性质分为四大类。
///
/// ## 分类说明
///
/// - **官方**：课本、历年真题等权威来源
/// - **学校**：校内考试、模拟考、作业
/// - **课外**：练习册、辅导班、竞赛
/// - **其他**：网络、自测等
///
/// ## 使用示例
///
/// ```swift
/// let category = SourceCategory.official
/// print(category.displayName)  // "官方"
/// print(category.icon)         // "building.columns"
/// ```
enum SourceCategory: String, Sendable, CaseIterable, Codable, Hashable, Identifiable {

    /// 官方来源
    ///
    /// 包括课本、历年真题等权威出版物。
    case official = "官方"

    /// 学校来源
    ///
    /// 包括考试、模拟考、作业等校内资料。
    case school = "学校"

    /// 课外来源
    ///
    /// 包括练习册、辅导班、竞赛等校外资料。
    case extra = "课外"

    /// 其他来源
    ///
    /// 包括网络、自测等来源不明确的资料。
    case other = "其他"

    // MARK: - Identifiable

    /// 唯一标识符
    nonisolated var id: String { rawValue }
}

// MARK: - SourceCategory Display Properties

extension SourceCategory {

    /// 显示名称
    nonisolated var displayName: String {
        String(localized: localizationKey)
    }

    /// 本地化键值
    private var localizationKey: String.LocalizationValue {
        switch self {
        case .official: "source_category_official"
        case .school: "source_category_school"
        case .extra: "source_category_extra"
        case .other: "source_category_other"
        }
    }

    /// 简短标签
    nonisolated var shortLabel: String {
        String(localized: shortLabelKey)
    }

    /// 简短标签本地化键值
    private var shortLabelKey: String.LocalizationValue {
        switch self {
        case .official: "source_category_official_short"
        case .school: "source_category_school_short"
        case .extra: "source_category_extra_short"
        case .other: "source_category_other_short"
        }
    }

    /// SF Symbol 图标名称
    nonisolated var icon: String {
        switch self {
        case .official: "building.columns"
        case .school: "graduationcap"
        case .extra: "books.vertical"
        case .other: "ellipsis.circle"
        }
    }

    /// 主题颜色
    nonisolated var color: Color {
        switch self {
        case .official: .red
        case .school: .blue
        case .extra: .orange
        case .other: .gray
        }
    }

    /// 分类描述
    nonisolated var categoryDescription: String {
        String(localized: categoryDescriptionKey)
    }

    /// 分类描述本地化键值
    private var categoryDescriptionKey: String.LocalizationValue {
        switch self {
        case .official: "source_category_official_desc"
        case .school: "source_category_school_desc"
        case .extra: "source_category_extra_desc"
        case .other: "source_category_other_desc"
        }
    }
}

//
//  ReviewItemType.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  题型值对象
//

import SwiftUI

// MARK: - ReviewItemType

/// 错题类型（题型）
///
/// K12 教育中常见的各种题型，按分类组织。
///
/// ## 题型分布
///
/// ### 客观题（5种）
/// - 选择题、多选题、判断题、填空题、连线题
///
/// ### 主观题（6种）
/// - 简答题、计算题、证明题、作图题、实验题、材料分析
///
/// ### 综合题（3种）
/// - 阅读理解、作文、完形填空
///
/// ## 使用示例
///
/// ```swift
/// let type = ReviewItemType.calculation
/// print(type.displayName)  // "计算题"
/// print(type.category)     // .subjective
/// print(type.estimatedMinutes)  // 8
///
/// // 获取数学适用的题型
/// let mathTypes = ReviewItemType.types(for: .math)
/// ```
enum ReviewItemType: String, Sendable, CaseIterable, Codable, Hashable, Identifiable {

    // MARK: - Objective Types (客观题)

    /// 选择题
    ///
    /// 单项选择，四选一最常见。
    case choice = "选择题"

    /// 多选题
    ///
    /// 多项选择，通常有多个正确答案。
    case multiChoice = "多选题"

    /// 判断题
    ///
    /// 判断对错，二选一。
    case judgment = "判断题"

    /// 填空题
    ///
    /// 填写空缺内容，答案通常唯一。
    case fillBlank = "填空题"

    /// 连线题
    ///
    /// 将相关内容进行匹配连接。
    case matching = "连线题"

    // MARK: - Subjective Types (主观题)

    /// 简答题
    ///
    /// 简要回答问题，通常有要点采分。
    case shortAnswer = "简答题"

    /// 计算题
    ///
    /// 需要列式计算，按步骤给分。
    case calculation = "计算题"

    /// 证明题
    ///
    /// 数学或物理证明，逻辑严密性要求高。
    case proof = "证明题"

    /// 作图题
    ///
    /// 绘制图形、图表或示意图。
    case drawing = "作图题"

    /// 实验题
    ///
    /// 涉及实验设计、现象描述、结论分析。
    case experiment = "实验题"

    /// 材料分析
    ///
    /// 根据给定材料进行分析回答。
    case analysis = "材料分析"

    // MARK: - Comprehensive Types (综合题)

    /// 阅读理解
    ///
    /// 语文或英语阅读，综合理解能力。
    case reading = "阅读理解"

    /// 作文
    ///
    /// 写作题，考察语言表达和组织能力。
    case writing = "作文"

    /// 完形填空
    ///
    /// 英语完形填空，综合语法和语境理解。
    case cloze = "完形填空"

    // MARK: - Other

    /// 其他
    ///
    /// 不便分类的特殊题型。
    case other = "其他"

    // MARK: - Identifiable

    /// 唯一标识符
    nonisolated var id: String { rawValue }
}

// MARK: - ReviewItemType Display Properties

extension ReviewItemType {

    /// 显示名称
    nonisolated var displayName: String {
        String(localized: localizationKey)
    }

    /// 本地化键值
    private var localizationKey: String.LocalizationValue {
        switch self {
        case .choice: "item_type_choice"
        case .multiChoice: "item_type_multi_choice"
        case .judgment: "item_type_judgment"
        case .fillBlank: "item_type_fill_blank"
        case .matching: "item_type_matching"
        case .shortAnswer: "item_type_short_answer"
        case .calculation: "item_type_calculation"
        case .proof: "item_type_proof"
        case .drawing: "item_type_drawing"
        case .experiment: "item_type_experiment"
        case .analysis: "item_type_analysis"
        case .reading: "item_type_reading"
        case .writing: "item_type_writing"
        case .cloze: "item_type_cloze"
        case .other: "item_type_other"
        }
    }

    /// 简短标签（单字）
    ///
    /// 用于空间有限的 UI 展示。
    nonisolated var shortLabel: String {
        String(localized: shortLabelKey)
    }

    /// 简短标签本地化键值
    private var shortLabelKey: String.LocalizationValue {
        switch self {
        case .choice: "item_type_choice_short"
        case .multiChoice: "item_type_multi_choice_short"
        case .judgment: "item_type_judgment_short"
        case .fillBlank: "item_type_fill_blank_short"
        case .matching: "item_type_matching_short"
        case .shortAnswer: "item_type_short_answer_short"
        case .calculation: "item_type_calculation_short"
        case .proof: "item_type_proof_short"
        case .drawing: "item_type_drawing_short"
        case .experiment: "item_type_experiment_short"
        case .analysis: "item_type_analysis_short"
        case .reading: "item_type_reading_short"
        case .writing: "item_type_writing_short"
        case .cloze: "item_type_cloze_short"
        case .other: "item_type_other_short"
        }
    }

    /// SF Symbol 图标名称
    nonisolated var icon: String {
        switch self {
        case .choice: "checkmark.circle"
        case .multiChoice: "checklist"
        case .judgment: "hand.thumbsup"
        case .fillBlank: "square.and.pencil"
        case .matching: "arrow.left.arrow.right"
        case .shortAnswer: "text.alignleft"
        case .calculation: "function"
        case .proof: "arrow.right.arrow.left"
        case .drawing: "pencil.and.ruler"
        case .experiment: "flask"
        case .analysis: "doc.text.magnifyingglass"
        case .reading: "book"
        case .writing: "pencil.line"
        case .cloze: "text.badge.minus"
        case .other: "ellipsis.circle"
        }
    }

    /// 主题颜色
    nonisolated var color: Color {
        switch self {
        case .choice: .blue
        case .multiChoice: .indigo
        case .judgment: .cyan
        case .fillBlank: .green
        case .matching: .teal
        case .shortAnswer: .orange
        case .calculation: .red
        case .proof: .purple
        case .drawing: .pink
        case .experiment: .mint
        case .analysis: .brown
        case .reading: .yellow
        case .writing: .red
        case .cloze: .indigo
        case .other: .gray
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - ReviewItemType Category

extension ReviewItemType {

    /// 题型分类
    nonisolated var category: ReviewItemCategory {
        switch self {
        case .choice, .multiChoice, .judgment, .fillBlank, .matching:
            .objective
        case .shortAnswer, .calculation, .proof, .drawing, .experiment, .analysis:
            .subjective
        case .reading, .writing, .cloze:
            .comprehensive
        case .other:
            .other
        }
    }

    /// 是否为客观题
    ///
    /// 客观题有唯一答案，便于自动批改。
    nonisolated var isObjective: Bool { category == .objective }

    /// 是否为主观题
    nonisolated var isSubjective: Bool { category == .subjective }

    /// 是否为综合题
    nonisolated var isComprehensive: Bool { category == .comprehensive }
}

// MARK: - ReviewItemType Time & Difficulty

extension ReviewItemType {

    /// 预估答题时间（分钟）
    ///
    /// 基于题型的典型时间需求估算。
    nonisolated var estimatedMinutes: Int {
        switch self {
        case .choice, .judgment: 1
        case .multiChoice, .fillBlank, .matching: 2
        case .shortAnswer, .drawing: 5
        case .calculation, .experiment: 8
        case .reading: 10
        case .proof, .analysis, .cloze: 12
        case .writing: 45
        case .other: 5
        }
    }

    /// 预估答题时间描述
    nonisolated var estimatedTimeDescription: String {
        switch estimatedMinutes {
        case 1...2: "约 \(estimatedMinutes) 分钟"
        case 3...10: "约 \(estimatedMinutes) 分钟"
        case 11...20: "约 \(estimatedMinutes) 分钟"
        default: "约 \(estimatedMinutes) 分钟"
        }
    }

    /// 难度权重
    ///
    /// 综合题和主观题通常更难，权重更高：
    /// - 客观题：1.0
    /// - 主观题：1.5
    /// - 综合题：2.0
    nonisolated var difficultyWeight: Double {
        switch category {
        case .objective: 1.0
        case .subjective: 1.5
        case .comprehensive: 2.0
        case .other: 1.0
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - ReviewItemType Subject Association

extension ReviewItemType {

    /// 常见适用学科
    ///
    /// 返回该题型最常出现的学科列表。
    nonisolated var applicableSubjects: [Subject] {
        switch self {
        case .choice, .multiChoice, .judgment, .fillBlank:
            Subject.allCases.filter { $0 != .other }
        case .matching:
            [.english, .chinese]
        case .shortAnswer:
            [.chinese, .history, .geography, .politics, .ethics, .biology]
        case .calculation:
            [.math, .physics, .chemistry]
        case .proof:
            [.math, .physics]
        case .drawing:
            [.math, .physics, .geography]
        case .experiment:
            [.physics, .chemistry, .biology, .science]
        case .analysis:
            [.history, .geography, .politics]
        case .reading:
            [.chinese, .english]
        case .writing:
            [.chinese, .english]
        case .cloze:
            [.english]
        case .other:
            Subject.allCases
        }
    }

    /// 是否适用于指定学科
    ///
    /// - Parameter subject: 要检查的学科
    /// - Returns: 该题型是否常见于该学科
    nonisolated func isApplicable(to subject: Subject) -> Bool {
        applicableSubjects.contains(subject)
    }
}

// MARK: - ReviewItemType Static Collections

extension ReviewItemType {

    /// 所有客观题类型
    nonisolated static var objectiveTypes: [ReviewItemType] {
        [.choice, .multiChoice, .judgment, .fillBlank, .matching]
    }

    /// 所有主观题类型
    nonisolated static var subjectiveTypes: [ReviewItemType] {
        [.shortAnswer, .calculation, .proof, .drawing, .experiment, .analysis]
    }

    /// 所有综合题类型
    nonisolated static var comprehensiveTypes: [ReviewItemType] {
        [.reading, .writing, .cloze]
    }
}

// MARK: - ReviewItemType Query Methods

extension ReviewItemType {

    /// 获取某分类下的所有题型
    ///
    /// - Parameter category: 题型分类
    /// - Returns: 该分类下的所有题型
    nonisolated static func types(in category: ReviewItemCategory) -> [ReviewItemType] {
        allCases.filter { $0.category == category }
    }

    /// 获取适用于某学科的题型
    ///
    /// - Parameter subject: 学科
    /// - Returns: 适用于该学科的所有题型
    nonisolated static func types(for subject: Subject) -> [ReviewItemType] {
        allCases.filter { $0.applicableSubjects.contains(subject) }
    }

    /// 按预估时间排序的所有题型
    ///
    /// 从快到慢排序。
    nonisolated static var sortedByTime: [ReviewItemType] {
        allCases.sorted { $0.estimatedMinutes < $1.estimatedMinutes }
    }

    /// 按难度权重排序的所有题型
    ///
    /// 从简单到困难排序。
    nonisolated static var sortedByDifficulty: [ReviewItemType] {
        allCases.sorted { $0.difficultyWeight < $1.difficultyWeight }
    }
}

//
//  KnowledgePoints.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  知识点值对象 - 不可变集合设计
//

import Foundation

// MARK: - KnowledgePoints

/// 知识点集合
///
/// 表示一道错题涉及的知识点列表，如 ["函数", "导数", "极限"]。
/// 遵循值对象原则：不可变，所有操作返回新实例。
///
/// ## 核心特性
/// - **不可变设计**：所有修改操作返回新实例
/// - **自动去重**：创建时自动去除重复项
/// - **空值安全**：自动过滤空字符串和空白
///
/// ## 使用示例
/// ```swift
/// // 创建知识点集合
/// let points: KnowledgePoints = ["函数", "导数", "极限"]
///
/// // 添加知识点（返回新实例）
/// let newPoints = points.adding("积分")
///
/// // 从字符串创建
/// let fromString = KnowledgePoints(from: "函数, 导数, 极限")
///
/// // 搜索匹配
/// let matches = points.matches("函")  // true
/// ```
struct KnowledgePoints: Sendable, Codable, Hashable, Identifiable {

    // MARK: - Properties

    /// 内部存储的知识点数组
    let items: [String]

    /// 空知识点集合
    static let empty = KnowledgePoints([])

    // MARK: - Initialization

    /// 从字符串数组创建
    /// - Parameter items: 知识点数组（自动去重、去空、去首尾空格）
    init(_ items: [String] = []) {
        self.items = items
            .map { $0.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces) }
            .filter { !$0.isEmpty }
            .uniqued()
    }

    /// 从逗号分隔的字符串创建
    /// - Parameter string: 逗号分隔的知识点字符串
    init(from string: String) {
        let components = string.components(separatedBy: ",")
        self.init(components)
    }

    // MARK: - Identifiable

    /// 唯一标识符
    nonisolated var id: String { rawValue }
}

// MARK: - KnowledgePoints Computed Properties

extension KnowledgePoints {
    /// 知识点数组
    nonisolated var array: [String] { items }

    /// 知识点数量
    nonisolated var count: Int { items.count }

    /// 是否为空
    nonisolated var isEmpty: Bool { items.isEmpty }

    /// 是否非空
    nonisolated var isNotEmpty: Bool { !items.isEmpty }

    /// 第一个知识点
    nonisolated var first: String? { items.first }

    /// 最后一个知识点
    nonisolated var last: String? { items.last }

    /// 转换为逗号分隔的字符串（用于存储）
    nonisolated var rawValue: String {
        items.joined(separator: ", ")
    }
}

// MARK: - KnowledgePoints Operations

extension KnowledgePoints {
    /// 添加单个知识点
    /// - Parameter point: 要添加的知识点
    /// - Returns: 包含新知识点的新实例
    nonisolated func adding(_ point: String) -> KnowledgePoints {
        let trimmed = point.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces)
        guard !trimmed.isEmpty, !items.contains(trimmed) else { return self }
        return KnowledgePoints(items + [trimmed])
    }

    /// 批量添加知识点
    /// - Parameter points: 要添加的知识点数组
    /// - Returns: 包含新知识点的新实例
    nonisolated func adding(_ points: [String]) -> KnowledgePoints {
        var newItems = items
        for point in points {
            let trimmed = point.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces)
            if !trimmed.isEmpty && !newItems.contains(trimmed) {
                newItems.append(trimmed)
            }
        }
        return KnowledgePoints(newItems)
    }

    /// 移除单个知识点
    /// - Parameter point: 要移除的知识点
    /// - Returns: 移除后的新实例
    nonisolated func removing(_ point: String) -> KnowledgePoints {
        KnowledgePoints(items.filter { $0 != point })
    }

    /// 批量移除知识点
    /// - Parameter points: 要移除的知识点数组
    /// - Returns: 移除后的新实例
    nonisolated func removing(_ points: [String]) -> KnowledgePoints {
        let pointsSet = Set(points)
        return KnowledgePoints(items.filter { !pointsSet.contains($0) })
    }

    /// 合并知识点集合
    /// - Parameter other: 要合并的知识点集合
    /// - Returns: 合并后的新实例
    nonisolated func merging(with other: KnowledgePoints) -> KnowledgePoints {
        KnowledgePoints(items + other.items)
    }

    /// 取交集
    /// - Parameter other: 另一个知识点集合
    /// - Returns: 交集后的新实例
    nonisolated func intersection(with other: KnowledgePoints) -> KnowledgePoints {
        let otherSet = Set(other.items)
        return KnowledgePoints(items.filter { otherSet.contains($0) })
    }

    /// 排序后的知识点
    /// - Returns: 按字母顺序排序的新实例
    nonisolated func sorted() -> KnowledgePoints {
        KnowledgePoints(items.sorted())
    }
}

// MARK: - KnowledgePoints Query Methods

extension KnowledgePoints {
    /// 是否包含知识点
    /// - Parameter point: 要查询的知识点
    /// - Returns: 是否包含
    nonisolated func contains(_ point: String) -> Bool {
        items.contains(point)
    }

    /// 是否包含任意一个知识点
    /// - Parameter points: 要查询的知识点数组
    /// - Returns: 是否包含任意一个
    nonisolated func containsAny(of points: [String]) -> Bool {
        let pointsSet = Set(points)
        return items.contains { pointsSet.contains($0) }
    }

    /// 是否包含所有知识点
    /// - Parameter points: 要查询的知识点数组
    /// - Returns: 是否全部包含
    nonisolated func containsAll(of points: [String]) -> Bool {
        let itemsSet = Set(items)
        return points.allSatisfy { itemsSet.contains($0) }
    }

    /// 搜索匹配（模糊搜索）
    /// - Parameter query: 搜索关键词
    /// - Returns: 是否有匹配
    nonisolated func matches(_ query: String) -> Bool {
        guard !query.isEmpty else { return true }
        let lowercasedQuery = query.lowercased()
        return items.contains { $0.lowercased().contains(lowercasedQuery) }
    }

    /// 过滤包含关键词的知识点
    /// - Parameter keyword: 过滤关键词
    /// - Returns: 过滤后的新实例
    nonisolated func filter(containing keyword: String) -> KnowledgePoints {
        guard !keyword.isEmpty else { return self }
        let lowercasedKeyword = keyword.lowercased()
        return KnowledgePoints(items.filter { $0.lowercased().contains(lowercasedKeyword) })
    }

    /// 下标访问（安全版本）
    /// - Parameter index: 索引
    /// - Returns: 对应的知识点，越界返回 nil
    nonisolated subscript(safe index: Int) -> String? {
        guard index >= 0 && index < items.count else { return nil }
        return items[index]
    }
}

// MARK: - KnowledgePoints Sequence

extension KnowledgePoints: Sequence {
    nonisolated func makeIterator() -> IndexingIterator<[String]> {
        items.makeIterator()
    }
}

// MARK: - KnowledgePoints Collection

extension KnowledgePoints: Collection {
    nonisolated var startIndex: Int { items.startIndex }
    nonisolated var endIndex: Int { items.endIndex }

    nonisolated func index(after i: Int) -> Int {
        items.index(after: i)
    }

    nonisolated subscript(position: Int) -> String {
        items[position]
    }
}

// MARK: - KnowledgePoints ExpressibleByArrayLiteral

extension KnowledgePoints: ExpressibleByArrayLiteral {
    init(arrayLiteral elements: String...) {
        self.init(elements)
    }
}

// MARK: - KnowledgePoints CustomStringConvertible

extension KnowledgePoints: CustomStringConvertible {
    nonisolated var description: String { rawValue }
}

// MARK: - Helper

private extension Array where Element: Hashable {
    /// 去重并保持顺序
    func uniqued() -> [Element] {
        var seen = Set<Element>()
        return filter { seen.insert($0).inserted }
    }
}

//
//  Subject.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  学科值对象 - K12完整覆盖

import SwiftUI

// MARK: - SubjectCategory

/// 学科分类
///
/// 将学科按性质分为五大类别，便于筛选和展示。
///
/// ## 分类说明
/// - ``language``: 语言类 - 语文、英语
/// - ``science``: 理科类 - 数学、物理、化学、生物、科学
/// - ``humanities``: 人文类 - 历史、地理、政治、道德与法治
/// - ``technology``: 技术类 - 信息技术、通用技术
/// - ``other``: 其他 - 无法归类的学科
///
/// ## 使用示例
/// ```swift
/// let category = SubjectCategory.science
/// print(category.displayName)  // "理科"
/// print(category.icon)         // "flask"
/// ```
enum SubjectCategory: String, Sendable, CaseIterable, Codable, Hashable, Identifiable {
    case language = "language"
    case science = "science"
    case humanities = "humanities"
    case technology = "technology"
    case other = "other"

    // MARK: Identifiable

    nonisolated var id: String { rawValue }
}

// MARK: - SubjectCategory Display Properties

extension SubjectCategory {
    /// 显示名称
    nonisolated var displayName: String {
        String(localized: localizationKey)
    }

    /// 本地化键值
    private var localizationKey: String.LocalizationValue {
        switch self {
        case .language: "subject_category_language"
        case .science: "subject_category_science"
        case .humanities: "subject_category_humanities"
        case .technology: "subject_category_technology"
        case .other: "subject_category_other"
        }
    }

    /// 简短标签
    nonisolated var shortLabel: String {
        String(localized: shortLabelKey)
    }

    /// 简短标签本地化键值
    private var shortLabelKey: String.LocalizationValue {
        switch self {
        case .language: "subject_category_language_short"
        case .science: "subject_category_science_short"
        case .humanities: "subject_category_humanities_short"
        case .technology: "subject_category_technology_short"
        case .other: "subject_category_other_short"
        }
    }

    /// SF Symbol 图标名称
    nonisolated var icon: String {
        switch self {
        case .language: "textformat"
        case .science: "flask"
        case .humanities: "book"
        case .technology: "desktopcomputer"
        case .other: "ellipsis.circle"
        }
    }

    /// 主题颜色
    nonisolated var color: Color {
        switch self {
        case .language: .red
        case .science: .blue
        case .humanities: .orange
        case .technology: .purple
        case .other: .gray
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Subject

/// 学科（K12全覆盖）
///
/// 覆盖小学、初中、高中所有主要学科，支持按学段筛选。
///
/// ## 学科列表
///
/// ### 语言类
/// - ``chinese``: 语文
/// - ``english``: 英语
///
/// ### 理科类
/// - ``math``: 数学
/// - ``physics``: 物理
/// - ``chemistry``: 化学
/// - ``biology``: 生物
/// - ``science``: 科学（小学、初中）
///
/// ### 人文类
/// - ``history``: 历史
/// - ``geography``: 地理
/// - ``politics``: 政治
/// - ``ethics``: 道德与法治
///
/// ### 技术类
/// - ``informationTech``: 信息技术
/// - ``generalTech``: 通用技术
///
/// ## 使用示例
/// ```swift
/// // 获取高中适用学科
/// let seniorSubjects = Subject.subjects(for: .senior)
///
/// // 检查学科是否适用于某学段
/// let isApplicable = Subject.physics.isApplicable(for: .junior)
/// ```
enum Subject: String, Sendable, CaseIterable, Codable, Hashable, Identifiable {
    // 语言类
    /// 语文
    case chinese = "chinese"
    /// 英语
    case english = "english"

    // 理科类
    /// 数学
    case math = "math"
    /// 物理（初中、高中）
    case physics = "physics"
    /// 化学（初中、高中）
    case chemistry = "chemistry"
    /// 生物（高中）
    case biology = "biology"
    /// 科学（小学、初中科学课）
    case science = "science"

    // 人文类
    /// 历史（初中、高中）
    case history = "history"
    /// 地理（初中、高中）
    case geography = "geography"
    /// 政治（初中、高中）
    case politics = "politics"
    /// 道德与法治（小学、初中）
    case ethics = "ethics"

    // 技术类
    /// 信息技术
    case informationTech = "information_tech"
    /// 通用技术（高中）
    case generalTech = "general_tech"

    // 其他
    /// 其他学科
    case other = "other"

    // MARK: Identifiable

    nonisolated var id: String { rawValue }
}

// MARK: - Subject Display Properties

extension Subject {
    /// 显示名称
    nonisolated var displayName: String {
        String(localized: localizationKey)
    }

    /// 本地化键值
    private var localizationKey: String.LocalizationValue {
        switch self {
        case .chinese: "subject_chinese"
        case .english: "subject_english"
        case .math: "subject_math"
        case .physics: "subject_physics"

        case .politics: "subject_politics"
        case .ethics: "subject_ethics"

        case .generalTech: "subject_general_tech"
        case .other: "subject_other"
        }
    }

    nonisolated var shortLabel: String {
        String(localized: shortLabelKey)
    }

    /// 简短标签本地化键值
    private var shortLabelKey: String.LocalizationValue {
        switch self {
        case .chinese: "subject_chinese_short"
        case .english: "subject_english_short"

    /// SF Symbol 图标名称
    nonisolated var icon: String {
        switch self {
        case .chinese: "character.book.closed"

        }
    }

    /// - Parameter grade: 年级
    /// - Returns: 标题占位符示例
    nonisolated func titlePlaceholder(for grade: Grade) -> String {
        let key = titlePlaceholderKey(for: grade.stage)
        return String(localized: key)
    }

        case (.math, .primary): return "subject_placeholder_title_math_primary"
        case (.math, .junior): return "subject_placeholder_title_math_junior"
        case (.math, .senior): return "subject_placeholder_title_math_senior"

        case (.biology, .junior): return "subject_placeholder_title_biology_junior"
        case (.biology, .senior): return "subject_placeholder_title_biology_senior"

// MARK: - Subject Classification

extension Subject {
    /// 学科分类
    nonisolated var category: SubjectCategory {
        switch self {
        case .chinese, .english:
            .language
        case .math, .physics, .chemistry, .biology, .science:
            .science
        case .history, .geography, .politics, .ethics:
            .humanities
        case .informationTech, .generalTech:
            .technology
        case .other:
            .other
        }
    }

    /// 适用学段（中国大陆学制）
    /// 
    /// 此属性返回中国大陆教育体系下的学科适用学段。
    /// 如需获取其他地区的适用学段，请使用 `applicableStages(for:)` 方法。
    nonisolated var applicableStages: [GradeStage] {
        applicableStages(for: .china)
    }
    
    /// 获取指定教育地区的适用学段
    /// - Parameter region: 教育地区
    /// - Returns: 适用的学段数组
    nonisolated func applicableStages(for region: EducationRegion) -> [GradeStage] {
        switch region {
        case .china:
            // 中国大陆学制
            switch self {
            case .chinese, .math, .english:
                [.primary, .junior, .senior]
            case .science, .ethics:
                [.primary, .junior]
            case .physics, .chemistry, .history, .geography, .politics, .biology:
                [.junior, .senior]
            case .generalTech:
                [.senior]
            case .informationTech, .other:
                [.primary, .junior, .senior]
            }
        case .japan:
            // 日本学制：理科(科学)贯穿全学段，社会科目从小学开始
            switch self {
            case .chinese, .math, .english:
                [.primary, .junior, .senior]
            case .science:  // 日本的理科从小学就有
                [.primary, .junior, .senior]
            case .physics, .chemistry, .biology:
                [.junior, .senior]
            case .history, .geography, .politics:  // 社会科从小学开始
                [.primary, .junior, .senior]
            case .ethics:  // 道德教育贯穿
                [.primary, .junior, .senior]
            case .informationTech:
                [.junior, .senior]
            case .generalTech, .other:
                [.primary, .junior, .senior]
            }
        case .korea:
            // 韩国学制：6-3-3结构，与中国类似但有细微差别
            switch self {
            case .chinese, .math, .english:
                [.primary, .junior, .senior]
            case .science:  // 韩国小学有"科学"课
                [.primary, .junior]
            case .physics, .chemistry, .biology:
                [.junior, .senior]
            case .history, .geography, .politics:  // 社会科从小学开始（사회）
                [.primary, .junior, .senior]
            case .ethics:  // 道德从小学开始（도덕）
                [.primary, .junior]
            case .informationTech:  // 信息从小学高年级开始
                [.primary, .junior, .senior]
            case .generalTech:
                [.senior]
            case .other:
                [.primary, .junior, .senior]
            }
        case .singapore:
            // 新加坡学制：6-4-2结构（小学6年+中学4年+初级学院2年）
            switch self {
            case .chinese, .math, .english:  // 双语教育，从小学开始
                [.primary, .junior, .senior]
            case .science:  // Primary Science 从小学开始
                [.primary, .junior, .senior]
            case .physics, .chemistry, .biology:  // 中学分科
                [.junior, .senior]
            case .history, .geography:  // Social Studies/Humanities
                [.primary, .junior, .senior]
            case .politics:  // Social Studies 的一部分
                [.junior, .senior]
            case .ethics:  // Character and Citizenship Education
                [.primary, .junior, .senior]
            case .informationTech:  // Computing 从中学开始
                [.junior, .senior]
            case .generalTech:  // Design & Technology
                [.junior, .senior]
            case .other:
                [.primary, .junior, .senior]
            }
        case .usa:
            // 美国学制：K-5 + 6-8 + 9-12（因州而异）
            switch self {
            case .chinese:  // 通常作为外语，从中学开始
                [.junior, .senior]
            case .math, .english:  // 核心课程，全学段
                [.primary, .junior, .senior]
            case .science:  // Science 贯穿 K-12
                [.primary, .junior, .senior]
            case .physics, .chemistry, .biology:  // 高中分科
                [.senior]
            case .history, .geography, .politics:  // Social Studies 从小学开始
                [.primary, .junior, .senior]
            case .ethics:  // 不单独设课，融入其他课程
                [.junior, .senior]
            case .informationTech:  // Computer Science
                [.primary, .junior, .senior]
            case .generalTech:  // Technology Education
                [.junior, .senior]
            case .other:
                [.primary, .junior, .senior]
            }
        case .uk:
            // 英国学制：Primary 1-6 + Secondary 7-11 + Sixth Form 12-13
            switch self {
            case .chinese:  // 作为 MFL（现代外语），从中学开始
                [.junior, .senior]
            case .math, .english:  // 核心课程，全学段必修
                [.primary, .junior, .senior]
            case .science:  // Science 必修到 GCSE
                [.primary, .junior, .senior]
            case .physics, .chemistry, .biology:  // A-Level 分科（Sixth Form）
                [.senior]
            case .history, .geography:  // 从小学开始（Key Stage 1）
                [.primary, .junior, .senior]
            case .politics:  // Citizenship/Politics A-Level
                [.junior, .senior]
            case .ethics:  // PSHE/Religious Education
                [.primary, .junior, .senior]
            case .informationTech:  // Computing
                [.primary, .junior, .senior]
            case .generalTech:  // Design and Technology
                [.primary, .junior, .senior]
            case .other:
                [.primary, .junior, .senior]
            }
        case .international, .custom:
            // 国际学校/IB体系/自定义：灵活配置，大多数学科全学段可选
            switch self {
            case .chinese, .math, .english:
                [.primary, .junior, .senior]
            case .science:
                [.primary, .junior, .senior]
            case .physics, .chemistry, .biology:
                [.junior, .senior]
            case .history, .geography, .politics:
                [.primary, .junior, .senior]
            case .ethics:
                [.primary, .junior, .senior]
            case .informationTech:
                [.primary, .junior, .senior]
            case .generalTech:
                [.junior, .senior]
            case .other:
                [.primary, .junior, .senior]
            }
        }
    }

    /// 是否适用于指定学段
    /// - Parameter stage: 学段
    /// - Returns: 是否适用
    nonisolated func isApplicable(for stage: GradeStage) -> Bool {
        applicableStages.contains(stage)
    }
    
    /// 是否适用于指定学段（指定教育地区）
    /// - Parameters:
    ///   - stage: 学段
    ///   - region: 教育地区
    /// - Returns: 是否适用
    nonisolated func isApplicable(for stage: GradeStage, in region: EducationRegion) -> Bool {
        applicableStages(for: region).contains(stage)
    }
    
    /// 是否适用于指定年级
    /// - Parameter grade: 年级
    /// - Returns: 是否适用
    nonisolated func isApplicable(for grade: Grade) -> Bool {
        applicableStages.contains(grade.stage)
    }
    
    /// 是否适用于指定年级（指定教育地区）
    /// - Parameters:
    ///   - grade: 年级
    ///   - region: 教育地区
    /// - Returns: 是否适用
    nonisolated func isApplicable(for grade: Grade, in region: EducationRegion) -> Bool {
        applicableStages(for: region).contains(grade.stage)
    }
    
    /// 获取该学科适用的所有年级（使用默认地区：中国大陆）
    /// - Returns: 适用的年级数组（不含幼儿园）
    nonisolated var applicableGrades: [Grade] {
        applicableGrades(for: .china)
    }
    
    /// 获取该学科在指定教育地区适用的所有年级
    /// - Parameter region: 教育地区
    /// - Returns: 适用的年级数组（不含幼儿园）
    nonisolated func applicableGrades(for region: EducationRegion) -> [Grade] {
        let stages = applicableStages(for: region)
        return Grade.allCases.filter { grade in
            grade != .kindergarten && stages.contains(grade.stage)
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Subject Query Methods

extension Subject {
    /// 获取指定学段的学科列表
    /// - Parameter stage: 学段
    /// - Returns: 适用的学科数组
    static func subjects(for stage: GradeStage) -> [Subject] {
        allCases.filter { $0.isApplicable(for: stage) }
    }

    /// 获取指定分类的学科列表
    /// - Parameter category: 学科分类
    /// - Returns: 该分类下的学科数组
    static func subjects(in category: SubjectCategory) -> [Subject] {
        allCases.filter { $0.category == category }
    }
}

// MARK: - Subject CustomStringConvertible

extension Subject: CustomStringConvertible {
    nonisolated var description: String { displayName }
}

// MARK: - Subject Collections

extension Subject {
    /// 主要学科（语数英）
    static let coreSubjects: [Subject] = [.chinese, .math, .english]

    /// 中考学科
    static let juniorExamSubjects: [Subject] = [
        .chinese, .math, .english,
        .physics, .chemistry,
        .history, .geography, .politics, .biology
    ]

    /// 高考学科
    static let seniorExamSubjects: [Subject] = [
        .chinese, .math, .english,
        .physics, .chemistry, .biology,
        .history, .geography, .politics
    ]

    /// 理科组合（物化生）
    static let scienceCombo: [Subject] = [.physics, .chemistry, .biology]

    /// 文科组合（史地政）
    static let artsCombo: [Subject] = [.history, .geography, .politics]
}

//
//  MasteryLevel.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  掌握程度值对象 - 5级制
//

import SwiftUI

// MARK: - MasteryLevel

/// 错题掌握程度（5级制）
///
/// 类似5星评分系统，用于追踪学生对错题的掌握程度。
/// 复习间隔计算由 ``ReviewInterval`` 负责。
///
/// ## 掌握等级
/// - ``none``: ⭐ 完全不会 - 需要重新学习基础概念
/// - ``glimpse``: ⭐⭐ 一知半解 - 看答案后能懂，但自己做不出来
/// - ``partial``: ⭐⭐⭐ 似懂非懂 - 能做对但不确定
/// - ``good``: ⭐⭐⭐⭐ 基本掌握 - 能独立完成
/// - ``mastered``: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 完全掌握 - 能举一反三
///
/// ## 使用示例
/// ```swift
/// let level = MasteryLevel.partial
/// print(level.displayName)    // "似懂非懂"
/// print(level.stars)          // 3
/// print(level.needsReview)    // true
/// print(level.reviewPriority) // 3
/// ```
enum MasteryLevel: Int, Sendable, CaseIterable, Codable, Hashable, Identifiable {
    /// 完全不会 - 需要重新学习基础概念
    case none = 0
    /// 一知半解 - 看答案后能懂，但自己做不出来
    case glimpse = 1
    /// 似懂非懂 - 能做对但不确定，解题思路不清晰
    case partial = 2
    /// 基本掌握 - 能独立完成，偶尔会粗心出错
    case good = 3
    /// 完全掌握 - 完全掌握，能举一反三解决变式题
    case mastered = 4

    // MARK: Identifiable

    nonisolated var id: Int { rawValue }
}

// MARK: - MasteryLevel Display Properties

extension MasteryLevel {
    /// 显示名称
    nonisolated var displayName: String {
        String(localized: localizationKey)
    }

    /// 本地化键值
    private var localizationKey: String.LocalizationValue {
        switch self {
        case .none: "mastery_none"
        case .glimpse: "mastery_glimpse"
        case .partial: "mastery_partial"
        case .good: "mastery_good"
        case .mastered: "mastery_mastered"
        }
    }

    /// 简短标签
    nonisolated var shortLabel: String {
        String(localized: shortLabelKey)
    }

    /// 简短标签本地化键值
    private var shortLabelKey: String.LocalizationValue {
        switch self {
        case .none: "mastery_none_short"
        case .glimpse: "mastery_glimpse_short"
        case .partial: "mastery_partial_short"
        case .good: "mastery_good_short"
        case .mastered: "mastery_mastered_short"
        }
    }

    /// 详细描述
    nonisolated var detailText: String {
        String(localized: detailTextKey)
    }

    /// 详细描述本地化键值
    private var detailTextKey: String.LocalizationValue {
        switch self {
        case .none: "mastery_none_detail"
        case .glimpse: "mastery_glimpse_detail"
        case .partial: "mastery_partial_detail"
        case .good: "mastery_good_detail"
        case .mastered: "mastery_mastered_detail"
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - MasteryLevel Visual Properties

extension MasteryLevel {
    /// SF Symbol 图标名称
    nonisolated var icon: String {
        switch self {
        case .none: "xmark.circle.fill"
        case .glimpse: "eye.fill"
        case .partial: "questionmark.circle.fill"
        case .good: "checkmark.circle.fill"
        case .mastered: "star.circle.fill"
        }
    }

    /// 主题颜色（红→橙→黄→薄荷→绿 渐进）
    nonisolated var color: Color {
        switch self {
        case .none: Color.brand.error
        case .glimpse: Color.brand.warning
        case .partial: .yellow
        case .good: .mint
        case .mastered: Color.brand.success
        }
    }

    /// 星级（1-5）
    nonisolated var stars: Int { rawValue + 1 }
}

// MARK: - MasteryLevel Metrics

extension MasteryLevel {
    /// 进度值（0.0 - 1.0）
    nonisolated var progress: Double {
        Double(rawValue) / Double(Self.allCases.count - 1)
    }

    /// 复习优先级（越高越优先）
    ///
    /// 用于排序：掌握程度越低，优先级越高（越需要优先复习）
    /// - Note: 具体复习间隔由 `ReviewInterval` 计算，此属性仅用于相对排序
    nonisolated var reviewPriority: Int {
        Self.allCases.count - rawValue
    }
}

// MARK: - MasteryLevel Status Checks

extension MasteryLevel {
    /// 是否需要重点复习
    nonisolated var needsReview: Bool {
        self <= .partial
    }

    /// 是否已掌握
    nonisolated var isMastered: Bool {
        self >= .good
    }

    /// 是否完全掌握
    nonisolated var isFullyMastered: Bool {
        self == .mastered
    }

    /// 是否完全不会
    nonisolated var isUnknown: Bool {
        self == .none
    }
}

// MARK: - MasteryLevel Factory Methods

extension MasteryLevel {
    /// 从星级创建掌握程度（1-5）
    /// - Parameter stars: 星级数量
    /// - Returns: 对应的掌握程度，无效输入返回 nil
    static func from(stars: Int) -> MasteryLevel? {
        Self(rawValue: stars - 1)
    }

    /// 从进度值创建掌握程度（0.0-1.0）
    /// - Parameter progress: 进度值
    /// - Returns: 最接近的掌握程度
    static func from(progress: Double) -> MasteryLevel {
        let clamped = max(0, min(1, progress))
        let index = Int(round(clamped * Double(Self.allCases.count - 1)))
        return Self(rawValue: index) ?? .partial
    }
}

// MARK: - MasteryLevel Comparable

extension MasteryLevel: Comparable {
    nonisolated static func < (lhs: MasteryLevel, rhs: MasteryLevel) -> Bool {
        lhs.rawValue < rhs.rawValue
    }
}

// MARK: - MasteryLevel CustomStringConvertible

extension MasteryLevel: CustomStringConvertible {
    nonisolated var description: String { displayName }
}

// MARK: - MasteryLevel Collections

extension MasteryLevel {
    /// 需要复习的掌握程度
    static let reviewNeeded: [MasteryLevel] = [.none, .glimpse, .partial]

    /// 已掌握的程度
    static let masteredLevels: [MasteryLevel] = [.good, .mastered]

    /// 按复习优先级排序（优先复习的在前）
    static let sortedByReviewPriority: [MasteryLevel] = allCases.sorted { $0.reviewPriority > $1.reviewPriority }
}

//
//  ErrorCategory.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  错误分类值对象

import SwiftUI

// MARK: - ErrorCategory

/// 错误类型分类
///
/// 将错误按根本原因分为五大类别，便于分析和改进。
/// 这种分类帮助学生识别问题的本质，从而制定针对性的改进策略。
///
/// ## 分类说明
/// - ``knowledge``: 知识类 - 概念不清、知识遗忘等知识储备问题
/// - ``method``: 方法类 - 方法不当、思路错误等解题策略问题
/// - ``habit``: 习惯类 - 计算错误、粗心大意、审题失误、步骤遗漏等习惯问题
/// - ``objective``: 客观类 - 时间不足等不可控因素
/// - ``other``: 其他 - 无法明确归类的情况
///
/// ## 使用示例
/// ```swift
/// let category = ErrorCategory.knowledge
/// print(category.displayName)           // "知识类"
/// print(category.improvementDirection)  // "加强学习理解"
/// ```
enum ErrorCategory: String, Sendable, CaseIterable, Codable, Hashable, Identifiable {
    case knowledge = "知识类"
    case method = "方法类"
    case habit = "习惯类"
    case objective = "客观类"
    case other = "其他"

    // MARK: Identifiable

    nonisolated var id: String { rawValue }
}

// MARK: - ErrorCategory Display Properties

extension ErrorCategory {
    /// 显示名称
    nonisolated var displayName: String {
        String(localized: localizationKey)
    }

    /// 本地化键值
    private var localizationKey: String.LocalizationValue {
        switch self {
        case .knowledge: "error_category_knowledge"
        case .method: "error_category_method"
        case .habit: "error_category_habit"
        case .objective: "error_category_objective"
        case .other: "error_category_other"
        }
    }

    /// 简短标签
    nonisolated var shortLabel: String {
        String(localized: shortLabelKey)
    }

    /// 简短标签本地化键值
    private var shortLabelKey: String.LocalizationValue {
        switch self {
        case .knowledge: "error_category_knowledge_short"
        case .method: "error_category_method_short"
        case .habit: "error_category_habit_short"
        case .objective: "error_category_objective_short"
        case .other: "error_category_other_short"
        }
    }

    /// SF Symbol 图标名称
    nonisolated var icon: String {
        switch self {
        case .knowledge: "brain"
        case .method: "arrow.triangle.branch"
        case .habit: "hand.raised"
        case .objective: "clock"
        case .other: "ellipsis.circle"
        }
    }

    /// 主题颜色
    nonisolated var color: Color {
        switch self {
        case .knowledge: .purple
        case .method: .red
        case .habit: .orange
        case .objective: .gray
        case .other: .secondary
        }
    }

    /// 改进方向建议
    nonisolated var improvementDirection: String {
        String(localized: improvementDirectionKey)
    }

    /// 改进方向本地化键值
    private var improvementDirectionKey: String.LocalizationValue {
        switch self {
        case .knowledge: "error_category_knowledge_improvement"
        case .method: "error_category_method_improvement"
        case .habit: "error_category_habit_improvement"
        case .objective: "error_category_objective_improvement"
        case .other: "error_category_other_improvement"
        }
    }
}
