//
//  ErrorType.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  错误类型值对象 - 按错误根因分类
//

import SwiftUI

// MARK: - ErrorType

/// 错题错误类型
///
/// 对错题的错误原因进行细分，帮助学生精准识别薄弱环节。
/// 每种错误类型都归属于一个``ErrorCategory``，并提供针对性的改进建议。
///
/// ## 错误类型分类
///
/// ### 知识类 (Knowledge)
/// - ``concept``: 概念不清 - 对知识点理解有偏差
/// - ``forgotten``: 知识遗忘 - 曾经会但忘记了
///
/// ### 方法类 (Method)
/// - ``method``: 方法不当 - 解题方法选择有问题
/// - ``wrongDirection``: 思路错误 - 解题方向不对
///
/// ### 习惯类 (Habit)
/// - ``calculation``: 计算错误 - 运算失误
/// - ``careless``: 粗心大意 - 非知识性失误
/// - ``misread``: 审题失误 - 题目理解错误
/// - ``incomplete``: 步骤遗漏 - 解题不完整
///
/// ### 客观类 (Objective)
/// - ``timeLimit``: 时间不足 - 考试时间紧张
///
/// ### 其他
/// - ``other``: 其他 - 无法明确归类
///
/// ## 使用示例
/// ```swift
/// let errorType = ErrorType.careless
/// print(errorType.category)     // .habit
/// print(errorType.suggestion)   // "做题时放慢速度..."
/// print(errorType.severity)     // 2
/// ```
enum ErrorType: String, Sendable, CaseIterable, Codable, Hashable, Identifiable {
    // 知识类
    /// 概念不清 - 对基础概念理解有偏差
    case concept = "概念不清"
    /// 知识遗忘 - 曾经掌握但已遗忘
    case forgotten = "知识遗忘"

    // 方法类
    /// 方法不当 - 解题方法选择不合适
    case method = "方法不当"
    /// 思路错误 - 解题方向从一开始就错了
    case wrongDirection = "思路错误"

    // 习惯类
    /// 计算错误 - 运算过程中的失误
    case calculation = "计算错误"
    /// 粗心大意 - 非知识性的低级失误
    case careless = "粗心大意"
    /// 审题失误 - 题目理解或条件提取错误
    case misread = "审题失误"
    /// 步骤遗漏 - 解题过程不完整
    case incomplete = "步骤遗漏"

    // 客观类
    /// 时间不足 - 考试时间紧张导致
    case timeLimit = "时间不足"

    // 其他
    /// 其他 - 无法明确归类的错误
    case other = "其他"

    // MARK: Identifiable

    nonisolated var id: String { rawValue }
}

// MARK: - ErrorType Display Properties

extension ErrorType {
    /// 显示名称
    nonisolated var displayName: String {
        String(localized: localizationKey)
    }

    /// 本地化键值
    private var localizationKey: String.LocalizationValue {
        switch self {
        case .concept: "error_type_concept"
        case .forgotten: "error_type_forgotten"
        case .method: "error_type_method"
        case .wrongDirection: "error_type_wrong_direction"
        case .calculation: "error_type_calculation"
        case .careless: "error_type_careless"
        case .misread: "error_type_misread"
        case .incomplete: "error_type_incomplete"
        case .timeLimit: "error_type_time_limit"
        case .other: "error_type_other"
        }
    }

    /// 简短标签（2字）
    nonisolated var shortLabel: String {
        String(localized: shortLabelKey)
    }

    /// 简短标签本地化键值
    private var shortLabelKey: String.LocalizationValue {
        switch self {
        case .concept: "error_type_concept_short"
        case .forgotten: "error_type_forgotten_short"
        case .method: "error_type_method_short"
        case .wrongDirection: "error_type_wrong_direction_short"
        case .calculation: "error_type_calculation_short"
        case .careless: "error_type_careless_short"
        case .misread: "error_type_misread_short"
        case .incomplete: "error_type_incomplete_short"
        case .timeLimit: "error_type_time_limit_short"
        case .other: "error_type_other_short"
        }
    }

    /// SF Symbol 图标名称
    nonisolated var icon: String {
        switch self {
        case .concept: "lightbulb.slash"
        case .forgotten: "brain.head.profile"
        case .method: "arrow.triangle.branch"
        case .wrongDirection: "arrow.uturn.backward"
        case .calculation: "function"
        case .careless: "exclamationmark.triangle"
        case .misread: "eye.slash"
        case .incomplete: "checklist.unchecked"
        case .timeLimit: "clock.badge.exclamationmark"
        case .other: "questionmark.circle"
        }
    }

    /// 主题颜色
    nonisolated var color: Color {
        switch self {
        case .concept: .purple
        case .forgotten: .indigo
        case .method: .red
        case .wrongDirection: .pink
        case .calculation: .blue
        case .careless: .yellow
        case .misread: .orange
        case .incomplete: .mint
        case .timeLimit: .gray
        case .other: .secondary
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - ErrorType Classification

extension ErrorType {
    /// 错误分类
    nonisolated var category: ErrorCategory {
        switch self {
        case .concept, .forgotten:
            .knowledge
        case .method, .wrongDirection:
            .method
        case .calculation, .careless, .misread, .incomplete:
            .habit
        case .timeLimit:
            .objective
        case .other:
            .other
        }
    }

    /// 获取某分类下的所有错误类型
    /// - Parameter category: 错误分类
    /// - Returns: 该分类下的错误类型数组
    static func types(in category: ErrorCategory) -> [ErrorType] {
        allCases.filter { $0.category == category }
    }
}

// MARK: - ErrorType Improvement Suggestions

extension ErrorType {
    /// 改进建议
    nonisolated var suggestion: String {
        String(localized: suggestionKey)
    }

    /// 改进建议本地化键值
    private var suggestionKey: String.LocalizationValue {
        switch self {
        case .concept: "error_type_concept_suggestion"
        case .forgotten: "error_type_forgotten_suggestion"
        case .method: "error_type_method_suggestion"
        case .wrongDirection: "error_type_wrong_direction_suggestion"
        case .calculation: "error_type_calculation_suggestion"
        case .careless: "error_type_careless_suggestion"
        case .misread: "error_type_misread_suggestion"
        case .incomplete: "error_type_incomplete_suggestion"
        case .timeLimit: "error_type_time_limit_suggestion"
        case .other: "error_type_other_suggestion"
        }
    }

    /// 是否属于主观可控错误（可通过努力改进）
    nonisolated var isControllable: Bool {
        category != .objective && self != .other
    }
}

// MARK: - ErrorType Severity

extension ErrorType {
    /// 严重程度（1-5，越高越需要重视）
    ///
    /// 严重程度基于错误对学习的影响程度：
    /// - 5: 概念性和方法性错误，影响知识体系
    /// - 4: 知识遗忘和思路错误，需要系统复习
    /// - 3: 计算和审题错误，需要加强练习
    /// - 2: 粗心和步骤遗漏，需要培养习惯
    /// - 1: 时间不足和其他，相对不可控
    nonisolated var severity: Int {
        switch self {
        case .concept, .method: 5
        case .forgotten, .wrongDirection, .misread: 4
        case .incomplete: 3
        case .calculation, .careless: 2
        case .timeLimit, .other: 1
        }
    }

    /// 复习优先级（基于严重程度）
    nonisolated var reviewPriority: Int { severity }
}

// MARK: - ErrorType Comparable

extension ErrorType: Comparable {
    nonisolated static func < (lhs: ErrorType, rhs: ErrorType) -> Bool {
        lhs.severity < rhs.severity
    }
}

// MARK: - ErrorType CustomStringConvertible

extension ErrorType: CustomStringConvertible {
    nonisolated var description: String { displayName }
}

// MARK: - ErrorType Collections

extension ErrorType {
    /// 常见错误类型（排除"其他"）
    static let commonTypes: [ErrorType] = allCases.filter { $0 != .other }

    /// 可控错误类型
    static let controllableTypes: [ErrorType] = allCases.filter { $0.isControllable }

    /// 按严重程度降序排列
    static let sortedBySeverity: [ErrorType] = allCases.sorted { $0.severity > $1.severity }

    /// 知识类错误
    static let knowledgeTypes: [ErrorType] = [.concept, .forgotten]

    /// 方法类错误
    static let methodTypes: [ErrorType] = [.method, .wrongDirection]

    /// 习惯类错误
    static let habitTypes: [ErrorType] = [.calculation, .careless, .misread, .incomplete]
}

//
//  CustomSubject.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  用户自定义学科
//

import SwiftUI
#if canImport(UIKit)
import UIKit
#endif

// MARK: - CustomSubject

/// 用户自定义学科
///
/// 允许用户创建预设学科列表之外的学科，如艺术、音乐、体育等。
/// 自定义学科不参与本地化，用户输入什么就显示什么。
///
/// ## 使用示例
/// ```swift
/// let art = CustomSubject(name: "美术", icon: "paintpalette", colorHex: "#FF6B6B")
/// print(art.displayName)  // "美术"
/// ```
struct CustomSubject: Identifiable, Codable, Hashable, Sendable {
    
    // MARK: - Properties
    
    /// 唯一标识符
    let id: UUID
    
    /// 学科名称（用户输入）
    var name: String
    
    /// SF Symbol 图标名称
    var icon: String
    
    /// 颜色（十六进制）
    var colorHex: String
    
    /// 学科分类
    var category: SubjectCategory
    
    /// 适用的学段
    var applicableStages: Set<GradeStage>
    
    /// 创建时间
    let createdAt: Date
    
    /// 更新时间
    var updatedAt: Date
    
    /// 排序顺序
    var sortOrder: Int
    
    // MARK: - Initialization
    
    init(
        id: UUID = UUID(),
        name: String,
        icon: String = "book.closed",
        colorHex: String = "#6B7280",
        category: SubjectCategory = .other,
        applicableStages: Set<GradeStage> = Set(GradeStage.allCases),
        createdAt: Date = Date(),
        updatedAt: Date = Date(),
        sortOrder: Int = 0
    ) {
        self.id = id
        self.name = name
        self.icon = icon
        self.colorHex = colorHex
        self.category = category
        self.applicableStages = applicableStages
        self.createdAt = createdAt
        self.updatedAt = updatedAt
        self.sortOrder = sortOrder
    }
    
    // MARK: - Display Properties
    
    /// 显示名称（直接返回用户输入的名称）
    var displayName: String { name }
    
    /// 简短标签（取名称的第一个字符）
    var shortLabel: String {
        String(name.prefix(1))
    }
    
    /// 颜色
    var color: Color {
        Color(hex: colorHex) ?? .gray
    }
    
    /// 是否适用于指定学段
    func isApplicable(for stage: GradeStage) -> Bool {
        applicableStages.contains(stage)
    }
    
    /// 是否适用于指定年级
    func isApplicable(for grade: Grade) -> Bool {
        applicableStages.contains(grade.stage)
    }
    
    /// 获取适用的年级列表
    var applicableGrades: [Grade] {
        Grade.allCases.filter { grade in
            grade != .kindergarten && applicableStages.contains(grade.stage)
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Color Extension

extension Color {
    /// 从十六进制字符串创建颜色
    init?(hex: String) {
        var hexSanitized = hex.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
        hexSanitized = hexSanitized.replacingOccurrences(of: "#", with: "")
        
        var rgb: UInt64 = 0
        guard Scanner(string: hexSanitized).scanHexInt64(&rgb) else { return nil }
        
        let length = hexSanitized.count
        switch length {
        case 6:
            self.init(
                red: Double((rgb & 0xFF0000) >> 16) / 255.0,
                green: Double((rgb & 0x00FF00) >> 8) / 255.0,
                blue: Double(rgb & 0x0000FF) / 255.0
            )
        case 8:
            self.init(
                red: Double((rgb & 0xFF000000) >> 24) / 255.0,
                green: Double((rgb & 0x00FF0000) >> 16) / 255.0,
                blue: Double((rgb & 0x0000FF00) >> 8) / 255.0,
                opacity: Double(rgb & 0x000000FF) / 255.0
            )
        default:
            return nil
        }
    }
    
    /// 转换为十六进制字符串
    func toHex() -> String? {
        #if canImport(UIKit)
        guard let components = UIColor(self).cgColor.components else { return nil }
        
        let r = components.count >= 1 ? components[0] : 0
        let g = components.count >= 2 ? components[1] : 0
        let b = components.count >= 3 ? components[2] : 0
        
        return String(format: "#%02X%02X%02X", Int(r * 255), Int(g * 255), Int(b * 255))
        #else
        return nil
        #endif
    }
}

//
//  Difficulty.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  题目难度值对象 - 5级制
//

import SwiftUI

// MARK: - Difficulty

/// 题目难度等级（5级制）
///
/// 表示题目的难度等级，从基础到压轴共5个级别。
/// 用于帮助学生识别题目难度，合理分配复习时间。
///
/// ## 难度等级
/// - ``basic``: 送分题 - 基础概念直接应用
/// - ``easy``: 简单题 - 常规题型
/// - ``medium``: 中等题 - 需要分析思考
/// - ``hard``: 困难题 - 综合性强
/// - ``extreme``: 压轴题 - 极具挑战性
///
/// ## 使用示例
/// ```swift
/// let difficulty = Difficulty.medium
/// print(difficulty.displayName)  // "中等"
/// print(difficulty.stars)        // 3
/// print(difficulty.coefficient)  // 0.5
/// ```
enum Difficulty: Int, Sendable, CaseIterable, Codable, Hashable, Identifiable {
    /// 送分题 - 基础概念直接应用，几乎不会出错
    case basic = 0

    /// 简单题 - 常规题型，稍加思考即可解决
    case easy = 1

    /// 中等题 - 需要一定分析，容易粗心出错
    case medium = 2

    /// 困难题 - 综合性强，需要灵活运用多个知识点
    case hard = 3

    /// 压轴题 - 压轴难度，极具挑战性
    case extreme = 4

    // MARK: Identifiable

    nonisolated var id: Int { rawValue }
}

// MARK: - Difficulty Display Properties

extension Difficulty {
    /// 显示名称
    ///
    /// 用于在 UI 中显示完整的难度名称
    nonisolated var displayName: String {
        String(localized: localizationKey)
    }

    /// 本地化键值
    private var localizationKey: String.LocalizationValue {
        switch self {
        case .basic: "difficulty_basic"
        case .easy: "difficulty_easy"
        case .medium: "difficulty_medium"
        case .hard: "difficulty_hard"
        case .extreme: "difficulty_extreme"
        }
    }

    /// 简短标签
    ///
    /// 单字标签，适用于空间受限的场景（如徽章、标签）
    nonisolated var shortLabel: String {
        String(localized: shortLabelKey)
    }

    /// 简短标签本地化键值
    private var shortLabelKey: String.LocalizationValue {
        switch self {
        case .basic: "difficulty_basic_short"
        case .easy: "difficulty_easy_short"
        case .medium: "difficulty_medium_short"
        case .hard: "difficulty_hard_short"
        case .extreme: "difficulty_extreme_short"
        }
    }

    /// 详细描述
    ///
    /// 提供该难度等级的详细说明，帮助用户理解
    nonisolated var detailText: String {
        String(localized: detailTextKey)
    }

    /// 详细描述本地化键值
    private var detailTextKey: String.LocalizationValue {
        switch self {
        case .basic: "difficulty_basic_detail"
        case .easy: "difficulty_easy_detail"
        case .medium: "difficulty_medium_detail"
        case .hard: "difficulty_hard_detail"
        case .extreme: "difficulty_extreme_detail"
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Difficulty Visual Properties

extension Difficulty {
    /// SF Symbol 图标名称
    ///
    /// 返回适合该难度等级的 SF Symbol 图标
    nonisolated var icon: String {
        switch self {
        case .basic: "gift"
        case .easy: "star"
        case .medium: "star.leadinghalf.filled"
        case .hard: "star.fill"
        case .extreme: "flame.fill"
        }
    }

    /// 主题颜色
    ///
    /// 采用渐进式配色方案：绿→黄→橙→红
    nonisolated var color: Color {
        switch self {
        case .basic: .mint
        case .easy: .green
        case .medium: .yellow
        case .hard: .orange
        case .extreme: .red
        }
    }

    /// 星级评分（1-5）
    ///
    /// 用于可视化显示难度等级
    nonisolated var stars: Int { rawValue + 1 }
}

// MARK: - Difficulty Metrics

extension Difficulty {
    /// 难度系数（0.0-1.0）
    ///
    /// 归一化的难度值，可用于算法计算
    /// - Returns: 0.0（最简单）到 1.0（最困难）之间的值
    nonisolated var coefficient: Double {
        Double(rawValue) / Double(Self.allCases.count - 1)
    }

    /// 预计耗时倍数
    ///
    /// 相对于题型标准时间（`ReviewItemType.estimatedMinutes`）的倍数。
    /// 例如：中等难度计算题 = 8分钟 × 1.5 = 12分钟
    /// - Returns: 0.5（送分题）到 3.0（压轴题）的倍数系数
    nonisolated var timeMultiplier: Double {
        switch self {
        case .basic: 0.5
        case .easy: 1.0
        case .medium: 1.5
        case .hard: 2.0
        case .extreme: 3.0
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Difficulty Comparable

extension Difficulty: Comparable {
    /// 比较两个难度等级
    ///
    /// 基于 rawValue 进行比较，数值越大难度越高
    nonisolated static func < (lhs: Difficulty, rhs: Difficulty) -> Bool {
        lhs.rawValue < rhs.rawValue
    }
}

// MARK: - Difficulty CustomStringConvertible

extension Difficulty: CustomStringConvertible {
    nonisolated var description: String { displayName }
}

// MARK: - Difficulty Factory Methods

extension Difficulty {
    /// 从星级创建难度（1-5）
    /// - Parameter stars: 星级数量
    /// - Returns: 对应的难度等级，无效输入返回 nil
    static func from(stars: Int) -> Difficulty? {
        Self(rawValue: stars - 1)
    }

    /// 从系数创建难度（0.0-1.0）
    /// - Parameter coefficient: 难度系数
    /// - Returns: 最接近的难度等级
    static func from(coefficient: Double) -> Difficulty {
        let clamped = max(0, min(1, coefficient))
        let index = Int(round(clamped * Double(Self.allCases.count - 1)))
        return Self(rawValue: index) ?? .medium
    }
}

//
//  CaptureView+Sections.swift
//  NotBad

import SwiftUI
import PhotosUI

// MARK: - Form Sections

extension CaptureView {
    /// 基本信息区域（标题、学科、年级、题型）
    func basicInfoSection(viewModel: CaptureViewModel) -> some View {
        FormCard {
            VStack(spacing: 0) {
                // 标题（必填）
                FormRow(isLast: false) {
                    HStack {
                        Text("capture_field_title")
                            .foregroundStyle(.primary)
                        Text("*")
                            .foregroundStyle(Color.brand.error)
                        Spacer()
                    }
                } content: {
                    TextField(
                        viewModel.subject.titlePlaceholder(for: viewModel.grade),
                        text: .init(
                            get: { viewModel.title },
                            set: { viewModel.title = $0 }
                        )
                    )
                    .multilineTextAlignment(.trailing)
                    .submitLabel(.done)
                    .onSubmit {
                        UIApplication.shared.sendAction(#selector(UIResponder.resignFirstResponder), to: nil, from: nil, for: nil)
                    }
                }

                // 学科
                FormRow(isLast: false) {
                    HStack(spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.xs) {
                        Text("capture_field_subject")
                        if viewModel.isAnalyzing {
                            ProgressView()
                                .scaleEffect(0.7)
                        } else if viewModel.subjectWasAutoSelected {
                            Image(systemName: "sparkles")
                                .font(.caption)
                                .foregroundStyle(Color.brand.primary)
                        }
                    }
                } content: {
                    let currentRegion = EducationSystemManager.shared.currentRegion
                    Picker("", selection: .init(
                        get: { viewModel.subject },
                        set: { newSubject in
                            viewModel.subject = newSubject
                            viewModel.subjectWasAutoSelected = false
                            // 如果当前年级不适用于新学科，自动调整到适用的第一个年级
                            if !newSubject.isApplicable(for: viewModel.grade, in: currentRegion) {
                                if let firstApplicableGrade = newSubject.applicableGrades(for: currentRegion).first {
                                    viewModel.grade = firstApplicableGrade
                                }
                            }
                            // 如果当前题型不适用于新学科，自动调整
                            if !viewModel.questionType.isApplicable(to: newSubject) {
                                viewModel.questionType = ReviewItemType.types(for: newSubject).first ?? .other
                            }
                        }
                    )) {
                        ForEach(Subject.allCases) { subject in
                            Text(subject.displayName)
                                .tag(subject)
                        }
                    }
                    .pickerStyle(.menu)
                    .tint(.primary)
                }

                // 年级（仅显示当前学科在当前教育地区适用的年级）
                FormRow(isLast: false) {
                    Text("capture_field_grade")
                } content: {
                    let currentRegion = EducationSystemManager.shared.currentRegion
                    Picker("", selection: .init(
                        get: { viewModel.grade },
                        set: { viewModel.grade = $0 }
                    )) {
                        ForEach(viewModel.subject.applicableGrades(for: currentRegion)) { grade in
                            Text(grade.displayName)
                                .tag(grade)
                        }
                    }
                    .pickerStyle(.menu)
                    .tint(.primary)
                }
                
                // 题型（根据学科动态筛选）
                FormRow(isLast: false) {
                    HStack(spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.xs) {
                        Text("capture_field_question_type")
                        Image(systemName: viewModel.questionType.icon)
                            .font(.caption)
                            .foregroundStyle(viewModel.questionType.color)
                    }
                } content: {
                    Picker("", selection: .init(
                        get: { viewModel.questionType },
                        set: { viewModel.questionType = $0 }
                    )) {
                        // 按类别分组显示
                        let applicableTypes = ReviewItemType.types(for: viewModel.subject)
                        
                        // 客观题
                        let objectiveTypes = applicableTypes.filter { $0.isObjective }
                        if !objectiveTypes.isEmpty {
                            Section {
                                ForEach(objectiveTypes, id: \.self) { type in
                                    Label(type.displayName, systemImage: type.icon)
                                        .tag(type)
                                }
                            } header: {
                                Text("capture_question_type_objective")
                            }
                        }
                        
                        // 主观题
                        let subjectiveTypes = applicableTypes.filter { $0.isSubjective }
                        if !subjectiveTypes.isEmpty {
                            Section {
                                ForEach(subjectiveTypes, id: \.self) { type in
                                    Label(type.displayName, systemImage: type.icon)
                                        .tag(type)
                                }
                            } header: {
                                Text("capture_question_type_subjective")
                            }
                        }
                        
                        // 综合题
                        let comprehensiveTypes = applicableTypes.filter { $0.isComprehensive }
                        if !comprehensiveTypes.isEmpty {
                            Section {
                                ForEach(comprehensiveTypes, id: \.self) { type in
                                    Label(type.displayName, systemImage: type.icon)
                                        .tag(type)
                                }
                            } header: {
                                Text("capture_question_type_comprehensive")
                            }
                        }
                        
                        // 其他
                        Section {
                            Label(ReviewItemType.other.displayName, systemImage: ReviewItemType.other.icon)
                                .tag(ReviewItemType.other)
                        }
                    }
                    .pickerStyle(.menu)
                    .tint(.primary)
                }
                
                // 难度（星星数量表示难度等级：1星最简单，5星最难）
                FormRow(isLast: true) {
                    Text("capture_field_difficulty")
                } content: {
                    Picker("", selection: .init(
                        get: { viewModel.difficulty },
                        set: { viewModel.difficulty = $0 }
                    )) {
                        ForEach(Difficulty.allCases) { difficulty in
                            // 用文字拼接星星，绕过 Label icon 只显示一个的限制
                            Text(String(repeating: "★", count: difficulty.stars) + " " + difficulty.displayName)
                                .tag(difficulty)
                        }
                    }
                    .pickerStyle(.menu)
                    .tint(viewModel.difficulty.color)
                }
            }
        } header: {
            Text("capture_section_basic")
        }
    }

    /// 补充信息区域（知识点、来源、笔记）
    func additionalInfoSection(viewModel: CaptureViewModel) -> some View {
        FormCard {
            VStack(spacing: 0) {
                // 知识点
                FormRow(isLast: false) {
                    Text("capture_field_knowledge_points")
                } content: {
                    TextField(
                        viewModel.subject.knowledgePointsPlaceholder(for: viewModel.grade),
                        text: .init(
                            get: { viewModel.knowledgePointsInput },
                            set: { viewModel.knowledgePointsInput = $0 }
                        )
                    )
                    .multilineTextAlignment(.trailing)
                    .submitLabel(.done)
                    .onSubmit {
                        UIApplication.shared.sendAction(#selector(UIResponder.resignFirstResponder), to: nil, from: nil, for: nil)
                    }
                }
                
                // 来源
                FormRow(isLast: false) {
                    HStack(spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.xs) {
                        Text("capture_field_source")
                        Image(systemName: viewModel.source.icon)
                            .font(.caption)
                            .foregroundStyle(viewModel.source.color)
                    }
                } content: {
                    Picker("", selection: .init(
                        get: { viewModel.source },
                        set: { viewModel.source = $0 }
                    )) {
                        // 按分类分组显示
                        ForEach(SourceCategory.allCases) { category in
                            Section {
                                ForEach(Source.allCases.filter { $0.category == category }) { source in
                                    Label(source.displayName, systemImage: source.icon)
                                        .tag(source)
                                }
                            } header: {
                                Text(category.displayName)
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    .pickerStyle(.menu)
                    .tint(.primary)
                }

                // 笔记
                FormRow(isLast: true, alignment: .top) {
                    Text("capture_field_note")
                        .padding(.top, DesignTokens.Spacing.sm)
                } content: {
                    TextField(
                        String(localized: "capture_field_note_placeholder"),
                        text: .init(
                            get: { viewModel.note },
                            set: { viewModel.note = $0 }
                        ),
                        axis: .vertical
                    )
                    .lineLimit(2...4)
                    .multilineTextAlignment(.trailing)
                    .submitLabel(.done)
                    .onSubmit {
                        UIApplication.shared.sendAction(#selector(UIResponder.resignFirstResponder), to: nil, from: nil, for: nil)
                    }
                }
            }
        } header: {
            Text("capture_section_additional")
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - FormCard

/// 表单卡片容器
struct FormCard<Content: View, Header: View>: View {
    @ViewBuilder let content: () -> Content
    @ViewBuilder let header: () -> Header

    var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.sm) {
            header()
                .font(.subheadline)
                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                .textCase(.uppercase)
                .padding(.horizontal, DesignTokens.Spacing.sm)

            content()
                .background(Color.semantic.secondaryBackground)
                .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: DesignTokens.CornerRadius.md))
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - FormRow

/// 表单行
struct FormRow<Label: View, Content: View>: View {
    let isLast: Bool
    var alignment: VerticalAlignment = .center
    @ViewBuilder let label: () -> Label
    @ViewBuilder let content: () -> Content

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 0) {
            HStack(alignment: alignment) {
                label()
                    .font(.body)
                Spacer()
                content()
                    .font(.body)
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            }
            .padding(.horizontal, DesignTokens.Spacing.md)
            .padding(.vertical, DesignTokens.Spacing.md)

            if !isLast {
                Divider()
                    .padding(.leading, DesignTokens.Spacing.md)
            }
        }
    }
}

//
//  CaptureViewModel+OCR.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  Created by LIAOYIMING on 2025/6/5.
//

import SwiftUI
import OSLog

// MARK: - OCR Actions

extension CaptureViewModel {
    /// 识别图片中的文字
    func recognizeText() async {
        guard let image = selectedUIImage else { return }

        isRecognizingText = true

        do {
            let result = try await ocrService.recognizeText(from: image)
            recognizedText = result

            // 提取标题
            let extractedTitle = ocrService.extractTitle(from: result)
            if title.isEmpty {
                title = extractedTitle
            }

            isRecognizingText = false
            currentStep = .fillForm

            // 启动智能分析（异步，不阻塞）
            if smartAnalysisAvailable {
                Task {
                    await performSmartAnalysis(text: result)
                }
            }

            showSuccessAlert(String(localized: "capture_ocr_success"))
        } catch {
            isRecognizingText = false
            currentStep = .fillForm

            showWarningAlert(String(format: String(localized: "capture_ocr_failure"), error.localizedDescription))
        }
    }

    /// 重新识别
    func retryRecognition() async {
        recognizedText = ""
        title = ""
        suggestedSubject = nil
        subjectWasAutoSelected = false
        await recognizeText()
    }

    /// 处理实时扫描结果
    func handleLiveScanResult(_ text: String, imageData: Data?) {
        Logger.ocr.info("handleLiveScanResult: text长度=\(text.count), 图片=\(imageData?.count ?? 0) bytes")
        
        // 关闭扫描器界面
        showLiveScanner = false
        isFromLiveScanner = true
        
        recognizedText = text
        
        // 保存截图
        if let imageData = imageData {
            selectedImageData = imageData
            if let uiImage = UIImage(data: imageData) {
                selectedImage = Image(uiImage: uiImage)
                selectedUIImage = uiImage
            }
        }

        let firstLine = text.components(separatedBy: .newlines).first ?? text
        if title.isEmpty {
            title = String(firstLine.prefix(50))
        }

        currentStep = .fillForm
        
        // 启动智能分析（异步，不阻塞）
        if smartAnalysisAvailable {
            Task {
                await performSmartAnalysis(text: text)
            }
        }

        Logger.ocr.debug("处理结果: title=\(self.title), hasImage=\(self.hasImage), isValid=\(self.isValid)")
    }
}

// MARK: - Smart Analysis

extension CaptureViewModel {
    /// 执行智能分析
    ///
    /// 使用 Apple Intelligence 分析题目内容，自动识别科目并生成标题建议
    func performSmartAnalysis(text: String) async {
        guard !text.isEmpty else { return }
        guard smartAnalysisAvailable else { return }
        
        isAnalyzing = true
        
        do {
            let result = try await smartAnalysisService.analyze(text: text)
            
            Logger.ai.info("科目: \(result.suggestedSubject.displayName), 置信度: \(result.confidence)")
            Logger.ai.debug("标题建议: \(result.suggestedTitle)")
            
            // 自动选择科目
            suggestedSubject = result.suggestedSubject
            subject = result.suggestedSubject
            subjectWasAutoSelected = true
            
            // 如果标题仍是默认提取的（第一行），且 AI 生成了更好的标题，则替换
            if result.confidence >= 0.7 && !result.suggestedTitle.isEmpty {
                let firstLine = recognizedText.components(separatedBy: .newlines).first ?? ""
                if title == String(firstLine.prefix(50)) {
                    title = result.suggestedTitle
                }
            }
            
            isAnalyzing = false
        } catch {
            Logger.ai.error("分析失败: \(error.localizedDescription)")
            isAnalyzing = false
            // 分析失败不影响正常流程，静默处理
        }
    }
    
    /// 手动触发智能分析
    func triggerSmartAnalysis() async {
        await performSmartAnalysis(text: recognizedText)
    }
}

//
//  CaptureViewModel.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  Created by LIAOYIMING on 2025/6/5.
//  Phase 3: ViewModel Dependency Injection
//

import Foundation
import Observation
import PhotosUI
import SwiftData
import SwiftUI

// MARK: - CaptureViewModel

/// 错题录入视图模型
///
/// 负责处理图片选择、OCR 识别、表单管理和保存操作
/// 使用 Swift 6 的 @Observable 宏实现响应式更新
///
/// ## 依赖注入
///
/// 支持注入 DataProvider 用于测试：
///
/// ```swift
/// // 生产环境
/// let viewModel = CaptureViewModel()
/// viewModel.configure(with: modelContext)
///
/// // 测试环境
/// let mockProvider = MockReviewItemProvider()
/// let viewModel = CaptureViewModel(dataProvider: mockProvider)
/// ```
@MainActor
@Observable
final class CaptureViewModel {
    // MARK: - Image State

    var selectedItem: PhotosPickerItem?
    var selectedImage: Image?
    var selectedImageData: Data?
    var selectedUIImage: UIImage?

    // MARK: - Form State

    var title: String = ""
    var note: String = ""
    var subject: Subject = .math
    var grade: Grade = getUserDefaultGrade()
    var knowledgePointsInput: String = ""
    var difficulty: Difficulty = .medium
    var errorType: ErrorType = .other
    var source: Source = .other
    var questionType: ReviewItemType = .other

    // MARK: - UI State

    var currentStep: CaptureStep = .selectImage
    var showAlert: Bool = false
    var alertMessage: String = ""
    var alertType: AlertType = .success
    var isSuccessAlert: Bool = false
    var showCamera: Bool = false
    var showLiveScanner: Bool = false
    var showPhotoPicker: Bool = false

    // MARK: - OCR State

    var isRecognizingText: Bool = false
    var recognizedText: String = ""

    // MARK: - Smart Analysis State
    
    var isAnalyzing: Bool = false
    var smartAnalysisAvailable: Bool = false
    var suggestedSubject: Subject?
    var subjectWasAutoSelected: Bool = false

    // MARK: - Save State

    var isSaving: Bool = false

    // MARK: - Scanner Mode

    var isFromLiveScanner: Bool = false

    // MARK: - Dependencies

    /// 数据提供者（可选，用于依赖注入）
    private var dataProvider: (any ReviewItemDataProviding)?

    var modelContext: ModelContext?
    let ocrService = OCRService.shared
    let smartAnalysisService = SmartAnalysisService.shared

    // MARK: - Initialization

    /// 默认初始化
    init() {
        // 检查智能分析是否可用
        smartAnalysisAvailable = smartAnalysisService.isAvailable
    }

    /// 依赖注入初始化（推荐用于测试）
    ///
    /// - Parameter dataProvider: 数据提供者
    init(dataProvider: any ReviewItemDataProviding) {
        self.dataProvider = dataProvider
        smartAnalysisAvailable = smartAnalysisService.isAvailable
    }

    /// 配置 ModelContext
    func configure(with modelContext: ModelContext) {
        self.modelContext = modelContext
    }

    // MARK: - Grade Default

    static func getUserDefaultGrade() -> Grade {
        let gradeCode = UserDefaults.standard.string(forKey: "defaultGrade") ?? Grade.grade7.rawValue
        return Grade(rawValue: gradeCode) ?? .grade7
    }
}

// MARK: - Computed Properties

extension CaptureViewModel {
    /// 是否已选择图片
    var hasImage: Bool {
        selectedImageData != nil
    }

    /// 表单是否有效
    var isValid: Bool {
        !title.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines).isEmpty &&
            (hasImage || isFromLiveScanner)
    }

    /// 验证错误列表
    var validationErrors: [String] {
        var errors: [String] = []

        if title.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines).isEmpty {
            errors.append(String(localized: "capture_validation_title_required"))
        }

        if !hasImage && !isFromLiveScanner {
            errors.append(String(localized: "capture_validation_image_required"))
        }

        return errors
    }

    /// 当前步骤是否可继续
    var canProceed: Bool {
        switch currentStep {
        case .selectImage:
            return hasImage
        case .recognize:
            return !isRecognizingText
        case .fillForm:
            return isValid
        case .review:
            return isValid
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Form Actions

extension CaptureViewModel {
    /// 添加知识点
    func addKnowledgePoint(_ point: String) {
        let trimmed = point.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
        guard !trimmed.isEmpty else { return }

        if knowledgePointsInput.isEmpty {
            knowledgePointsInput = trimmed
        } else {
            knowledgePointsInput += ", \(trimmed)"
        }
    }

    /// 解析的知识点列表
    var parsedKnowledgePoints: [String] {
        KnowledgePoints(from: knowledgePointsInput).items
    }
}

// MARK: - CaptureStep

/// 录入步骤
enum CaptureStep: Int, CaseIterable, Identifiable {
    case selectImage = 0
    case recognize = 1
    case fillForm = 2
    case review = 3

    var id: Int { rawValue }

    var title: String {
        switch self {
        case .selectImage: String(localized: "capture_step_select_image")
        case .recognize: String(localized: "capture_step_recognize")
        case .fillForm: String(localized: "capture_step_fill_form")
        case .review: String(localized: "capture_step_review")
        }
    }

    var icon: String {
        switch self {
        case .selectImage: "photo"
        case .recognize: "text.viewfinder"
        case .fillForm: "square.and.pencil"
        case .review: "checkmark.circle"
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - AlertType

/// 提示类型
enum AlertType: Sendable {
    case success
    case warning
    case error
    case info

    var icon: String {
        switch self {
        case .success: "checkmark.circle.fill"
        case .warning: "exclamationmark.triangle.fill"
        case .error: "xmark.circle.fill"
        case .info: "info.circle.fill"
        }
    }

    var color: Color {
        switch self {
        case .success: .green
        case .warning: .orange
        case .error: .red
        case .info: .blue
        }
    }
}

// FILE PATH: NotBad/Presentation/Features/Capture/CaptureViewModel+Save.swift

//
//  CaptureViewModel+Save.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  Created by LIAOYIMING on 2025/6/5.
//

import SwiftUI
import UIKit
import OSLog

// MARK: - Save Actions

extension CaptureViewModel {
    /// 进入预览步骤
    func proceedToReview() {
        guard isValid else { return }
        currentStep = .review
    }

    /// 保存错题
    func saveItem() {
        guard let modelContext else {
            Logger.data.error("保存失败：modelContext 为 nil")
            showErrorAlert(String(localized: "capture_save_error_context"))
            return
        }

        // 验证：必须有图片或来自实时扫描
        guard hasImage || isFromLiveScanner else {
            Logger.data.error("保存失败：无图片且非实时扫描")
            showErrorAlert(String(localized: "capture_save_error_no_image"))
            return
        }

        isSaving = true

        let newItem = ReviewItem(
            imageData: selectedImageData,  // 可为 nil（实时扫描模式）
            title: title.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines),
            note: note,
            subject: subject,
            grade: grade,
            knowledgePoints: KnowledgePoints(from: knowledgePointsInput),
            difficulty: difficulty,
            errorType: errorType,
            source: source,
            questionType: questionType
        )

        Logger.data.info("创建 ReviewItem: id=\(newItem.id), title=\(newItem.title)")

        modelContext.insert(newItem)
        Logger.data.debug("insert 完成")

        do {
            try modelContext.save()
            Logger.data.info("✅ ReviewItem 保存成功: \(newItem.id)")

            // 触觉反馈 - 成功
            let generator = UINotificationFeedbackGenerator()
            generator.notificationOccurred(.success)

            // 延迟显示成功提示，改善体验
            Task { @MainActor [weak self] in
                try? await Task.sleep(for: .milliseconds(300))
                self?.isSaving = false
                self?.showSuccessAlert(String(localized: "capture_save_success"))

                // 发送通知
                NotificationCenter.default.post(name: .reviewItemAdded, object: newItem)
            }
        } catch {
            Logger.data.error("❌ ReviewItem 保存失败: \(error.localizedDescription)")

            // 触觉反馈 - 失败
            let generator = UINotificationFeedbackGenerator()
            generator.notificationOccurred(.error)

            isSaving = false
            showErrorAlert(String(format: String(localized: "capture_save_error_generic"), error.localizedDescription))
        }
    }

    /// 保存并继续录入下一题
    func saveAndContinue() {
        saveItem()

        // 保存成功后重置（保留学科和年级）
        Task { @MainActor [weak self] in
            try? await Task.sleep(for: .milliseconds(500))
            self?.resetForm(keepSubjectAndGrade: true)
        }
    }

    /// 重置表单
    ///
    /// - Parameter keepSubjectAndGrade: 是否保留学科和年级设置
    func resetForm(keepSubjectAndGrade: Bool = false) {
        selectedItem = nil
        selectedImage = nil
        selectedImageData = nil
        selectedUIImage = nil
        title = ""
        note = ""
        knowledgePointsInput = ""
        recognizedText = ""
        currentStep = .selectImage

        if !keepSubjectAndGrade {
            subject = .math
            grade = CaptureViewModel.getUserDefaultGrade()
        }

        difficulty = .medium
        errorType = .other
        source = .other
        questionType = .other
    }
}

// MARK: - Alert Helpers

extension CaptureViewModel {
    func showSuccessAlert(_ message: String) {
        alertType = .success
        alertMessage = message
        isSuccessAlert = true
        showAlert = true
    }

    func showWarningAlert(_ message: String) {
        alertType = .warning
        alertMessage = message
        isSuccessAlert = false
        showAlert = true
    }

    func showErrorAlert(_ message: String) {
        alertType = .error
        alertMessage = message
        isSuccessAlert = false
        showAlert = true
    }

    /// 显示验证错误
    func showValidationError() {
        let errors = validationErrors
        if !errors.isEmpty {
            showWarningAlert(errors.joined(separator: "\n"))
        }
    }
}

//
//  CaptureViewModel+Image.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  Created by LIAOYIMING on 2025/6/5.
//

import PhotosUI
import SwiftUI

// MARK: - Image Actions

extension CaptureViewModel {
    /// 处理选中的图片
    ///
    /// - Parameter image: 选中的 UIImage
    func handlePickedImage(_ image: UIImage) {
        selectedUIImage = image
        selectedImage = Image(uiImage: image)

        // 使用 ImageCompressor 压缩图片
        selectedImageData = ImageCompressor.compress(image)

        // 更新步骤
        currentStep = .recognize

        // 自动触发 OCR
        if title.isEmpty {
            Task {
                await recognizeText()
            }
        }
    }

    /// 从 PhotosPicker 加载图片
    func loadTransferable(from item: PhotosPickerItem?) async {
        guard let item,
              let data = try? await item.loadTransferable(type: Data.self),
              let uiImage = UIImage(data: data) else { return }

        handlePickedImage(uiImage)
    }

    /// 清除已选图片
    func clearImage() {
        selectedItem = nil
        selectedImage = nil
        selectedImageData = nil
        selectedUIImage = nil
        currentStep = .selectImage
    }
}

//
//  CaptureView.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  Created by LIAOYIMING on 2025/6/5.
//

import SwiftUI
import PhotosUI
import SwiftData
import TipKit

// MARK: - CaptureView

/// 错题录入视图
///
/// 符合 Apple HIG 的现代化录入界面：
/// - 图片选择卡片（拍照/扫描/相册）
/// - Form 表单布局
/// - 固定底部保存按钮
/// - 实时表单验证
struct CaptureView: View {

    // MARK: - Environment

    @Environment(\.modelContext) private var modelContext

    // MARK: - State

    @State private var viewModel = CaptureViewModel()
    @State private var selectedItem: PhotosPickerItem?
    @State private var isKeyboardVisible = false

    // MARK: - Body

    var body: some View {
        NavigationStack {
            mainContent
                .navigationTitle(LocalizedStringKey("capture_title"))
                .navigationBarTitleDisplayMode(.large)
                .onAppear {
                    viewModel.configure(with: modelContext)
                }
                .onChange(of: selectedItem) { _, newValue in
                    Task {
                        await viewModel.loadTransferable(from: newValue)
                    }
                }
                .dropDestination(for: Data.self) { items, _ in
                    guard let item = items.first, let image = UIImage(data: item) else { return false }
                    viewModel.handlePickedImage(image)
                    return true
                }
                .sheet(isPresented: $viewModel.showCamera) {
                    ImagePicker(sourceType: .camera) { image in
                        viewModel.handlePickedImage(image)
                    }
                }
                .fullScreenCover(isPresented: $viewModel.showLiveScanner) {
                    liveScannerSheet
                }
                .alert(viewModel.alertMessage, isPresented: $viewModel.showAlert) {
                    Button(LocalizedStringKey("common_confirm")) {
                        if viewModel.isSuccessAlert {
                            viewModel.resetForm()
                            selectedItem = nil
                        }
                    }
                }
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Main Content

extension CaptureView {
    private var mainContent: some View {
        Group {
            if viewModel.selectedImage == nil {
                // 未选择图片：显示表单 + 底部选择按钮
                initialInputView
            } else {
                // 已选择图片：显示完整编辑表单 + 保存按钮
                editFormView
            }
        }
    }
    
    /// 初始录入视图（未选择图片）
    private var initialInputView: some View {
        ScrollView {
            VStack(spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.lg) {
                // 首次使用提示
                TipView(CapturePhotoTip(), arrowEdge: .bottom)
                    .tipBackground(Color(.secondarySystemBackground))
                
                formSection
            }
            .padding(.horizontal)
            .padding(.top, DesignTokens.Spacing.md)
            .padding(.bottom, 120)
        }
        .scrollDismissesKeyboard(.interactively)
        .onTapGesture {
            hideKeyboard()
        }
        .safeAreaInset(edge: .bottom) {
            if !isKeyboardVisible {
                imageSourceBar
                    .transition(.move(edge: .bottom).combined(with: .opacity))
            }
        }
        .animation(.easeInOut(duration: 0.25), value: isKeyboardVisible)
        .onReceive(NotificationCenter.default.publisher(for: UIResponder.keyboardWillShowNotification)) { _ in
            isKeyboardVisible = true
        }
        .onReceive(NotificationCenter.default.publisher(for: UIResponder.keyboardWillHideNotification)) { _ in
            isKeyboardVisible = false
        }
    }
    
    /// 编辑表单视图（选择图片后）
    private var editFormView: some View {
        ScrollView {
            VStack(spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.lg) {
                imageCard
                formSection
            }
            .padding(.horizontal)
            .padding(.top, DesignTokens.Spacing.md)
            .padding(.bottom, 100)
        }
        .scrollDismissesKeyboard(.interactively)
        .onTapGesture {
            hideKeyboard()
        }
        .safeAreaInset(edge: .bottom) {
            saveButtonBar
        }
    }

    private func hideKeyboard() {
        UIApplication.shared.sendAction(
            #selector(UIResponder.resignFirstResponder),
            to: nil,
            from: nil,
            for: nil
        )
    }
}

    }
}

import SwiftUI
import UIKit

// MARK: - SelectedImageCard

/// 已选图片展示卡片
///
/// 仅在选择图片后显示，提供：
/// - 图片预览
/// - 取消选择
/// - OCR 文字识别
/// - 重新选择（通过 Menu）
struct SelectedImageCard: View {

    // MARK: - Properties

    let selectedImage: Image
    let isRecognizingText: Bool
    let showLiveScannerSupport: Bool

    // MARK: - Actions

    let onCameraPressed: () -> Void
    let onLiveScanPressed: () -> Void
    let onRecognizeText: () -> Void
    let onClearImage: () -> Void

    // MARK: - Body

    var body: some View {
        ZStack(alignment: .bottom) {
            // 图片
            selectedImage
                .resizable()
                .scaledToFit()
                .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
                .frame(height: 260)
                .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: DesignTokens.CornerRadius.lg))

            // 底部操作栏
            imageActionBar
        }
        .background(Color.semantic.secondaryBackground)
        .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: DesignTokens.CornerRadius.lg))
        .overlay(
            RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: DesignTokens.CornerRadius.lg)
                .strokeBorder(Color.semantic.separator, lineWidth: 1)
        )
        .accessibilityIdentifier("selected_image_card")
    }

    // MARK: - Image Action Bar

    private var imageActionBar: some View {
        HStack(spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.md) {
            // 取消按钮
            Button {
                onClearImage()
            } label: {
                HStack(spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.xs) {
                    Image(systemName: "xmark")
                    Text("common_cancel")
                }
                .font(.subheadline.weight(.medium))
                .foregroundStyle(.white)
                .padding(.horizontal, DesignTokens.Spacing.md)
                .padding(.vertical, DesignTokens.Spacing.sm)
                .background(Color.brand.error.opacity(0.8), in: Capsule())
            }

            Spacer()

            // OCR 识别按钮

                onRecognizeText()
            } label: {
                HStack(spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.xs) {
                    if isRecognizingText {
                        ProgressView()
                            .scaleEffect(0.8)
                            .tint(.white)
                    } else {
                        Image(systemName: "text.viewfinder")
                    }
                    Text(isRecognizingText ? "capture_recognizing" : "capture_ocr")
                }
                .font(.subheadline.weight(.medium))
                .foregroundStyle(.white)
                .padding(.horizontal, DesignTokens.Spacing.md)
                .padding(.vertical, DesignTokens.Spacing.sm)
                .background(Color.brand.warning, in: Capsule())
            }
            .disabled(isRecognizingText)

            // 重选按钮
            Menu {
                Button {
                    onCameraPressed()
                } label: {
                    Label("capture_camera", systemImage: "camera")
                }

                if showLiveScannerSupport {
                    Button {
                        onLiveScanPressed()
                    } label: {
                        Label("capture_scan", systemImage: "doc.text.viewfinder")
                    }
                }
            } label: {
                HStack(spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.xs) {
                    Image(systemName: "arrow.triangle.2.circlepath")
                    Text("capture_reselect_short")
                }
                .font(.subheadline.weight(.medium))
                .foregroundStyle(.white)
                .padding(.horizontal, DesignTokens.Spacing.md)
                .padding(.vertical, DesignTokens.Spacing.sm)
                .background(.ultraThinMaterial, in: Capsule())
            }
        }
        .padding(DesignTokens.Spacing.md)
        .background(
            LinearGradient(
                colors: [.clear, .black.opacity(0.5)],
                startPoint: .top,
                endPoint: .bottom
            )
        )
    }
}

//
//  LibraryViewModel.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  Created for NotBad K12 错题本
//  Phase 3: ViewModel Dependency Injection
//

import SwiftUI
import SwiftData
import OSLog

// MARK: - LibraryViewModel

/// 题库 ViewModel
///
/// 负责管理错题列表的筛选、搜索、排序和批量操作。
///
/// ## 职责
///
/// - 错题筛选（学科、掌握程度、难度、来源）
/// - 关键词搜索
/// - 排序方式切换
/// - 批量删除操作
///
/// ## 依赖注入
///
/// 支持两种使用方式：
///
/// ```swift
/// // 方式1: 使用 DataProvider（推荐，支持测试）
/// let provider = SwiftDataReviewItemProvider(modelContext: context)
/// let viewModel = LibraryViewModel(dataProvider: provider)
/// let filtered = viewModel.filteredItems()
///
/// // 方式2: 传入 items（向后兼容）
/// let viewModel = LibraryViewModel()
/// let filtered = viewModel.filteredItems(from: items)
/// ```
@MainActor
@Observable
final class LibraryViewModel {

    // MARK: - Dependencies

    /// 数据提供者（可选，用于依赖注入）
    private var dataProvider: (any ReviewItemDataProviding)?

    // MARK: - Search State

    /// 搜索关键词
    var searchText = ""
    
    /// 搜索历史管理器
    private let searchHistoryManager = SearchHistoryManager.shared

    /// 是否正在搜索
    var isSearching: Bool {
        !searchText.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines).isEmpty
    }

    /// 高级搜索条件
    var advancedCriteria = SearchCriteria()

    /// 是否显示高级搜索
    var showAdvancedSearch = false

    // MARK: - Filter State

    /// 选中的学科
    var selectedSubject: Subject?

    /// 选中的掌握程度
    var selectedMastery: MasteryLevel?

    /// 选中的难度
    var selectedDifficulty: Difficulty?

    /// 选中的来源
    var selectedSource: Source?

    /// 是否只显示待复习
    var showPendingReviewOnly = false

    /// 是否有活跃的筛选条件
    var hasActiveFilters: Bool {
        selectedSubject != nil ||
        selectedMastery != nil ||
        selectedDifficulty != nil ||
        selectedSource != nil ||
        showPendingReviewOnly ||
        advancedCriteria.hasActiveFilters
    }

    /// 活跃筛选条件数量
    var activeFilterCount: Int {
        var count = 0
        if selectedSubject != nil { count += 1 }
        if selectedMastery != nil { count += 1 }
        if selectedDifficulty != nil { count += 1 }
        if selectedSource != nil { count += 1 }
        if showPendingReviewOnly { count += 1 }
        count += advancedCriteria.activeFilterCount
        return count
    }

    // MARK: - Sort State

    /// 排序方式
    var sortOption: SortOption = .createdAtDesc

    // MARK: - Selection State

    /// 是否处于选择模式
    var isSelectionMode = false

    /// 选中的项目 ID
    var selectedItemIds: Set<UUID> = []

    /// 选中数量
    var selectedCount: Int {
        selectedItemIds.count
    }
    
    // MARK: - Cache
    
    /// 缓存的筛选结果
    private var cachedFilteredItems: [ReviewItem] = []
    
    /// 缓存的数据源 hash（用于判断是否需要重新计算）
    private var cachedSourceHash: Int = 0
    
    /// 缓存的筛选条件 hash
    private var cachedFilterHash: Int = 0

    // MARK: - Dependencies

    private var modelContext: ModelContext?

    // MARK: - Initialization

    /// 默认初始化（向后兼容）
    init() {}

    /// 依赖注入初始化（推荐用于测试）
    ///
    /// - Parameter dataProvider: 数据提供者
    init(dataProvider: any ReviewItemDataProviding) {
        self.dataProvider = dataProvider
    }

    /// 配置 ModelContext
    func configure(with modelContext: ModelContext) {
        self.modelContext = modelContext
    }

    // MARK: - Data Access

    /// 获取所有错题
    ///
    /// 优先从 dataProvider 获取，否则返回空数组
    var items: [ReviewItem] {
        dataProvider?.items ?? []
    }

    /// 获取筛选后的错题（使用 DataProvider）
    ///
    /// - Returns: 筛选后的错题列表
    func filteredItems() -> [ReviewItem] {
        filteredItems(from: items)
    }

    // MARK: - Filtering
    
    /// 计算当前筛选条件的 hash 值
    private var currentFilterHash: Int {
        var hasher = Hasher()
        hasher.combine(searchText)
        hasher.combine(selectedSubject)
        hasher.combine(selectedMastery)
        hasher.combine(selectedDifficulty)
        hasher.combine(selectedSource)
        hasher.combine(showPendingReviewOnly)
        hasher.combine(sortOption)
        hasher.combine(advancedCriteria.hasActiveFilters)
        return hasher.finalize()
    }

    /// 根据筛选条件过滤错题（带缓存优化）
    ///
    /// - Parameter items: 原始错题列表
    /// - Returns: 过滤后的错题列表
    ///
    /// 使用 hash 值判断是否需要重新计算，避免 SwiftUI 每次 body 求值都触发筛选。
    func filteredItems(from items: [ReviewItem]) -> [ReviewItem] {
        // 计算数据源和筛选条件的 hash
        let sourceHash = items.count  // 简单用 count 作为 hash，因为 items 变化时 count 一定变
        let filterHash = currentFilterHash
        
        // 如果缓存有效，直接返回
        if sourceHash == cachedSourceHash && filterHash == cachedFilterHash {
            return cachedFilteredItems
        }
        
        // 重新计算
        var result = items

        // 搜索筛选
        if isSearching {
            let query = searchText.lowercased()
            result = result.filter { item in
                item.title.lowercased().contains(query) ||
                item.knowledgePoints.matches(searchText) ||
                item.note.lowercased().contains(query)
            }
        }

        // 学科筛选
        if let subject = selectedSubject {
            result = result.filter { $0.subject == subject }
        }

        // 掌握程度筛选
        if let mastery = selectedMastery {
            result = result.filter { $0.mastery == mastery }
        }

        // 难度筛选
        if let difficulty = selectedDifficulty {
            result = result.filter { $0.difficulty == difficulty }
        }

        // 来源筛选
        if let source = selectedSource {
            result = result.filter { $0.source == source }
        }

        // 待复习筛选
        if showPendingReviewOnly {
            result = result.filter { $0.needsReview }
        }

        // 高级搜索条件筛选
        if advancedCriteria.hasActiveFilters {
            result = advancedCriteria.filter(result)
        }

        // 排序
        result = sortItems(result)
        
        // 更新缓存
        cachedSourceHash = sourceHash
        cachedFilterHash = filterHash
        cachedFilteredItems = result

        return result
    }

    /// 排序错题
    private func sortItems(_ items: [ReviewItem]) -> [ReviewItem] {
        switch sortOption {
        case .createdAtDesc:
            items.sorted { $0.createdAt > $1.createdAt }
        case .createdAtAsc:
            items.sorted { $0.createdAt < $1.createdAt }
        case .titleAsc:
            items.sorted { $0.title.localizedCompare($1.title) == .orderedAscending }
        case .masteryAsc:
            items.sorted { $0.masteryLevel < $1.masteryLevel }
        case .masteryDesc:
            items.sorted { $0.masteryLevel > $1.masteryLevel }
        case .difficultyDesc:
            items.sorted { $0.difficultyRaw > $1.difficultyRaw }
        case .reviewDateAsc:
            items.sorted { $0.nextReviewDate < $1.nextReviewDate }
        }
    }

    // MARK: - Filter Actions
    
    /// 提交搜索（保存到历史记录）
    ///
    /// 当用户按下回车确认搜索时调用，将搜索词保存到历史记录中。
    func submitSearch() {
        let trimmed = searchText.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
        guard !trimmed.isEmpty else { return }
        searchHistoryManager.addSearch(trimmed)
    }
    
    /// 从历史记录选择搜索词
    ///
    /// - Parameter query: 历史记录中的搜索词
    func selectFromHistory(_ query: String) {
        searchText = query
        searchHistoryManager.addSearch(query)
    }

    /// 选择学科
    func selectSubject(_ subject: Subject?) {
        selectedSubject = subject
    }

    /// 选择掌握程度
    func selectMastery(_ mastery: MasteryLevel?) {
        selectedMastery = mastery
    }

    /// 选择难度
    func selectDifficulty(_ difficulty: Difficulty?) {
        selectedDifficulty = difficulty
    }

    /// 选择来源
    func selectSource(_ source: Source?) {
        selectedSource = source
    }

    /// 重置所有筛选条件
    func resetFilters() {
        selectedSubject = nil
        selectedMastery = nil
        selectedDifficulty = nil
        selectedSource = nil
        showPendingReviewOnly = false
        searchText = ""
        advancedCriteria = SearchCriteria()
    }

    // MARK: - Selection Actions

    /// 切换选择模式
    func toggleSelectionMode() {
        isSelectionMode.toggle()
        if !isSelectionMode {
            selectedItemIds.removeAll()
        }
    }

    /// 切换单个项目的选中状态
    func toggleSelection(for itemId: UUID) {
        if selectedItemIds.contains(itemId) {
            selectedItemIds.remove(itemId)
        } else {
            selectedItemIds.insert(itemId)
        }
    }

    /// 全选
    func selectAll(from items: [ReviewItem]) {
        selectedItemIds = Set(items.map { $0.id })
    }

    /// 取消全选
    func deselectAll() {
        selectedItemIds.removeAll()
    }

    /// 检查项目是否被选中
    func isSelected(_ itemId: UUID) -> Bool {
        selectedItemIds.contains(itemId)
    }

    // MARK: - CRUD Actions

    /// 删除指定位置的错题
    func deleteItems(from items: [ReviewItem], at offsets: IndexSet) {
        guard let modelContext else { return }

        for index in offsets {
            modelContext.delete(items[index])
        }

        do {
            try modelContext.save()
        } catch {
            Logger.data.error("删除失败: \(error)")
        }
    }

    /// 删除单个错题
    func deleteItem(_ item: ReviewItem) {
        guard let modelContext else { return }

        modelContext.delete(item)

        do {
            try modelContext.save()
        } catch {
            Logger.data.error("删除失败: \(error)")
        }
    }

    /// 批量删除选中的错题
    func deleteSelectedItems(from items: [ReviewItem]) {
        guard let modelContext else { return }

        let itemsToDelete = items.filter { selectedItemIds.contains($0.id) }

        for item in itemsToDelete {
            modelContext.delete(item)
        }

        do {
            try modelContext.save()
            selectedItemIds.removeAll()
            isSelectionMode = false
        } catch {
            Logger.data.error("批量删除失败: \(error)")
        }
    }
    
    /// 批量标记掌握程度
    ///
    /// - Parameters:
    ///   - items: 所有错题列表
    ///   - mastery: 要设置的掌握程度
    func markSelectedItems(from items: [ReviewItem], as mastery: MasteryLevel) {
        guard let modelContext else { return }
        
        let itemsToUpdate = items.filter { selectedItemIds.contains($0.id) }
        
        for item in itemsToUpdate {
            item.mastery = mastery
            item.updatedAt = Date()
        }
        
        do {
            try modelContext.save()
            selectedItemIds.removeAll()
            isSelectionMode = false
        } catch {
            Logger.data.error("批量标记失败: \(error)")
        }
    }

    // MARK: - Statistics

    /// 计算当前筛选结果的统计
    func computeFilteredStatistics(from items: [ReviewItem]) -> FilteredStatistics {
        let filtered = filteredItems(from: items)

        return FilteredStatistics(
            totalCount: items.count,
            filteredCount: filtered.count,
            masteredCount: filtered.filter { $0.isMastered }.count,
            pendingReviewCount: filtered.filter { $0.needsReview }.count
        )
    }
}

// MARK: - SortOption

/// 排序选项
enum SortOption: String, CaseIterable, Identifiable {
    case createdAtDesc
    case createdAtAsc
    case titleAsc
    case masteryAsc
    case masteryDesc
    case difficultyDesc
    case reviewDateAsc

    var id: String { rawValue }

    var displayName: String {
        switch self {
        case .createdAtDesc: String(localized: "sort_newest")
        case .createdAtAsc: String(localized: "sort_oldest")
        case .titleAsc: String(localized: "sort_title")
        case .masteryAsc: String(localized: "sort_mastery_asc")
        case .masteryDesc: String(localized: "sort_mastery_desc")
        case .difficultyDesc: String(localized: "sort_difficulty")
        case .reviewDateAsc: String(localized: "sort_review_needed")
        }
    }
    
    /// 简短名称（用于筛选栏按钮显示）
    var shortName: String {
        switch self {
        case .createdAtDesc: String(localized: "sort_short_newest")
        case .createdAtAsc: String(localized: "sort_short_oldest")
        case .titleAsc: String(localized: "sort_short_title")
        case .masteryAsc: String(localized: "sort_short_mastery_asc")
        case .masteryDesc: String(localized: "sort_short_mastery_desc")
        case .difficultyDesc: String(localized: "sort_short_difficulty")
        case .reviewDateAsc: String(localized: "sort_short_review")
        }
    }

    var icon: String {
        switch self {
        case .createdAtDesc: "arrow.down.circle"
        case .createdAtAsc: "arrow.up.circle"
        case .titleAsc: "textformat.abc"
        case .masteryAsc, .masteryDesc: "chart.bar"
        case .difficultyDesc: "flame"
        case .reviewDateAsc: "clock"
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - FilteredStatistics

/// 筛选结果统计
struct FilteredStatistics: Sendable, Equatable {
    let totalCount: Int
    let filteredCount: Int
    let masteredCount: Int
    let pendingReviewCount: Int

    /// 筛选率描述
    var filterDescription: String {
        if filteredCount == totalCount {
            return String(format: String(localized: "filter_total_count"), totalCount)
        } else {
            return String(format: String(localized: "filter_filtered_count"), filteredCount, totalCount)
        }
    }
}

//
//  ItemDetailView.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  错题详情页 - iOS 26 现代化设计
//

import SwiftUI
import SwiftData

// MARK: - ItemDetailView

/// 错题详情视图
///
/// 展示和编辑错题的详细信息，包括图片、标题、学科、年级、知识点和笔记。
///
/// ## 功能特性
///
/// - 查看错题完整信息
/// - 编辑错题内容
/// - 删除错题
/// - 显示掌握度和复习次数
///
/// ## 使用示例
///
/// ```swift
/// NavigationStack {
///     ItemDetailView(item: reviewItem)
/// }
/// ```
///
/// ## 设计模式
///
/// - 使用 `@Bindable` 支持双向绑定（读取）
/// - 使用 `ViewModel` 处理写操作（CQRS）
/// - 编辑模式和显示模式分离
struct ItemDetailView: View {

    // MARK: - Properties

    /// 错题数据（可绑定，只读展示）
    @Bindable var item: ReviewItem

    /// 数据上下文
    @Environment(\.modelContext) private var modelContext

    /// 关闭视图
    @Environment(\.dismiss) private var dismiss

    // MARK: - State
    
    /// ViewModel（处理写操作）
    @State private var viewModel = ItemDetailViewModel()

    /// 是否处于编辑模式
    @State private var isEditing = false

    /// 是否显示删除确认
    @State private var showDeleteAlert = false

    // MARK: - Body

    var body: some View {
        ScrollView {
            VStack(spacing: 24) {
                imagePreview

                if isEditing {
                    EditingContent(item: item, onSave: saveChanges)
                } else {
                    DisplayContent(item: item)
                }
            }
            .padding()
        }
        .navigationTitle("detail_title")
        .navigationBarTitleDisplayMode(.inline)
        .toolbar { toolbarContent }
        .alert("detail_delete_confirm_title", isPresented: $showDeleteAlert) {
            Button("common_cancel", role: .cancel) {}
            Button("common_delete", role: .destructive) { deleteItem() }
        } message: {
            Text("detail_delete_confirm_message")
        }
        .onAppear {
            viewModel.configure(with: modelContext)
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Toolbar

private extension ItemDetailView {

    /// 工具栏内容
    @ToolbarContentBuilder
    var toolbarContent: some ToolbarContent {
        ToolbarItem(placement: .topBarTrailing) {
            Menu {
                Button {
                    isEditing.toggle()
                } label: {
                    Label(
                        isEditing ? String(localized: "detail_finish_editing") : String(localized: "detail_edit"),
                        systemImage: isEditing ? "checkmark" : "pencil"
                    )
                }

                Button(role: .destructive) {
                    showDeleteAlert = true
                } label: {
                    Label("common_delete", systemImage: "trash")
                }
            } label: {
                Image(systemName: "ellipsis.circle")
            }
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Subviews

private extension ItemDetailView {

    /// 图片预览
    @ViewBuilder
    var imagePreview: some View {
        if let imageData = item.imageData,
           let uiImage = UIImage(data: imageData) {
            Image(uiImage: uiImage)
                .resizable()
                .scaledToFit()
                .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 20))
                .shadow(color: .black.opacity(0.1), radius: 10, y: 5)
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Actions

private extension ItemDetailView {

    /// 保存修改（委托给 ViewModel）
    func saveChanges() {
        withAnimation {
            viewModel.save(item)
            isEditing = false
        }
    }

    /// 删除错题（委托给 ViewModel）
    func deleteItem() {
        viewModel.delete(item)
        dismiss()
    }
}

// MARK: - Preview

#Preview("Item Detail") {
    NavigationStack {
        ItemDetailView(item: ReviewItem(
            imageData: nil,
            title: "数学-三角函数",
            note: "这是解题思路",
            subject: .math,
            grade: .grade10,
            knowledgePoints: ["函数", "三角"]
        ))
        .modelContainer(for: ReviewItem.self, inMemory: true)
    }
}
