//
//  LibraryView.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  题库视图 - iOS 26 现代化设计
//

import SwiftUI
import SwiftData
import OSLog

// MARK: - LibraryView

/// 题库视图
///
/// 展示所有错题的列表视图，支持按学科筛选和搜索功能。
///
/// ## 功能特性
///
/// - 按学科筛选错题
/// - 搜索标题和知识点
/// - 滑动删除错题
/// - 导航到错题详情
///
/// ## 使用示例
///
/// ```swift
/// LibraryView()
///     .modelContainer(for: ReviewItem.self)
/// ```
///
/// ## 架构设计
///
/// 视图采用 MVVM 架构：
/// - 使用 `@Query` 从 SwiftData 获取数据
/// - 使用 `LibraryViewModel` 处理筛选和删除逻辑
/// - 子组件（FilterChip、ItemRow）保持独立可复用
struct LibraryView: View {

    // MARK: - Properties

    /// 所有错题数据（按创建时间倒序）
    @Query(sort: \ReviewItem.createdAt, order: .reverse)
    private var items: [ReviewItem]

    /// 数据上下文
    @Environment(\.modelContext) private var modelContext

    /// 视图模型
    @State private var viewModel = LibraryViewModel()
    
    /// 用户配置管理器（获取启用的学科）
    @StateObject private var profileManager = UserProfileManager.shared
    
    /// 程序化导航路径
    @State private var navigationPath = NavigationPath()
    
    /// 搜索是否激活
    @Environment(\.isSearching) private var isSearching

    // MARK: - Computed Properties

    /// 筛选后的错题列表
    private var filteredItems: [ReviewItem] {
        viewModel.filteredItems(from: items)
    }
    
    /// 用户启用的学科列表（按原始顺序排列）
    /// 如果用户没有选择任何学科，显示所有学科
    private var enabledSubjects: [Subject] {
        let enabled = Subject.allCases.filter { profileManager.enabledSubjects.contains($0) }
        return enabled.isEmpty ? Array(Subject.allCases) : enabled
    }

    // MARK: - Body

    var body: some View {
        NavigationStack(path: $navigationPath) {
            contentView
                .navigationTitle("library_title")
                .navigationBarTitleDisplayMode(.large)
                .searchable(
                    text: $viewModel.searchText,
                    placement: .navigationBarDrawer(displayMode: .always),
                    prompt: Text("library_search_prompt")
                )
                .onSubmit(of: .search) {
                    viewModel.submitSearch()
                }
                .toolbar {
                    // 右上角编辑按钮
                    ToolbarItem(placement: .topBarTrailing) {
                        if !items.isEmpty {
                            Button {
                                withAnimation(.spring(response: 0.3)) {
                                    viewModel.toggleSelectionMode()
                                }
                            } label: {
                                Text(viewModel.isSelectionMode ? "library_done" : "library_edit")
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                .safeAreaInset(edge: .bottom) {
                    // 批量操作工具栏
                    if viewModel.isSelectionMode {
                        batchActionBar
                            .transition(.move(edge: .bottom).combined(with: .opacity))
                    }
                }
                .sheet(isPresented: $viewModel.showAdvancedSearch) {
                    AdvancedSearchView(searchCriteria: $viewModel.advancedCriteria)
                }
                .onAppear {
                    viewModel.configure(with: modelContext)
                    Logger.ui.debug("LibraryView onAppear - 共 \(items.count) 条数据")
                }
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Subviews

private extension LibraryView {

    /// 内容视图
    @ViewBuilder
    var contentView: some View {
        if items.isEmpty {
            // 完全没有数据 - 显示首次使用引导
            EmptyStateView.noItems {
                // 发送通知切换到录入页面
                NotificationCenter.default.post(name: .switchToCapture, object: nil)
            }
        } else {
            itemList
        }
    }

    /// 筛选栏（固定在搜索栏下方）
    var filterBar: some View {
        ScrollView(.horizontal, showsIndicators: false) {
            HStack(spacing: 10) {
                // 全部按钮
                FilterChip(
                    title: String(localized: "filter_all"),
                    isSelected: viewModel.selectedSubject == nil
                ) {
                    withAnimation(.spring(response: 0.3)) {
                        viewModel.selectSubject(nil)
                    }
                }

                // 只显示用户启用的学科
                ForEach(enabledSubjects, id: \.self) { subject in
                    FilterChip(
                        title: subject.displayName,
                        isSelected: viewModel.selectedSubject == subject
                    ) {
                        withAnimation(.spring(response: 0.3)) {
                            viewModel.selectSubject(subject)
                        }
                    }
                }
                
                // 分隔线
                Divider()
                    .frame(height: 20)
                
                // 排序按钮
                sortButton
                
                // 高级筛选按钮
                advancedFilterButton
            }
            .padding(.horizontal)
            .padding(.vertical, 8)
        }
    }
    
    /// 排序按钮
    private var sortButton: some View {
        Menu {
            ForEach(SortOption.allCases) { option in
                Button {
                    withAnimation {
                        viewModel.sortOption = option
                    }
                } label: {
                    HStack {
                        Text(option.displayName)
                        if viewModel.sortOption == option {
                            Image(systemName: "checkmark")
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        } label: {
            HStack(spacing: 4) {
                Image(systemName: "arrow.up.arrow.down")
                Text(viewModel.sortOption.shortName)
            }
            .font(.subheadline)
            .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            .padding(.horizontal, 12)
            .padding(.vertical, 8)
            .background(Color.semantic.tertiaryBackground, in: Capsule())
        }
    }
    
    /// 高级筛选按钮
    private var advancedFilterButton: some View {
        Button {
            viewModel.showAdvancedSearch = true
        } label: {
            HStack(spacing: 4) {
                Image(systemName: "slider.horizontal.3")
                if viewModel.advancedCriteria.hasActiveFilters {
                    Text("\(viewModel.advancedCriteria.activeFilterCount)")
                        .font(.caption2.bold())
                        .foregroundStyle(.white)
                        .padding(.horizontal, 6)
                        .padding(.vertical, 2)
                        .background(Color.brand.primary, in: Capsule())
                }
            }
            .font(.subheadline)
            .foregroundStyle(viewModel.advancedCriteria.hasActiveFilters ? Color.brand.primary : .secondary)
            .padding(.horizontal, 12)
            .padding(.vertical, 8)
            .background(Color.semantic.tertiaryBackground, in: Capsule())
        }
    }

    /// 错题列表
    var itemList: some View {
        List {
            // 筛选栏（固定在顶部）
            Section {
                filterBar
            }
            .listRowInsets(EdgeInsets())
            .listRowBackground(Color.clear)
            .listRowSeparator(.hidden)
            
            // 搜索历史（仅在搜索框为空且有历史记录时显示）
            if viewModel.searchText.isEmpty && !isSearching {
                Section {
                    SearchHistoryView { query in
                        viewModel.selectFromHistory(query)
                    }
                }
                .listRowInsets(EdgeInsets())
                .listRowBackground(Color.clear)
                .listRowSeparator(.hidden)
            }
            
            // 错题内容
            Section {
                if filteredItems.isEmpty {
                    // 有数据但筛选结果为空
                    ContentUnavailableView {
                        Label(String(localized: "library_no_results"), systemImage: "magnifyingglass")
                    } description: {
                        Text("library_try_different_filter")
                    }
                    .listRowSeparator(.hidden)
                } else {
                    ForEach(filteredItems) { item in
                        if viewModel.isSelectionMode {
                            // 选择模式：点击切换选中状态
                            Button {
                                withAnimation(.spring(response: 0.2)) {
                                    viewModel.toggleSelection(for: item.id)
                                }
                            } label: {
                                HStack {
                                    Image(systemName: viewModel.isSelected(item.id) ? "checkmark.circle.fill" : "circle")
                                        .font(.title2)
                                        .foregroundStyle(viewModel.isSelected(item.id) ? Color.brand.primary : .secondary)
                                    ItemRow(item: item)
                                }
                            }
                            .buttonStyle(.plain)
                            .listRowBackground(viewModel.isSelected(item.id) ? Color.brand.primary.opacity(0.1) : Color.clear)
                        } else {
                            // 正常模式：点击导航到详情
                            Button {
                                navigationPath.append(item)
                            } label: {
                                ItemRow(item: item)
                            }
                            .buttonStyle(.plain)
                            // 添加右侧箭头，模拟 NavigationLink 外观
                            .listRowBackground(Color.clear)
                            .background(alignment: .trailing) {
                                Image(systemName: "chevron.right")
                                    .font(.system(size: 14, weight: .semibold))
                                    .foregroundStyle(.tertiary)
                                    .padding(.trailing, 4)
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    .onDelete { offsets in
                        withAnimation {
                            viewModel.deleteItems(from: filteredItems, at: offsets)
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        .listStyle(.plain)
        .navigationDestination(for: ReviewItem.self) { item in
            ItemDetailView(item: item)
        }
    }
    
    /// 批量操作工具栏
    var batchActionBar: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 0) {
            Divider()
            
            HStack(spacing: 16) {
                // 选中数量提示
                Text(String(format: String(localized: "batch_selected_count"), viewModel.selectedCount))
                    .font(.subheadline)
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                
                Spacer()
                
                // 全选/取消全选
                Button {
                    withAnimation(.spring(response: 0.2)) {
                        if viewModel.selectedCount == filteredItems.count {
                            viewModel.deselectAll()
                        } else {
                            viewModel.selectAll(from: filteredItems)
                        }
                    }
                } label: {
                    Text(viewModel.selectedCount == filteredItems.count ? "batch_deselect_all" : "batch_select_all")
                        .font(.subheadline)
                }
                
                // 标记掌握度菜单
                Menu {
                    ForEach(MasteryLevel.allCases, id: \.self) { level in
                        Button {
                            withAnimation(.spring(response: 0.3)) {
                                viewModel.markSelectedItems(from: items, as: level)
                            }
                        } label: {
                            Label(level.displayName, systemImage: level.icon)
                        }
                    }
                } label: {
                    Label("batch_mark_mastery", systemImage: "checkmark.seal")
                        .font(.subheadline)
                }
                .disabled(viewModel.selectedCount == 0)
                
                // 删除按钮
                Button(role: .destructive) {
                    withAnimation(.spring(response: 0.3)) {
                        viewModel.deleteSelectedItems(from: items)
                    }
                } label: {
                    Label("batch_delete", systemImage: "trash")
                        .font(.subheadline)
                }
                .disabled(viewModel.selectedCount == 0)
            }
            .padding(.horizontal)
            .padding(.vertical, 12)
            .background(.regularMaterial)
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - FilterChip

/// 筛选芯片组件
///
/// 用于学科筛选的可选中按钮组件。
///
/// ## 使用示例
///
/// ```swift
/// FilterChip(
///     title: "数学",
///     isSelected: selectedSubject == .math
/// ) {
///     selectedSubject = .math
/// }
/// ```
struct FilterChip: View {

    // MARK: - Properties

    /// 显示标题
    let title: String

    /// 是否选中
    let isSelected: Bool

    /// 点击回调
    let action: () -> Void

    // MARK: - Body

    var body: some View {
        Button(action: action) {
            Text(title)
                .font(.subheadline)
                .fontWeight(isSelected ? .semibold : .regular)
                .padding(.horizontal, 16)
                .padding(.vertical, 12) // Increased vertical padding for better touch target
                .frame(minHeight: 44)   // Ensure minimum touch target height
                .background(backgroundGradient)
                .foregroundStyle(isSelected ? .white : .primary)
                .clipShape(Capsule())
                .shadow(
                    color: isSelected ? .blue.opacity(0.3) : .clear,
                    radius: 4,
                    y: 2
                )
        }
        .accessibilityAddTraits(isSelected ? .isSelected : [])
        .accessibilityHint(isSelected ? "Double tap to deselect" : "Double tap to filter by this subject")
    }

    // MARK: - Private

    /// 背景渐变
    private var backgroundGradient: some ShapeStyle {
        if isSelected {
            LinearGradient(
                colors: [.blue, .blue.opacity(0.8)],
                startPoint: .leading,
                endPoint: .trailing
            )
        } else {
            LinearGradient(
                colors: [Color(uiColor: .secondarySystemBackground)],
                startPoint: .leading,
                endPoint: .trailing
            )
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - ItemRow

/// 错题列表行组件
///
/// 展示错题的缩略图、标题、学科、掌握度和日期信息。
///
/// ## 性能优化
///
/// - 使用 `AsyncImage` 风格的懒加载避免主线程阻塞
/// - 缓存解码后的缩略图
///
/// ## 使用示例
///
/// ```swift
/// List(items) { item in
///     ItemRow(item: item)
/// }
/// ```
struct ItemRow: View {

    // MARK: - Properties

    /// 错题数据
    let item: ReviewItem
    
    /// 缓存的缩略图
    @State private var cachedThumbnail: UIImage?

    // MARK: - Constants

    /// 缩略图尺寸
    private enum Layout {
        static let thumbnailSize: CGFloat = 70
        static let cornerRadius: CGFloat = 12
    }

    // MARK: - Body

    var body: some View {
        HStack(spacing: 12) {
            thumbnailView
            infoSection
        }
        .padding(.vertical, 4)
        .accessibilityElement(children: .combine)
        .accessibilityLabel("\(item.title), \(item.subject.displayName), \(item.mastery.displayName)")
        .task(id: item.id) {
            // 异步加载缩略图，避免阻塞主线程
            await loadThumbnail()
        }
    }
    
    // MARK: - Thumbnail Loading
    
    /// 异步加载并缓存缩略图
    private func loadThumbnail() async {
        guard cachedThumbnail == nil,
              let data = item.imageData else { return }
        
        // 在后台线程解码和缩放图片
        let thumbnail = await Task.detached(priority: .userInitiated) {
            guard let original = UIImage(data: data) else { return nil as UIImage? }
            
            // 生成缩略图，避免加载全尺寸图片
            let targetSize = CGSize(width: Layout.thumbnailSize * 2, height: Layout.thumbnailSize * 2)
            let renderer = UIGraphicsImageRenderer(size: targetSize)
            return renderer.image { _ in
                original.draw(in: CGRect(origin: .zero, size: targetSize))
            }
        }.value
        
        await MainActor.run {
            cachedThumbnail = thumbnail
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - ItemRow Subviews

private extension ItemRow {

    /// 缩略图（使用缓存）
    @ViewBuilder
    var thumbnailView: some View {
        if let thumbnail = cachedThumbnail {
            Image(uiImage: thumbnail)
                .resizable()
                .scaledToFill()
                .frame(width: Layout.thumbnailSize, height: Layout.thumbnailSize)
                .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: Layout.cornerRadius))
        } else if item.imageData != nil {
            // 有图片数据但还在加载中
            loadingThumbnail
        } else {
            placeholderThumbnail
        }
    }
    
    /// 加载中的缩略图
    var loadingThumbnail: some View {
        RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: Layout.cornerRadius)
            .fill(Color.gray.opacity(0.1))
            .frame(width: Layout.thumbnailSize, height: Layout.thumbnailSize)
            .overlay {
                ProgressView()
                    .scaleEffect(0.8)
            }
    }

    /// 占位缩略图
    var placeholderThumbnail: some View {
        RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: Layout.cornerRadius)
            .fill(Color.gray.opacity(0.1))
            .frame(width: Layout.thumbnailSize, height: Layout.thumbnailSize)
            .overlay {
                Image(systemName: "photo")
                    .font(.title2)
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            }
    }

    /// 信息区域
    var infoSection: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 6) {
            Text(item.title)
                .font(.headline)
                .lineLimit(2)

            HStack(spacing: 8) {
                subjectTag
                MasteryBadge(level: item.mastery)
                Spacer()
                dateLabel
            }
        }
    }

    /// 学科标签
    var subjectTag: some View {
        Text(item.subject.displayName)
            .font(.caption)
            .padding(.horizontal, 8)
            .padding(.vertical, 3)
            .background(item.subject.color.opacity(0.1))
            .foregroundStyle(item.subject.color)
            .clipShape(Capsule())
    }

    /// 日期标签
    var dateLabel: some View {
        Text(item.createdAt, format: .dateTime.month().day())
            .font(.caption)
            .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
    }
}

        FilterChip(title: "全部", isSelected: true) {}
        FilterChip(title: "数学", isSelected: false) {}
    }
    .padding()

/// 高级搜索视图
///
/// 提供多条件筛选功能，支持按学科、难度、掌握程度、日期等条件组合搜索。
struct AdvancedSearchView: View {

    // MARK: - Environment

    @Environment(\.dismiss) private var dismiss

    // MARK: - Bindings

    /// 筛选条件
    @Binding var searchCriteria: SearchCriteria

    // MARK: - State

    /// 本地编辑的条件副本
    @State private var localCriteria: SearchCriteria

    // MARK: - Init

    init(searchCriteria: Binding<SearchCriteria>) {
        _searchCriteria = searchCriteria
        _localCriteria = State(initialValue: searchCriteria.wrappedValue)
    }

    // MARK: - Body

    var body: some View {
        NavigationStack {
            Form {
                keywordSection
                subjectSection
                difficultySection
                masterySection
                dateSection
                otherConditionsSection
                resetSection
            }
            .navigationTitle("高级搜索")
            .navigationBarTitleDisplayMode(.inline)
            .toolbar {
                toolbarContent
            }
        }
    }

                .autocorrectionDisabled()
        }

        Section("学科") {

        Section("掌握程度") {
            MasterySelectionRow(selectedMasteries: $localCriteria.masteryLevels)
        }
    }

    /// 日期范围区域
    private var dateSection: some View {
        Section("创建日期") {
            DateRangeRow(dateRange: $localCriteria.dateRange)
        }
    }

    /// 其他条件区域
    private var otherConditionsSection: some View {
        Section("其他条件") {

            Toggle("仅显示有图片", isOn: $localCriteria.hasImageOnly)
            Toggle("仅显示有笔记", isOn: $localCriteria.hasNoteOnly)
        }
    }

    /// 重置按钮区域
    private var resetSection: some View {
        Section {

            }

//
//  AdvancedSearchModels.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  Created by LIAOYIMING on 2025/6/5.
//

import SwiftUI

// MARK: - SearchCriteria

/// 搜索条件模型
struct SearchCriteria: Equatable, Sendable {
    /// 关键词
    var keyword: String = ""

    /// 选中的学科
    var subjects: Set<Subject> = []

    /// 选中的难度
    var difficulties: Set<Difficulty> = []

    /// 选中的掌握程度
    var masteryLevels: Set<MasteryLevel> = []

    /// 日期范围
    var dateRange: DateRangeOption = .all

    /// 仅显示待复习
    var needsReviewOnly: Bool = false

    /// 仅显示已逾期
    var overdueOnly: Bool = false

    /// 仅显示有图片
    var hasImageOnly: Bool = false

    /// 仅显示有笔记
    var hasNoteOnly: Bool = false

    /// 是否有活动筛选条件
    var hasActiveFilters: Bool {
        !keyword.isEmpty ||
        !subjects.isEmpty ||
        !difficulties.isEmpty ||
        !masteryLevels.isEmpty ||
        dateRange != .all ||
        needsReviewOnly ||
        overdueOnly ||
        hasImageOnly ||
        hasNoteOnly
    }

    /// 活动筛选条件数量
    var activeFilterCount: Int {
        var count = 0
        if !keyword.isEmpty { count += 1 }
        if !subjects.isEmpty { count += 1 }
        if !difficulties.isEmpty { count += 1 }
        if !masteryLevels.isEmpty { count += 1 }
        if dateRange != .all { count += 1 }
        if needsReviewOnly { count += 1 }
        if overdueOnly { count += 1 }
        if hasImageOnly { count += 1 }
        if hasNoteOnly { count += 1 }
        return count
    }
}

// MARK: - DateRangeOption

/// 日期范围选项
enum DateRangeOption: String, CaseIterable, Sendable {
    case all = "全部时间"
    case today = "今天"
    case thisWeek = "本周"
    case thisMonth = "本月"
    case lastMonth = "上月"
    case thisYear = "今年"
    case custom = "自定义"

    /// 获取日期范围
    var dateRange: ClosedRange<Date>? {
        let calendar = Calendar.current
        let now = Date()

        switch self {
        case .all:
            return nil
        case .today:
            let start = calendar.startOfDay(for: now)
            let end = calendar.date(byAdding: .day, value: 1, to: start)!
            return start...end
        case .thisWeek:
            let start = calendar.date(from: calendar.dateComponents([.yearForWeekOfYear, .weekOfYear], from: now))!
            let end = calendar.date(byAdding: .weekOfYear, value: 1, to: start)!
            return start...end
        case .thisMonth:
            let start = calendar.date(from: calendar.dateComponents([.year, .month], from: now))!
            let end = calendar.date(byAdding: .month, value: 1, to: start)!
            return start...end
        case .lastMonth:
            let thisMonthStart = calendar.date(from: calendar.dateComponents([.year, .month], from: now))!
            let start = calendar.date(byAdding: .month, value: -1, to: thisMonthStart)!
            return start...thisMonthStart
        case .thisYear:
            let start = calendar.date(from: calendar.dateComponents([.year], from: now))!
            let end = calendar.date(byAdding: .year, value: 1, to: start)!
            return start...end
        case .custom:
            return nil
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - SearchCriteria Extension for Filtering

extension SearchCriteria {

    /// 应用筛选条件到错题列表
    func filter(_ items: [ReviewItem]) -> [ReviewItem] {
        items.filter { item in
            // 关键词筛选
            if !keyword.isEmpty {
                let lowercasedKeyword = keyword.lowercased()
                let matchesKeyword = item.title.lowercased().contains(lowercasedKeyword) ||
                    item.note.lowercased().contains(lowercasedKeyword) ||
                    item.knowledgePoints.matches(keyword)
                if !matchesKeyword { return false }
            }

            // 学科筛选
            if !subjects.isEmpty && !subjects.contains(item.subject) {
                return false
            }

            // 难度筛选
            if !difficulties.isEmpty && !difficulties.contains(item.difficulty) {
                return false
            }

            // 掌握程度筛选
            if !masteryLevels.isEmpty && !masteryLevels.contains(item.mastery) {
                return false
            }

            // 日期范围筛选
            if let range = dateRange.dateRange {
                if !range.contains(item.createdAt) {
                    return false
                }
            }

            // 待复习筛选
            if needsReviewOnly && !item.needsReview {
                return false
            }

            // 逾期筛选
            if overdueOnly && !item.isOverdue {
                return false
            }

            // 有图片筛选
            if hasImageOnly && !item.hasImage {
                return false
            }

            // 有笔记筛选
            if hasNoteOnly && !item.hasNote {
                return false
            }

            return true
        }
    }
}

import SwiftUI

// MARK: - SubjectSelectionGrid

/// 学科选择网格
struct SubjectSelectionGrid: View {
    @Binding var selectedSubjects: Set<Subject>

    private let columns = [
        GridItem(.flexible()),
        GridItem(.flexible()),
        GridItem(.flexible())
    ]

    var body: some View {
        LazyVGrid(columns: columns, spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.sm) {
            ForEach(Subject.allCases, id: \.self) { subject in
                SelectionChip(
                    title: subject.displayName,
                    icon: subject.icon,
                    color: subject.color,
                    isSelected: selectedSubjects.contains(subject)
                ) {
                    withAnimation(.spring(response: 0.3)) {
                        if selectedSubjects.contains(subject) {
                            selectedSubjects.remove(subject)
                        } else {
                            selectedSubjects.insert(subject)
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

//
//  ItemDetailViewModel.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  Created for NotBad K12 错题本
//  CQRS 架构：Command 层 - 处理写操作
//

import SwiftUI
import SwiftData
import OSLog

// MARK: - ItemDetailViewModel

/// 错题详情 ViewModel
///
/// 负责处理错题详情页的业务逻辑和写操作。
/// 遵循 CQRS 原则：View 使用 `@Bindable` 读取数据，
/// 所有修改操作通过 ViewModel 执行。
///
/// ## 职责
///
/// - 删除错题
/// - 保存修改
/// - 业务逻辑验证
///
/// ## 依赖注入
///
/// ```swift
/// @State private var viewModel = ItemDetailViewModel()
/// viewModel.configure(with: modelContext)
/// ```
@Observable
@MainActor
final class ItemDetailViewModel {
    
    // MARK: - Dependencies
    
    /// 数据上下文
    private var modelContext: ModelContext?
    
    /// 分析服务
    private let analyticsService: any AnalyticsServiceProtocol
    
    // MARK: - Initialization
    
    init(analyticsService: any AnalyticsServiceProtocol = LocalAnalyticsService.shared) {
        self.analyticsService = analyticsService
    }
    
    // MARK: - Configuration
    
    /// 配置 ViewModel
    ///
    /// - Parameter context: SwiftData 模型上下文
    func configure(with context: ModelContext) {
        self.modelContext = context
    }
    
    // MARK: - Commands
    
    /// 删除错题
    ///
    /// - Parameter item: 要删除的错题
    /// - Returns: 删除是否成功
    @discardableResult
    func delete(_ item: ReviewItem) -> Bool {
        guard let modelContext else {
            Logger.data.error("ItemDetailViewModel: modelContext 未配置")
            return false
        }
        
        // 记录分析事件
        analyticsService.track(AnalyticsEvent(
            name: AnalyticsEventName.itemDeleted,
            parameters: [
                "subject": item.subject.rawValue,
                "mastery": String(item.mastery.rawValue)
            ]
        ))
        
        // 执行删除
        modelContext.delete(item)
        
        do {
            try modelContext.save()
            Logger.data.info("删除错题成功: \(item.title)")
            
            // 发送通知
            NotificationCenter.default.post(name: .reviewItemDeleted, object: item.id)
            
            return true
        } catch {
            Logger.data.error("删除错题失败: \(error)")
            return false
        }
    }
    
    /// 保存修改
    ///
    /// - Parameter item: 要保存的错题
    /// - Returns: 保存是否成功
    @discardableResult
    func save(_ item: ReviewItem) -> Bool {
        guard let modelContext else {
            Logger.data.error("ItemDetailViewModel: modelContext 未配置")
            return false
        }
        
        // 更新时间戳
        item.updatedAt = Date()
        
        do {
            try modelContext.save()
            Logger.data.debug("保存错题成功: \(item.title)")
            
            // 发送通知
            NotificationCenter.default.post(name: .reviewItemUpdated, object: item)
            
            return true
        } catch {
            Logger.data.error("保存错题失败: \(error)")
            return false
        }
    }
}

//
//  DashboardView.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  Created for NotBad K12 错题本
//

import SwiftUI
import SwiftData
import Charts

// MARK: - DashboardView

/// 数据看板视图
///
/// 展示学习数据统计和可视化图表。
///
/// ## 功能特性
///
/// - 欢迎卡片
/// - 统计数据展示
/// - 掌握度分布饼图
/// - 学科分布条形图
/// - 快捷操作入口
struct DashboardView: View {

    // MARK: - Environment

    @Query private var allItems: [ReviewItem]

    // MARK: - Body

    var body: some View {
        NavigationStack {
            ScrollView {
                VStack(spacing: 24) {
                    WelcomeCard()

                    StatisticsGrid(
                        totalCount: allItems.count,
                        masteredCount: masteredCount,
                        weeklyNewCount: weeklyNewCount,
                        totalReviewCount: totalReviewCount
                    )

                    MasteryDistributionChart(
                        data: masteryData,
                        isEmpty: allItems.isEmpty
                    )

                    SubjectDistributionChart(
                        data: subjectData,
                        isEmpty: allItems.isEmpty
                    )

                    quickActions
                }
                .padding()
            }
            .navigationTitle("dashboard_title")
            .navigationBarTitleDisplayMode(.large)
        }
    }

    // MARK: - Quick Actions

    private var quickActions: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 16) {
            Text("dashboard_quick_actions")
                .font(.headline)

            VStack(spacing: 12) {
                NavigationLink(destination: CaptureView()) {
                    QuickActionButton(
                        title: "action_quick_capture",
                        icon: "plus.circle.fill",
                        color: .blue
                    )
                }

                NavigationLink(destination: ReviewView()) {
                    QuickActionButton(
                        title: "action_start_review",
                        icon: "sparkles",
                        color: .orange
                    )
                }

                NavigationLink(destination: LibraryView()) {
                    QuickActionButton(
                        title: "action_view_library",
                        icon: "books.vertical.fill",
                        color: .green
                    )
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // MARK: - Computed Properties

    private var masteredCount: Int {
        allItems.filter { $0.masteryLevel == MasteryLevel.mastered.rawValue }.count
    }

    private var weeklyNewCount: Int {
        let weekAgo = Calendar.current.date(byAdding: .day, value: -7, to: Date()) ?? Date()
        return allItems.filter { $0.createdAt >= weekAgo }.count
    }

    private var totalReviewCount: Int {
        allItems.reduce(0) { $0 + $1.reviewCount }
    }

    private var masteryData: [MasteryChartData] {
        MasteryLevel.allCases.compactMap { level in
            let count = allItems.filter { $0.masteryLevel == level.rawValue }.count
            guard count > 0 else { return nil }
            let total = max(1, allItems.count)
            return MasteryChartData(
                level: level,
                count: count,
                percentage: Double(count) / Double(total)
            )
        }
    }

    private var subjectData: [SubjectData] {
        Dictionary(grouping: allItems, by: { $0.subject })
            .map { SubjectData(subject: $0.key.displayName, count: $0.value.count) }
            .sorted { $0.count > $1.count }
    }
}

// MARK: - Preview

#Preview {
    DashboardView()
        .modelContainer(for: ReviewItem.self, inMemory: true)
}

//
//  DashboardModels.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  Created by LIAOYIMING on 2025/6/5.

import SwiftUI

// MARK: - TimeRange

/// 时间范围选项
enum TimeRange: String, CaseIterable, Identifiable {
    case week = "本周"
    case month = "本月"
    case quarter = "本季度"
    case year = "今年"
    case all = "全部"

    var id: String { rawValue }

    var displayName: String { rawValue }

    var startDate: Date? {
        let calendar = Calendar.current
        let now = Date()

        switch self {
        case .week:
            return calendar.date(byAdding: .day, value: -7, to: now)
        case .month:
            return calendar.date(byAdding: .month, value: -1, to: now)
        case .quarter:
            return calendar.date(byAdding: .month, value: -3, to: now)
        case .year:
            return calendar.date(byAdding: .year, value: -1, to: now)
        case .all:
            return nil
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - DashboardStatistics

/// 仪表盘统计数据
struct DashboardStatistics: Sendable, Equatable {
    let totalCount: Int
    let masteredCount: Int
    let weeklyNewCount: Int
    let totalReviewCount: Int
    let pendingReviewCount: Int
    let overdueCount: Int
    let masteryRate: Double
    let averageReviewCount: Double

    /// 掌握率百分比描述
    var masteryPercentageText: String {
        "\(Int(masteryRate * 100))%"
    }

    /// 是否有待复习
    var hasPendingReview: Bool {
        pendingReviewCount > 0
    }

    /// 是否有逾期
    var hasOverdue: Bool {
        overdueCount > 0
    }

    /// 空统计数据
    static let empty = DashboardStatistics(
        totalCount: 0,
        masteredCount: 0,
        weeklyNewCount: 0,
        totalReviewCount: 0,
        pendingReviewCount: 0,
        overdueCount: 0,
        masteryRate: 0,
        averageReviewCount: 0
    )
}

// MARK: - Chart Data Models

/// 掌握程度图表数据
struct MasteryChartData: Identifiable, Sendable {
    let level: MasteryLevel
    let count: Int
    let percentage: Double

    var id: Int { level.rawValue }
    var label: String { level.displayName }
    var color: Color { level.color }
}

/// 学科图表数据
struct SubjectChartData: Identifiable, Sendable {
    let subject: Subject
    let count: Int
    let percentage: Double

    var id: String { subject.rawValue }
    var displayName: String { subject.displayName }
    var color: Color { subject.color }
}

/// 难度图表数据
struct DifficultyChartData: Identifiable, Sendable {
    let difficulty: Difficulty
    let count: Int

    var id: Int { difficulty.rawValue }
    var label: String { difficulty.displayName }
    var color: Color { difficulty.color }
}

/// 每日趋势数据
struct DailyTrendData: Identifiable, Sendable {
    let date: Date
    let newCount: Int
    let reviewedCount: Int

    var id: Date { date }

    var dayLabel: String {
        let formatter = DateFormatter()
        formatter.dateFormat = "E"
        formatter.locale = Locale(identifier: "zh_CN")
        return formatter.string(from: date)
    }
}

// MARK: - Learning Insight

/// 学习洞察
struct LearningInsight: Identifiable, Sendable {
    let id = UUID()
    let type: InsightType
    let title: String
    let message: String

    enum InsightType: Sendable {
        case success
        case warning
        case info

        var icon: String {
            switch self {
            case .success: "checkmark.circle.fill"
            case .warning: "exclamationmark.triangle.fill"
            case .info: "info.circle.fill"
            }
        }

        var color: Color {
            switch self {
            case .success: .green
            case .warning: .orange
            case .info: .blue
            }
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Legacy Compatibility

/// 兼容旧版 MasteryData
typealias MasteryData = MasteryChartData

/// 兼容旧版 SubjectData
struct SubjectData: Sendable {
    let subject: String
    let count: Int

    init(subject: String, count: Int) {
        self.subject = subject
        self.count = count
    }

    init(from chartData: SubjectChartData) {
        self.subject = chartData.subject.displayName
        self.count = chartData.count
    }
}

// FILE PATH: NotBad/Presentation/Features/Dashboard/DashboardViewModel.swift

//
//  DashboardViewModel.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  Created by LIAOYIMING on 2025/6/5.
//  Phase 3: ViewModel Dependency Injection
//

import SwiftUI
import SwiftData

// MARK: - DashboardViewModel

/// 数据看板 ViewModel
///
/// 负责处理首页仪表盘的数据统计和展示逻辑。
///
/// ## 职责
///
/// - 计算错题统计数据（总数、已掌握、本周新增等）
/// - 生成图表所需的数据结构
/// - 提供复习建议和学习洞察
///
/// ## 依赖注入
///
/// 支持两种使用方式：
///
/// ```swift
/// // 方式1: 使用 DataProvider（推荐，支持测试）
/// let provider = SwiftDataReviewItemProvider(modelContext: context)
/// let viewModel = DashboardViewModel(dataProvider: provider)
/// let stats = viewModel.computeStatistics()
///
/// // 方式2: 传入 items（向后兼容）
/// let viewModel = DashboardViewModel()
/// let stats = viewModel.computeStatistics(from: items)
/// ```
@MainActor
@Observable
final class DashboardViewModel {

    // MARK: - Dependencies

    /// 数据提供者（可选，用于依赖注入）
    private var dataProvider: (any ReviewItemDataProviding)?

    // MARK: - State

    /// 选中的时间范围
    var selectedTimeRange: TimeRange = .week

    /// 选中的学科（用于筛选）
    var selectedSubject: Subject?

    // MARK: - Initialization

    /// 默认初始化（向后兼容）
    init() {}

    /// 依赖注入初始化（推荐用于测试）
    ///
    /// - Parameter dataProvider: 数据提供者
    init(dataProvider: any ReviewItemDataProviding) {
        self.dataProvider = dataProvider
    }

    // MARK: - Data Access

    /// 获取所有错题
    ///
    /// 优先从 dataProvider 获取，否则返回空数组
    var items: [ReviewItem] {
        dataProvider?.items ?? []
    }

    // MARK: - Private Helpers

    /// 根据筛选条件过滤错题
    private func filterItems(_ items: [ReviewItem]) -> [ReviewItem] {
        var filtered = items

        // 按学科筛选
        if let subject = selectedSubject {
            filtered = filtered.filter { $0.subject == subject }
        }

        // 按时间范围筛选
        if let startDate = selectedTimeRange.startDate {
            filtered = filtered.filter { $0.createdAt >= startDate }
        }

        return filtered
    }
}

// MARK: - Statistics

extension DashboardViewModel {
    /// 计算综合统计数据
    ///
    /// - Parameter items: 错题列表
    /// - Returns: 统计数据结构
    func computeStatistics(from items: [ReviewItem]) -> DashboardStatistics {
        let filteredItems = filterItems(items)

        return DashboardStatistics(
            totalCount: filteredItems.count,
            masteredCount: masteredCount(from: filteredItems),
            weeklyNewCount: weeklyNewCount(from: filteredItems),
            totalReviewCount: totalReviewCount(from: filteredItems),
            pendingReviewCount: pendingReviewCount(from: filteredItems),
            overdueCount: overdueCount(from: filteredItems),
            masteryRate: masteryRate(from: filteredItems),
            averageReviewCount: averageReviewCount(from: filteredItems)
        )
    }

    /// 已掌握数量
    func masteredCount(from items: [ReviewItem]) -> Int {
        items.filter { $0.isMastered }.count
    }

    /// 本周新增数量
    func weeklyNewCount(from items: [ReviewItem]) -> Int {
        let weekAgo = Calendar.current.date(byAdding: .day, value: -7, to: Date()) ?? Date()
        return items.filter { $0.createdAt >= weekAgo }.count
    }

    /// 累计复习次数
    func totalReviewCount(from items: [ReviewItem]) -> Int {
        items.reduce(0) { $0 + $1.reviewCount }
    }

    /// 待复习数量
    func pendingReviewCount(from items: [ReviewItem]) -> Int {
        items.filter { $0.needsReview }.count
    }

    /// 已逾期数量
    func overdueCount(from items: [ReviewItem]) -> Int {
        items.filter { $0.isOverdue }.count
    }

    /// 掌握率
    func masteryRate(from items: [ReviewItem]) -> Double {
        guard !items.isEmpty else { return 0 }
        return Double(masteredCount(from: items)) / Double(items.count)
    }

    /// 平均复习次数
    func averageReviewCount(from items: [ReviewItem]) -> Double {
        guard !items.isEmpty else { return 0 }
        return Double(totalReviewCount(from: items)) / Double(items.count)
    }
}

// MARK: - Chart Data

extension DashboardViewModel {
    /// 掌握程度分布数据
    func masteryData(from items: [ReviewItem]) -> [MasteryChartData] {
        let filteredItems = filterItems(items)

        return MasteryLevel.allCases.compactMap { level in
            let count = filteredItems.filter { $0.mastery == level }.count
            guard count > 0 else { return nil }
            return MasteryChartData(
                level: level,
                count: count,
                percentage: Double(count) / Double(max(1, filteredItems.count))
            )
        }
    }

    /// 学科分布数据
    func subjectData(from items: [ReviewItem]) -> [SubjectChartData] {
        let filteredItems = filterItems(items)
        let total = filteredItems.count

        return Dictionary(grouping: filteredItems, by: { $0.subject })
            .map { subject, subjectItems in
                SubjectChartData(
                    subject: subject,
                    count: subjectItems.count,
                    percentage: Double(subjectItems.count) / Double(max(1, total))
                )
            }
            .sorted { $0.count > $1.count }
    }

    /// 难度分布数据
    func difficultyData(from items: [ReviewItem]) -> [DifficultyChartData] {
        let filteredItems = filterItems(items)

        return Difficulty.allCases.compactMap { difficulty in
            let count = filteredItems.filter { $0.difficulty == difficulty }.count
            guard count > 0 else { return nil }
            return DifficultyChartData(
                difficulty: difficulty,
                count: count
            )
        }
    }

    /// 每日趋势数据（最近7天）
    func dailyTrendData(from items: [ReviewItem]) -> [DailyTrendData] {
        let calendar = Calendar.current
        let today = calendar.startOfDay(for: Date())

        return (0..<7).reversed().map { daysAgo in
            let date = calendar.date(byAdding: .day, value: -daysAgo, to: today)!
            let nextDate = calendar.date(byAdding: .day, value: 1, to: date)!

            let newCount = items.filter {
                $0.createdAt >= date && $0.createdAt < nextDate
            }.count

            let reviewedCount = items.filter {
                $0.reviewCount > 0 && $0.updatedAt >= date && $0.updatedAt < nextDate
            }.count

            return DailyTrendData(
                date: date,
                newCount: newCount,
                reviewedCount: reviewedCount
            )
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Insights

extension DashboardViewModel {
    /// 生成学习洞察
    func generateInsights(from items: [ReviewItem]) -> [LearningInsight] {
        var insights: [LearningInsight] = []

        let stats = computeStatistics(from: items)

        // 逾期提醒
        if stats.overdueCount > 0 {
            insights.append(LearningInsight(
                type: .warning,
                title: "有 \(stats.overdueCount) 道题已逾期",
                message: "建议尽快复习，避免遗忘"
            ))
        }

        // 掌握率提示
        if stats.masteryRate >= 0.8 {
            insights.append(LearningInsight(
                type: .success,
                title: "掌握率很棒！",
                message: "已掌握 \(Int(stats.masteryRate * 100))% 的错题"
            ))
        } else if stats.masteryRate < 0.3 && stats.totalCount > 10 {
            insights.append(LearningInsight(
                type: .info,
                title: "继续加油",
                message: "多复习可以提高掌握率"
            ))
        }

        // 薄弱学科
        let subjectStats = subjectData(from: items)
        if let weakest = subjectStats.first, weakest.count > 5 {
            insights.append(LearningInsight(
                type: .info,
                title: "\(weakest.subject.displayName) 错题最多",
                message: "共 \(weakest.count) 道题，建议重点复习"
            ))
        }

        return insights
    }
}

// MARK: - MasteryDistributionChart

/// 掌握度分布图表
struct MasteryDistributionChart: View {
    let data: [MasteryChartData]
    let isEmpty: Bool

    var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.lg) {
            Text("chart_mastery_distribution")
                .font(.headline)
                .accessibilityAddTraits(.isHeader)

            if isEmpty {
                EmptyChartPlaceholder()
            } else {
                Chart {
                    ForEach(data) { item in
                        SectorMark(
                            angle: .value("数量", item.count),
                            innerRadius: .ratio(0.6),
                            angularInset: 2
                        )
                        .foregroundStyle(item.color.gradient)
                        .cornerRadius(4)
                        .annotation(position: .overlay) {
                            VStack(spacing: 2) {
                                Text("\(item.count)")
                                    .font(.headline)
                                    .fontWeight(.bold)
                            }
                            .foregroundStyle(.white)
                        }
                    }
                }
                .frame(height: 200)
                .accessibilityLabel(chartAccessibilityLabel)

                // 图例
                HStack(spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.lg) {
                    ForEach(data) { item in
                        HStack(spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.sm) {
                            Circle()
                                .fill(item.color)
                                .frame(width: 12, height: 12)
                                .accessibilityHidden(true)
                            Text(item.label)
                                .font(.caption)
                        }
                        .accessibilityElement(children: .combine)
                        .accessibilityLabel("\(item.label)：\(item.count)题")
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        .padding(DesignTokens.Spacing.lg)
        .background(Color.semantic.secondaryBackground)
        .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: DesignTokens.CornerRadius.lg))
    }

    private var chartAccessibilityLabel: String {
        let descriptions = data.map { "\($0.label)\($0.count)题" }
        return "掌握度分布图：" + descriptions.joined(separator: "，")
    }
}

struct StatCard: View {

    let value: String
    let icon: String

    @State private var isAppeared = false

    var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.md) {

                    Circle()

                        .frame(width: 40, height: 40)

                    Image(systemName: icon)
                        .font(.system(size: 18, weight: .semibold))
                        .foregroundStyle(color)
                }
                .accessibilityHidden(true)

                Spacer()
            }

            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.xs) {
                Text(value)
                    .font(.system(size: 28, weight: .bold, design: .rounded))
                    .contentTransition(.numericText())

                Text(title)
                    .font(.caption)
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            }
        }
        .padding(DesignTokens.Spacing.lg)
        .background(Color.semantic.secondaryBackground)
        .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: DesignTokens.CornerRadius.lg))

        .opacity(isAppeared ? 1 : 0)

        .accessibilityLabel(title)
        .accessibilityValue(value)
        .onAppear {
            withAnimation(.spring(response: 0.4, dampingFraction: 0.7)) {
                isAppeared = true
            }
        }
    }

//
//  ExportFilterModel.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  导出筛选模型 - 基于东亚/中国学生实际使用场景设计
//
//  ## 设计理念
//
//  中国学生的错题导出场景分析：
//
//  1. **考前复习** - 最常见场景
//     - 期中/期末考试前，按科目导出未掌握的题目
//     - 月考前，导出本月积累的错题
//     - 重点突破难题或薄弱知识点
//
//  2. **周末巩固** - 高频场景
//     - 每周末导出本周错题，打印后练习
//     - 家长检查孩子学习情况
//
//  3. **专项训练** - 针对性学习
//     - 针对某一科目的专项突破
//     - 针对某类错误类型（计算失误、概念不清等）
//     - 按难度阶梯式练习
//
//  4. **学期总结** - 周期性场景
//     - 学期末整理错题本
//     - 寒暑假复习资料准备
//

import SwiftUI

// MARK: - Export Filter Configuration

/// 导出筛选配置
///
/// 综合考虑时间、学科、难度、掌握程度等多维度筛选条件
@Observable
final class ExportFilterConfig {
    
    // MARK: - 时间维度
    
    /// 时间范围类型
    var dateRangeType: ExportDateRangeType = .all
    
    /// 自定义开始日期
    var customStartDate: Date = Calendar.current.date(byAdding: .month, value: -1, to: Date()) ?? Date()
    
    /// 自定义结束日期
    var customEndDate: Date = Date()
    
    // MARK: - 学科维度
    
    /// 是否启用学科筛选
    var filterBySubject: Bool = false
    
    /// 选中的学科（多选）
    var selectedSubjects: Set<Subject> = []
    
    // MARK: - 难度维度
    
    /// 是否启用难度筛选
    var filterByDifficulty: Bool = false
    
    /// 最小难度（1-5）
    var minDifficulty: Int = 1
    
    /// 最大难度（1-5）
    var maxDifficulty: Int = 5
    
    // MARK: - 掌握程度维度（最重要！）
    
    /// 是否启用掌握程度筛选
    var filterByMastery: Bool = false
    
    /// 掌握程度筛选类型
    var masteryFilterType: MasteryFilterType = .notMastered
    
    // MARK: - 错误类型维度
    
    /// 是否启用错误类型筛选
    var filterByErrorType: Bool = false
    
    /// 选中的错误类型（多选）
    var selectedErrorTypes: Set<ErrorType> = []
    
    // MARK: - 来源维度
    
    /// 是否启用来源筛选
    var filterBySource: Bool = false
    
    /// 选中的来源（多选）
    var selectedSources: Set<Source> = []
    
    // MARK: - 快捷预设
    
    /// 应用预设配置
    func applyPreset(_ preset: ExportPreset) {
        // 重置所有筛选
        resetAll()
        
        switch preset {
        case .all:
            break // 默认全部
            
        case .thisWeekReview:
            // 本周复习：本周 + 未掌握
            dateRangeType = .thisWeek
            filterByMastery = true
            masteryFilterType = .notMastered
            
        case .examPrep:
            // 考前冲刺：未掌握 + 中高难度
            filterByMastery = true
            masteryFilterType = .notMastered
            filterByDifficulty = true
            minDifficulty = 3
            maxDifficulty = 5
            
        case .monthlyReview:
            // 月度复习：本月全部
            dateRangeType = .thisMonth
            
        case .weakPoints:
            // 薄弱点专项：掌握度<50%
            filterByMastery = true
            masteryFilterType = .veryWeak
            
        case .easyFirst:
            // 先易后难：低难度 + 未掌握
            filterByMastery = true
            masteryFilterType = .notMastered
            filterByDifficulty = true
            minDifficulty = 1
            maxDifficulty = 2
            
        case .hardChallenge:
            // 难题挑战：高难度
            filterByDifficulty = true
            minDifficulty = 4
            maxDifficulty = 5
        }
    }
    
    /// 重置所有筛选条件
    func resetAll() {
        dateRangeType = .all
        customStartDate = Calendar.current.date(byAdding: .month, value: -1, to: Date()) ?? Date()
        customEndDate = Date()
        filterBySubject = false
        selectedSubjects = []
        filterByDifficulty = false
        minDifficulty = 1
        maxDifficulty = 5
        filterByMastery = false
        masteryFilterType = .notMastered
        filterByErrorType = false
        selectedErrorTypes = []
        filterBySource = false
        selectedSources = []
    }
    
    // MARK: - 筛选逻辑
    
    /// 筛选错题
    func filter(_ items: [ReviewItem]) -> [ReviewItem] {
        items.filter { item in
            // 时间筛选
            if !passesDateFilter(item) { return false }
            
            // 学科筛选
            if filterBySubject && !selectedSubjects.isEmpty {
                if !selectedSubjects.contains(item.subject) { return false }
            }
            
            // 难度筛选
            if filterByDifficulty {
                let difficulty = item.difficulty.stars  // 1-5
                if difficulty < minDifficulty || difficulty > maxDifficulty { return false }
            }
            
            // 掌握程度筛选
            if filterByMastery {
                if !passesMasteryFilter(item) { return false }
            }
            
            // 错误类型筛选
            if filterByErrorType && !selectedErrorTypes.isEmpty {
                if !selectedErrorTypes.contains(item.errorType) { return false }
            }
            
            // 来源筛选
            if filterBySource && !selectedSources.isEmpty {
                if !selectedSources.contains(item.source) { return false }
            }
            
            return true
        }
    }
    
    /// 检查是否通过时间筛选
    private func passesDateFilter(_ item: ReviewItem) -> Bool {
        let (startDate, endDate) = dateRangeType.dateRange(
            customStart: customStartDate,
            customEnd: customEndDate
        )
        
        if let start = startDate, item.createdAt < start { return false }
        if let end = endDate, item.createdAt > end { return false }
        
        return true
    }
    
    /// 检查是否通过掌握程度筛选
    private func passesMasteryFilter(_ item: ReviewItem) -> Bool {
        let mastery = item.masteryLevel
        
        switch masteryFilterType {
        case .notMastered:
            return mastery < 80 // 未掌握：<80%
        case .veryWeak:
            return mastery < 50 // 非常薄弱：<50%
        case .needsReview:
            return mastery >= 50 && mastery < 80 // 需要复习：50-80%
        case .mastered:
            return mastery >= 80 // 已掌握：≥80%
        case .customRange(let min, let max):
            return mastery >= min && mastery <= max
        }
    }
    
    // MARK: - 描述
    
    /// 获取筛选条件的描述文本
    var filterDescription: String {
        var parts: [String] = []
        
        // 时间
        if dateRangeType != .all {
            parts.append(dateRangeType.shortDescription)
        }
        
        // 学科
        if filterBySubject && !selectedSubjects.isEmpty {
            if selectedSubjects.count <= 2 {
                parts.append(selectedSubjects.map { $0.displayName }.joined(separator: "、"))
            } else {
                parts.append("\(selectedSubjects.count)个学科")
            }
        }
        
        // 难度
        if filterByDifficulty {
            if minDifficulty == maxDifficulty {
                parts.append("\(minDifficulty)星难度")
            } else {
                parts.append("\(minDifficulty)-\(maxDifficulty)星")
            }
        }
        
        // 掌握程度
        if filterByMastery {
            parts.append(masteryFilterType.shortDescription)
        }
        
        // 错误类型
        if filterByErrorType && !selectedErrorTypes.isEmpty {
            if selectedErrorTypes.count == 1 {
                parts.append(selectedErrorTypes.first!.displayName)
            } else {
                parts.append("\(selectedErrorTypes.count)种错误类型")
            }
        }
        
        return parts.isEmpty ? "全部错题" : parts.joined(separator: " · ")
    }
    
    /// 是否有任何筛选条件
    var hasAnyFilter: Bool {
        dateRangeType != .all ||
        (filterBySubject && !selectedSubjects.isEmpty) ||
        filterByDifficulty ||
        filterByMastery ||
        (filterByErrorType && !selectedErrorTypes.isEmpty) ||
        (filterBySource && !selectedSources.isEmpty)
    }
}

// MARK: - Export Date Range Type

/// 导出时间范围类型
enum ExportDateRangeType: String, CaseIterable, Identifiable {
    case all = "all"
    case thisWeek = "this_week"
    case thisMonth = "this_month"
    case lastMonth = "last_month"
    case thisYear = "this_year"
    case custom = "custom"
    
    var id: String { rawValue }
    
    var displayName: LocalizedStringKey {
        switch self {
        case .all: return "export_range_all"
        case .thisWeek: return "export_range_this_week"
        case .thisMonth: return "export_range_this_month"
        case .lastMonth: return "export_range_last_month"
        case .thisYear: return "export_range_this_year"
        case .custom: return "export_range_custom"
        }
    }
    
    var shortDescription: String {
        switch self {
        case .all: return "全部"
        case .thisWeek: return "本周"
        case .thisMonth: return "本月"
        case .lastMonth: return "上月"
        case .thisYear: return "今年"
        case .custom: return "自定义"
        }
    }
    
    var icon: String {
        switch self {
        case .all: return "infinity"
        case .thisWeek: return "calendar.badge.clock"
        case .thisMonth: return "calendar"
        case .lastMonth: return "calendar.badge.minus"
        case .thisYear: return "calendar.circle"
        case .custom: return "calendar.badge.plus"
        }
    }
    
    /// 获取日期范围
    func dateRange(customStart: Date? = nil, customEnd: Date? = nil) -> (start: Date?, end: Date?) {
        let calendar = Calendar.current
        let now = Date()
        
        switch self {
        case .all:
            return (nil, nil)
        case .thisWeek:
            let start = calendar.dateInterval(of: .weekOfYear, for: now)?.start
            return (start, now)
        case .thisMonth:
            let start = calendar.dateInterval(of: .month, for: now)?.start
            return (start, now)
        case .lastMonth:
            guard let lastMonth = calendar.date(byAdding: .month, value: -1, to: now),
                  let interval = calendar.dateInterval(of: .month, for: lastMonth) else {
                return (nil, nil)
            }
            return (interval.start, interval.end)
        case .thisYear:
            let start = calendar.dateInterval(of: .year, for: now)?.start
            return (start, now)
        case .custom:
            return (customStart, customEnd)
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Mastery Filter Type

/// 掌握程度筛选类型
enum MasteryFilterType: Equatable, Hashable {
    case notMastered      // 未掌握 <80%
    case veryWeak         // 非常薄弱 <50%
    case needsReview      // 需要复习 50-80%
    case mastered         // 已掌握 ≥80%
    case customRange(min: Int, max: Int)  // 自定义范围
    
    var displayName: LocalizedStringKey {
        switch self {
        case .notMastered: return "export_mastery_not_mastered"
        case .veryWeak: return "export_mastery_very_weak"
        case .needsReview: return "export_mastery_needs_review"
        case .mastered: return "export_mastery_mastered"
        case .customRange: return "export_mastery_custom"
        }
    }
    
    var shortDescription: String {
        switch self {
        case .notMastered: return "未掌握"
        case .veryWeak: return "薄弱"
        case .needsReview: return "需复习"
        case .mastered: return "已掌握"
        case .customRange(let min, let max): return "\(min)-\(max)%"
        }
    }
    
    var description: LocalizedStringKey {
        switch self {
        case .notMastered: return "export_mastery_not_mastered_desc"
        case .veryWeak: return "export_mastery_very_weak_desc"
        case .needsReview: return "export_mastery_needs_review_desc"
        case .mastered: return "export_mastery_mastered_desc"
        case .customRange: return "export_mastery_custom_desc"
        }
    }
    
    var icon: String {
        switch self {
        case .notMastered: return "exclamationmark.triangle.fill"
        case .veryWeak: return "xmark.circle.fill"
        case .needsReview: return "arrow.clockwise.circle.fill"
        case .mastered: return "checkmark.circle.fill"
        case .customRange: return "slider.horizontal.3"
        }
    }
    
    var color: Color {
        switch self {
        case .notMastered: return .orange
        case .veryWeak: return .red
        case .needsReview: return .yellow
        case .mastered: return .green
        case .customRange: return .blue
        }
    }
    
    /// 预设选项（不包含自定义）
    static var presets: [MasteryFilterType] {
        [.notMastered, .veryWeak, .needsReview, .mastered]
    }
}

// MARK: - Export Preset

/// 导出预设配置
///
/// 基于中国学生常见使用场景设计的快捷预设
enum ExportPreset: String, CaseIterable, Identifiable {

    case thisWeekReview = "this_week_review"
    case examPrep = "exam_prep"
    case monthlyReview = "monthly_review"
    case weakPoints = "weak_points"
    case easyFirst = "easy_first"
    case hardChallenge = "hard_challenge"
    
    var id: String { rawValue }
    
    var displayName: LocalizedStringKey {
        switch self {
        case .all: return "export_preset_all"
        case .thisWeekReview: return "export_preset_this_week"
        case .examPrep: return "export_preset_exam_prep"
        case .monthlyReview: return "export_preset_monthly"
        case .weakPoints: return "export_preset_weak_points"
        case .easyFirst: return "export_preset_easy_first"
        case .hardChallenge: return "export_preset_hard_challenge"
        }
    }
    
    var description: LocalizedStringKey {
        switch self {
        case .all: return "export_preset_all_desc"
        case .thisWeekReview: return "export_preset_this_week_desc"
        case .examPrep: return "export_preset_exam_prep_desc"
        case .monthlyReview: return "export_preset_monthly_desc"
        case .weakPoints: return "export_preset_weak_points_desc"
        case .easyFirst: return "export_preset_easy_first_desc"
        case .hardChallenge: return "export_preset_hard_challenge_desc"
        }
    }
    
    var icon: String {
        switch self {
        case .all: return "tray.full.fill"
        case .thisWeekReview: return "calendar.badge.clock"
        case .examPrep: return "graduationcap.fill"
        case .monthlyReview: return "calendar"
        case .weakPoints: return "exclamationmark.triangle.fill"
        case .easyFirst: return "leaf.fill"
        case .hardChallenge: return "flame.fill"
        }
    }
    
    var color: Color {
        switch self {
        case .all: return .secondary
        case .thisWeekReview: return .blue
        case .examPrep: return .purple
        case .monthlyReview: return .green
        case .weakPoints: return .red
        case .easyFirst: return .mint
        case .hardChallenge: return .orange
        }
    }
}

//
//  DataManagementView+Import.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  数据管理 - 导入功能
//

import SwiftUI
import SwiftData

// MARK: - Import Methods

extension DataManagementView {

    /// 处理文件导入
    func handleImport(_ result: Result<[URL], Error>) {
        switch result {
        case .success(let urls):
            guard let url = urls.first else { return }
            Task {
                await importData(from: url)
            }

        case .failure(let error):
            showToast("导入失败: \(error.localizedDescription)", isError: true)
        }
    }

    /// 从 URL 导入数据
    func importData(from url: URL) async {
        guard url.startAccessingSecurityScopedResource() else {
            await MainActor.run {
                showToast("无法访问文件", isError: true)
            }
            return
        }

        defer {
            url.stopAccessingSecurityScopedResource()
        }

        do {
            let data = try Data(contentsOf: url)

            // 尝试解析 JSON
            if let items = try? JSONSerialization.jsonObject(with: data) as? [[String: Any]] {
                await importItems(items, imagesDir: nil)
            } else {
                await MainActor.run {
                    showToast("文件格式不支持", isError: true)
                }
            }
        } catch {
            await MainActor.run {
                showToast("导入失败: \(error.localizedDescription)", isError: true)
            }
        }
    }

    /// 导入错题数据
    func importItems(_ items: [[String: Any]], imagesDir: URL?) async {
        var importedCount = 0

        for itemDict in items {
            guard let title = itemDict["title"] as? String else { continue }

            let item = ReviewItem(
                imageData: nil,
                title: title,
                note: itemDict["note"] as? String ?? "",
                subject: Subject(rawValue: itemDict["subject"] as? String ?? "") ?? .other,
                grade: Grade(rawValue: itemDict["grade"] as? String ?? "") ?? .grade10,
                knowledgePoints: KnowledgePoints(from: itemDict["knowledgePoints"] as? String ?? "")
            )

            // 设置其他属性
            if let difficultyRaw = itemDict["difficulty"] as? Int {
                item.difficulty = Difficulty(rawValue: difficultyRaw) ?? .medium
            }
            if let sourceRaw = itemDict["source"] as? String {
                item.source = Source(rawValue: sourceRaw) ?? .other
            }
            if let questionTypeRaw = itemDict["questionType"] as? String {
                item.questionType = ReviewItemType(rawValue: questionTypeRaw) ?? .other
            }
            if let masteryLevel = itemDict["masteryLevel"] as? Int {
                item.masteryLevel = masteryLevel
            }
            if let reviewCount = itemDict["reviewCount"] as? Int {
                item.reviewCount = reviewCount
            }

            // 导入图片
            if let imageName = itemDict["imageName"] as? String,
               let imagesDir = imagesDir {
                let imageURL = imagesDir.appendingPathComponent(imageName)
                if let imageData = try? Data(contentsOf: imageURL) {
                    item.imageData = imageData
                }
            }

            await MainActor.run {
                modelContext.insert(item)
            }
            importedCount += 1
        }

        await MainActor.run {
            do {
                try modelContext.save()
                showToast("成功导入 \(importedCount) 道错题", isError: false)
            } catch {
                showToast("保存失败", isError: true)
            }
        }
    }

    /// 删除所有数据
    func deleteAllData() {
        for item in allItems {
            modelContext.delete(item)
        }

        do {
            try modelContext.save()
            showToast("数据已清空", isError: false)
        } catch {
            showToast("清空失败", isError: true)
        }
    }

    // MARK: - Toast Helper

    func showToast(_ message: String, isError: Bool) {
        toastMessage = message
        showSuccessToast = true
        Task { @MainActor in
            try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(2))
            showSuccessToast = false
        }
    }
}

//
//  SubjectSettingsView.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  学科偏好设置视图
//

import SwiftUI

// MARK: - SubjectSettingsView

/// 学科偏好设置视图
///
/// 允许用户选择在题库筛选栏中显示哪些学科。
struct SubjectSettingsView: View {
    
    // MARK: - Properties
    
    @StateObject private var profileManager = UserProfileManager.shared
    @Environment(\.dismiss) private var dismiss
    @State private var showingAddCustomSubject = false
    @State private var editingCustomSubject: CustomSubject?
    
    // MARK: - Body
    
    var body: some View {
        NavigationStack {
            List {
                // 说明
                Section {
                    Text("subject_settings_description")
                        .font(.subheadline)
                        .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                }
                
                // 按分类显示预设学科
                ForEach(SubjectCategory.allCases) { category in
                    let subjectsInCategory = Subject.allCases.filter { $0.category == category }
                    
                    if !subjectsInCategory.isEmpty {
                        Section(category.displayName) {
                            ForEach(subjectsInCategory) { subject in
                                SubjectToggleRow(
                                    subject: subject,
                                    isEnabled: profileManager.isSubjectEnabled(subject),
                                    canDisable: profileManager.enabledSubjects.count > 1 || !profileManager.isSubjectEnabled(subject)
                                ) {
                                    withAnimation(.spring(response: 0.3)) {
                                        profileManager.toggleSubject(subject)
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                
                // 自定义学科
                Section {
                    ForEach(profileManager.customSubjects) { customSubject in
                        CustomSubjectToggleRow(
                            customSubject: customSubject,
                            isEnabled: profileManager.isCustomSubjectEnabled(customSubject)
                        ) {
                            withAnimation(.spring(response: 0.3)) {
                                profileManager.toggleCustomSubject(customSubject)
                            }
                        }
                        .swipeActions(edge: .trailing, allowsFullSwipe: false) {
                            Button(role: .destructive) {
                                withAnimation {
                                    profileManager.deleteCustomSubject(id: customSubject.id)
                                }
                            } label: {
                                Label("common_delete", systemImage: "trash")
                            }
                            
                            Button {
                                editingCustomSubject = customSubject
                            } label: {
                                Label("common_edit", systemImage: "pencil")
                            }
                            .tint(.orange)
                        }
                    }
                    .onMove { source, destination in
                        var subjects = profileManager.customSubjects
                        subjects.move(fromOffsets: source, toOffset: destination)
                        profileManager.reorderCustomSubjects(subjects)
                    }
                    
                    // 添加自定义学科按钮
                    Button {
                        showingAddCustomSubject = true
                    } label: {
                        Label("custom_subject_add", systemImage: "plus.circle")
                            .foregroundStyle(Color.brand.primary)
                    }
                } header: {
                    Text("custom_subject_section_title")
                } footer: {
                    Text("custom_subject_section_footer")
                        .font(.caption)
                }
                
                // 快捷操作
                Section {
                    Button {
                        withAnimation {
                            profileManager.resetToDefaultSubjects()
                        }
                    } label: {
                        Label("subject_settings_reset", systemImage: "arrow.counterclockwise")
                    }
                    
                    Button {
                        withAnimation {
                            profileManager.enabledSubjects = Set(Subject.allCases)
                        }
                    } label: {
                        Label("subject_settings_enable_all", systemImage: "checkmark.circle")
                    }
                }
            }
            .navigationTitle("subject_settings_title")
            .navigationBarTitleDisplayMode(.inline)
            .toolbar {
                ToolbarItem(placement: .confirmationAction) {
                    Button("common_done") {
                        dismiss()
                    }
                }
            }
            .sheet(isPresented: $showingAddCustomSubject) {
                CustomSubjectEditorView(mode: .add)
            }
            .sheet(item: $editingCustomSubject) { subject in
                CustomSubjectEditorView(mode: .edit(subject))
            }
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - SubjectToggleRow

/// 学科开关行
private struct SubjectToggleRow: View {
    let subject: Subject
    let isEnabled: Bool
    let canDisable: Bool
    let action: () -> Void
    
    var body: some View {
        Button(action: action) {
            HStack {
                // 学科图标和名称
                Label {
                    Text(subject.displayName)
                        .foregroundStyle(.primary)
                } icon: {
                    Image(systemName: subject.icon)
                        .foregroundStyle(subject.color)
                }
                
                Spacer()
                
                // 选中状态
                if isEnabled {
                    Image(systemName: "checkmark.circle.fill")
                        .foregroundStyle(Color.brand.primary)
                        .imageScale(.large)
                } else {
                    Image(systemName: "circle")
                        .foregroundStyle(.tertiary)
                        .imageScale(.large)
                }
            }
            .contentShape(Rectangle())
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
        .opacity(canDisable ? 1 : 0.5)
        .disabled(!canDisable && isEnabled)
    }
}

// MARK: - CustomSubjectToggleRow

/// 自定义学科开关行
private struct CustomSubjectToggleRow: View {
    let customSubject: CustomSubject
    let isEnabled: Bool
    let action: () -> Void
    
    var body: some View {
        Button(action: action) {
            HStack {
                // 学科图标和名称
                Label {
                    Text(customSubject.name)
                        .foregroundStyle(.primary)
                } icon: {
                    Image(systemName: customSubject.icon)
                        .foregroundStyle(customSubject.color)
                }
                
                Spacer()
                
                // 选中状态
                if isEnabled {
                    Image(systemName: "checkmark.circle.fill")
                        .foregroundStyle(Color.brand.primary)
                        .imageScale(.large)
                } else {
                    Image(systemName: "circle")
                        .foregroundStyle(.tertiary)
                        .imageScale(.large)
                }
            }
            .contentShape(Rectangle())
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
    }
}

//
//  ProfileEditView.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  个人资料编辑视图
