import SwiftUI

// MARK: - ProfileEditView

/// 个人资料编辑视图
///
/// 允许用户自定义昵称和头像。
struct ProfileEditView: View {
    
    // MARK: - Environment
    
    @Environment(\.dismiss) private var dismiss
    
    // MARK: - State
    
    @State private var nickname: String = ""
    @State private var selectedAvatar: String = "person.fill"
    
    // MARK: - Constants
    
    /// 可选的头像图标
    private let avatarOptions: [String] = [
        "person.fill",
        "face.smiling.fill",
        "star.fill",
        "heart.fill",
        "book.fill",
        "graduationcap.fill",
        "pencil.and.ruler.fill",
        "lightbulb.fill",
        "brain.fill",
        "trophy.fill",
        "medal.fill",
        "flag.fill"
    ]
    
    /// 头像背景渐变色选项
    private let gradientOptions: [[Color]] = [
        [Color.brand.primary, Color.brand.secondary],
        [.purple, .pink],
        [.orange, .red],
        [.green, .mint],
        [.blue, .cyan],
        [.indigo, .purple]
    ]
    
    @State private var selectedGradientIndex: Int = 0
    
    // MARK: - Body
    
    var body: some View {
        NavigationStack {
            Form {
                avatarSection
                nicknameSection
                gradientSection
            }
            .navigationTitle("profile_edit_title")
            .navigationBarTitleDisplayMode(.inline)
            .toolbar {
                ToolbarItem(placement: .cancellationAction) {
                    Button("common_cancel") {
                        dismiss()
                    }
                }
                ToolbarItem(placement: .confirmationAction) {
                    Button("common_save") {
                        saveProfile()
                        dismiss()
                    }
                    .fontWeight(.semibold)
                }
            }
            .onAppear {
                loadProfile()
            }
        }
    }
    
    // MARK: - Avatar Section
    
    private var avatarSection: some View {
        Section {
            VStack(spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.lg) {
                // 当前头像预览
                ZStack {
                    Circle()
                        .fill(
                            LinearGradient(
                                colors: gradientOptions[selectedGradientIndex],
                                startPoint: .topLeading,
                                endPoint: .bottomTrailing
                            )
                        )
                        .frame(width: 100, height: 100)
                        .shadow(color: gradientOptions[selectedGradientIndex][0].opacity(0.3), radius: 10, x: 0, y: 5)
                    
                    Image(systemName: selectedAvatar)
                        .font(.system(size: 44, weight: .medium))
                        .foregroundStyle(.white)
                }
                .padding(.vertical, DesignTokens.Spacing.md)
                
                // 头像选择网格
                LazyVGrid(columns: Array(repeating: GridItem(.flexible()), count: 6), spacing: 12) {
                    ForEach(avatarOptions, id: \.self) { avatar in
                        Button {
                            withAnimation(.spring(response: 0.3)) {
                                selectedAvatar = avatar
                            }
                        } label: {
                            ZStack {
                                Circle()
                                    .fill(selectedAvatar == avatar ? Color.brand.primary.opacity(0.15) : Color.clear)
                                    .frame(width: 44, height: 44)
                                
                                Image(systemName: avatar)
                                    .font(.system(size: 22))
                                    .foregroundStyle(selectedAvatar == avatar ? Color.brand.primary : .secondary)
                            }
                        }
                        .buttonStyle(.plain)
                    }
                }
            }
            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
        } header: {
            Text("profile_edit_avatar")
        }
    }
    
    // MARK: - Nickname Section
    
    private var nicknameSection: some View {
        Section {
            TextField("profile_edit_nickname_placeholder", text: $nickname)
                .textContentType(.nickname)
                .autocorrectionDisabled()
        } header: {
            Text("profile_edit_nickname")
        } footer: {
            Text("profile_edit_nickname_hint")
        }
    }
    
    // MARK: - Gradient Section
    
    private var gradientSection: some View {
        Section {
            HStack(spacing: 12) {
                ForEach(0..<gradientOptions.count, id: \.self) { index in
                    Button {
                        withAnimation(.spring(response: 0.3)) {
                            selectedGradientIndex = index
                        }
                    } label: {
                        Circle()
                            .fill(
                                LinearGradient(
                                    colors: gradientOptions[index],
                                    startPoint: .topLeading,
                                    endPoint: .bottomTrailing
                                )
                            )
                            .frame(width: 36, height: 36)
                            .overlay {
                                if selectedGradientIndex == index {
                                    Circle()
                                        .strokeBorder(.white, lineWidth: 3)
                                }
                            }
                            .shadow(color: gradientOptions[index][0].opacity(0.3), radius: 4, x: 0, y: 2)
                    }
                    .buttonStyle(.plain)
                }
                Spacer()
            }
            .padding(.vertical, DesignTokens.Spacing.sm)
        } header: {
            Text("profile_edit_color")
        }
    }
    
    // MARK: - Methods
    
    private func loadProfile() {
        nickname = UserProfileManager.shared.nickname
        selectedAvatar = UserProfileManager.shared.avatar
        selectedGradientIndex = UserProfileManager.shared.gradientIndex
    }
    
    private func saveProfile() {
        UserProfileManager.shared.nickname = nickname.isEmpty ? String(localized: "profile_nickname") : nickname
        UserProfileManager.shared.avatar = selectedAvatar
        UserProfileManager.shared.gradientIndex = selectedGradientIndex
    }
}

// MARK: - Preview

#Preview {
    ProfileEditView()
}

import SwiftUI

// MARK: - HelpCenterView

/// 帮助中心视图
///
/// 提供使用指南和常见问题解答。
struct HelpCenterView: View {

    // MARK: - State

    @State private var expandedSection: HelpSection?
    @State private var searchText = ""

    // MARK: - Body

    var body: some View {
        List {
            quickStartSection
            faqSection
            contactSection
        }
        .navigationTitle("帮助中心")
        #if os(iOS)
        .navigationBarTitleDisplayMode(.large)
        .searchable(text: $searchText, placement: .navigationBarDrawer(displayMode: .always), prompt: "搜索问题")
        #else
        .searchable(text: $searchText, prompt: "搜索问题")
        #endif
    }

    // MARK: - Quick Start Section

    private var quickStartSection: some View {
        Section("快速入门") {
            ForEach(QuickStartItem.allCases) { item in
                DisclosureGroup {
                    Text(item.content)
                        .font(.subheadline)
                        .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                        .padding(.vertical, DesignTokens.Spacing.sm)
                } label: {
                    Label(item.title, systemImage: item.icon)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // MARK: - FAQ Section

    private var faqSection: some View {
        Section("常见问题") {
            ForEach(filteredFAQs) { faq in
                DisclosureGroup {
                    Text(faq.answer)
                        .font(.subheadline)
                        .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                        .padding(.vertical, DesignTokens.Spacing.sm)
                } label: {
                    Text(faq.question)
                        .font(.body)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // MARK: - Contact Section

    private var contactSection: some View {
        Section {
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.md) {
                Text("help_other_questions")
                    .font(.headline)

                Text("help_contact_description")
                    .font(.subheadline)
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)

                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.sm) {
                    contactRow(icon: "envelope.fill", text: "feedback@notbad.app", color: Color.brand.primary)
                    contactRow(icon: "globe", text: "notbad.app/help", color: Color.brand.secondary)
                }
            }
            .padding(.vertical, DesignTokens.Spacing.sm)
        }
    }

    private func contactRow(icon: String, text: String, color: Color) -> some View {
        HStack(spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.sm) {
            Image(systemName: icon)
                .foregroundStyle(color)
            Text(text)
                .font(.subheadline)
                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
        }
    }

    // MARK: - Computed Properties

    private var filteredFAQs: [FAQ] {
        if searchText.isEmpty {
            return FAQ.allCases
        }
        return FAQ.allCases.filter { faq in
            faq.question.localizedCaseInsensitiveContains(searchText) ||
            faq.answer.localizedCaseInsensitiveContains(searchText)
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - HelpSection

    case faq

//
//  NotificationSettingsView.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  Created for NotBad K12 错题本
//

import SwiftUI
import UserNotifications

// MARK: - NotificationSettingsView

/// 复习提醒设置视图
///
/// 管理每日复习提醒通知。
struct NotificationSettingsView: View {

    // MARK: - State

    @AppStorage("reminderEnabled") private var reminderEnabled = false
    @AppStorage("reminderHour") private var reminderHour = 20
    @AppStorage("reminderMinute") private var reminderMinute = 0
    @State private var showTimePicker = false
    @State private var notificationStatus: UNAuthorizationStatus = .notDetermined
    @State private var showPermissionAlert = false

    // MARK: - Body

    var body: some View {
        List {
            reminderSection
            timeSection
            tipsSection
        }
        .navigationTitle("复习提醒")
        .navigationBarTitleDisplayMode(.inline)
        .task {
            await checkNotificationStatus()
        }
        .alert("notification_permission_required", isPresented: $showPermissionAlert) {
            Button("common_cancel", role: .cancel) {
                reminderEnabled = false
            }
            Button("notification_go_settings") {
                if let url = URL(string: UIApplication.openSettingsURLString) {
                    UIApplication.shared.open(url)
                }
            }
        } message: {
            Text("notification_permission_message")
        }
    }

    // MARK: - Reminder Section

    private var reminderSection: some View {
        Section {
            Toggle(isOn: $reminderEnabled) {
                Label {
                    VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.xs) {
                        Text("notification_daily_reminder")
                        Text("notification_reminder_description")
                            .font(.caption)
                            .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                    }
                } icon: {
                    Image(systemName: "bell.fill")
                        .foregroundStyle(Color.brand.warning)
                }
            }
            .onChange(of: reminderEnabled) { _, newValue in
                if newValue {
                    Task {
                        await handleEnableReminder()
                    }
                } else {
                    cancelReminder()
                }
            }
        } footer: {
            if notificationStatus == .denied {
                Text("notification_permission_denied")
                    .foregroundStyle(Color.brand.error)
            }
        }
    }

    // MARK: - Time Section

    private var timeSection: some View {
        Section("notification_reminder_time") {
            Button {
                showTimePicker.toggle()
            } label: {
                HStack {
                    Label("notification_time", systemImage: "clock.fill")
                        .foregroundStyle(.primary)
                    Spacer()
                    Text(formattedTime)
                        .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                    Image(systemName: "chevron.right")
                        .font(.caption)
                        .foregroundStyle(.tertiary)
                }
            }
            .disabled(!reminderEnabled)
            .opacity(reminderEnabled ? 1 : 0.5)

            if showTimePicker {
                DatePicker(
                    "notification_select_time",
                    selection: timeBinding,
                    displayedComponents: .hourAndMinute
                )
                .datePickerStyle(.wheel)
                .labelsHidden()
                .onChange(of: reminderHour) { _, _ in
                    scheduleReminder()
                }
                .onChange(of: reminderMinute) { _, _ in
                    scheduleReminder()
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // MARK: - Tips Section

    private var tipsSection: some View {
        Section {
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.md) {
                Label("小贴士", systemImage: "lightbulb.fill")
                    .font(.headline)
                    .foregroundStyle(Color.brand.warning)

                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.sm) {
                    tipRow("建议在晚上 8-9 点复习，记忆效果更好")
                    tipRow("每天坚持复习 10-15 分钟即可")
                    tipRow("及时复习能有效防止遗忘")
                }
            }
            .padding(.vertical, DesignTokens.Spacing.sm)
        }
    }

    private func tipRow(_ text: String) -> some View {
        HStack(alignment: .top, spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.sm) {
            Image(systemName: "checkmark.circle.fill")
                .foregroundStyle(Color.brand.success)
                .font(.caption)
            Text(text)
                .font(.subheadline)
                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
        }
    }

    // MARK: - Computed Properties

    private var formattedTime: String {
        String(format: "%02d:%02d", reminderHour, reminderMinute)
    }

    private var timeBinding: Binding<Date> {
        Binding(
            get: {
                var components = DateComponents()
                components.hour = reminderHour
                components.minute = reminderMinute
                return Calendar.current.date(from: components) ?? Date()
            },
            set: { newDate in
                let components = Calendar.current.dateComponents([.hour, .minute], from: newDate)
                reminderHour = components.hour ?? 20
                reminderMinute = components.minute ?? 0
            }
        )
    }

    // MARK: - Methods

    private func checkNotificationStatus() async {
        let settings = await UNUserNotificationCenter.current().notificationSettings()
        await MainActor.run {
            notificationStatus = settings.authorizationStatus
        }
    }

    private func handleEnableReminder() async {
        let center = UNUserNotificationCenter.current()

        do {
            let granted = try await center.requestAuthorization(options: [.alert, .sound, .badge])
            await MainActor.run {
                if granted {
                    notificationStatus = .authorized
                    scheduleReminder()
                } else {
                    notificationStatus = .denied
                    reminderEnabled = false
                    showPermissionAlert = true
                }
            }
        } catch {
            await MainActor.run {
                reminderEnabled = false
            }
        }
    }

    private func scheduleReminder() {
        guard reminderEnabled else { return }

        let center = UNUserNotificationCenter.current()

        // 取消现有提醒
        center.removePendingNotificationRequests(withIdentifiers: ["dailyReviewReminder"])

        // 创建新提醒
        let content = UNMutableNotificationContent()
        content.title = "📚 复习时间到！"
        content.body = "花几分钟复习一下错题，巩固今天的知识吧！"
        content.sound = .default
        content.badge = 1

        var dateComponents = DateComponents()
        dateComponents.hour = reminderHour
        dateComponents.minute = reminderMinute

        let trigger = UNCalendarNotificationTrigger(dateMatching: dateComponents, repeats: true)
        let request = UNNotificationRequest(identifier: "dailyReviewReminder", content: content, trigger: trigger)

        center.add(request)
    }

    private func cancelReminder() {
        UNUserNotificationCenter.current().removePendingNotificationRequests(withIdentifiers: ["dailyReviewReminder"])
    }
}

// MARK: - Preview

#Preview {
    NavigationStack {
        NotificationSettingsView()
    }
}

//
//  DataManagementView.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  数据管理视图 - 主文件
//

import SwiftUI
import SwiftData
import UniformTypeIdentifiers

// MARK: - DataManagementView

/// 数据管理视图
///
/// 提供数据导出、导入和清理功能。
///
/// ## 文件结构
///
/// - `DataManagementView.swift` - 主视图和 UI 部分
/// - `DataManagementView+Export.swift` - 导出相关方法
/// - `DataManagementView+Import.swift` - 导入相关方法
struct DataManagementView: View {

    // MARK: - Environment

    @Environment(\.modelContext) var modelContext
    @Query var allItems: [ReviewItem]

    // MARK: - State

    @State var showExportSheet = false
    @State var showDeleteAlert = false
    @State var showSuccessToast = false
    @State var toastMessage = ""
    @State var exportedFileURL: URL?
    @State var isExporting = false
    @State var exportProgress: Double = 0
    @State var showImportPicker = false
    
    // 导出筛选状态
    @State var showExportFilterSheet = false
    @State var pendingExportType: ExportType?
    @State var exportFilterConfig = ExportFilterConfig()
    
    // 最近导出缓存
    @State private var cachedFiles: [CachedExportFile] = []
    @State private var showClearCacheAlert = false

    // MARK: - Body

    var body: some View {
        List {
            storageSection
            recentExportsSection
            exportSection
            importSection
            dangerZoneSection
        }
        .navigationTitle("data_management_title")
        .navigationBarTitleDisplayMode(.inline)
        .onAppear {
            refreshCachedFiles()
        }
        .sheet(isPresented: $showExportSheet) {
            if let url = exportedFileURL {
                ShareSheet(activityItems: [url])
            }
        }
        .fileImporter(
            isPresented: $showImportPicker,
            allowedContentTypes: [.json, .zip],
            allowsMultipleSelection: false
        ) { result in
            handleImport(result)
        }
        .sheet(isPresented: $showExportFilterSheet) {
            ExportFilterView(
                exportType: pendingExportType ?? .pdf,
                config: exportFilterConfig,
                allItems: allItems,
                onExport: { performFilteredExport() },
                onCancel: { showExportFilterSheet = false }
            )
        }
        .alert("data_confirm_delete_all", isPresented: $showDeleteAlert) {
            Button("common_cancel", role: .cancel) { }
            Button("data_clear", role: .destructive) {
                deleteAllData()
            }
        } message: {
            Text("data_delete_warning")
        }
        .overlay {
            if showSuccessToast {
                toastOverlay
            }
        }
    }

    // MARK: - Toast Overlay

    private var toastOverlay: some View {
        VStack {
            Spacer()
            ToastView(toast: Toast(type: toastMessage.contains("失败") ? .error : .success, message: toastMessage))
                .padding(.bottom, DesignTokens.Spacing.xl)
        }
        .transition(.move(edge: .bottom).combined(with: .opacity))
        .animation(.spring(), value: showSuccessToast)
    }

    // MARK: - Computed Properties

    var imageCount: Int {
        allItems.filter { $0.imageData != nil }.count
    }

    var estimatedSize: String {
        let textSize = allItems.reduce(0) { total, item in
            total + item.title.utf8.count + item.note.utf8.count
        }
        let imageSize = allItems.reduce(0) { $0 + ($1.imageData?.count ?? 0) }
        let totalBytes = textSize + imageSize

        return ByteCountFormatter.string(fromByteCount: Int64(totalBytes), countStyle: .file)
    }
    
    /// 刷新缓存文件列表
    func refreshCachedFiles() {
        cachedFiles = ExportCacheManager.shared.getCachedFiles()
    }
}

// MARK: - Sections

extension DataManagementView {

    /// 存储信息部分
    var storageSection: some View {
        Section("data_section_storage") {
            HStack {
                Label("data_item_count", systemImage: "doc.text.fill")

                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            }

            HStack {
                Label("data_image_count", systemImage: "photo.fill")
                Spacer()
                Text(String(format: String(localized: "data_images_unit"), imageCount))
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            }

            HStack {
                Label("data_estimated_size", systemImage: "externaldrive.fill")
                Spacer()
                Text(estimatedSize)
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            }
        }
    }
    
    /// 最近导出部分
    @ViewBuilder
    var recentExportsSection: some View {
        if !cachedFiles.isEmpty {
            Section {
                ForEach(cachedFiles) { file in
                    Button {
                        exportedFileURL = file.url
                        showExportSheet = true
                    } label: {
                        HStack(spacing: 12) {
                            // 文件类型图标
                            Image(systemName: file.icon)
                                .font(.title2)
                                .foregroundStyle(fileColor(for: file))
                                .frame(width: 32)
                            
                            // 文件信息
                            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 2) {
                                Text(file.fileName)
                                    .font(.subheadline)
                                    .foregroundStyle(.primary)
                                    .lineLimit(1)
                                
                                HStack(spacing: 8) {
                                    Text(file.formattedSize)
                                    Text("•")
                                    Text(file.formattedDate)
                                }
                                .font(.caption)
                                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                            }
                            
                            Spacer()
                            
                            // 分享图标
                            Image(systemName: "square.and.arrow.up")
                                .font(.subheadline)
                                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                        }
                    }
                    .swipeActions(edge: .trailing, allowsFullSwipe: true) {
                        Button(role: .destructive) {
                            withAnimation {
                                ExportCacheManager.shared.deleteFile(file)
                                refreshCachedFiles()
                            }
                        } label: {
                            Label("common_delete", systemImage: "trash")
                        }
                    }
                }
                
                // 清除所有缓存
                if cachedFiles.count > 1 {
                    Button(role: .destructive) {
                        showClearCacheAlert = true
                    } label: {
                        Label("export_clear_cache", systemImage: "trash")
                    }
                    .alert("export_clear_cache_confirm", isPresented: $showClearCacheAlert) {
                        Button("common_cancel", role: .cancel) { }
                        Button("common_delete", role: .destructive) {
                            withAnimation {
                                ExportCacheManager.shared.deleteAllFiles()
                                refreshCachedFiles()
                            }
                        }
                    } message: {
                        Text("export_clear_cache_message")
                    }
                }
            } header: {
                Text("export_recent_files")
            } footer: {
                Text("export_recent_files_footer")
            }
        }
    }
    
    /// 根据文件类型获取颜色
    private func fileColor(for file: CachedExportFile) -> Color {
        switch file.color {
        case "primary": return Color.brand.primary
        case "success": return Color.brand.success
        case "warning": return Color.brand.warning
        default: return .secondary
        }
    }

    var exportSection: some View {

                    badge: "export_filterable"
                )
            }
            .disabled(allItems.isEmpty || isExporting)
            
            // CSV 导出（推荐给普通用户）- 支持筛选
            Button {
                pendingExportType = .csv
                showExportFilterSheet = true
            } label: {

                )
            }
            .disabled(allItems.isEmpty || isExporting)

            // JSON 导出（给技术用户）

            } label: {

                    title: "data_export_json",
                    description: "data_export_json_description",
                    icon: "curlybraces",
                    color: .secondary
                )
            }
            .disabled(allItems.isEmpty || isExporting)
            .disabled(allItems.isEmpty || isExporting)
        }

    /// 导入部分
    var importSection: some View {

private struct ExportRowLabel: View {

    var badge: LocalizedStringKey? = nil

    var body: some View {

                            .font(.caption2)
                            .fontWeight(.medium)
                            .padding(.horizontal, 6)
                            .padding(.vertical, 2)
                            .background(Color.brand.primary.opacity(0.15))
                            .foregroundStyle(Color.brand.primary)
                            .clipShape(Capsule())
                    }
                    if isLoading {
                        ProgressView()
                            .scaleEffect(0.8)
                    }
                }
                Text(description)
                    .font(.caption)
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            }
        } icon: {
            Image(systemName: icon)
                .foregroundStyle(color)
        }
    }

import SwiftUI

// MARK: - AppearanceSettingsView

/// 外观设置视图
///
/// 管理应用主题和显示设置。
struct AppearanceSettingsView: View {

    // MARK: - State

    @AppStorage("colorScheme") private var colorScheme = "system"
    @AppStorage("useDynamicType") private var useDynamicType = true
    @AppStorage("reduceMotion") private var reduceMotion = false

    // MARK: - Body

    var body: some View {
        List {
            themeSection
            displaySection
            accessibilitySection
        }
        .navigationTitle("外观设置")
        .navigationBarTitleDisplayMode(.inline)
    }

    // MARK: - Theme Section

    private var themeSection: some View {
        Section("主题") {
            ForEach(ColorSchemeOption.allCases) { option in
                Button {
                    withAnimation(.easeInOut(duration: 0.2)) {
                        colorScheme = option.rawValue
                    }
                } label: {
                    HStack {
                        Label(option.displayName, systemImage: option.icon)
                            .foregroundStyle(.primary)
                        Spacer()
                        if colorScheme == option.rawValue {
                            Image(systemName: "checkmark")
                                .foregroundStyle(Color.brand.primary)
                                .fontWeight(.semibold)
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // MARK: - Display Section

    private var displaySection: some View {
        Section {
            Toggle(isOn: $useDynamicType) {
                Label {
                    VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.xs) {
                        Text("appearance_dynamic_font")
                        Text("appearance_dynamic_font_description")
                            .font(.caption)
                            .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                    }
                } icon: {
                    Image(systemName: "textformat.size")
                        .foregroundStyle(Color.brand.primary)
                }
            }
        } header: {
            Text("appearance_section_display")
        } footer: {
            Text("appearance_display_footer")
        }
    }

    // MARK: - Accessibility Section

    private var accessibilitySection: some View {
        Section {
            Toggle(isOn: $reduceMotion) {
                Label {
                    VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.xs) {
                        Text("appearance_reduce_motion")
                        Text("appearance_reduce_motion_description")
                            .font(.caption)
                            .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                    }
                } icon: {
                    Image(systemName: "figure.walk.motion")
                        .foregroundStyle(Color.brand.secondary)
                }
            }
        } header: {
            Text("appearance_section_accessibility")
        } footer: {
            Text("appearance_accessibility_footer")
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - ColorSchemeOption

enum ColorSchemeOption: String, CaseIterable, Identifiable {
    case system
    case light
    case dark

    var id: String { rawValue }

    var displayName: String {
        switch self {
        case .system: return "跟随系统"
        case .light: return "浅色模式"
        case .dark: return "深色模式"
        }
    }

    var icon: String {
        switch self {
        case .system: return "gear"
        case .light: return "sun.max.fill"
        case .dark: return "moon.fill"
        }
    }

    var colorScheme: ColorScheme? {
        switch self {
        case .system: return nil
        case .light: return .light
        case .dark: return .dark
        }
    }
}

//
//  FeedbackView.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  Created for NotBad K12 错题本
//

import SwiftUI
import MessageUI

// MARK: - FeedbackView

/// 意见反馈视图
///
/// 收集用户反馈和建议。
struct FeedbackView: View {

    // MARK: - State

    @State private var feedbackType: FeedbackType = .suggestion
    @State private var feedbackContent = ""
    @State private var contactInfo = ""
    @State private var showMailComposer = false
    @State private var showSuccessAlert = false
    @State private var showCopiedToast = false
    @FocusState private var isFocused: Bool

    // MARK: - Body

    var body: some View {
        List {
            typeSection
            contentSection
            contactSection
            submitSection
        }
        .navigationTitle("意见反馈")
        .navigationBarTitleDisplayMode(.inline)
        .toolbar {
            ToolbarItemGroup(placement: .keyboard) {
                Spacer()
                Button("完成") {
                    isFocused = false
                }
            }
        }
        .sheet(isPresented: $showMailComposer) {
            MailComposerView(
                subject: feedbackSubject,
                body: feedbackBody,
                recipients: ["feedback@notbad.app"]
            )
        }
        .alert("feedback_thank_you", isPresented: $showSuccessAlert) {
            Button("common_ok") { }
        } message: {
            Text("feedback_received_message")
        }
        .overlay {
            if showCopiedToast {
                VStack {
                    Spacer()
                    ToastView(toast: Toast.success("已复制到剪贴板"))
                        .padding(.bottom, DesignTokens.Spacing.xl)
                }
                .transition(.move(edge: .bottom).combined(with: .opacity))
                .animation(.spring(), value: showCopiedToast)
            }
        }
    }

    // MARK: - Type Section

    private var typeSection: some View {
        Section("feedback_section_type") {
            ForEach(FeedbackType.allCases) { type in
                Button {
                    feedbackType = type
                } label: {
                    HStack {
                        Label(type.displayName, systemImage: type.icon)
                            .foregroundStyle(.primary)
                        Spacer()
                        if feedbackType == type {
                            Image(systemName: "checkmark")
                                .foregroundStyle(Color.brand.primary)
                                .fontWeight(.semibold)
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // MARK: - Content Section

    private var contentSection: some View {
        Section {
            TextEditor(text: $feedbackContent)
                .frame(minHeight: 150)
                .focused($isFocused)
                .overlay(alignment: .topLeading) {
                    if feedbackContent.isEmpty {
                        Text("feedback_placeholder")
                            .foregroundStyle(.tertiary)
                            .padding(.top, 8)
                            .padding(.leading, 4)
                            .allowsHitTesting(false)
                    }
                }
        } header: {
            Text("feedback_section_description")
        } footer: {
            Text(String(format: String(localized: "feedback_character_count"), feedbackContent.count))
                .foregroundStyle(feedbackContent.count > 500 ? Color.brand.error : .secondary)
        }
    }

    // MARK: - Contact Section

    private var contactSection: some View {
        Section {
            TextField(String(localized: "feedback_contact_placeholder"), text: $contactInfo)
                .keyboardType(.emailAddress)
                .textContentType(.emailAddress)
                .autocapitalization(.none)
                .focused($isFocused)
        } header: {
            Text("feedback_section_contact")
        } footer: {
            Text("feedback_contact_footer")
        }
    }

    // MARK: - Submit Section

    private var submitSection: some View {
        Section {
            if MFMailComposeViewController.canSendMail() {
                Button {
                    showMailComposer = true
                } label: {
                    HStack {
                        Spacer()
                        Label("feedback_send_email", systemImage: "envelope.fill")
                            .fontWeight(.semibold)
                        Spacer()
                    }
                }
                .disabled(!isValid)
            } else {
                Button {
                    copyFeedbackToClipboard()
                } label: {
                    HStack {
                        Spacer()
                        Label("feedback_copy_content", systemImage: "doc.on.doc.fill")
                            .fontWeight(.semibold)
                        Spacer()
                    }
                }
                .disabled(!isValid)
            }
        } footer: {
            if !MFMailComposeViewController.canSendMail() {
                Text("feedback_no_email_tip")
            }
        }
    }

    // MARK: - Computed Properties

    private var isValid: Bool {
        !feedbackContent.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines).isEmpty &&
        feedbackContent.count <= 500
    }

    private var feedbackSubject: String {
        "[NotBad 反馈] \(feedbackType.displayName)"
    }

    private var feedbackBody: String {
        """
        反馈类型：\(feedbackType.displayName)

        反馈内容：
        \(feedbackContent)

        联系方式：\(contactInfo.isEmpty ? "未填写" : contactInfo)

        ---
        设备信息：
        • 应用版本：1.0.0
        • 系统版本：iOS \(UIDevice.current.systemVersion)
        • 设备型号：\(UIDevice.current.model)
        """
    }

    // MARK: - Methods

    private func copyFeedbackToClipboard() {
        UIPasteboard.general.string = feedbackBody
        showCopiedToast = true
        Task { @MainActor in
            try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(2))
            showCopiedToast = false
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - FeedbackType

enum FeedbackType: String, CaseIterable, Identifiable {
    case bug
    case suggestion
    case question
    case other

    var id: String { rawValue }

    var displayName: String {
        switch self {
        case .bug: return "问题反馈"
        case .suggestion: return "功能建议"
        case .question: return "使用疑问"
        case .other: return "其他"
        }
    }

    var icon: String {
        switch self {
        case .bug: return "ladybug.fill"
        case .suggestion: return "lightbulb.fill"
        case .question: return "questionmark.circle.fill"
        case .other: return "ellipsis.circle.fill"
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - MailComposerView

struct MailComposerView: UIViewControllerRepresentable {
    let subject: String
    let body: String
    let recipients: [String]

    @Environment(\.dismiss) private var dismiss

    func makeUIViewController(context: Context) -> MFMailComposeViewController {
        let composer = MFMailComposeViewController()
        composer.mailComposeDelegate = context.coordinator
        composer.setSubject(subject)
        composer.setMessageBody(body, isHTML: false)
        composer.setToRecipients(recipients)
        return composer
    }

    func updateUIViewController(_ uiViewController: MFMailComposeViewController, context: Context) {}

    func makeCoordinator() -> Coordinator {
        Coordinator(self)
    }

    class Coordinator: NSObject, @preconcurrency MFMailComposeViewControllerDelegate {
        let parent: MailComposerView

        init(_ parent: MailComposerView) {
            self.parent = parent
        }

        @MainActor
        func mailComposeController(_ controller: MFMailComposeViewController, didFinishWith result: MFMailComposeResult, error: Error?) {
            parent.dismiss()
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Preview

#Preview {
    NavigationStack {
        FeedbackView()
    }
}

//
//  ExportFilterView.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  导出筛选视图 - 多维度筛选界面

import SwiftUI

// MARK: - Export Filter View

/// 导出筛选视图
///
/// 提供多维度的筛选条件设置，包括：
/// - 快捷预设（一键配置常用场景）
/// - 时间范围
/// - 学科筛选
/// - 难度筛选
/// - 掌握程度筛选
/// - 错误类型筛选
struct ExportFilterView: View {
    
    // MARK: - Properties
    
    let exportType: ExportType
    @Bindable var config: ExportFilterConfig
    let allItems: [ReviewItem]
    let onExport: () -> Void
    let onCancel: () -> Void
    
    @Environment(\.dismiss) private var dismiss
    @State private var showAdvancedOptions = false
    
    /// 筛选后的数量
    private var filteredCount: Int {
        config.filter(allItems).count
    }
    
    // MARK: - Body
    
    var body: some View {
        NavigationStack {
            Form {
                // 预览信息
                previewSection
                
                // 快捷预设
                presetsSection
                
                // 时间范围
                dateRangeSection
                
                // 学科筛选
                subjectSection
                
                // 掌握程度筛选（最重要）
                masterySection
                
                // 高级选项
                advancedSection
            }
            .navigationTitle(exportType == .pdf ? "data_export_pdf" : "data_export_csv")
            .navigationBarTitleDisplayMode(.inline)
            .toolbar {
                ToolbarItem(placement: .cancellationAction) {
                    Button("common_cancel") {
                        onCancel()
                    }
                }
                ToolbarItem(placement: .confirmationAction) {
                    Button {
                        onExport()
                        dismiss()
                    } label: {
                        HStack(spacing: 4) {
                            Text("export_confirm")
                            Text("(\(filteredCount))")
                                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                        }
                    }
                    .fontWeight(.semibold)
                    .disabled(filteredCount == 0)
                }
            }
        }
        .presentationDetents([.large])
        .presentationDragIndicator(.visible)
    }
    
    // MARK: - Preview Section
    
    private var previewSection: some View {
        Section {
            HStack {
                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 4) {
                    Text("export_filter_preview")
                        .font(.subheadline)
                        .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                    Text(config.filterDescription)
                        .font(.headline)
                }
                
                Spacer()
                
                // 数量显示
                VStack(alignment: .trailing, spacing: 4) {
                    Text("\(filteredCount)")
                        .font(.system(size: 28, weight: .bold, design: .rounded))
                        .foregroundStyle(filteredCount > 0 ? Color.brand.primary : .secondary)
                    Text("export_items_count")
                        .font(.caption)
                        .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                }
            }
            .padding(.vertical, 4)
            
            // 重置按钮
            if config.hasAnyFilter {
                Button(role: .destructive) {
                    withAnimation(.spring(response: 0.3)) {
                        config.resetAll()
                    }
                } label: {
                    Label("export_reset_filters", systemImage: "arrow.counterclockwise")
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    // MARK: - Presets Section
    
    private var presetsSection: some View {
        Section {
            ScrollView(.horizontal, showsIndicators: false) {
                HStack(spacing: 10) {
                    ForEach(ExportPreset.allCases) { preset in
                        PresetChip(preset: preset) {
                            withAnimation(.spring(response: 0.3)) {
                                config.applyPreset(preset)
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                .padding(.horizontal, 4)
                .padding(.vertical, 8)
            }
            .listRowInsets(EdgeInsets(top: 0, leading: 12, bottom: 0, trailing: 12))
        } header: {
            Text("export_quick_presets")
        } footer: {
            Text("export_presets_description")
        }
    }
    
    // MARK: - Date Range Section
    
    private var dateRangeSection: some View {
        Section("export_section_time") {
            Picker("export_date_range", selection: $config.dateRangeType) {
                ForEach(ExportDateRangeType.allCases) { range in
                    Label(range.displayName, systemImage: range.icon)
                        .tag(range)
                }
            }
            
            if config.dateRangeType == .custom {
                DatePicker(
                    "export_start_date",
                    selection: $config.customStartDate,
                    in: ...config.customEndDate,
                    displayedComponents: .date
                )
                
                DatePicker(
                    "export_end_date",
                    selection: $config.customEndDate,
                    in: config.customStartDate...,
                    displayedComponents: .date
                )
            }
        }
    }
    
    // MARK: - Subject Section
    
    private var subjectSection: some View {
        Section {
            Toggle("export_filter_by_subject", isOn: $config.filterBySubject.animation(.spring(response: 0.3)))
            
            if config.filterBySubject {
                // 按类别分组显示学科
                ForEach(SubjectCategory.allCases, id: \.self) { category in
                    let subjects = Subject.allCases.filter { $0.category == category }
                    if !subjects.isEmpty {
                        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 8) {
                            Text(category.displayName)
                                .font(.caption)
                                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                                .padding(.top, 4)
                            
                            FlowLayout(spacing: 8) {
                                ForEach(subjects, id: \.self) { subject in
                                    SubjectChip(
                                        subject: subject,
                                        isSelected: config.selectedSubjects.contains(subject)
                                    ) {
                                        withAnimation(.spring(response: 0.2)) {
                                            if config.selectedSubjects.contains(subject) {
                                                config.selectedSubjects.remove(subject)
                                            } else {
                                                config.selectedSubjects.insert(subject)
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        } header: {
            Text("export_section_subject")
        }
    }
    
    // MARK: - Mastery Section
    
    private var masterySection: some View {
        Section {
            Toggle("export_filter_by_mastery", isOn: $config.filterByMastery.animation(.spring(response: 0.3)))
            
            if config.filterByMastery {
                ForEach(MasteryFilterType.presets, id: \.self) { type in
                    Button {
                        withAnimation(.spring(response: 0.2)) {
                            config.masteryFilterType = type
                        }
                    } label: {
                        HStack {
                            Image(systemName: type.icon)
                                .foregroundStyle(type.color)
                                .frame(width: 24)
                            
                            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 2) {
                                Text(type.displayName)
                                    .foregroundStyle(.primary)
                                Text(type.description)
                                    .font(.caption)
                                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                            }
                            
                            Spacer()
                            
                            if config.masteryFilterType == type {
                                Image(systemName: "checkmark")
                                    .foregroundStyle(Color.brand.primary)
                                    .fontWeight(.semibold)
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        } header: {
            HStack {
                Text("export_section_mastery")
                Spacer()
                Text("export_section_mastery_tip")
                    .font(.caption)
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            }
        } footer: {
            if config.filterByMastery {
                Text("export_mastery_footer")
            }
        }
    }
    
    // MARK: - Advanced Section
    
    private var advancedSection: some View {
        Section {
            DisclosureGroup("export_advanced_options", isExpanded: $showAdvancedOptions) {
                // 难度筛选
                Toggle("export_filter_by_difficulty", isOn: $config.filterByDifficulty.animation(.spring(response: 0.3)))
                
                if config.filterByDifficulty {
                    VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 8) {
                        Text("export_difficulty_range")
                            .font(.caption)
                            .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                        
                        HStack(spacing: 8) {
                            ForEach(1...5, id: \.self) { level in
                                DifficultyStarButton(
                                    level: level,
                                    isInRange: level >= config.minDifficulty && level <= config.maxDifficulty
                                ) {
                                    withAnimation(.spring(response: 0.2)) {
                                        // 点击逻辑：设置范围
                                        if level < config.minDifficulty {
                                            config.minDifficulty = level
                                        } else if level > config.maxDifficulty {
                                            config.maxDifficulty = level
                                        } else if level == config.minDifficulty && level == config.maxDifficulty {
                                            // 如果只选中一个，重置为全部
                                            config.minDifficulty = 1
                                            config.maxDifficulty = 5
                                        } else if level == config.minDifficulty {
                                            config.minDifficulty = level + 1
                                        } else if level == config.maxDifficulty {
                                            config.maxDifficulty = level - 1
                                        } else {
                                            // 点击中间的，调整为只选这个
                                            config.minDifficulty = level
                                            config.maxDifficulty = level
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    .padding(.vertical, 4)
                }
                
                // 错误类型筛选
                Toggle("export_filter_by_error_type", isOn: $config.filterByErrorType.animation(.spring(response: 0.3)))
                
                if config.filterByErrorType {
                    FlowLayout(spacing: 8) {
                        ForEach(ErrorType.allCases, id: \.self) { errorType in
                            ErrorTypeChip(
                                errorType: errorType,
                                isSelected: config.selectedErrorTypes.contains(errorType)
                            ) {
                                withAnimation(.spring(response: 0.2)) {
                                    if config.selectedErrorTypes.contains(errorType) {
                                        config.selectedErrorTypes.remove(errorType)
                                    } else {
                                        config.selectedErrorTypes.insert(errorType)
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    .padding(.vertical, 4)
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

================================================================================

//
//  DataManagementView+Export.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  数据管理 - 导出功能
//

import SwiftUI
import SwiftData

// MARK: - Export Methods

extension DataManagementView {
    
    /// 根据筛选条件获取要导出的项目
    func filteredItemsForExport() -> [ReviewItem] {
        exportFilterConfig.filter(allItems)
    }
    
    /// 执行筛选后的导出
    func performFilteredExport() {
        showExportFilterSheet = false
        
        switch pendingExportType {
        case .pdf:
            exportToPDF()
        case .csv:
            exportToCSV()
        case .none:
            break
        }
        
        // 刷新缓存列表
        refreshCachedFiles()
    }

    /// 导出为 PDF（打印用）
    func exportToPDF() {
        let itemsToExport = filteredItemsForExport()
        
        guard !itemsToExport.isEmpty else {
            showToast(String(localized: "export_no_items_in_range"), isError: true)
            return
        }
        
        let pdfData = PDFExportService.shared.exportToPDF(
            items: itemsToExport,
            title: String(localized: "pdf_export_title"),
            includeImages: true,
            includeNotes: true
        )
        
        do {
            let fileName = exportFileName(type: "pdf", count: itemsToExport.count)
            // 使用缓存管理器保存文件（而非临时目录）
            let cachedURL = try ExportCacheManager.shared.cacheExportFile(data: pdfData, fileName: fileName)
            exportedFileURL = cachedURL
            showExportSheet = true
        } catch {
            showToast(String(localized: "export_failed"), isError: true)
        }
    }

    /// 导出为 JSON
    func exportData() {
        let exportItems: [[String: Any]] = allItems.map { item in
            [
                "id": item.id.uuidString,
                "title": item.title,
                "note": item.note,
                "subject": item.subject.rawValue,
                "questionType": item.questionType.rawValue,
                "difficulty": item.difficulty.rawValue,
                "source": item.source.rawValue,
                "grade": item.grade.rawValue,
                "masteryLevel": item.masteryLevel,
                "reviewCount": item.reviewCount,
                "createdAt": ISO8601DateFormatter().string(from: item.createdAt),
                "knowledgePoints": item.knowledgePoints.rawValue,
                "nextReviewDate": ISO8601DateFormatter().string(from: item.nextReviewDate)
            ]
        }

        do {
            let jsonData = try JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: exportItems, options: [.prettyPrinted, .sortedKeys])
            let tempURL = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appendingPathComponent("notbad_export_\(Date().timeIntervalSince1970).json")
            try jsonData.write(to: tempURL)
            exportedFileURL = tempURL
            showExportSheet = true
        } catch {
            showToast("导出失败", isError: true)
        }
    }

    /// 导出为 CSV
    func exportToCSV() {
        let itemsToExport = filteredItemsForExport()
        
        guard !itemsToExport.isEmpty else {
            showToast(String(localized: "export_no_items_in_range"), isError: true)
            return
        }
        
        // CSV 表头（使用本地化字符串）
        var csvString = "ID,标题,笔记,科目,题型,难度,来源,年级,掌握程度,复习次数,创建时间,知识点\n"

        for item in itemsToExport {
            let row = [
                item.id.uuidString,
                escapeCSV(item.title),
                escapeCSV(item.note),
                item.subject.displayName,  // 使用显示名称而非 rawValue
                item.questionType.displayName,
                item.difficulty.displayName,
                item.source.displayName,
                item.grade.displayName,
                String(item.masteryLevel),
                String(item.reviewCount),
                ISO8601DateFormatter().string(from: item.createdAt),
                escapeCSV(item.knowledgePoints.rawValue)
            ].joined(separator: ",")
            csvString += row + "\n"
        }

        do {
            // 添加 UTF-8 BOM，让 Excel 正确识别编码
            var data = Data([0xEF, 0xBB, 0xBF])  // UTF-8 BOM
            data.append(csvString.data(using: .utf8)!)
            
            let fileName = exportFileName(type: "csv", count: itemsToExport.count)
            // 使用缓存管理器保存文件
            let cachedURL = try ExportCacheManager.shared.cacheExportFile(data: data, fileName: fileName)
            exportedFileURL = cachedURL
            showExportSheet = true
        } catch {
            showToast("导出失败", isError: true)
        }
    }

    /// 导出完整备份（含图片）
    func exportFullBackup() async {
        await MainActor.run {
            isExporting = true
            exportProgress = 0
        }

        do {
            // 创建临时目录
            let tempDir = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appendingPathComponent("notbad_backup_\(UUID().uuidString)")
            try FileManager.default.createDirectory(at: tempDir, withIntermediateDirectories: true)

            // 创建图片目录
            let imagesDir = tempDir.appendingPathComponent("images")
            try FileManager.default.createDirectory(at: imagesDir, withIntermediateDirectories: true)

            // 导出数据和图片
            var exportItems: [[String: Any]] = []
            let totalItems = allItems.count

            for (index, item) in allItems.enumerated() {
                var dict: [String: Any] = [
                    "id": item.id.uuidString,
                    "title": item.title,
                    "note": item.note,
                    "subject": item.subject.rawValue,
                    "questionType": item.questionType.rawValue,
                    "difficulty": item.difficulty.rawValue,
                    "source": item.source.rawValue,
                    "grade": item.grade.rawValue,
                    "masteryLevel": item.masteryLevel,
                    "reviewCount": item.reviewCount,
                    "createdAt": ISO8601DateFormatter().string(from: item.createdAt),
                    "updatedAt": ISO8601DateFormatter().string(from: item.updatedAt),
                    "knowledgePoints": item.knowledgePoints.rawValue,
                    "nextReviewDate": ISO8601DateFormatter().string(from: item.nextReviewDate),
                    "errorType": item.errorType.rawValue
                ]

                // 导出图片
                if let imageData = item.imageData {
                    let imageName = "\(item.id.uuidString).jpg"
                    let imageURL = imagesDir.appendingPathComponent(imageName)
                    try imageData.write(to: imageURL)
                    dict["imageName"] = imageName
                }

                exportItems.append(dict)

                await MainActor.run {
                    exportProgress = Double(index + 1) / Double(totalItems)
                }
            }

            // 写入 JSON 文件
            let jsonData = try JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: exportItems, options: [.prettyPrinted, .sortedKeys])
            let jsonURL = tempDir.appendingPathComponent("data.json")
            try jsonData.write(to: jsonURL)

            // 写入元数据
            let metadata: [String: Any] = [
                "version": "1.0",
                "exportDate": ISO8601DateFormatter().string(from: Date()),
                "itemCount": allItems.count,
                "imageCount": imageCount,
                "appVersion": Bundle.main.infoDictionary?["CFBundleShortVersionString"] as? String ?? "1.0.0"
            ]
            let metadataData = try JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: metadata, options: .prettyPrinted)
            let metadataURL = tempDir.appendingPathComponent("metadata.json")
            try metadataData.write(to: metadataURL)

            // 创建 ZIP 文件
            let zipURL = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appendingPathComponent("notbad_backup_\(dateString()).zip")
            try await createZipFile(from: tempDir, to: zipURL)

            // 清理临时目录
            try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: tempDir)

            await MainActor.run {
                exportedFileURL = zipURL
                isExporting = false
                showExportSheet = true
            }
        } catch {
            await MainActor.run {
                isExporting = false
                showToast("备份失败: \(error.localizedDescription)", isError: true)
            }
        }
    }

    // MARK: - Helper Methods

    func escapeCSV(_ string: String) -> String {
        let escaped = string.replacingOccurrences(of: "\"", with: "\"\"")
        if escaped.contains(",") || escaped.contains("\n") || escaped.contains("\"") {
            return "\"\(escaped)\""
        }
        return escaped
    }

    func createZipFile(from sourceDir: URL, to destinationURL: URL) async throws {
        let coordinator = NSFileCoordinator()
        var error: NSError?

        coordinator.coordinate(readingItemAt: sourceDir, options: .forUploading, error: &error) { zipURL in
            try? FileManager.default.copyItem(at: zipURL, to: destinationURL)
        }

        if let error = error {
            throw error
        }
    }

    func dateString() -> String {
        let formatter = DateFormatter()
        formatter.dateFormat = "yyyyMMdd_HHmmss"
        return formatter.string(from: Date())
    }
    
    /// 生成导出文件名（包含筛选条件信息）
    func exportFileName(type: String, count: Int) -> String {
        let dateFormatter = DateFormatter()
        dateFormatter.dateFormat = "yyyyMMdd"
        
        // 构建文件名各部分
        var parts: [String] = ["notbad"]
        
        // 时间范围
        switch exportFilterConfig.dateRangeType {
        case .all:
            break // 不添加
        case .thisWeek:
            parts.append("week")
        case .thisMonth:
            parts.append("month_\(dateFormatter.string(from: Date()))")
        case .lastMonth:
            let lastMonth = Calendar.current.date(byAdding: .month, value: -1, to: Date()) ?? Date()
            parts.append("month_\(dateFormatter.string(from: lastMonth))")
        case .thisYear:
            let year = Calendar.current.component(.year, from: Date())
            parts.append("year_\(year)")
        case .custom:
            let start = dateFormatter.string(from: exportFilterConfig.customStartDate)
            let end = dateFormatter.string(from: exportFilterConfig.customEndDate)
            parts.append("\(start)-\(end)")
        }
        
        // 学科（如果只选了1-2个）
        if exportFilterConfig.filterBySubject && !exportFilterConfig.selectedSubjects.isEmpty {
            if exportFilterConfig.selectedSubjects.count <= 2 {
                let subjectNames = exportFilterConfig.selectedSubjects.map { $0.rawValue }.joined(separator: "_")
                parts.append(subjectNames)
            }
        }
        
        // 掌握程度
        if exportFilterConfig.filterByMastery {
            switch exportFilterConfig.masteryFilterType {
            case .notMastered:
                parts.append("未掌握")
            case .veryWeak:
                parts.append("薄弱")
            case .needsReview:
                parts.append("需复习")
            case .mastered:
                parts.append("已掌握")
            case .customRange:
                break
            }
        }
        
        // 数量
        parts.append("\(count)题")
        
        return parts.joined(separator: "_") + ".\(type)"
    }
}

//
//  CustomSubjectEditorView.swift

import SwiftUI

// MARK: - CustomSubjectEditorView

/// 自定义学科编辑视图
///
/// 用于创建或编辑自定义学科。
struct CustomSubjectEditorView: View {
    
    // MARK: - Mode
    
    enum Mode: Identifiable {
        case add
        case edit(CustomSubject)
        
        var id: String {
            switch self {
            case .add: return "add"
            case .edit(let subject): return subject.id.uuidString
            }
        }
    }
    
    // MARK: - Properties
    
    let mode: Mode
    
    @StateObject private var profileManager = UserProfileManager.shared
    @Environment(\.dismiss) private var dismiss
    
    @State private var name: String = ""
    @State private var selectedIcon: String = "book.fill"
    @State private var selectedColor: Color = .blue
    @State private var selectedCategory: SubjectCategory = .humanities
    @State private var applicableStages: Set<GradeStage> = Set(GradeStage.allCases)
    
    @State private var showingIconPicker = false
    
    // MARK: - Available Icons
    
    private let availableIcons: [String] = [
        // 书籍和学习
        "book.fill", "books.vertical.fill", "text.book.closed.fill",
        "bookmark.fill", "graduationcap.fill", "backpack.fill",
        
        // 科学
        "atom", "flask.fill", "testtube.2", "chart.bar.fill",
        "function", "sum", "divide", "multiply",
        
        // 艺术
        "paintbrush.fill", "paintpalette.fill", "music.note",
        "guitars.fill", "pianokeys", "theatermasks.fill",
        
        // 运动
        "figure.run", "sportscourt.fill", "basketball.fill",
        "soccerball", "tennis.racket", "figure.swimming",
        
        // 语言
        "globe", "character.book.closed.fill", "abc",
        "textformat.abc", "bubble.left.and.bubble.right.fill",
        
        // 技术
        "desktopcomputer", "laptopcomputer", "keyboard.fill",
        "cpu.fill", "memorychip.fill", "network",
        
        // 自然
        "leaf.fill", "tree.fill", "cloud.sun.fill",
        "mountain.2.fill", "water.waves", "sparkles",
        
        // 其他
        "star.fill", "heart.fill", "lightbulb.fill",
        "puzzlepiece.fill", "flag.fill", "mappin.and.ellipse"
    ]
    
    // MARK: - Available Colors
    
    private let availableColors: [Color] = [
        .red, .orange, .yellow, .green, .mint, .teal,
        .cyan, .blue, .indigo, .purple, .pink, .brown
    ]
    
    // MARK: - Computed Properties
    
    private var isValid: Bool {
        !name.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines).isEmpty && !applicableStages.isEmpty
    }
    
    private var navigationTitle: LocalizedStringKey {
        switch mode {
        case .add: return "custom_subject_add_title"
        case .edit: return "custom_subject_edit_title"
        }
    }
    
    // MARK: - Body
    
    var body: some View {
        NavigationStack {
            Form {
                // 名称输入
                Section {
                    TextField("custom_subject_name_placeholder", text: $name)
                        .onSubmit {
                            UIApplication.shared.sendAction(#selector(UIResponder.resignFirstResponder), to: nil, from: nil, for: nil)
                        }
                } header: {
                    Text("custom_subject_name_section")
                }
                
                // 图标选择
                Section {
                    Button {
                        showingIconPicker = true
                    } label: {
                        HStack {
                            Text("custom_subject_icon")
                                .foregroundStyle(.primary)
                            
                            Spacer()
                            
                            Image(systemName: selectedIcon)
                                .font(.title2)
                                .foregroundStyle(selectedColor)
                                .frame(width: 44, height: 44)
                                .background(selectedColor.opacity(0.15))
                                .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 10))
                        }
                    }
                } header: {
                    Text("custom_subject_appearance_section")
                }
                
                // 颜色选择
                Section {
                    LazyVGrid(columns: Array(repeating: GridItem(.flexible()), count: 6), spacing: 12) {
                        ForEach(availableColors, id: \.self) { color in
                            Button {
                                withAnimation(.spring(response: 0.3)) {
                                    selectedColor = color
                                }
                            } label: {
                                Circle()
                                    .fill(color)
                                    .frame(width: 36, height: 36)
                                    .overlay {
                                        if color == selectedColor {
                                            Image(systemName: "checkmark")
                                                .font(.caption.bold())
                                                .foregroundStyle(.white)
                                        }
                                    }
                            }
                            .buttonStyle(.plain)
                        }
                    }
                    .padding(.vertical, 8)
                } header: {
                    Text("custom_subject_color_section")
                }
                
                // 分类选择
                Section {
                    Picker("custom_subject_category", selection: $selectedCategory) {
                        ForEach(SubjectCategory.allCases) { category in
                            Text(category.displayName).tag(category)
                        }
                    }
                } header: {
                    Text("custom_subject_category_section")
                }
                
                // 适用学段选择
                Section {
                    ForEach(GradeStage.allCases) { stage in
                        Button {
                            withAnimation(.spring(response: 0.3)) {
                                if applicableStages.contains(stage) {
                                    // 至少保留一个学段
                                    if applicableStages.count > 1 {
                                        applicableStages.remove(stage)
                                    }
                                } else {
                                    applicableStages.insert(stage)
                                }
                            }
                        } label: {
                            HStack {
                                Text(stage.displayName)
                                    .foregroundStyle(.primary)
                                
                                Spacer()
                                
                                if applicableStages.contains(stage) {
                                    Image(systemName: "checkmark.circle.fill")
                                        .foregroundStyle(Color.brand.primary)
                                } else {
                                    Image(systemName: "circle")
                                        .foregroundStyle(.tertiary)
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        .buttonStyle(.plain)
                    }
                } header: {
                    Text("custom_subject_stages_section")
                } footer: {
                    Text("custom_subject_stages_footer")
                        .font(.caption)
                }
            }
            .navigationTitle(navigationTitle)
            .navigationBarTitleDisplayMode(.inline)
            .toolbar {
                ToolbarItem(placement: .cancellationAction) {
                    Button("common_cancel") {
                        dismiss()
                    }
                }
                
                ToolbarItem(placement: .confirmationAction) {
                    Button("common_save") {
                        saveSubject()
                        dismiss()
                    }
                    .disabled(!isValid)
                }
            }
            .sheet(isPresented: $showingIconPicker) {
                IconPickerView(
                    availableIcons: availableIcons,
                    selectedIcon: $selectedIcon,
                    selectedColor: selectedColor
                )
            }
            .onAppear {
                loadExistingData()
            }
        }
    }
    
    // MARK: - Methods
    
    private func loadExistingData() {
        if case .edit(let subject) = mode {
            name = subject.name
            selectedIcon = subject.icon
            selectedColor = subject.color
            selectedCategory = subject.category
            applicableStages = subject.applicableStages
        }
    }
    
    private func saveSubject() {
        let trimmedName = name.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
        
        switch mode {
        case .add:
            let newSubject = CustomSubject(
                name: trimmedName,
                icon: selectedIcon,
                colorHex: selectedColor.toHex() ?? "#007AFF",
                category: selectedCategory,
                applicableStages: applicableStages
            )
            profileManager.addCustomSubject(newSubject)
            
        case .edit(var existingSubject):
            existingSubject.name = trimmedName
            existingSubject.icon = selectedIcon
            existingSubject.colorHex = selectedColor.toHex() ?? "#007AFF"
            existingSubject.category = selectedCategory
            existingSubject.applicableStages = applicableStages
            profileManager.updateCustomSubject(existingSubject)
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - IconPickerView

/// 图标选择视图
private struct IconPickerView: View {
    let availableIcons: [String]
    @Binding var selectedIcon: String
    let selectedColor: Color
    @Environment(\.dismiss) private var dismiss
    
    var body: some View {
        NavigationStack {
            ScrollView {
                LazyVGrid(columns: Array(repeating: GridItem(.flexible()), count: 5), spacing: 16) {
                    ForEach(availableIcons, id: \.self) { icon in
                        Button {
                            withAnimation(.spring(response: 0.3)) {
                                selectedIcon = icon
                            }
                            dismiss()
                        } label: {
                            Image(systemName: icon)
                                .font(.title2)
                                .foregroundStyle(icon == selectedIcon ? .white : selectedColor)
                                .frame(width: 50, height: 50)
                                .background(icon == selectedIcon ? selectedColor : selectedColor.opacity(0.15))
                                .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 12))
                                .overlay {
                                    if icon == selectedIcon {
                                        RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 12)
                                            .strokeBorder(selectedColor, lineWidth: 2)
                                    }
                                }
                        }
                        .buttonStyle(.plain)
                    }
                }
                .padding()
            }
            .navigationTitle("custom_subject_icon_picker_title")
            .navigationBarTitleDisplayMode(.inline)
            .toolbar {
                ToolbarItem(placement: .confirmationAction) {
                    Button("common_done") {
                        dismiss()
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        .presentationDetents([.medium])
    }
}

//
//  ReviewModels.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  复习功能相关模型
//

import SwiftUI

// MARK: - ReviewMode

/// 复习模式
///
/// 定义不同的复习策略。
///
/// ## 使用示例
///
/// ```swift
/// let mode = ReviewMode.smart
/// print(mode.displayName)  // "智能推荐"
/// print(mode.description)  // "根据艾宾浩斯曲线智能排序"
/// ```
enum ReviewMode: String, CaseIterable, Identifiable {
    case smart
    case weakest
    case random
    case newest
    case overdue

    var id: String { rawValue }

    var displayName: String {
        String(localized: displayNameKey)
    }

    private var displayNameKey: String.LocalizationValue {
        switch self {
        case .smart: "review_mode_smart"
        case .weakest: "review_mode_weakest"
        case .random: "review_mode_random"
        case .newest: "review_mode_newest"
        case .overdue: "review_mode_overdue"
        }
    }

    var icon: String {
        switch self {
        case .smart: "brain"
        case .weakest: "exclamationmark.triangle"
        case .random: "shuffle"
        case .newest: "clock"
        case .overdue: "calendar.badge.exclamationmark"
        }
    }

    var description: String {
        String(localized: descriptionKey)
    }

    private var descriptionKey: String.LocalizationValue {
        switch self {
        case .smart: "review_mode_smart_desc"
        case .weakest: "review_mode_weakest_desc"
        case .random: "review_mode_random_desc"
        case .newest: "review_mode_newest_desc"
        case .overdue: "review_mode_overdue_desc"
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - ReviewSessionState

/// 复习会话状态
///
/// 表示复习会话的当前状态。
enum ReviewSessionState: Sendable {
    case idle
    case inProgress
    case paused
    case completed

    var isActive: Bool {
        self == .inProgress || self == .paused
    }
}

// MARK: - ReviewSessionStatistics

/// 复习会话统计
///
/// 记录一次复习会话的统计数据。
///
/// ## 使用示例
///
/// ```swift
/// let stats = ReviewSessionStatistics(
///     totalReviewed: 10,
///     elapsedSeconds: 300,
///     masteryResults: [.mastered: 3, .good: 5, .needsWork: 2]
/// )
/// print(stats.formattedDuration)  // "5 分 0 秒"
/// print(stats.masteryRateDescription)  // "80%"
/// ```
struct ReviewSessionStatistics: Sendable {
    let totalReviewed: Int
    let elapsedSeconds: Int
    let masteryResults: [MasteryLevel: Int]

    /// 格式化的用时
    var formattedDuration: String {
        let minutes = elapsedSeconds / 60
        let seconds = elapsedSeconds % 60

        if minutes > 0 {
            return String(localized: "review_stats_duration_minutes_seconds \(minutes) \(seconds)")
        } else {
            return String(localized: "review_stats_duration_seconds \(seconds)")
        }
    }

    /// 掌握率
    var masteryRate: Double {
        guard totalReviewed > 0 else { return 0 }
        let goodCount = (masteryResults[.mastered] ?? 0) + (masteryResults[.good] ?? 0)
        return Double(goodCount) / Double(totalReviewed)
    }

    /// 掌握率描述
    var masteryRateDescription: String {
        "\(Int(masteryRate * 100))%"
    }

    /// 是否表现良好
    var isGoodPerformance: Bool {
        masteryRate >= 0.6
    }

    /// 鼓励语
    var encouragement: String {
        switch masteryRate {
        case 0.8...: String(localized: "review_stats_encouragement_excellent")
        case 0.6..<0.8: String(localized: "review_stats_encouragement_good")
        case 0.4..<0.6: String(localized: "review_stats_encouragement_keep_going")
        default: String(localized: "review_stats_encouragement_practice_more")
        }
    }
}
