//
//  ReviewViewModel.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  Created for NotBad K12 错题本
//  Phase 3: ViewModel Dependency Injection
//

import SwiftUI
import SwiftData
import OSLog

// MARK: - ReviewViewModel

/// 复习 ViewModel
///
/// 负责管理错题复习的完整流程，包括复习队列、进度追踪和掌握度更新。
///
/// ## 复习流程
///
/// 1. **生成队列**：根据艾宾浩斯曲线和掌握程度排序
/// 2. **逐题复习**：显示错题，用户评估掌握程度
/// 3. **更新状态**：记录复习结果，计算下次复习时间
/// 4. **完成统计**：显示本次复习成果
///
/// ## 依赖注入
///
/// 支持两种使用方式：
///
/// ```swift
/// // 方式1: 使用 DataProvider（推荐，支持测试）
/// let provider = SwiftDataReviewItemProvider(modelContext: context)
/// let viewModel = ReviewViewModel(dataProvider: provider)
/// let queue = viewModel.generateReviewQueue()
///
/// // 方式2: 传入 items（向后兼容）
/// let viewModel = ReviewViewModel()
/// let queue = viewModel.generateReviewQueue(from: items)
/// ```
@MainActor
@Observable
final class ReviewViewModel {

    // MARK: - Dependencies

    /// 数据提供者（可选，用于依赖注入）
    private var dataProvider: (any ReviewItemDataProviding)?

    // MARK: - Review State

    /// 当前复习索引
    var currentIndex = 0

    /// 复习会话状态
    var sessionState: ReviewSessionState = .idle

    /// 是否显示完成弹窗
    var showCompletionAlert = false

    /// 是否显示退出确认
    var showExitConfirmation = false

    // MARK: - Statistics

    /// 本次复习计数
    var reviewedCount = 0

    /// 各掌握程度计数
    var masteryResults: [MasteryLevel: Int] = [:]

    /// 复习开始时间
    var sessionStartTime: Date?

    /// 已用时间（秒）
    var elapsedSeconds: Int {
        guard let start = sessionStartTime else { return 0 }
        return Int(Date().timeIntervalSince(start))
    }

    // MARK: - Filter State

    /// 复习模式
    var reviewMode: ReviewMode = .smart

    /// 筛选的学科
    var filterSubject: Subject?

    /// 每次复习数量限制
    var batchSize: Int = 20

    // MARK: - Dependencies

    private var modelContext: ModelContext?

    // MARK: - Initialization

    /// 默认初始化（向后兼容）
    init() {}

    /// 依赖注入初始化（推荐用于测试）
    ///
    /// - Parameter dataProvider: 数据提供者
    init(dataProvider: any ReviewItemDataProviding) {
        self.dataProvider = dataProvider
    }

    func configure(with modelContext: ModelContext) {
        self.modelContext = modelContext
    }

    // MARK: - Data Access

    /// 获取所有错题
    ///
    /// 优先从 dataProvider 获取，否则返回空数组
    var items: [ReviewItem] {
        dataProvider?.items ?? []
    }

    /// 生成复习队列（使用 DataProvider）
    ///
    /// - Returns: 排序后的复习队列
    func generateReviewQueue() -> [ReviewItem] {
        generateReviewQueue(from: items)
    }

    // MARK: - Queue Generation

    /// 生成复习队列
    ///
    /// 根据复习模式和筛选条件生成优化的复习队列。
    ///
    /// - Parameter allItems: 所有错题
    /// - Returns: 排序后的复习队列
    func generateReviewQueue(from allItems: [ReviewItem]) -> [ReviewItem] {
        var items = allItems

        // 学科筛选
        if let subject = filterSubject {
            items = items.filter { $0.subject == subject }
        }

        // 根据模式筛选和排序
        switch reviewMode {
        case .smart:
            // 智能模式：优先复习需要复习的
            items = items
                .filter { $0.needsReview }
                .sorted { item1, item2 in
                    // 逾期优先
                    if item1.isOverdue != item2.isOverdue {
                        return item1.isOverdue
                    }
                    // 掌握程度低优先
                    if item1.masteryLevel != item2.masteryLevel {
                        return item1.masteryLevel < item2.masteryLevel
                    }
                    // 复习次数少优先
                    return item1.reviewCount < item2.reviewCount
                }

        case .weakest:
            // 薄弱项模式：按掌握程度从低到高
            items = items.sorted { $0.masteryLevel < $1.masteryLevel }

        case .random:
            // 随机模式
            items = items.shuffled()

        case .newest:
            // 最新添加
            items = items.sorted { $0.createdAt > $1.createdAt }

        case .overdue:
            // 仅逾期
            items = items.filter { $0.isOverdue }
                .sorted { $0.reviewInterval.overdueByDays > $1.reviewInterval.overdueByDays }
        }

        // 限制数量
        return Array(items.prefix(batchSize))
    }

    /// 获取当前复习项
    func currentItem(from queue: [ReviewItem]) -> ReviewItem? {
        guard currentIndex < queue.count else { return nil }
        return queue[currentIndex]
    }

    /// 复习进度（0.0 - 1.0）
    func progress(totalCount: Int) -> Double {
        guard totalCount > 0 else { return 0 }
        return Double(currentIndex) / Double(totalCount)
    }

    /// 进度描述
    func progressDescription(totalCount: Int) -> String {
        "\(currentIndex + 1) / \(totalCount)"
    }

    // MARK: - Session Control

    /// 开始复习会话
    func startSession() {
        sessionState = .inProgress
        sessionStartTime = Date()
        currentIndex = 0
        reviewedCount = 0
        masteryResults = [:]
    }

    /// 暂停复习会话
    func pauseSession() {
        sessionState = .paused
    }

    /// 恢复复习会话
    func resumeSession() {
        sessionState = .inProgress
    }

    /// 结束复习会话
    func endSession() {
        sessionState = .completed
        showCompletionAlert = true
    }

    /// 重置会话
    func reset() {
        currentIndex = 0
        reviewedCount = 0
        masteryResults = [:]
        sessionState = .idle
        sessionStartTime = nil
        showCompletionAlert = false
    }

    // MARK: - Review Actions

    /// 处理掌握度更新
    ///
    /// 更新错题的掌握程度，计算下次复习时间。
    ///
    /// - Parameters:
    ///   - item: 当前错题
    ///   - level: 评估的掌握程度
    func handleMasteryUpdate(for item: ReviewItem, level: MasteryLevel) {
        guard let modelContext else { return }

        // 记录复习
        item.recordReview(newMastery: level)

        // 保存
        do {
            try modelContext.save()
        } catch {
            Logger.data.error("保存失败: \(error)")
        }

        // 更新统计
        reviewedCount += 1
        masteryResults[level, default: 0] += 1

        // 发送通知
        NotificationCenter.default.post(name: .reviewItemUpdated, object: item)
    }

    /// 移动到下一题
    func moveToNext(totalCount: Int) {
        if currentIndex < totalCount - 1 {
            currentIndex += 1
        } else {
            endSession()
        }
    }

    /// 移动到上一题
    func moveToPrevious() {
        if currentIndex > 0 {
            currentIndex -= 1
        }
    }

    /// 跳过当前题
    func skipCurrent(totalCount: Int) {
        moveToNext(totalCount: totalCount)
    }

    // MARK: - Session Statistics

    /// 生成会话统计
    func generateSessionStatistics() -> ReviewSessionStatistics {
        ReviewSessionStatistics(
            totalReviewed: reviewedCount,
            elapsedSeconds: elapsedSeconds,
            masteryResults: masteryResults
        )
    }

    /// 平均每题用时（秒）
    var averageTimePerItem: Int {
        guard reviewedCount > 0 else { return 0 }
        return elapsedSeconds / reviewedCount
    }

    /// 掌握率（本次）
    var sessionMasteryRate: Double {
        guard reviewedCount > 0 else { return 0 }
        let goodCount = (masteryResults[.mastered] ?? 0) + (masteryResults[.good] ?? 0)
        return Double(goodCount) / Double(reviewedCount)
    }
}

//
//  ReviewView.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  复习视图 - iOS 26 现代化设计
//

import SwiftUI
import SwiftData
import TipKit

// MARK: - ReviewView

/// 复习视图
///
/// 提供卡片式复习界面，用户可以通过滑动浏览需要复习的错题，
/// 并根据掌握程度进行自我评估。
///
/// ## 功能特性
///
/// - 卡片式错题浏览
/// - 自我评估（不会/模糊/掌握）
/// - 复习进度追踪
/// - 复习完成统计
///
/// ## 使用示例
///
/// ```swift
/// ReviewView()
///     .modelContainer(for: ReviewItem.self)
/// ```
///
/// ## 复习算法
///
/// 根据用户的自我评估更新掌握度：
/// - 不会：掌握度重置为"未掌握"
/// - 模糊：掌握度设为"一知半解"
/// - 掌握：掌握度提升到"完全掌握"
struct ReviewView: View {

    // MARK: - Properties

    /// 所有错题数据
    @Query(sort: \ReviewItem.createdAt, order: .reverse)
    private var allItems: [ReviewItem]

    /// 数据上下文
    @Environment(\.modelContext) private var modelContext

    /// 视图模型
    @State private var viewModel = ReviewViewModel()

    // MARK: - Computed Properties

    /// 需要复习的错题
    private var reviewItems: [ReviewItem] {
        viewModel.generateReviewQueue(from: allItems)
    }

    // MARK: - Body

    var body: some View {
        @Bindable var bindableViewModel = viewModel

        NavigationStack {
            ZStack {
                if reviewItems.isEmpty {
                    EmptyReviewState()
                } else {
                    VStack(spacing: 0) {
                        // 首次复习提示
                        TipView(ReviewGestureTip(), arrowEdge: .bottom)
                            .tipBackground(Color(.secondarySystemBackground))
                            .padding(.horizontal)
                        
                        ReviewContent(
                            items: reviewItems,
                            currentIndex: $bindableViewModel.currentIndex,
                            onMasteryUpdate: handleMastery
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
            .navigationTitle("review_title")
            .navigationBarTitleDisplayMode(.large)
            .onAppear {
                viewModel.configure(with: modelContext)
            }
            .alert("review_complete_title", isPresented: $bindableViewModel.showCompletionAlert) {
                Button("review_complete_button") {
                    viewModel.reset()
                }
            } message: {
                Text("review_complete_message \(viewModel.reviewedCount)")
            }
        }
    }

    // MARK: - Actions

    /// 处理掌握度评估
    private func handleMastery(index: Int, level: MasteryLevel) {
        guard index < reviewItems.count else { return }

        // 触觉反馈
        let generator = UIImpactFeedbackGenerator(style: .medium)
        generator.impactOccurred()

        withAnimation {
            viewModel.handleMasteryUpdate(for: reviewItems[index], level: level)
            viewModel.moveToNext(totalCount: reviewItems.count)
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Preview

#Preview("Review View") {
    ReviewView()
        .modelContainer(for: ReviewItem.self, inMemory: true)
}

//
//  ReviewCard.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  Created for NotBad K12 错题本
//

import SwiftUI

// MARK: - AsyncImageView

/// 异步图片加载视图
///
/// 在后台线程解码图片，避免阻塞主线程。
/// 对于复习页面的滑动性能至关重要。
private struct AsyncImageView: View {
    let imageData: Data
    
    @State private var image: UIImage?
    @State private var isLoading = true
    
    var body: some View {
        Group {
            if let image {
                Image(uiImage: image)
                    .resizable()
                    .scaledToFit()
            } else if isLoading {
                ProgressView()
                    .frame(height: 200)
            }
        }
        .task(id: imageData.hashValue) {
            await loadImage()
        }
    }
    
    private func loadImage() async {
        isLoading = true
        
        // 在后台线程解码图片
        let decoded = await Task.detached(priority: .userInitiated) {
            // 解码图片
            guard let original = UIImage(data: imageData) else { return nil as UIImage? }
            
            // 限制最大尺寸以减少内存占用和渲染压力
            let maxDimension: CGFloat = 800
            let scale = min(maxDimension / original.size.width, maxDimension / original.size.height, 1.0)
            
            if scale < 1.0 {
                let newSize = CGSize(
                    width: original.size.width * scale,
                    height: original.size.height * scale
                )
                let renderer = UIGraphicsImageRenderer(size: newSize)
                return renderer.image { _ in
                    original.draw(in: CGRect(origin: .zero, size: newSize))
                }
            }
            
            return original
        }.value
        
        await MainActor.run {
            self.image = decoded
            self.isLoading = false
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - ReviewCard

/// 复习卡片组件
///
/// 展示单道错题的详细信息，支持显示/隐藏答案，
/// 并提供掌握度自评按钮。
///
/// ## 使用示例
///
/// ```swift
/// ReviewCard(
///     item: reviewItem,
///     onMastered: { /* 完全掌握 */ },
///     onUnclear: { /* 一知半解 */ },
///     onFailed: { /* 不会 */ }
/// )
/// ```
struct ReviewCard: View {

    // MARK: - Properties

    /// 错题数据
    let item: ReviewItem

    /// 掌握回调
    let onMastered: () -> Void

    /// 模糊回调
    let onUnclear: () -> Void

    /// 不会回调
    let onFailed: () -> Void

    // MARK: - State

    /// 是否显示答案
    @State private var showAnswer = false

    /// 卡片出现动画
    @State private var isAppeared = false

    // MARK: - Body

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 0) {
            ScrollView {
                VStack(spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.xl) {
                    headerSection
                    imageSection
                    titleSection
                    answerSection
                    metadataSection
                }
                .padding()
            }

            ActionButtons(
                onFailed: onFailed,
                onUnclear: onUnclear,
                onMastered: onMastered
            )
        }
        .background(Color.semantic.background)
        .opacity(isAppeared ? 1 : 0)
        .offset(y: isAppeared ? 0 : 20)
        .accessibilityIdentifier("review_card")
        .onAppear {
            withAnimation(.spring(response: 0.5, dampingFraction: 0.8)) {
                isAppeared = true
            }
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - ReviewCard Subviews

extension ReviewCard {

    /// 头部区域
    var headerSection: some View {
        HStack {
            // Subject badge with enhanced styling
            HStack(spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.xs) {
                Image(systemName: item.subject.icon)
                    .symbolEffect(.pulse.byLayer, options: .repeating.speed(0.5), value: isAppeared)
                Text(item.subject.displayName)
            }
            .font(.caption.weight(.semibold))
            .padding(.horizontal, 14)
            .padding(.vertical, 8)
            .background(
                Capsule()
                    .fill(item.subject.color.opacity(0.15))
                    .overlay(
                        Capsule()
                            .strokeBorder(item.subject.color.opacity(0.3), lineWidth: 1)
                    )
            )
            .foregroundStyle(item.subject.color)

            Spacer()

            // Grade badge with subtle styling
            Text(item.grade.displayName)
                .font(.caption.weight(.medium))
                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                .padding(.horizontal, 10)
                .padding(.vertical, 6)
                .background(Color.semantic.secondaryBackground)
                .clipShape(Capsule())
        }
    }

    /// 图片区域
    @ViewBuilder
    var imageSection: some View {
        if let imageData = item.imageData {
            AsyncImageView(imageData: imageData)
                .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: DesignTokens.CornerRadius.lg))
                .overlay(
                    RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: DesignTokens.CornerRadius.lg)
                        .strokeBorder(Color.primary.opacity(0.08), lineWidth: 1)
                )
                .shadow(color: .black.opacity(0.08), radius: 12, x: 0, y: 4)
                .shadow(color: .black.opacity(0.04), radius: 4, x: 0, y: 2)
        }
    }

    /// 标题区域
    var titleSection: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.sm) {
            Text("review_question_label")
                .font(.caption.weight(.medium))
                .foregroundStyle(.tertiary)
                .textCase(.uppercase)
                .tracking(0.5)

            Text(item.title)
                .font(.title3)
                .fontWeight(.semibold)
                .lineSpacing(4)
        }
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
    }

    /// 答案区域
    @ViewBuilder
    var answerSection: some View {
        if !item.note.isEmpty {
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.md) {
                answerToggleButton

                if showAnswer {
                    Text(item.note)
                        .font(.body)
                        .padding(DesignTokens.Spacing.lg)
                        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
                        .background(Color.semantic.secondaryBackground)
                        .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: DesignTokens.CornerRadius.md))
                        .transition(.scale.combined(with: .opacity))
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /// 答案显示/隐藏按钮
    var answerToggleButton: some View {
        Button {
            withAnimation(DesignTokens.Animation.spring) {
                showAnswer.toggle()
            }
        } label: {
            HStack {
                Image(systemName: showAnswer ? "eye.slash.fill" : "eye.fill")
                    .symbolEffect(.bounce, value: showAnswer)
                Text(showAnswer ? "隐藏答案" : "查看答案")
                    .fontWeight(.semibold)
                Spacer()
                Image(systemName: "chevron.down")
                    .font(.caption.weight(.bold))
                    .rotationEffect(.degrees(showAnswer ? 180 : 0))
            }
            .padding(DesignTokens.Spacing.lg)
            .background(
                RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: DesignTokens.CornerRadius.md)
                    .fill(Color.brand.warning.opacity(0.12))
                    .overlay(
                        RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: DesignTokens.CornerRadius.md)
                            .strokeBorder(Color.brand.warning.opacity(0.25), lineWidth: 1)
                    )
            )
            .foregroundStyle(Color.brand.warning)
        }
        .buttonStyle(AnswerToggleButtonStyle())
        .accessibilityLabel(showAnswer ? "隐藏答案" : "查看答案")
    }

    /// 答案切换按钮样式
    private struct AnswerToggleButtonStyle: ButtonStyle {
        func makeBody(configuration: Configuration) -> some View {
            configuration.label
                .scaleEffect(configuration.isPressed ? 0.98 : 1.0)
                .opacity(configuration.isPressed ? 0.8 : 1.0)
                .animation(.spring(response: 0.25, dampingFraction: 0.7), value: configuration.isPressed)
        }
    }

    /// 元数据区域
    var metadataSection: some View {
        VStack(spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.md) {
            if !item.knowledgePoints.isEmpty {
                HStack {
                    Image(systemName: "lightbulb.fill")
                        .font(.caption)
                    Text(item.knowledgePoints.rawValue)
                        .font(.caption)
                    Spacer()
                }
                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            }

            HStack {
                Label("已复习 \(item.reviewCount) 次", systemImage: "clock.fill")
                    .font(.caption)
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)

                Spacer()

                MasteryBadge(
                    level: MasteryLevel(rawValue: item.masteryLevel) ?? .none,
                    showDetailText: true
                )
            }
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - MasteryButton

/// 单个评估按钮
struct MasteryButton: View {

    let icon: String
    let title: String
    let color: Color
    let action: () -> Void

    @State private var isPressed = false

    var body: some View {
        Button(action: action) {
            VStack(spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.sm) {
                // Icon with circle background
                ZStack {
                    Circle()
                        .fill(color.opacity(0.15))
                        .frame(width: 48, height: 48)

                    Image(systemName: icon)
                        .font(.title2)
                        .symbolEffect(.bounce, value: isPressed)
                        .accessibilityHidden(true)
                }

                Text(title)
                    .font(.caption)
                    .fontWeight(.semibold)
            }
            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
            .padding(.vertical, DesignTokens.Spacing.lg)
            .background(
                RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: DesignTokens.CornerRadius.lg)
                    .fill(color.opacity(0.08))
                    .overlay(
                        RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: DesignTokens.CornerRadius.lg)
                            .strokeBorder(color.opacity(0.2), lineWidth: 1)
                    )
            )
            .foregroundStyle(color)
        }
        .buttonStyle(MasteryButtonStyle(isPressed: $isPressed))
        .sensoryFeedback(.impact(weight: .medium), trigger: title)
        .accessibilityIdentifier(title)
        .accessibleButton(title, hint: "点击标记为\(title)")
    }
}

/// Mastery Button 按压样式
private struct MasteryButtonStyle: ButtonStyle {
    @Binding var isPressed: Bool

    func makeBody(configuration: Configuration) -> some View {
        configuration.label
            .scaleEffect(configuration.isPressed ? 0.95 : 1.0)
            .opacity(configuration.isPressed ? 0.9 : 1.0)
            .animation(.spring(response: 0.3, dampingFraction: 0.7), value: configuration.isPressed)
            .onChange(of: configuration.isPressed) { _, newValue in
                isPressed = newValue
            }
    }
}

//
//  ReviewComponents.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  Created for NotBad K12 错题本
//

import SwiftUI

// MARK: - ReviewContent

/// 复习内容视图
///
/// 使用懒加载机制，只渲染当前卡片及相邻卡片，
/// 避免一次性加载所有图片导致的性能问题。
struct ReviewContent: View {

    let items: [ReviewItem]
    @Binding var currentIndex: Int
    let onMasteryUpdate: (Int, MasteryLevel) -> Void
    
    /// 预加载范围（前后各几个）
    private let preloadRange = 1

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 0) {
            ProgressBar(current: currentIndex + 1, total: items.count)

            TabView(selection: $currentIndex) {
                ForEach(items.indices, id: \.self) { index in
                    // 懒加载：只渲染当前页及相邻页
                    LazyReviewCardView(
                        item: items[index],
                        index: index,
                        currentIndex: currentIndex,
                        preloadRange: preloadRange,
                        onMastered: { onMasteryUpdate(index, .mastered) },
                        onUnclear: { onMasteryUpdate(index, .glimpse) },
                        onFailed: { onMasteryUpdate(index, .none) }
                    )
                    .tag(index)
                }
            }
            .tabViewStyle(.page(indexDisplayMode: .never))
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - LazyReviewCardView

/// 懒加载复习卡片包装器
///
/// 只有当卡片进入预加载范围时才真正渲染内容，
/// 大幅减少初始加载时间和内存占用。
private struct LazyReviewCardView: View {
    let item: ReviewItem
    let index: Int
    let currentIndex: Int
    let preloadRange: Int
    let onMastered: () -> Void
    let onUnclear: () -> Void
    let onFailed: () -> Void
    
    /// 是否应该加载此卡片
    private var shouldLoad: Bool {
        abs(index - currentIndex) <= preloadRange
    }
    
    var body: some View {
        Group {
            if shouldLoad {
                ReviewCard(
                    item: item,
                    onMastered: onMastered,
                    onUnclear: onUnclear,
                    onFailed: onFailed
                )
            } else {
                // 占位视图，保持尺寸一致
                Color.clear
            }
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - ProgressBar

/// 进度条组件
struct ProgressBar: View {

    let current: Int
    let total: Int

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.md) {
            HStack {
                Text("review_progress_title")
                    .font(.subheadline)
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)

                Spacer()

                Text("\(current) / \(total)")
                    .font(.headline)
                    .foregroundStyle(Color.brand.primary)
            }

            ProgressView(value: Double(current), total: Double(total))
                .tint(Color.brand.primary)
        }
        .padding(DesignTokens.Spacing.lg)
        .background(Color.semantic.secondaryBackground)
        .accessibilityElement(children: .combine)
        .accessibilityLabel(String(format: String(localized: "review_progress_accessibility"), current, total))
        .accessibilityValue("\(Int(Double(current) / Double(total) * 100))%")
    }
}

import SwiftUI

// MARK: - RegionOptionButton

/// 地区选择按钮
///
/// 用于引导流程中选择教育体系地区。
struct RegionOptionButton: View {
    let region: EducationRegion
    let isSelected: Bool
    let action: () -> Void

    var body: some View {
        Button {
            // 触觉反馈
            let generator = UISelectionFeedbackGenerator()
            generator.selectionChanged()
            action()
        } label: {
            HStack(spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.md) {
                Text(region.flag)
                    .font(.largeTitle)

                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 2) {
                    Text(region.displayName)
                        .font(.headline)
                        .foregroundStyle(.primary)

                    Text(region.educationSystemDescription)
                        .font(.caption)
                        .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                }

                Spacer()

                if isSelected {
                    Image(systemName: "checkmark.circle.fill")
                        .font(.title2)
                        .foregroundStyle(Color.brand.primary)
                }
            }
            .padding(DesignTokens.Spacing.md)
            .background(
                RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: DesignTokens.CornerRadius.md)
                    .fill(Color.semantic.secondaryBackground)
            )
            .overlay(
                RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: DesignTokens.CornerRadius.md)
                    .strokeBorder(
                        isSelected ? Color.brand.primary : Color.clear,
                        lineWidth: 2
                    )
            )
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
        .accessibilityLabel(region.displayName)
        .accessibilityHint(region.educationSystemDescription)
        .accessibilityAddTraits(isSelected ? .isSelected : [])
    }
}

    let subject: Subject
    let isSelected: Bool
    let action: () -> Void
    
    var body: some View {
        Button {
            let generator = UISelectionFeedbackGenerator()
            generator.selectionChanged()
            action()
        } label: {
            VStack(spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.xs) {
                Image(systemName: subject.icon)
                    .font(.title3)
                    .foregroundStyle(isSelected ? .white : subject.color)

                    .font(.caption)
                    .foregroundStyle(isSelected ? .white : .primary)
                    .lineLimit(1)
                    .minimumScaleFactor(0.8)
            }
            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
            .frame(height: 70)
            .background(
                RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: DesignTokens.CornerRadius.sm)
                    .fill(isSelected ? subject.color : Color.semantic.secondaryBackground)
            )
            .overlay(
                RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: DesignTokens.CornerRadius.sm)
                    .strokeBorder(
                        isSelected ? subject.color : Color.semantic.separator,
                        lineWidth: isSelected ? 2 : 1
                    )
            )
            .overlay(alignment: .topTrailing) {
                if isSelected {
                    Image(systemName: "checkmark.circle.fill")
                        .font(.caption)
                        .foregroundStyle(.white)
                        .background(Circle().fill(subject.color))
                        .offset(x: 4, y: -4)
                }
            }
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
        .accessibilityLabel(subject.displayName)
        .accessibilityAddTraits(isSelected ? .isSelected : [])
    }
}

// MARK: - EducationRegion Extensions

extension EducationRegion {
    /// 教育体系描述（用于 Onboarding）
    var educationSystemDescription: String {
        switch self {
        case .china:
            return String(localized: "onboarding_education_system_china")
        case .japan:
            return String(localized: "onboarding_education_system_japan")
        case .korea:
            return String(localized: "onboarding_education_system_korea")
        case .singapore:
            return String(localized: "onboarding_education_system_singapore")
        case .international:
            return String(localized: "onboarding_education_system_international")
        case .usa:
            return String(localized: "onboarding_education_system_usa")
        default:
            return String(localized: "onboarding_education_system_other")
        }
    }
}

//
//  OnboardingView.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  首次启动引导视图
//

import SwiftUI

// MARK: - OnboardingView

/// 首次启动引导视图
///
/// 引导用户完成初始设置：
/// 1. 选择国家/地区（确定教育体系）
/// 2. 选择当前年级
/// 3. 选择学科（根据年级推荐）
struct OnboardingView: View {

    // MARK: - Environment

    @Environment(\.dismiss) private var dismiss

    // MARK: - State

    @State private var currentStep: OnboardingStep = .welcome
    @State private var selectedRegion: EducationRegion = .china
    @State private var selectedGrade: Grade = .grade7
    @State private var selectedSubjects: Set<Subject> = []
    
    // MARK: - Profile Manager
    
    @StateObject private var profileManager = UserProfileManager.shared

    // MARK: - Callbacks

    let onComplete: () -> Void

    // MARK: - Body

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 0) {
            // 进度指示器
            progressIndicator
                .padding(.top, DesignTokens.Spacing.lg)

            // 内容区域
            TabView(selection: $currentStep) {
                welcomeStep
                    .tag(OnboardingStep.welcome)

                regionStep
                    .tag(OnboardingStep.selectRegion)

                gradeStep
                    .tag(OnboardingStep.selectGrade)
                
                subjectStep
                    .tag(OnboardingStep.selectSubjects)
            }
            .tabViewStyle(.page(indexDisplayMode: .never))
            .animation(.easeInOut, value: currentStep)

            // 底部按钮
            bottomButton
                .padding(.horizontal, DesignTokens.Spacing.xl)
                .padding(.bottom, DesignTokens.Spacing.xl)
        }
        .background(Color.semantic.background)
    }

    // MARK: - Progress Indicator

    private var progressIndicator: some View {
        HStack(spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.sm) {
            ForEach(OnboardingStep.allCases) { step in
                Capsule()
                    .fill(step.rawValue <= currentStep.rawValue
                          ? Color.brand.primary
                          : Color.semantic.separator)
                    .frame(height: 4)
            }
        }
        .padding(.horizontal, DesignTokens.Spacing.xl)
    }

    // MARK: - Welcome Step

    private var welcomeStep: some View {
        VStack(spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.xl) {
            Spacer()

            // App 图标
            Image(systemName: "checkmark.circle.badge.xmark")
                .font(.system(size: 80))
                .foregroundStyle(Color.brand.primary)
                .symbolRenderingMode(.hierarchical)

            VStack(spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.md) {
                Text("onboarding_welcome_title")
                    .font(.largeTitle.bold())

                Text("onboarding_welcome_subtitle")
                    .font(.body)
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                    .multilineTextAlignment(.center)
                    .padding(.horizontal, DesignTokens.Spacing.xl)
            }

            Spacer()
            Spacer()
        }
    }

    // MARK: - Region Step

    private var regionStep: some View {
        VStack(spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.xl) {
            VStack(spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.md) {
                Image(systemName: "globe.asia.australia")
                    .font(.system(size: 60))
                    .foregroundStyle(Color.brand.primary)

                Text("onboarding_region_title")
                    .font(.title.bold())

                Text("onboarding_region_subtitle")
                    .font(.body)
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                    .multilineTextAlignment(.center)
            }
            .padding(.top, DesignTokens.Spacing.xl)

            // 地区选择
            ScrollView {
                VStack(spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.md) {
                    ForEach(EducationRegion.builtInRegions) { region in
                        RegionOptionButton(
                            region: region,
                            isSelected: selectedRegion == region,
                            action: { selectedRegion = region }
                        )
                    }
                }
                .padding(.horizontal, DesignTokens.Spacing.lg)
            }

            Spacer()
        }
    }

    // MARK: - Grade Step

    private var gradeStep: some View {
        VStack(spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.xl) {
            VStack(spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.md) {
                Image(systemName: "graduationcap")
                    .font(.system(size: 60))
                    .foregroundStyle(Color.brand.primary)

                Text("onboarding_grade_title")
                    .font(.title.bold())

                Text("onboarding_grade_subtitle")
                    .font(.body)
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                    .multilineTextAlignment(.center)
            }
            .padding(.top, DesignTokens.Spacing.xl)

            // 年级选择
            ScrollView {
                LazyVGrid(columns: [
                    GridItem(.flexible()),
                    GridItem(.flexible()),
                    GridItem(.flexible())
                ], spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.md) {
                    ForEach(availableGrades) { grade in
                        GradeOptionButton(
                            grade: grade,
                            isSelected: selectedGrade == grade,
                            action: { selectedGrade = grade }
                        )
                    }
                }
                .padding(.horizontal, DesignTokens.Spacing.lg)
            }
        }
    }
    
    // MARK: - Subject Step
    
    private var subjectStep: some View {
        VStack(spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.xl) {
            VStack(spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.md) {
                Image(systemName: "book.fill")
                    .font(.system(size: 60))
                    .foregroundStyle(Color.brand.primary)
                
                Text("onboarding_subject_title")
                    .font(.title.bold())
                
                Text("onboarding_subject_subtitle")
                    .font(.body)
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                    .multilineTextAlignment(.center)
                    .padding(.horizontal, DesignTokens.Spacing.lg)
            }
            .padding(.top, DesignTokens.Spacing.xl)
            
            // 学科选择
            ScrollView {
                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.lg) {
                    // 按分类显示适用于当前年级的学科
                    ForEach(SubjectCategory.allCases) { category in
                        let subjectsInCategory = recommendedSubjects.filter { $0.category == category }
                        
                        if !subjectsInCategory.isEmpty {
                            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.sm) {
                                Text(category.displayName)
                                    .font(.subheadline.bold())
                                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                                    .padding(.horizontal, DesignTokens.Spacing.xs)
                                
                                LazyVGrid(columns: [
                                    GridItem(.flexible()),
                                    GridItem(.flexible()),
                                    GridItem(.flexible())
                                ], spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.sm) {
                                    ForEach(subjectsInCategory) { subject in
                                        SubjectOptionButton(
                                            subject: subject,
                                            isSelected: selectedSubjects.contains(subject),
                                            action: { toggleSubject(subject) }
                                        )
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                .padding(.horizontal, DesignTokens.Spacing.lg)
            }
            
            // 已选学科数量提示
            if !selectedSubjects.isEmpty {
                Text("onboarding_subject_selected_count \(selectedSubjects.count)")
                    .font(.caption)
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                    .padding(.bottom, DesignTokens.Spacing.sm)
            }
        }
    }

    // MARK: - Bottom Button

    private var bottomButton: some View {
        Button {
            handleButtonTap()
        } label: {
            Text(buttonTitle)
                .font(.headline)
                .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
                .frame(height: 50)
                .background(Color.brand.primary)
                .foregroundStyle(.white)
                .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: DesignTokens.CornerRadius.md))
        }
    }

    // MARK: - Computed Properties

    private var buttonTitle: LocalizedStringKey {
        switch currentStep {
        case .welcome:
            return "onboarding_button_start"
        case .selectRegion:
            return "onboarding_button_next"
        case .selectGrade:
            return "onboarding_button_next"
        case .selectSubjects:
            return "onboarding_button_done"
        }
    }

    private var availableGrades: [Grade] {
        switch selectedRegion {
        case .china, .japan, .korea, .singapore:
            // 东亚地区：不含幼儿园
            return Grade.allCases.filter { $0 != .kindergarten }
        case .international, .usa:
            // 国际/美国：包含 K-12
            return Grade.allCases
        default:
            return Grade.allCases.filter { $0 != .kindergarten }
        }
    }
    
    /// 根据年级推荐的学科
    private var recommendedSubjects: [Subject] {
        Subject.subjects(for: selectedGrade.stage)
    }

    // MARK: - Actions
    
    private func toggleSubject(_ subject: Subject) {
        withAnimation(.spring(response: 0.3)) {
            if selectedSubjects.contains(subject) {
                selectedSubjects.remove(subject)
            } else {
                selectedSubjects.insert(subject)
            }
        }
    }

    private func handleButtonTap() {
        switch currentStep {
        case .welcome:
            withAnimation {
                currentStep = .selectRegion
            }
        case .selectRegion:
            // 保存地区设置
            EducationSystemManager.shared.switchTo(selectedRegion)
            withAnimation {
                currentStep = .selectGrade
            }
        case .selectGrade:
            // 根据年级预选推荐学科
            selectedSubjects = Set(recommendedSubjects)
            withAnimation {
                currentStep = .selectSubjects
            }
        case .selectSubjects:
            // 保存所有设置并完成
            UserDefaults.standard.set(selectedGrade.rawValue, forKey: "user_current_grade")
            UserDefaults.standard.set(true, forKey: "has_completed_onboarding")
            
            // 保存用户选择的学科
            profileManager.enabledSubjects = selectedSubjects.isEmpty 
                ? Set(recommendedSubjects)  // 如果用户没选，使用推荐学科
                : selectedSubjects
            
            onComplete()
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Preview

#Preview {
    OnboardingView {
        print("Onboarding completed")
    }
}

//
//  MainTabView.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  Created for NotBad K12 错题本
//

import SwiftUI

// MARK: - Tab

/// 应用 Tab 枚举
enum Tab: Int, CaseIterable, Identifiable, Sendable {
    case dashboard = 0
    case library = 1
    case capture = 2
    case review = 3
    case profile = 4

    var id: Int { rawValue }

    /// Tab 标题
    var title: LocalizedStringKey {
        switch self {
        case .dashboard: "tab_dashboard"
        case .library: "tab_library"
        case .capture: "tab_capture"
        case .review: "tab_review"
        case .profile: "tab_profile"
        }
    }

    /// 默认图标
    var icon: String {
        switch self {
        case .dashboard: "house"
        case .library: "books.vertical"
        case .capture: "plus.circle"
        case .review: "sparkles"
        case .profile: "person.crop.circle"
        }
    }

    /// 选中状态图标
    var selectedIcon: String {
        switch self {
        case .dashboard: "house.fill"
        case .library: "books.vertical.fill"
        case .capture: "plus.circle.fill"
        case .review: "sparkles"
        case .profile: "person.crop.circle.fill"
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - MainTabView

/// 主界面 Tab 视图
///
/// 应用的核心导航结构，包含五个主要功能 Tab。
///
/// ## Tab 结构
///
/// 1. **首页** - 数据看板和快捷操作
/// 2. **题库** - 错题列表和管理
/// 3. **录入** - 快速录入新错题
/// 4. **复习** - 智能复习模式
/// 5. **我的** - 个人中心和设置
struct MainTabView: View {

    // MARK: - Bindings

    /// 外部 Tab 选择绑定（用于 Deep Link）
    @Binding var selectedTab: Int

    // MARK: - State

    @State private var currentTab: Tab = .dashboard
    
    // 预加载各 Tab 视图，避免切换时重新创建
    @State private var loadedTabs: Set<Tab> = [.dashboard]

    // MARK: - Init

    init(selectedTab: Binding<Int> = .constant(0)) {
        _selectedTab = selectedTab
    }

    // MARK: - Body

    var body: some View {
        TabView(selection: $currentTab) {
            ForEach(Tab.allCases) { tab in
                LazyTabContent(tab: tab, isLoaded: loadedTabs.contains(tab))
                    .tabItem {
                        tabLabel(for: tab)
                    }
                    .tag(tab)
            }
        }
        .tint(Color.brand.primary)
        .onChange(of: currentTab) { _, newValue in
            // 标记当前 Tab 为已加载
            loadedTabs.insert(newValue)
            selectedTab = newValue.rawValue
        }
        .onChange(of: selectedTab) { _, newValue in
            if let tab = Tab(rawValue: newValue) {
                currentTab = tab
            }
        }
        .onReceive(NotificationCenter.default.publisher(for: .switchToCapture)) { _ in
            currentTab = .capture
        }
        .onReceive(NotificationCenter.default.publisher(for: .switchToReview)) { _ in
            currentTab = .review
        }
        .onReceive(NotificationCenter.default.publisher(for: .switchToLibrary)) { _ in
            currentTab = .library
        }
        .task {
            // 后台预加载其他 Tab（延迟执行，不阻塞首屏）
            try? await Task.sleep(for: .milliseconds(500))
            await MainActor.run {
                loadedTabs = Set(Tab.allCases)
            }
        }
    }

    // MARK: - Tab Label

    private func tabLabel(for tab: Tab) -> some View {
        let isSelected = currentTab == tab

        return Label {
            Text(tab.title)
        } icon: {
            Image(systemName: isSelected ? tab.selectedIcon : tab.icon)
        }
        .accessibilityLabel(tab.title)
    }
}

// MARK: - Lazy Tab Content

/// 懒加载 Tab 内容容器
private struct LazyTabContent: View {
    let tab: Tab
    let isLoaded: Bool
    
    var body: some View {
        if isLoaded {
            tabView
        } else {
            // 占位视图，防止布局跳动
            Color.clear
                .overlay {
                    ProgressView()
                        .scaleEffect(0.8)
                }
        }
    }
    
    @ViewBuilder
    private var tabView: some View {
        switch tab {
        case .dashboard:
            DashboardView()
        case .library:
            LibraryView()
        case .capture:
            CaptureView()
        case .review:
            ReviewView()
        case .profile:
            ProfileView()
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Preview

#Preview {
    MainTabView()
        .modelContainer(for: ReviewItem.self, inMemory: true)
}

//
//  AdaptiveNavigationView.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  Created for NotBad K12 错题本
//  iPad 自适应导航视图

import SwiftUI

// MARK: - Sidebar Item

/// 侧边栏导航项
enum SidebarItem: Int, CaseIterable, Identifiable, Hashable {
    case dashboard = 0
    case library = 1
    case capture = 2
    case review = 3
    case profile = 4
    
    var id: Int { rawValue }
    
    /// 标题
    var title: LocalizedStringKey {
        switch self {
        case .dashboard: "tab_dashboard"
        case .library: "tab_library"
        case .capture: "tab_capture"
        case .review: "tab_review"
        case .profile: "tab_profile"
        }
    }
    
    /// 图标
    var icon: String {
        switch self {
        case .dashboard: "house"
        case .library: "books.vertical"
        case .capture: "plus.circle"
        case .review: "sparkles"
        case .profile: "person.crop.circle"
        }
    }
    
    /// 选中图标
    var selectedIcon: String {
        switch self {
        case .dashboard: "house.fill"
        case .library: "books.vertical.fill"
        case .capture: "plus.circle.fill"
        case .review: "sparkles"
        case .profile: "person.crop.circle.fill"
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - AdaptiveNavigationView

/// iPad 自适应导航视图
///
/// 在 iPad 上使用 NavigationSplitView 提供侧边栏导航，
/// 在 iPhone 上回退到标准 TabView 导航。
///
/// ## 功能特性
///
/// - iPad: 双栏布局，左侧为功能导航，右侧为详细内容
/// - iPhone: 标准底部 Tab 导航
/// - 自动响应设备类型和屏幕尺寸
///
/// ## 使用示例
///
/// ```swift
/// AdaptiveNavigationView()
///     .modelContainer(for: ReviewItem.self)
/// ```
struct AdaptiveNavigationView: View {
    
    // MARK: - Environment
    
    /// 水平尺寸类
    @Environment(\.horizontalSizeClass) private var horizontalSizeClass
    
    // MARK: - State
    
    /// 当前选中的侧边栏项
    @State private var selectedSidebarItem: SidebarItem? = .dashboard
    
    /// Tab 选择绑定（用于 Deep Link）
    @Binding var selectedTab: Int
    
    /// 侧边栏可见性
    @State private var columnVisibility: NavigationSplitViewVisibility = .all
    
    // MARK: - Init
    
    init(selectedTab: Binding<Int>) {
        _selectedTab = selectedTab
    }
    
    // MARK: - Body
    
    var body: some View {
        Group {
            if horizontalSizeClass == .regular {
                // iPad: 使用 NavigationSplitView
                iPadLayout
            } else {
                // iPhone: 使用 TabView
                MainTabView(selectedTab: $selectedTab)
            }
        }
        .onChange(of: selectedTab) { _, newValue in
            if let item = SidebarItem(rawValue: newValue) {
                selectedSidebarItem = item
            }
        }
        .onChange(of: selectedSidebarItem) { _, newValue in
            if let item = newValue {
                selectedTab = item.rawValue
            }
        }
        .onReceive(NotificationCenter.default.publisher(for: .switchToCapture)) { _ in
            handleDeepLink(.capture)
        }
        .onReceive(NotificationCenter.default.publisher(for: .switchToReview)) { _ in
            handleDeepLink(.review)
        }
        .onReceive(NotificationCenter.default.publisher(for: .switchToLibrary)) { _ in
            handleDeepLink(.library)
        }
        // Handoff Support
        .userActivity(UserActivityType.viewDashboard, isActive: isCurrent(.dashboard)) { activity in
            activity.title = String(localized: "tab_dashboard")
        }
        .userActivity(UserActivityType.viewLibrary, isActive: isCurrent(.library)) { activity in
            activity.title = String(localized: "tab_library")
        }
        .userActivity(UserActivityType.captureItem, isActive: isCurrent(.capture)) { activity in
            activity.title = String(localized: "tab_capture")
        }
        .userActivity(UserActivityType.reviewSession, isActive: isCurrent(.review)) { activity in
            activity.title = String(localized: "tab_review")
        }
        .userActivity(UserActivityType.viewProfile, isActive: isCurrent(.profile)) { activity in
            activity.title = String(localized: "tab_profile")
        }
    }
    
    // MARK: - Helper
    
    private func isCurrent(_ item: SidebarItem) -> Bool {
        if horizontalSizeClass == .regular {
            return selectedSidebarItem == item
        } else {
            return selectedTab == item.rawValue
        }
    }
    
    // MARK: - iPad Layout
    
    /// iPad 双栏布局
    private var iPadLayout: some View {
        NavigationSplitView(columnVisibility: $columnVisibility) {
            // 侧边栏
            sidebarContent
                .navigationTitle("app_name")
        } detail: {
            // 详细内容
            detailContent
        }
        .navigationSplitViewStyle(.balanced)
        .tint(Color.brand.primary)
    }
    
    // MARK: - Sidebar Content
    
    /// 侧边栏内容
    private var sidebarContent: some View {
        List(selection: $selectedSidebarItem) {
            // 主要功能区
            Section {
                ForEach(SidebarItem.allCases.prefix(4)) { item in
                    sidebarRow(for: item)
                }
            } header: {
                Text("sidebar_section_main")
            }
            
            // 设置区
            Section {
                sidebarRow(for: .profile)
            } header: {
                Text("sidebar_section_settings")
            }
        }
        .listStyle(.sidebar)
    }
    
    /// 侧边栏行
    private func sidebarRow(for item: SidebarItem) -> some View {
        Label {
            Text(item.title)
        } icon: {
            Image(systemName: selectedSidebarItem == item ? item.selectedIcon : item.icon)
                .foregroundStyle(selectedSidebarItem == item ? Color.brand.primary : .secondary)
        }
        .tag(item)
        .accessibilityLabel(item.title)
    }
    
    // MARK: - Detail Content
    
    /// 详细内容视图
    @ViewBuilder
    private var detailContent: some View {
        switch selectedSidebarItem {
        case .dashboard:
            DashboardView()
        case .library:
            LibraryView()
        case .capture:
            CaptureView()
        case .review:
            ReviewView()
        case .profile:
            ProfileView()
        case .none:
            // 默认显示 Dashboard
            DashboardView()
        }
    }
    
    // MARK: - Deep Link
    
    /// 处理 Deep Link 导航
    private func handleDeepLink(_ item: SidebarItem) {
        if horizontalSizeClass == .regular {
            selectedSidebarItem = item
        } else {
            selectedTab = item.rawValue
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Preview

        .modelContainer(for: ReviewItem.self, inMemory: true)
}

#Preview("iPhone Layout") {
    AdaptiveNavigationView(selectedTab: .constant(0))
        .modelContainer(for: ReviewItem.self, inMemory: true)
}

//
//  AdaptiveLayout.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  自适应布局工具
//

import SwiftUI

// MARK: - Device Environment

/// 设备环境信息
@MainActor
struct DeviceEnvironment {

    /// 当前设备是否为 iPad
    static var isIPad: Bool {
        UIDevice.current.userInterfaceIdiom == .pad
    }

    /// 当前设备是否为 iPhone
    static var isIPhone: Bool {
        UIDevice.current.userInterfaceIdiom == .phone
    }

    /// 当前是否为横屏
    static var isLandscape: Bool {
        UIDevice.current.orientation.isLandscape
    }

    /// 获取推荐的列数
    static func recommendedColumns(for width: CGFloat) -> Int {
        switch width {
        case ..<400:
            return 1
        case 400..<700:
            return 2
        case 700..<1000:
            return 3
        default:
            return 4
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Adaptive Grid

/// 自适应网格布局
struct AdaptiveGrid<Content: View, Item: Identifiable>: View {

    let items: [Item]
    let content: (Item) -> Content

    @Environment(\.horizontalSizeClass) private var sizeClass

    init(items: [Item], @ViewBuilder content: @escaping (Item) -> Content) {
        self.items = items
        self.content = content
    }

    var body: some View {
        GeometryReader { geometry in
            let columns = DeviceEnvironment.recommendedColumns(for: geometry.size.width)

            ScrollView {
                LazyVGrid(
                    columns: Array(repeating: GridItem(.flexible(), spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.md), count: columns),
                    spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.md
                ) {
                    ForEach(items) { item in
                        content(item)
                    }
                }
                .padding(DesignTokens.Spacing.md)
            }
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Sidebar Adaptive View

/// 侧边栏自适应视图
///
/// 在 iPad 上显示侧边栏，在 iPhone 上显示 Tab 栏
struct SidebarAdaptiveView<Sidebar: View, Content: View>: View {

    @Environment(\.horizontalSizeClass) private var sizeClass

    let sidebar: () -> Sidebar
    let content: () -> Content

    init(
        @ViewBuilder sidebar: @escaping () -> Sidebar,
        @ViewBuilder content: @escaping () -> Content
    ) {
        self.sidebar = sidebar
        self.content = content
    }

    var body: some View {
        if sizeClass == .regular {
            NavigationSplitView {
                sidebar()
            } detail: {
                content()
            }
        } else {
            content()
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Adaptive Spacing

/// 自适应间距
struct AdaptiveSpacing {

    @Environment(\.horizontalSizeClass) private var sizeClass

    /// 获取自适应间距
    static func spacing(for sizeClass: UserInterfaceSizeClass?) -> CGFloat {
        switch sizeClass {
        case .regular:
            return DesignTokens.Spacing.lg
        default:
            return DesignTokens.Spacing.md
        }
    }

    /// 获取自适应 Padding
    static func padding(for sizeClass: UserInterfaceSizeClass?) -> EdgeInsets {
        switch sizeClass {
        case .regular:
            return EdgeInsets(
                top: DesignTokens.Spacing.lg,
                leading: DesignTokens.Spacing.xl,
                bottom: DesignTokens.Spacing.lg,
                trailing: DesignTokens.Spacing.xl
            )
        default:
            return EdgeInsets(
                top: DesignTokens.Spacing.md,
                leading: DesignTokens.Spacing.md,
                bottom: DesignTokens.Spacing.md,
                trailing: DesignTokens.Spacing.md
            )
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Adaptive Width Modifier

/// 自适应最大宽度修饰器
struct AdaptiveWidthModifier: ViewModifier {

    @Environment(\.horizontalSizeClass) private var sizeClass

    let maxWidth: CGFloat

    func body(content: Content) -> some View {
        if sizeClass == .regular {
            content
                .frame(maxWidth: maxWidth)
        } else {
            content
        }
    }
}

extension View {

    /// 应用自适应最大宽度
    func adaptiveMaxWidth(_ maxWidth: CGFloat = 700) -> some View {
        modifier(AdaptiveWidthModifier(maxWidth: maxWidth))
    }
}

// MARK: - Responsive Font

/// 响应式字体
extension Font {

    /// 自适应标题字体
    static func adaptiveTitle(for sizeClass: UserInterfaceSizeClass?) -> Font {
        switch sizeClass {
        case .regular:
            return .largeTitle
        default:
            return .title
        }
    }

    /// 自适应正文字体
    static func adaptiveBody(for sizeClass: UserInterfaceSizeClass?) -> Font {
        switch sizeClass {
        case .regular:
            return .title3
        default:
            return .body
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - iPad Optimized List Style

/// iPad 优化的列表样式
struct IPadOptimizedListStyle: ViewModifier {

    @Environment(\.horizontalSizeClass) private var sizeClass

    func body(content: Content) -> some View {
        if sizeClass == .regular {
            content
                .listStyle(.insetGrouped)
        } else {
            content
                .listStyle(.plain)
        }
    }
}

extension View {

    /// 应用 iPad 优化的列表样式
    func iPadOptimizedListStyle() -> some View {
        modifier(IPadOptimizedListStyle())
    }
}

//
//  Accessibility.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  无障碍辅助扩展
//

import SwiftUI

// MARK: - View Accessibility Extensions

extension View {

    /// 标记为按钮并添加无障碍标签
    ///
    /// - Parameters:
    ///   - label: 无障碍标签（VoiceOver 朗读）
    ///   - hint: 无障碍提示（可选）
    /// - Returns: 添加无障碍特征的视图
    ///
    /// ## 使用示例
    /// ```swift
    /// Button(action: {}) {
    ///     Image(systemName: "plus")
    /// }
    /// .accessibleButton("添加错题", hint: "点击后进入拍照界面")
    /// ```
    func accessibleButton(_ label: String, hint: String? = nil) -> some View {
        self
            .accessibilityLabel(label)
            .accessibilityHint(hint ?? "")
            .accessibilityAddTraits(.isButton)
    }

    /// 标记为图片并添加无障碍标签
    ///
    /// - Parameter label: 图片描述
    /// - Returns: 添加无障碍特征的视图
    func accessibleImage(_ label: String) -> some View {
        self
            .accessibilityLabel(label)
            .accessibilityAddTraits(.isImage)
    }

    /// 标记为标题
    ///
    /// - Parameter level: 标题级别（默认无指定级别）
    /// - Returns: 添加标题特征的视图
    func accessibleHeader() -> some View {
        self.accessibilityAddTraits(.isHeader)
    }

    /// 标记为静态文本（纯装饰性）
    ///
    /// - Returns: 对辅助技术隐藏的视图
    func accessibleDecorative() -> some View {
        self.accessibilityHidden(true)
    }

    /// 添加无障碍值
    ///
    /// - Parameters:
    ///   - value: 当前值
    ///   - label: 值的描述
    /// - Returns: 添加无障碍值的视图
    ///
    /// ## 使用示例
    /// ```swift
    /// ProgressView(value: 0.75)
    ///     .accessibleValue("75%", label: "完成进度")
    /// ```
    func accessibleValue(_ value: String, label: String? = nil) -> some View {
        self
            .accessibilityValue(value)
            .accessibilityLabel(label ?? "")
    }

    /// 组合多个元素为一个无障碍单元
    ///
    /// - Parameter label: 组合后的标签
    /// - Returns: 组合后的视图
    ///
    /// ## 使用示例
    /// ```swift
    /// HStack {
    ///     Image(systemName: "star.fill")
    ///     Text("128")
    ///     Text("错题")
    /// }
    /// .accessibleCombined("128道错题")
    /// ```
    func accessibleCombined(_ label: String) -> some View {
        self
            .accessibilityElement(children: .combine)
            .accessibilityLabel(label)
    }

    /// 忽略子元素的无障碍信息
    ///
    /// - Parameter label: 自定义标签
    /// - Returns: 忽略子元素的视图
    func accessibleIgnoreChildren(_ label: String) -> some View {
        self
            .accessibilityElement(children: .ignore)
            .accessibilityLabel(label)
    }
}

// MARK: - Scaled Icon Sizes

/// 支持 Dynamic Type 的图标尺寸
///
/// 在视图中使用 @ScaledMetric 时参考这些基准值。
///
/// ## 使用示例
/// ```swift
/// struct MyView: View {
///     @ScaledMetric private var iconSize = IconSizeToken.large
///     
///     var body: some View {
///         Image(systemName: "star")
///             .font(.system(size: iconSize))
///     }
/// }
/// ```
enum IconSizeToken {
    /// 小图标（16pt）
    static let small: CGFloat = 16
    /// 中等图标（24pt）
    static let medium: CGFloat = 24
    /// 大图标（32pt）
    static let large: CGFloat = 32
    /// 超大图标（48pt）
    static let extraLarge: CGFloat = 48
    /// 巨大图标（64pt）
    static let huge: CGFloat = 64
}

// MARK: - Accessibility Announcements

/// 无障碍公告工具
@MainActor
enum AccessibilityAnnouncement {

    /// 发送无障碍公告
    ///
    /// - Parameter message: 要朗读的消息
    static func announce(_ message: String) {
        UIAccessibility.post(notification: .announcement, argument: message)
    }

    /// 发送屏幕变化通知
    ///
    /// - Parameter element: 新获得焦点的元素（可选）
    static func screenChanged(_ element: Any? = nil) {
        UIAccessibility.post(notification: .screenChanged, argument: element)
    }

    /// 发送布局变化通知
    ///
    /// - Parameter element: 新获得焦点的元素（可选）
    static func layoutChanged(_ element: Any? = nil) {
        UIAccessibility.post(notification: .layoutChanged, argument: element)
    }
}

// MARK: - Reduce Motion Support

extension View {

    /// 根据减少动态效果设置应用动画
    ///
    /// - Parameters:
    ///   - animation: 正常动画
    ///   - reducedAnimation: 减少动态效果时的动画
    ///   - value: 触发动画的值
    /// - Returns: 应用动画的视图
    func animationRespectingMotion<V: Equatable>(
        _ animation: Animation?,
        reduced reducedAnimation: Animation? = nil,
        value: V
    ) -> some View {
        self.modifier(ReducedMotionAnimationModifier(
            animation: animation,
            reducedAnimation: reducedAnimation,
            value: value
        ))
    }
}

/// 减少动态效果动画修饰器
private struct ReducedMotionAnimationModifier<V: Equatable>: ViewModifier {
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    let animation: Animation?
    let reducedAnimation: Animation?
    let value: V

    func body(content: Content) -> some View {
        content.animation(
            reduceMotion ? reducedAnimation : animation,
            value: value
        )
    }
}

//
//  CardStyles.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  统一卡片样式定义
//

import SwiftUI

// MARK: - CardModifier

/// 卡片样式修饰器
///
/// 为视图添加统一的卡片外观。
///
/// ## 使用示例
///
/// ```swift
/// VStack {
///     Text("卡片内容")
/// }
/// .cardStyle()
/// ```
struct CardModifier: ViewModifier {

    /// 卡片样式变体
    var variant: CardVariant = .elevated

    /// 内边距
    var padding: CGFloat = DesignTokens.Spacing.lg

    func body(content: Content) -> some View {
        content
            .padding(padding)
            .background(variant.background)
            .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: DesignTokens.CornerRadius.lg))
            .overlay(
                RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: DesignTokens.CornerRadius.lg)
                    .strokeBorder(variant.borderColor, lineWidth: variant.borderWidth)
            )
            .shadow(variant.shadow)
    }
}

// MARK: - CardVariant

/// 卡片样式变体
enum CardVariant {
    /// 浮起卡片 - 有阴影
    case elevated

    /// 扁平卡片 - 无阴影
    case flat

    /// 边框卡片 - 有边框
    case outlined

    /// 填充卡片 - 强调背景
    case filled

    var background: Color {
        switch self {
        case .elevated, .flat, .outlined:
            return Color.semantic.secondaryBackground
        case .filled:
            return Color.brand.primary.opacity(0.08)
        }
    }

    var shadow: ShadowStyle {
        switch self {
        case .elevated:
            return DesignTokens.Shadow.light
        case .flat, .outlined, .filled:
            return ShadowStyle(color: .clear, radius: 0, x: 0, y: 0)
        }
    }

    var borderColor: Color {
        switch self {
        case .outlined:
            return Color.semantic.separator
        case .filled:
            return Color.brand.primary.opacity(0.2)
        default:
            return .clear
        }
    }

    var borderWidth: CGFloat {
        switch self {
        case .outlined, .filled:
            return 1
        default:
            return 0
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - View Extension

extension View {

    /// 应用卡片样式
    ///
    /// - Parameters:
    ///   - variant: 卡片变体，默认浮起
    ///   - padding: 内边距
    /// - Returns: 应用卡片样式后的视图
    func cardStyle(
        _ variant: CardVariant = .elevated,
        padding: CGFloat = DesignTokens.Spacing.lg
    ) -> some View {
        modifier(CardModifier(variant: variant, padding: padding))
    }
}

// MARK: - ActionCard

/// 操作卡片组件
///
/// 带有点击操作的卡片。
struct ActionCard<Content: View>: View {

    let action: () -> Void
    @ViewBuilder let content: () -> Content

    var variant: CardVariant = .elevated

    var body: some View {
        Button(action: action) {
            content()
                .cardStyle(variant)
        }
        .buttonStyle(ScaleButtonStyle())
    }
}

// MARK: - ScaleButtonStyle

/// 缩放按钮样式
///
/// 点击时轻微缩放的按钮效果。
struct ScaleButtonStyle: ButtonStyle {
    func makeBody(configuration: Configuration) -> some View {
        configuration.label
            .scaleEffect(configuration.isPressed ? 0.97 : 1)
            .animation(DesignTokens.Animation.fast, value: configuration.isPressed)
    }
}

#Preview("Card Variants") {

            Text("浮起卡片，有阴影")

            Text("Flat").font(.caption).foregroundStyle(.secondary)

            Text("Outlined").font(.caption).foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            Text("边框卡片，有边框")
                .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
                .cardStyle(.outlined)

            Text("Filled").font(.caption).foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            Text("填充卡片，强调背景")
                .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
                .cardStyle(.filled)
        }
        .padding()
    }
}

//
//  ButtonStyles.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  统一按钮样式定义
//

import SwiftUI

// MARK: - PrimaryButtonStyle

/// 主要按钮样式
///
/// 用于最重要的操作，如「保存」「开始复习」。
///
/// ## 使用示例
///
/// ```swift
/// Button("保存") {
///     save()
/// }
/// .buttonStyle(.primary)
/// ```
struct PrimaryButtonStyle: ButtonStyle {

    @Environment(\.isEnabled) private var isEnabled

    /// 是否全宽
    var fullWidth: Bool = false

    /// 尺寸
    var size: ButtonSize = .medium

    func makeBody(configuration: Configuration) -> some View {
        configuration.label
            .font(size.font)
            .fontWeight(.semibold)
            .foregroundStyle(.white)
            .padding(.horizontal, size.horizontalPadding)
            .padding(.vertical, size.verticalPadding)
            .frame(maxWidth: fullWidth ? .infinity : nil)
            .background(
                RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: size.cornerRadius)
                    .fill(backgroundColor(isPressed: configuration.isPressed))
            )
            .scaleEffect(configuration.isPressed ? 0.97 : 1)
            .animation(DesignTokens.Animation.fast, value: configuration.isPressed)
    }

    private func backgroundColor(isPressed: Bool) -> Color {
        if !isEnabled {
            return .gray.opacity(0.3)
        }
        if isPressed {
            return Color.brand.primary.opacity(0.8)
        }
        return Color.brand.primary
    }
}

// MARK: - SecondaryButtonStyle

/// 次要按钮样式
///
/// 用于次要操作，如「取消」「跳过」。
struct SecondaryButtonStyle: ButtonStyle {

    @Environment(\.isEnabled) private var isEnabled

    var size: ButtonSize = .medium

    func makeBody(configuration: Configuration) -> some View {
        configuration.label
            .font(size.font)
            .fontWeight(.medium)
            .foregroundStyle(isEnabled ? Color.brand.primary : .gray)
            .padding(.horizontal, size.horizontalPadding)
            .padding(.vertical, size.verticalPadding)
            .background(
                RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: size.cornerRadius)
                    .fill(backgroundColor(isPressed: configuration.isPressed))
            )
            .overlay(
                RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: size.cornerRadius)
                    .strokeBorder(isEnabled ? Color.brand.primary : .gray, lineWidth: 1.5)
            )
            .scaleEffect(configuration.isPressed ? 0.97 : 1)
            .animation(DesignTokens.Animation.fast, value: configuration.isPressed)
    }

    private func backgroundColor(isPressed: Bool) -> Color {
        isPressed ? Color.brand.primary.opacity(0.1) : .clear
    }
}

// MARK: - GhostButtonStyle

/// 幽灵按钮样式
///
/// 用于低优先级操作或密集布局中的按钮。
struct GhostButtonStyle: ButtonStyle {

    @Environment(\.isEnabled) private var isEnabled

    var size: ButtonSize = .medium

    func makeBody(configuration: Configuration) -> some View {
        configuration.label
            .font(size.font)
            .fontWeight(.medium)
            .foregroundStyle(foregroundColor(isPressed: configuration.isPressed))
            .padding(.horizontal, size.horizontalPadding)
            .padding(.vertical, size.verticalPadding)
            .background(
                RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: size.cornerRadius)
                    .fill(configuration.isPressed ? Color.gray.opacity(0.1) : .clear)
            )
            .scaleEffect(configuration.isPressed ? 0.97 : 1)
            .animation(DesignTokens.Animation.fast, value: configuration.isPressed)
    }

    private func foregroundColor(isPressed: Bool) -> Color {
        if !isEnabled { return .gray }
        return isPressed ? Color.brand.primary.opacity(0.7) : Color.brand.primary
    }
}

// MARK: - DestructiveButtonStyle

/// 危险按钮样式
///
/// 用于删除、重置等破坏性操作。
struct DestructiveButtonStyle: ButtonStyle {

    @Environment(\.isEnabled) private var isEnabled

    var size: ButtonSize = .medium

    func makeBody(configuration: Configuration) -> some View {
        configuration.label
            .font(size.font)
            .fontWeight(.semibold)
            .foregroundStyle(.white)
            .padding(.horizontal, size.horizontalPadding)
            .padding(.vertical, size.verticalPadding)
            .background(
                RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: size.cornerRadius)
                    .fill(backgroundColor(isPressed: configuration.isPressed))
            )
            .scaleEffect(configuration.isPressed ? 0.97 : 1)
            .animation(DesignTokens.Animation.fast, value: configuration.isPressed)
    }

    private func backgroundColor(isPressed: Bool) -> Color {
        if !isEnabled { return .gray.opacity(0.3) }
        return isPressed ? Color.brand.error.opacity(0.8) : Color.brand.error
    }
}

// MARK: - IconButtonStyle

/// 图标按钮样式
///
/// 用于工具栏或紧凑布局中的纯图标按钮。
struct IconButtonStyle: ButtonStyle {

    @Environment(\.isEnabled) private var isEnabled

    /// 按钮尺寸
    var size: CGFloat = 44

    /// 是否有背景
    var hasBackground: Bool = true

    func makeBody(configuration: Configuration) -> some View {
        configuration.label
            .font(.system(size: size * 0.45))
            .foregroundStyle(isEnabled ? Color.brand.primary : .gray)
            .frame(width: size, height: size)
            .background(
                Circle()
                    .fill(backgroundColor(isPressed: configuration.isPressed))
            )
            .scaleEffect(configuration.isPressed ? 0.9 : 1)
            .animation(DesignTokens.Animation.fast, value: configuration.isPressed)
    }

    private func backgroundColor(isPressed: Bool) -> Color {
        guard hasBackground else { return .clear }
        return isPressed ? Color.brand.primary.opacity(0.15) : Color.brand.primary.opacity(0.1)
    }
}

// MARK: - ButtonSize

/// 按钮尺寸
enum ButtonSize {
    case small
    case medium
    case large

    var font: Font {
        switch self {
        case .small: .subheadline
        case .medium: .body
        case .large: .title3
        }
    }

    var horizontalPadding: CGFloat {
        switch self {
        case .small: 12
        case .medium: 20
        case .large: 28
        }
    }

    var verticalPadding: CGFloat {
        switch self {
        case .small: 8
        case .medium: 12
        case .large: 16
        }
    }

    var cornerRadius: CGFloat {
        switch self {
        case .small: DesignTokens.CornerRadius.sm
        case .medium: DesignTokens.CornerRadius.md
        case .large: DesignTokens.CornerRadius.lg
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - ButtonStyle Extensions

extension ButtonStyle where Self == PrimaryButtonStyle {
    /// 主要按钮样式
    static var primary: PrimaryButtonStyle { PrimaryButtonStyle() }

    /// 主要按钮样式（全宽）
    static var primaryFullWidth: PrimaryButtonStyle { PrimaryButtonStyle(fullWidth: true) }

    /// 主要按钮样式（小尺寸）
    static var primarySmall: PrimaryButtonStyle { PrimaryButtonStyle(size: .small) }
}

extension ButtonStyle where Self == SecondaryButtonStyle {
    /// 次要按钮样式
    static var secondary: SecondaryButtonStyle { SecondaryButtonStyle() }

    /// 次要按钮样式（小尺寸）
    static var secondarySmall: SecondaryButtonStyle { SecondaryButtonStyle(size: .small) }
}

extension ButtonStyle where Self == GhostButtonStyle {
    /// 幽灵按钮样式
    static var ghost: GhostButtonStyle { GhostButtonStyle() }
}

extension ButtonStyle where Self == DestructiveButtonStyle {
    /// 危险按钮样式
    static var destructive: DestructiveButtonStyle { DestructiveButtonStyle() }
}

//
//  Theme.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  品牌色系与设计令牌定义

import SwiftUI

// MARK: - Brand Colors

/// 品牌色系扩展
extension Color {

    /// 品牌色系命名空间
    static let brand = BrandColors()

    /// 语义色系命名空间
    static let semantic = SemanticColors()
}

// MARK: - BrandColors

/// 品牌色系
struct BrandColors {

    /// 主色 - 蓝紫色 (#4275F9)
    let primary = Color("BrandPrimary")

    /// 辅助色 - 橙黄色 (#FFC766)
    let secondary = Color("BrandSecondary")

    /// 成功色 - 绿色 (#33C766)
    let success = Color("BrandSuccess")

    /// 警告色 - 橙色 (#FF9933)
    let warning = Color("BrandWarning")

    /// 错误色 - 红色 (#EF4C4C)
    let error = Color("BrandError")
}

// MARK: - SemanticColors

/// 语义色系
struct SemanticColors {

    /// 主背景色
    var background: Color { Color(uiColor: .systemBackground) }

    /// 次级背景色
    var secondaryBackground: Color { Color(uiColor: .secondarySystemBackground) }

    /// 第三级背景色
    var tertiaryBackground: Color { Color(uiColor: .tertiarySystemBackground) }

    /// 分组背景色
    var groupedBackground: Color { Color(uiColor: .systemGroupedBackground) }

    /// 主文本色
    var text: Color { Color(uiColor: .label) }

    /// 次级文本色
    var secondaryText: Color { Color(uiColor: .secondaryLabel) }

    /// 第三级文本色
    var tertiaryText: Color { Color(uiColor: .tertiaryLabel) }

    /// 占位文本色
    var placeholderText: Color { Color(uiColor: .placeholderText) }

    /// 分隔线颜色
    var separator: Color { Color(uiColor: .separator) }

    /// 不透明分隔线
    var opaqueSeparator: Color { Color(uiColor: .opaqueSeparator) }
}

// MARK: - Design Tokens

/// 设计令牌
enum DesignTokens {

    // MARK: - Spacing

    enum Spacing {
        static let xs: CGFloat = 4
        static let sm: CGFloat = 8
        static let md: CGFloat = 12
        static let lg: CGFloat = 16
        static let xl: CGFloat = 24
        static let xxl: CGFloat = 32
    }

    // MARK: - Corner Radius

    enum CornerRadius {
        static let sm: CGFloat = 6
        static let md: CGFloat = 12
        static let lg: CGFloat = 16
        static let xl: CGFloat = 24
        static let full: CGFloat = .infinity
    }

    // MARK: - Shadow

    enum Shadow {
        static let light = ShadowStyle(
            color: .black.opacity(0.05),
            radius: 4,
            x: 0,
            y: 2
        )

        static let medium = ShadowStyle(
            color: .black.opacity(0.1),
            radius: 8,
            x: 0,
            y: 4
        )

        static let heavy = ShadowStyle(
            color: .black.opacity(0.15),
            radius: 16,
            x: 0,
            y: 8
        )
    }

    // MARK: - Animation

    enum Animation {
        static let fast: SwiftUI.Animation = .easeOut(duration: 0.15)
        static let standard: SwiftUI.Animation = .easeInOut(duration: 0.25)
        static let slow: SwiftUI.Animation = .easeInOut(duration: 0.4)
        static let spring: SwiftUI.Animation = .spring(response: 0.35, dampingFraction: 0.7)
    }
}

// MARK: - ShadowStyle

/// 阴影样式
struct ShadowStyle {
    let color: Color
    let radius: CGFloat
    let x: CGFloat
    let y: CGFloat
}

// MARK: - View Extension

extension View {

    /// 应用阴影样式
    func shadow(_ style: ShadowStyle) -> some View {
        shadow(color: style.color, radius: style.radius, x: style.x, y: style.y)
    }
}

//
//  InfoCard.swift
//  NotBad

//  Created for NotBad K12 错题本

import SwiftUI

// MARK: - InfoCard

/// 信息卡片组件
///
/// 用于展示错题详情的信息卡片。
///
/// ## 使用示例
///
/// ```swift
/// InfoCard(title: "标题", icon: "text.alignleft") {
///     Text("错题标题内容")
/// }
/// ```
struct InfoCard<Content: View>: View {

    // MARK: - Properties

    /// 卡片标题
    let title: String

    /// 图标名称
    let icon: String

    /// 卡片内容
    @ViewBuilder let content: Content

    // MARK: - Body

    var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.md) {
            // Header with icon and title
            HStack(spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.sm) {
                Image(systemName: icon)
                    .font(.system(size: 12, weight: .semibold))
                    .foregroundStyle(.tertiary)

                Text(title)
                    .font(.caption.weight(.semibold))
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                    .textCase(.uppercase)
                    .tracking(0.3)
            }
            .accessibilityAddTraits(.isHeader)

            content
        }
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
        .padding(DesignTokens.Spacing.lg)
        .background(
            RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: DesignTokens.CornerRadius.lg)
                .fill(Color.semantic.secondaryBackground)
                .overlay(
                    RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: DesignTokens.CornerRadius.lg)
                        .strokeBorder(Color.primary.opacity(0.04), lineWidth: 1)
                )
        )
        .accessibilityElement(children: .contain)
    }
}

#Preview("Info Card") {
    InfoCard(title: "测试标题", icon: "star.fill") {
        Text("测试内容")
    }
    .padding()
}

// FILE PATH: NotBad/Presentation/Common/Components/ToastView.swift
