//
//  ToastView.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  Created for NotBad K12 错题本
//

import SwiftUI

// MARK: - ToastType

/// Toast 消息类型
enum ToastType: Sendable {
    /// 成功
    case success

    /// 错误
    case error

    /// 警告
    case warning

    /// 信息
    case info

    /// 图标名称
    var icon: String {
        switch self {
        case .success: "checkmark.circle.fill"
        case .error: "xmark.circle.fill"
        case .warning: "exclamationmark.triangle.fill"
        case .info: "info.circle.fill"
        }
    }

    /// 颜色
    var color: Color {
        switch self {
        case .success: Color.brand.success
        case .error: Color.brand.error
        case .warning: Color.brand.warning
        case .info: Color.brand.primary
        }
    }

    /// 默认显示时长
    var defaultDuration: Double {
        switch self {
        case .success: 2.0
        case .error: 3.0
        case .warning: 2.5
        case .info: 2.0
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Toast

/// Toast 数据模型
///
/// ## 使用示例
///
/// ```swift
/// @State private var toast: Toast?
///
/// var body: some View {
///     ContentView()
///         .toast($toast)
///         .onTapGesture {
///             toast = .success("保存成功！")
///         }
/// }
/// ```
struct Toast: Equatable, Sendable {

    // MARK: - Properties

    /// 消息类型
    let type: ToastType

    /// 消息内容
    let message: String

    /// 显示时长（秒）
    var duration: Double

    /// 创建时间戳（用于唯一标识）
    let id: UUID

    // MARK: - Initialization

    init(type: ToastType, message: String, duration: Double? = nil) {
        self.type = type
        self.message = message
        self.duration = duration ?? type.defaultDuration
        self.id = UUID()
    }

    // MARK: - Equatable

    static func == (lhs: Toast, rhs: Toast) -> Bool {
        lhs.id == rhs.id
    }
}

// MARK: - Toast Convenience Initializers

extension Toast {

    /// 成功 Toast
    static func success(_ message: String, duration: Double? = nil) -> Toast {
        Toast(type: .success, message: message, duration: duration)
    }

    /// 错误 Toast
    static func error(_ message: String, duration: Double? = nil) -> Toast {
        Toast(type: .error, message: message, duration: duration)
    }

    /// 警告 Toast
    static func warning(_ message: String, duration: Double? = nil) -> Toast {
        Toast(type: .warning, message: message, duration: duration)
    }

    /// 信息 Toast
    static func info(_ message: String, duration: Double? = nil) -> Toast {
        Toast(type: .info, message: message, duration: duration)
    }
}

// MARK: - ToastView

/// Toast 视图
///
/// 显示单个 Toast 消息的视图组件。
struct ToastView: View {

    // MARK: - Properties

    let toast: Toast

    /// 点击关闭回调
    var onDismiss: (() -> Void)?

    // MARK: - Body

    var body: some View {
        HStack(spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.md) {
            Image(systemName: toast.type.icon)
                .font(.title3)
                .foregroundStyle(toast.type.color)
                .accessibilityHidden(true)

            Text(toast.message)
                .font(.subheadline)
                .fontWeight(.medium)
                .multilineTextAlignment(.leading)

            Spacer()

            if onDismiss != nil {
                Button {
                    onDismiss?()
                } label: {
                    Image(systemName: "xmark")
                        .font(.caption)
                        .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                }
                .accessibilityLabel("关闭提示")
            }
        }
        .padding(DesignTokens.Spacing.lg)
        .background(.ultraThinMaterial)
        .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: DesignTokens.CornerRadius.md))
        .shadow(DesignTokens.Shadow.medium)
        .padding(.horizontal)
        .accessibilityElement(children: .combine)
        .accessibilityLabel(accessibilityDescription)
        .accessibilityAddTraits(.isStaticText)
    }

    private var accessibilityDescription: String {
        let typeDescription: String
        switch toast.type {
        case .success: typeDescription = "成功"
        case .error: typeDescription = "错误"
        case .warning: typeDescription = "警告"
        case .info: typeDescription = "提示"
        }
        return "\(typeDescription)：\(toast.message)"
    }
}

// MARK: - ToastModifier

/// Toast 视图修饰器
private struct ToastModifier: ViewModifier {

    @Binding var toast: Toast?

    func body(content: Content) -> some View {
        content
            .overlay(alignment: .top) {
                if let toast {
                    ToastView(toast: toast) {
                        withAnimation {
                            self.toast = nil
                        }
                    }
                    .transition(.move(edge: .top).combined(with: .opacity))
                    .onAppear {
                        scheduleAutoDismiss(for: toast)
                        // VoiceOver 公告
                        announceForAccessibility(toast)
                    }
                    .padding(.top, 50)
                }
            }
            .animation(DesignTokens.Animation.spring, value: toast)
    }

    private func scheduleAutoDismiss(for toast: Toast) {
        Task { @MainActor in
            try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(toast.duration))
            // 确保当前 Toast 未被手动关闭
            if self.toast?.id == toast.id {
                withAnimation {
                    self.toast = nil
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private func announceForAccessibility(_ toast: Toast) {
        let typeDescription: String
        switch toast.type {
        case .success: typeDescription = "成功"
        case .error: typeDescription = "错误"
        case .warning: typeDescription = "警告"
        case .info: typeDescription = "提示"
        }
        AccessibilityAnnouncement.announce("\(typeDescription)：\(toast.message)")
    }
}

// MARK: - View Extension

extension View {

    /// 添加 Toast 支持
    ///
    /// - Parameter toast: Toast 状态绑定
    /// - Returns: 修改后的视图
    func toast(_ toast: Binding<Toast?>) -> some View {
        modifier(ToastModifier(toast: toast))
    }
}

// MARK: - Preview

#Preview("Toast Types") {
    VStack {
        Text("主内容")
    }
    .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
    .overlay(alignment: .top) {
        VStack(spacing: 16) {
            ToastView(toast: .success("保存成功！"))
            ToastView(toast: .error("保存失败，请重试"))
            ToastView(toast: .warning("网络不稳定"))
            ToastView(toast: .info("提示：双击可快速复习"))
        }
        .padding(.top, 60)
    }
}

#Preview("Interactive Toast") {
    struct PreviewWrapper: View {
        @State private var toast: Toast?

        var body: some View {
            VStack(spacing: 20) {
                Button("显示成功") {
                    toast = .success("操作成功")
                }
                Button("显示错误") {
                    toast = .error("操作失败")
                }
            }
            .toast($toast)
        }
    }
    return PreviewWrapper()
}

//
//  SearchHistoryView.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  搜索历史视图组件

import SwiftUI

// MARK: - SearchHistoryView

/// 搜索历史视图
///
/// 显示用户的搜索历史记录，支持点击快速搜索和删除。
///
/// ## 功能特性
///
/// - 显示最近搜索记录
/// - 点击记录快速填充搜索框
/// - 滑动删除单条记录
/// - 一键清空所有历史
///
/// ## 使用示例
///
/// ```swift
/// SearchHistoryView { query in
///     searchText = query
/// }
/// ```
struct SearchHistoryView: View {
    
    // MARK: - Properties
    
    /// 搜索历史管理器
    @State private var historyManager = SearchHistoryManager.shared
    
    /// 选择搜索词的回调
    let onSelect: (String) -> Void
    
    // MARK: - Body
    
    var body: some View {
        if !historyManager.searchHistory.isEmpty {
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 12) {
                // 标题和清空按钮
                HStack {
                    Label {
                        Text("search_history_title")
                            .font(.subheadline.weight(.medium))
                    } icon: {
                        Image(systemName: "clock.arrow.circlepath")
                            .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                    }
                    
                    Spacer()
                    
                    Button {
                        withAnimation(.spring(response: 0.3)) {
                            historyManager.clearHistory()
                        }
                    } label: {
                        Text("search_history_clear")
                            .font(.caption)
                            .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                    }
                }
                .padding(.horizontal)
                
                // 历史记录列表（使用 FlowLayout 标签形式）
                FlowLayout(spacing: 8) {
                    ForEach(historyManager.searchHistory, id: \.self) { query in
                        SearchHistoryChip(
                            text: query,
                            onTap: {
                                onSelect(query)
                            },
                            onDelete: {
                                withAnimation(.spring(response: 0.3)) {
                                    historyManager.removeSearch(query)
                                }
                            }
                        )
                    }
                }
                .padding(.horizontal)
            }
            .padding(.vertical, 12)
            .background(.ultraThinMaterial, in: RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 12))
            .padding(.horizontal)
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - SearchHistoryChip

/// 搜索历史标签
///
/// 单个搜索历史记录的展示组件，支持点击和删除。
private struct SearchHistoryChip: View {
    
    /// 搜索文本
    let text: String
    
    /// 点击回调
    let onTap: () -> Void
    
    /// 删除回调
    let onDelete: () -> Void
    
    var body: some View {
        HStack(spacing: 6) {
            Text(text)
                .font(.subheadline)
                .lineLimit(1)
            
            Button {
                onDelete()
            } label: {
                Image(systemName: "xmark.circle.fill")
                    .font(.caption)
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            }
            .buttonStyle(.plain)
        }
        .padding(.horizontal, 12)
        .padding(.vertical, 8)
        .background(.quaternary, in: Capsule())
        .contentShape(Capsule())
        .onTapGesture {
            onTap()
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Preview

#Preview {
    VStack {
        SearchHistoryView { query in
            print("Selected: \(query)")
        }
        Spacer()
    }
}

//
//  SubjectTag.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  Created for NotBad K12 错题本

import SwiftUI

// MARK: - SubjectTagStyle

/// 学科标签样式
enum SubjectTagStyle: Sendable {
    /// 紧凑 - 仅显示名称
    case compact

    /// 标准 - 图标 + 名称
    case standard

    /// 详细 - 图标 + 名称 + 数量
    case detailed

    /// 图标 - 仅图标
    case iconOnly
}

// MARK: - SubjectTag

/// 学科标签组件
///
/// 显示学科信息的可视化标签。
///
/// ## 功能特性
///
/// - 多种显示样式：紧凑、标准、详细、仅图标
/// - 选中状态支持
/// - 动画效果
///
/// ## 使用示例
///
/// ```swift
/// // 标准样式
/// SubjectTag(subject: .math)
///
/// // 带数量
/// SubjectTag(subject: .chinese, style: .detailed, count: 15)
///
/// // 选中状态
/// SubjectTag(subject: .english, isSelected: true)
/// ```
struct SubjectTag: View {

    // MARK: - Properties

    /// 学科
    let subject: Subject

    /// 显示样式
    var style: SubjectTagStyle = .standard

    /// 错题数量（详细样式时使用）
    var count: Int?

    /// 是否选中
    var isSelected: Bool = false

    // MARK: - Body

    var body: some View {
        HStack(spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.xs) {
            if style != .compact {
                iconView
            }

            if style != .iconOnly {
                textView
            }

            if style == .detailed, let count {
                countBadge(count)
            }
        }
        .padding(.horizontal, style == .compact ? DesignTokens.Spacing.sm : (style == .iconOnly ? DesignTokens.Spacing.xs : DesignTokens.Spacing.md))
        .padding(.vertical, style == .compact ? DesignTokens.Spacing.xs : (style == .iconOnly ? DesignTokens.Spacing.xs : DesignTokens.Spacing.xs))
        .background(backgroundStyle)
        .foregroundStyle(foregroundStyle)
        .clipShape(style == .iconOnly ? AnyShape(Circle()) : AnyShape(Capsule()))
        .shadow(
            color: isSelected ? subject.color.opacity(0.3) : .clear,
            radius: 4,
            y: 2
        )
    }

    // MARK: - Subviews

    private var iconView: some View {
        Image(systemName: subject.icon)
            .font(style == .iconOnly ? .subheadline : .caption)
    }

    private var textView: some View {
        Text(subject.displayName)
            .font(style == .compact ? .caption2 : .caption)
            .fontWeight(isSelected ? .semibold : .regular)
    }

    private func countBadge(_ count: Int) -> some View {
        Text("\(count)")
            .font(.caption2)
            .fontWeight(.bold)
            .padding(.horizontal, DesignTokens.Spacing.xs)
            .padding(.vertical, 2)
            .background(isSelected ? .white.opacity(0.3) : subject.color.opacity(0.2))
            .clipShape(Capsule())
    }

    // MARK: - Styling

    private var backgroundStyle: AnyShapeStyle {
        if isSelected {
            AnyShapeStyle(subject.color.gradient)
        } else {
            AnyShapeStyle(subject.color.opacity(0.1))
        }
    }

    private var foregroundStyle: Color {
        isSelected ? .white : subject.color
    }
}

// MARK: - SelectableSubjectTag

/// 可选择的学科标签
///
/// 带有点击选择功能的学科标签。
struct SelectableSubjectTag: View {

    // MARK: - Properties

    /// 学科
    let subject: Subject

    /// 选中状态绑定
    @Binding var isSelected: Bool

    /// 错题数量
    var count: Int?

    /// 样式
    var style: SubjectTagStyle = .standard

    // MARK: - Body

    var body: some View {
        Button {
            withAnimation(DesignTokens.Animation.spring) {
                isSelected.toggle()
            }
        } label: {
            SubjectTag(
                subject: subject,
                style: count != nil ? .detailed : style,
                count: count,
                isSelected: isSelected
            )
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
        .sensoryFeedback(.selection, trigger: isSelected)
    }
}

// MARK: - SubjectTagGroup

/// 学科标签组
///
/// 显示多个学科标签，支持单选或多选。
struct SubjectTagGroup: View {

    // MARK: - Properties

    /// 可选学科列表
    let subjects: [Subject]

    /// 选中的学科
    @Binding var selection: Set<Subject>

    /// 是否单选模式
    var singleSelection: Bool = false

    /// 各学科数量
    var counts: [Subject: Int] = [:]

    // MARK: - Body

    var body: some View {
        ScrollView(.horizontal, showsIndicators: false) {
            HStack(spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.sm) {
                ForEach(subjects, id: \.self) { subject in
                    tagButton(for: subject)
                }
            }
            .padding(.horizontal)
        }
    }

    // MARK: - Subviews

    private func tagButton(for subject: Subject) -> some View {
        let isSelected = selection.contains(subject)

        return Button {
            withAnimation(DesignTokens.Animation.spring) {
                if singleSelection {
                    selection = isSelected ? [] : [subject]
                } else {
                    if isSelected {
                        selection.remove(subject)
                    } else {
                        selection.insert(subject)
                    }
                }
            }
        } label: {
            SubjectTag(
                subject: subject,
                style: counts[subject] != nil ? .detailed : .standard,
                count: counts[subject],
                isSelected: isSelected
            )
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
        .sensoryFeedback(.selection, trigger: isSelected)
    }
}

// MARK: - Preview

        HStack {

            }
        }

        // Standard
        HStack {
            ForEach(Subject.coreSubjects, id: \.self) { subject in
                SubjectTag(subject: subject, style: .standard)
            }
        }

        // Icon Only
        HStack {
            ForEach(Subject.coreSubjects, id: \.self) { subject in
                SubjectTag(subject: subject, style: .iconOnly)

        }

        // Detailed
        HStack {

            SubjectTag(subject: .chinese, style: .detailed, count: 8)
            SubjectTag(subject: .english, style: .detailed, count: 12)
        }

        // Selected
        HStack {
            SubjectTag(subject: .math, style: .standard, isSelected: true)
            SubjectTag(subject: .physics, style: .standard, isSelected: false)
        }
    }
    .padding()
}

// FILE PATH: NotBad/Presentation/Common/Components/FlowLayout.swift
================================================================================

//
//  FlowLayout.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  Created for NotBad K12 错题本
//

import SwiftUI

// MARK: - FlowLayout

/// 流式布局容器
///
/// 自动换行的标签布局，适用于展示知识点、标签等。
///
/// ## 使用示例
///
/// ```swift
/// FlowLayout(spacing: 8) {
///     ForEach(tags, id: \.self) { tag in
///         TagView(tag)
///     }
/// }
/// ```
struct FlowLayout: Layout {

    /// 元素间距
    var spacing: CGFloat = DesignTokens.Spacing.sm

    /// 行间距
    var lineSpacing: CGFloat = DesignTokens.Spacing.sm

    func sizeThatFits(proposal: ProposedViewSize, subviews: Subviews, cache: inout ()) -> CGSize {
        let result = FlowResult(
            in: proposal.replacingUnspecifiedDimensions().width,
            subviews: subviews,
            spacing: spacing,
            lineSpacing: lineSpacing
        )
        return result.size
    }

    func placeSubviews(in bounds: CGRect, proposal: ProposedViewSize, subviews: Subviews, cache: inout ()) {
        let result = FlowResult(
            in: bounds.width,
            subviews: subviews,
            spacing: spacing,
            lineSpacing: lineSpacing
        )

        for (index, subview) in subviews.enumerated() {
            let position = result.positions[index]
            subview.place(
                at: CGPoint(x: bounds.minX + position.x, y: bounds.minY + position.y),
                proposal: .unspecified
            )
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - FlowResult

private struct FlowResult {
    var size: CGSize = .zero
    var positions: [CGPoint] = []

    init(in maxWidth: CGFloat, subviews: LayoutSubviews, spacing: CGFloat, lineSpacing: CGFloat) {
        var x: CGFloat = 0
        var y: CGFloat = 0
        var lineHeight: CGFloat = 0
        var maxWidth: CGFloat = 0

        for subview in subviews {
            let viewSize = subview.sizeThatFits(.unspecified)

            if x + viewSize.width > maxWidth, x > 0 {
                // 换行
                x = 0
                y += lineHeight + lineSpacing
                lineHeight = 0
            }

            positions.append(CGPoint(x: x, y: y))
            lineHeight = max(lineHeight, viewSize.height)
            x += viewSize.width + spacing
            maxWidth = max(maxWidth, x - spacing)
        }

        size = CGSize(width: maxWidth, height: y + lineHeight)
    }
}

// MARK: - Preview

#Preview {
    FlowLayout(spacing: 8) {
        ForEach(["函数", "导数", "积分", "微分方程", "线性代数"], id: \.self) { tag in
            Text(tag)
                .padding(.horizontal, 12)
                .padding(.vertical, 6)
                .background(Color.brand.primary.opacity(0.1))
                .foregroundStyle(Color.brand.primary)
                .clipShape(Capsule())
        }
    }
    .padding()
}

//
//  MasteryBadge.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  Created for NotBad K12 错题本

import SwiftUI

// MARK: - MasteryBadgeStyle

/// 掌握程度徽章样式
enum MasteryBadgeStyle: Sendable {
    /// 紧凑 - 仅图标
    case compact

    /// 标准 - 图标 + 名称
    case standard

    /// 详细 - 图标 + 详细描述
    case detailed

    /// 星级 - 星级显示
    case stars

    /// 进度条 - 带进度条
    case progress
}

// MARK: - MasteryBadge

/// 掌握程度徽章
///
/// 显示错题掌握程度的可视化组件。
///
/// ## 功能特性
///
/// - 多种显示样式：紧凑、标准、详细、星级、进度条
/// - 自动颜色适配
/// - 动画效果支持
///
/// ## 使用示例
///
/// ```swift
/// // 标准样式
/// MasteryBadge(level: .learning)
///
/// // 星级样式
/// MasteryBadge(level: .mastered, style: .stars)
///
/// // 进度样式
/// MasteryBadge(level: .reviewing, style: .progress)
/// ```
struct MasteryBadge: View {

    // MARK: - Properties

    /// 掌握程度
    let level: MasteryLevel

    /// 显示样式
    var style: MasteryBadgeStyle = .standard

    /// 是否显示动画
    var animated: Bool = false

    // MARK: - Backward Compatibility

    /// 向后兼容：是否显示详细文本
    var showDetailText: Bool = false

    private var effectiveStyle: MasteryBadgeStyle {
        showDetailText ? .detailed : style
    }

    // MARK: - Body

    var body: some View {
        Group {
            switch effectiveStyle {
            case .compact:
                compactView
            case .standard:
                standardView
            case .detailed:
                detailedView
            case .stars:
                starsView
            case .progress:
                progressView
            }
        }
    }

    // MARK: - Subviews

    private var compactView: some View {
        Image(systemName: level.icon)
            .font(.caption)
            .padding(DesignTokens.Spacing.sm)
            .background(level.color.opacity(0.1))
            .foregroundStyle(level.color)
            .clipShape(Circle())
            .symbolEffect(.pulse, isActive: animated)
            .accessibilityLabel("掌握程度：\(level.displayName)")
    }

    private var standardView: some View {
        HStack(spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.xs) {
            Image(systemName: level.icon)
                .symbolEffect(.pulse, isActive: animated)
                .accessibilityHidden(true)
            Text(level.displayName)
        }
        .font(.caption)
        .padding(.horizontal, DesignTokens.Spacing.md)
        .padding(.vertical, DesignTokens.Spacing.sm)
        .background(level.color.opacity(0.1))
        .foregroundStyle(level.color)
        .clipShape(Capsule())
        .accessibilityElement(children: .combine)
        .accessibilityLabel("掌握程度：\(level.displayName)")
    }

    private var detailedView: some View {
        HStack(spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.xs) {
            Image(systemName: level.icon)
                .symbolEffect(.pulse, isActive: animated)
                .accessibilityHidden(true)
            Text(level.detailText)
        }
        .font(.caption)
        .padding(.horizontal, DesignTokens.Spacing.md)
        .padding(.vertical, DesignTokens.Spacing.sm)
        .background(level.color.opacity(0.1))
        .foregroundStyle(level.color)
        .clipShape(Capsule())
        .accessibilityElement(children: .combine)
        .accessibilityLabel("掌握程度：\(level.detailText)")
    }

    private var starsView: some View {
        HStack(spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.xs / 2) {
            ForEach(0..<5, id: \.self) { index in
                Image(systemName: index < level.stars ? "star.fill" : "star")
                    .font(.caption2)
                    .foregroundStyle(index < level.stars ? level.color : .gray.opacity(0.3))
            }
        }
        .accessibilityElement(children: .ignore)
        .accessibilityLabel("掌握程度：\(level.stars)星，\(level.displayName)")
    }

    private var progressView: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.xs) {
            HStack {
                Text(level.displayName)
                    .font(.caption)
                    .fontWeight(.medium)
                Spacer()
                Text("\(Int(level.progress * 100))%")
                    .font(.caption2)
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            }

            GeometryReader { geo in
                ZStack(alignment: .leading) {
                    RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: DesignTokens.CornerRadius.sm)
                        .fill(Color.gray.opacity(0.2))

                    RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: DesignTokens.CornerRadius.sm)
                        .fill(level.color.gradient)
                        .frame(width: geo.size.width * level.progress)
                }
            }
            .frame(height: 6)
        }
        .frame(minWidth: 100)
        .accessibilityElement(children: .ignore)
        .accessibilityLabel("掌握程度：\(level.displayName)，\(Int(level.progress * 100))%")
        .accessibilityValue("\(Int(level.progress * 100))%")
    }
}

// MARK: - MasteryProgressView

/// 带进度条的掌握程度显示
///
/// 独立的进度条组件，提供更灵活的布局控制。
struct MasteryProgressView: View {

    // MARK: - Properties

    /// 掌握程度
    let level: MasteryLevel

    /// 是否显示标签
    var showLabel: Bool = true

    /// 进度条高度
    var barHeight: CGFloat = 8

    /// 是否显示动画
    var animated: Bool = true

    // MARK: - State

    @State private var animatedProgress: Double = 0

    // MARK: - Body

    var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.xs) {
            if showLabel {
                labelView
            }

            progressBar
        }
        .onAppear {
            if animated {
                withAnimation(.easeOut(duration: 0.8)) {
                    animatedProgress = level.progress
                }
            } else {
                animatedProgress = level.progress
            }
        }
        .onChange(of: level) { _, newValue in
            if animated {
                withAnimation(.easeOut(duration: 0.3)) {
                    animatedProgress = newValue.progress
                }
            } else {
                animatedProgress = newValue.progress
            }
        }
    }

    // MARK: - Subviews

    private var labelView: some View {
        HStack {
            Text(level.displayName)
                .font(.caption)
                .fontWeight(.medium)
            Spacer()
            Text("\(Int(level.progress * 100))%")
                .font(.caption)
                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
        }
    }

    private var progressBar: some View {
        GeometryReader { geo in
            ZStack(alignment: .leading) {
                // 背景
                RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: barHeight / 2)
                    .fill(Color.gray.opacity(0.2))

                // 进度
                RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: barHeight / 2)
                    .fill(level.color.gradient)
                    .frame(width: geo.size.width * animatedProgress)
            }
        }
        .frame(height: barHeight)
    }
}

// MARK: - MasteryComparisonView

/// 掌握程度对比视图
///
/// 显示两个掌握程度的对比（如复习前后）。
struct MasteryComparisonView: View {

    // MARK: - Properties

    /// 之前的程度
    let before: MasteryLevel

    /// 之后的程度
    let after: MasteryLevel

    /// 是否有进步
    var hasImproved: Bool {
        after.progress > before.progress
    }

    // MARK: - Body

    var body: some View {
        HStack(spacing: 12) {
            MasteryBadge(level: before, style: .compact)

            Image(systemName: "arrow.right")
                .font(.caption)
                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)

            MasteryBadge(level: after, style: .compact)

            if hasImproved {
                Image(systemName: "arrow.up.circle.fill")
                    .foregroundStyle(.green)
                    .font(.caption)
            }
        }
    }
}

//
//  EmptyStateView.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  Created for NotBad K12 错题本
//

import SwiftUI

// MARK: - EmptyStateView

/// 通用空状态视图
///
/// 用于在没有内容时向用户展示友好的空状态界面。
///
/// ## 功能特性
///
/// - 可自定义图标、标题和消息
/// - 可选的操作按钮
/// - 多种预定义状态
/// - 支持动画效果
///
/// ## 使用示例
///
/// ```swift
/// // 预定义状态
/// EmptyStateView.noItems
///
/// // 自定义状态
/// EmptyStateView(
///     icon: "folder",
///     title: "文件夹为空",
///     message: "还没有添加任何文件"
/// )
///
/// // 带操作按钮
/// EmptyStateView.networkError {
///     viewModel.refresh()
/// }
/// ```
struct EmptyStateView: View {

    // MARK: - Properties

    /// 图标名称
    let icon: String

    /// 标题文字
    let title: String

    /// 描述消息
    let message: String

    /// 操作按钮标题
    var actionTitle: String?

    /// 操作回调
    var action: (() -> Void)?

    /// 是否显示动画
    var animated: Bool = true

    /// 支持 Dynamic Type 的图标尺寸
    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .largeTitle) private var iconSize: CGFloat = 64

    // MARK: - Body

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.xl) {
            iconView
            textContent
            actionButton
        }
        .padding(DesignTokens.Spacing.xxl + DesignTokens.Spacing.sm)
    }

    // MARK: - Subviews

    private var iconView: some View {
        Image(systemName: icon)
            .font(.system(size: iconSize))
            .foregroundStyle(
                LinearGradient(
                    colors: [.gray.opacity(0.6), .gray.opacity(0.3)],
                    startPoint: .topLeading,
                    endPoint: .bottomTrailing
                )
            )
            .symbolEffect(.pulse, isActive: animated)
            .accessibleDecorative()
    }

    private var textContent: some View {
        VStack(spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.sm) {
            Text(title)
                .font(.title2)
                .fontWeight(.semibold)

            Text(message)
                .font(.subheadline)
                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                .multilineTextAlignment(.center)
        }
    }

    @ViewBuilder
    private var actionButton: some View {
        if let actionTitle, let action {
            Button(action: action) {
                Text(actionTitle)
                    .fontWeight(.semibold)
                    .padding(.horizontal, DesignTokens.Spacing.xl)
                    .padding(.vertical, DesignTokens.Spacing.md)
                    .background(Color.brand.primary)
                    .foregroundStyle(.white)
                    .clipShape(Capsule())
            }
            .accessibleButton(actionTitle)
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Convenience Initializers

extension EmptyStateView {

    /// 创建带操作的空状态视图
    init(
        icon: String,
        title: String,
        message: String,
        actionTitle: String,
        action: @escaping () -> Void
    ) {
        self.icon = icon
        self.title = title
        self.message = message
        self.actionTitle = actionTitle
        self.action = action
    }
}

// MARK: - Predefined States

extension EmptyStateView {

    /// 题库空状态 - 首次使用引导

        VStack(spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.xxl) {

                    .font(.system(size: 64))
                    .foregroundStyle(
                        LinearGradient(
                            colors: [Color.brand.primary, Color.brand.secondary],
                            startPoint: .topLeading,
                            endPoint: .bottomTrailing
                        )
                    )
                    .symbolEffect(.pulse)
                
                VStack(spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.sm) {
                    Text("library_empty_welcome_title")
                        .font(.title2)
                        .fontWeight(.bold)
                    
                    Text("library_empty_welcome_subtitle")
                        .font(.subheadline)
                        .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                        .multilineTextAlignment(.center)
                }
            }
            
            // 使用提示卡片
            VStack(spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.md) {

                        startPoint: .leading,
                        endPoint: .trailing
                    )
                )
                .clipShape(Capsule())
            }
        }
        .padding(DesignTokens.Spacing.xxl)
    }

                .foregroundStyle(Color.brand.primary)
                .frame(width: 24)

                .font(.subheadline)
                .foregroundStyle(.primary)

    static func permissionDenied(title: String, message: String, action: @escaping () -> Void) -> EmptyStateView {
        EmptyStateView(
            icon: "lock.shield",

    static func noCameraPermission(action: @escaping () -> Void) -> EmptyStateView {

            title: "无法访问相机",

        )

    /// 今日复习完成
    static var reviewCompleted: EmptyStateView {
        EmptyStateView(
            icon: "star.fill",
            title: "今日复习完成",
            message: "继续保持，明天再来！"
        )
    }

//
//  LoadingView.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  Created for NotBad K12 错题本
//

import SwiftUI

// MARK: - LoadingOverlay

/// 全屏加载遮罩
///
/// 用于在执行耗时操作时阻止用户交互。
///
/// ## 使用示例
///
/// ```swift
/// ZStack {
///     ContentView()
///     if isLoading {
///         LoadingOverlay("保存中...")
///     }
/// }
/// ```
struct LoadingOverlay: View {

    // MARK: - Properties

    /// 加载提示文字
    let message: String

    /// 背景透明度
    var backgroundOpacity: Double = 0.3

    /// 是否显示取消按钮
    var showCancel: Bool = false

    /// 取消回调
    var onCancel: (() -> Void)?

    // MARK: - Initialization

    init(
        _ message: String = "加载中...",
        backgroundOpacity: Double = 0.3,
        showCancel: Bool = false,
        onCancel: (() -> Void)? = nil
    ) {
        self.message = message
        self.backgroundOpacity = backgroundOpacity
        self.showCancel = showCancel
        self.onCancel = onCancel
    }

    // MARK: - Body

    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            Color.black.opacity(backgroundOpacity)
                .ignoresSafeArea()

            VStack(spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.lg) {
                ProgressView()
                    .scaleEffect(1.5)
                    .tint(.white)

                Text(message)
                    .font(.subheadline)
                    .foregroundStyle(.white)

                if showCancel, let onCancel {
                    Button("取消", action: onCancel)
                        .font(.subheadline)
                        .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.8))
                        .padding(.top, DesignTokens.Spacing.sm)
                }
            }
            .padding(DesignTokens.Spacing.xxl)
            .background(.ultraThinMaterial)
            .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: DesignTokens.CornerRadius.lg))
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - InlineLoader

/// 内联加载指示器
///
/// 用于在列表或内容中显示加载状态。
///
/// ## 使用示例
///
/// ```swift
/// if isLoading {
///     InlineLoader("正在加载更多...")
/// }
/// ```
struct InlineLoader: View {

    // MARK: - Properties

    /// 加载提示文字
    let message: String

    /// 指示器大小
    var scale: CGFloat = 1.0

    // MARK: - Initialization

    init(_ message: String = "加载中", scale: CGFloat = 1.0) {
        self.message = message
        self.scale = scale
    }

    // MARK: - Body

    var body: some View {
        HStack(spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.md) {
            ProgressView()
                .scaleEffect(scale)
            Text(message)
                .font(.subheadline)
                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
        }
        .padding(DesignTokens.Spacing.lg)
    }
}

// MARK: - AnimatedDots

/// 带动画的加载点
///
/// 显示三个循环动画的点，表示加载状态。
struct AnimatedDots: View {

    // MARK: - Properties

    /// 点的颜色
    var color: Color = .accentColor

    /// 点的大小
    var size: CGFloat = 8

    /// 动画持续时间
    var duration: Double = 0.6

    // MARK: - State

    @State private var animating = false

    // MARK: - Body

    var body: some View {
        HStack(spacing: size / 2) {
            ForEach(0..<3, id: \.self) { index in
                Circle()
                    .fill(color)
                    .frame(width: size, height: size)
                    .scaleEffect(animating ? 1.0 : 0.5)
                    .animation(
                        .easeInOut(duration: duration)
                        .repeatForever()
                        .delay(Double(index) * 0.2),
                        value: animating
                    )
            }
        }
        .onAppear { animating = true }
    }
}

// MARK: - SkeletonLoader

/// 骨架屏加载器
///
/// 显示内容占位符动画，提供更好的加载体验。
struct SkeletonLoader: View {

    // MARK: - Properties

    /// 宽度
    var width: CGFloat?

    /// 高度
    var height: CGFloat = 20

    /// 圆角半径
    var cornerRadius: CGFloat = 4

    // MARK: - State

    @State private var isAnimating = false

    // MARK: - Body

    var body: some View {
        RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: cornerRadius)
            .fill(
                LinearGradient(
                    colors: [
                        Color.gray.opacity(0.3),
                        Color.gray.opacity(0.1),
                        Color.gray.opacity(0.3)
                    ],
                    startPoint: isAnimating ? .leading : .trailing,
                    endPoint: isAnimating ? .trailing : .leading
                )
            )
            .frame(width: width, height: height)
            .onAppear {
                withAnimation(.linear(duration: 1.5).repeatForever(autoreverses: false)) {
                    isAnimating = true
                }
            }
    }
}

// MARK: - LoadingState

/// 加载状态枚举
enum LoadingState: Equatable, Sendable {
    /// 空闲
    case idle

    /// 加载中
    case loading(String?)

    /// 已加载
    case loaded

    /// 错误
    case error(String)

    /// 是否正在加载
    var isLoading: Bool {
        if case .loading = self { return true }
        return false
    }

    /// 获取加载消息
    var loadingMessage: String? {
        if case .loading(let message) = self { return message }
        return nil
    }

    /// 获取错误消息
    var errorMessage: String? {
        if case .error(let message) = self { return message }
        return nil
    }
}

//
//  ErrorAlertView.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  统一错误提示视图
//

import SwiftUI

// MARK: - ErrorAlertModifier

/// 错误提示修饰器
///
/// 统一处理应用中的错误提示展示。
struct ErrorAlertModifier: ViewModifier {
    
    /// 错误状态
    @Binding var error: AppError?
    
    /// 重试回调
    var onRetry: (() -> Void)?
    
    func body(content: Content) -> some View {
        content
            .alert(
                String(localized: "error_title"),
                isPresented: Binding(
                    get: { error != nil },
                    set: { if !$0 { error = nil } }
                ),
                presenting: error
            ) { error in
                // 按钮
                Button(String(localized: "error_button_ok"), role: .cancel) {
                    self.error = nil
                }
                
                if onRetry != nil && error.recoverySuggestion != nil {
                    Button(String(localized: "error_button_retry")) {
                        self.error = nil
                        onRetry?()
                    }
                }
                
                // 权限相关错误显示设置按钮
                if case .cameraPermissionDenied = error {
                    settingsButton
                } else if case .photoLibraryPermissionDenied = error {
                    settingsButton
                } else if case .notificationPermissionDenied = error {
                    settingsButton
                }
            } message: { error in
                VStack {
                    Text(error.userMessage)
                    if let suggestion = error.recoverySuggestion {
                        Text(suggestion)
                            .font(.caption)
                    }
                }
            }
    }
    
    /// 打开设置按钮
    private var settingsButton: some View {
        Button(String(localized: "error_button_settings")) {
            if let url = URL(string: UIApplication.openSettingsURLString) {
                UIApplication.shared.open(url)
            }
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - View Extension

extension View {
    /// 添加统一错误处理
    ///
    /// - Parameters:
    ///   - error: 错误状态绑定
    ///   - onRetry: 可选的重试回调
    /// - Returns: 带错误处理的视图
    ///
    /// ## 使用示例
    ///
    /// ```swift
    /// @State private var error: AppError?
    ///
    /// var body: some View {
    ///     ContentView()
    ///         .errorAlert($error) {
    ///             // 重试逻辑
    ///         }
    /// }
    /// ```
    func errorAlert(_ error: Binding<AppError?>, onRetry: (() -> Void)? = nil) -> some View {
        modifier(ErrorAlertModifier(error: error, onRetry: onRetry))
    }
}

// MARK: - ErrorBannerView

/// 错误横幅视图
///
/// 显示在视图顶部或底部的错误提示横幅。
struct ErrorBannerView: View {
    
    /// 错误
    let error: AppError
    
    /// 关闭回调
    var onDismiss: (() -> Void)?
    
    /// 重试回调
    var onRetry: (() -> Void)?
    
    var body: some View {
        HStack(spacing: 12) {
            // 图标
            Image(systemName: error.icon)
                .font(.title3)
                .foregroundStyle(.white)
            
            // 消息
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 2) {
                Text(error.userMessage)
                    .font(.subheadline.weight(.medium))
                    .foregroundStyle(.white)
                
                if let suggestion = error.recoverySuggestion {
                    Text(suggestion)
                        .font(.caption)
                        .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.8))
                }
            }
            
            Spacer()
            
            // 重试按钮
            if let onRetry = onRetry {
                Button {
                    onRetry()
                } label: {
                    Text("error_button_retry")
                        .font(.caption.weight(.semibold))
                        .foregroundStyle(.white)
                        .padding(.horizontal, 12)
                        .padding(.vertical, 6)
                        .background(.white.opacity(0.2), in: Capsule())
                }
            }
            
            // 关闭按钮
            if let onDismiss = onDismiss {
                Button {
                    onDismiss()
                } label: {
                    Image(systemName: "xmark")
                        .font(.caption.weight(.bold))
                        .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.8))
                }
            }
        }
        .padding()
        .background(Color.brand.error, in: RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 12))
        .padding(.horizontal)
    }
}

// MARK: - Preview

#Preview("Error Alert") {
    struct PreviewWrapper: View {
        @State private var error: AppError? = .saveFailed(reason: "数据库连接失败")
        
        var body: some View {
            VStack {
                Button("Show Error") {
                    error = .saveFailed(reason: "数据库连接失败")
                }
            }
            .errorAlert($error) {
                print("Retry tapped")
            }
        }
    }
    
    return PreviewWrapper()
}

#Preview("Error Banner") {
    VStack {
        ErrorBannerView(
            error: .networkUnavailable,
            onDismiss: {},
            onRetry: {}
        )
        
        ErrorBannerView(
            error: .cameraPermissionDenied,
            onDismiss: {}
        )
        
        Spacer()
    }
}

/// 智能识别提示
struct SmartAnalysisTip: Tip {
    var title: Text {
        Text("capture_tip_analysis_title")

// MARK: - Tips Configuration

/// Tips 配置管理
enum TipsConfiguration {
    
    /// 配置 TipKit
    static func configure() {
        try? Tips.configure([
            // 每天最多显示 3 个提示
            .displayFrequency(.daily),
            // Debug 模式下立即显示所有提示
            // .displayFrequency(.immediate)
        ])
    }
    
    /// 重置所有提示状态（用于测试）
    static func resetAllTips() {
        try? Tips.resetDatastore()
    }
    
    /// 更新题库数量参数
    static func updateItemCount(_ count: Int) {
        FilterTip.itemCount = count
        AdvancedSearchTip.itemCount = count
        iCloudSyncTip.itemCount = count
        StatisticsTip.hasData = count > 0
    }
    
    /// 标记用户已添加图片
    static func markImageAdded() {
        SmartAnalysisTip.hasAddedImage = true
    }
    
    /// 标记用户已完成复习
    static func markReviewCompleted() {
        MasteryMarkTip.hasCompletedReview = true
    }
}

// FILE PATH: NotBad/Presentation/Common/Views/LaunchScreenView.swift

//
//  LaunchScreenView.swift
//  NotBad
//
//  启动页面视图
//

import SwiftUI

// MARK: - LaunchScreenView

/// 应用启动页面
///
/// 采用苹果推荐的 SwiftUI 启动页面设计，
/// 展示应用 Logo 和品牌标识，提供流畅的启动体验。
struct LaunchScreenView: View {

    // MARK: - State

    @State private var isAnimating = false
    @State private var showTagline = false

    // MARK: - Body

    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            // 背景渐变
            LinearGradient(
                colors: [
                    Color.brand.primary.opacity(0.1),
                    Color(uiColor: .systemBackground)
                ],
                startPoint: .top,
                endPoint: .bottom
            )
            .ignoresSafeArea()

            VStack(spacing: DesignTokens.Spacing.xl) {
                Spacer()

                // Logo
                logoView

                // 应用名称
                Text("app_name")
                    .font(.system(size: 36, weight: .bold, design: .rounded))
                    .foregroundStyle(.primary)

                // 标语
                if showTagline {
                    Text("app_tagline")
                        .font(.subheadline)
                        .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                        .transition(.opacity.combined(with: .move(edge: .bottom)))
                }

                Spacer()
                Spacer()

                // 加载指示器
                ProgressView()
                    .progressViewStyle(.circular)
                    .tint(Color.brand.primary)
                    .scaleEffect(1.2)

                Spacer()
            }
            .padding()
        }
        .onAppear {
            startAnimations()
        }
    }

    // MARK: - Subviews

    /// Logo 视图
    private var logoView: some View {
        ZStack {
            // 背景圆
            Circle()
                .fill(Color.brand.primary.opacity(0.15))
                .frame(width: 120, height: 120)
                .scaleEffect(isAnimating ? 1.1 : 1.0)

            // Logo 图标
            Image(systemName: "book.closed.fill")
                .font(.system(size: 50))
                .foregroundStyle(Color.brand.primary)
                .rotationEffect(.degrees(isAnimating ? 0 : -5))
        }
        .shadow(
            color: Color.brand.primary.opacity(0.3),
            radius: isAnimating ? 20 : 10,
            y: isAnimating ? 8 : 4
        )
    }

    // MARK: - Animations

    private func startAnimations() {
        // Logo 呼吸动画
        withAnimation(.easeInOut(duration: 1.5).repeatForever(autoreverses: true)) {
            isAnimating = true
        }

        // 标语延迟显示
        withAnimation(.easeOut(duration: 0.6).delay(0.3)) {
            showTagline = true
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Preview

#Preview {
    LaunchScreenView()
}

import XCTest

/// 首页仪表盘 UI 测试
///

final class DashboardUITests: NotBadUITests {

    // MARK: - Setup

        try super.setUpWithError()
        app.launch()
        completeOnboardingIfNeeded()
    }

    // MARK: - Tests

    /// 测试首页显示
    func testDashboardDisplay() throws {
        // 首页应该是默认 Tab
        takeScreenshot(named: "dashboard_initial")

        // 验证欢迎卡片
        let welcomeCard = app.otherElements["welcome_card"]
        XCTAssertTrue(welcomeCard.waitForExistence(timeout: 3) ||
                      app.staticTexts.matching(NSPredicate(format: "label CONTAINS '今日'")).firstMatch.exists,
                      "欢迎卡片应该存在")
    }

    /// 测试统计卡片显示
    func testStatCardsDisplay() throws {
        takeScreenshot(named: "dashboard_stat_cards")

        // 验证统计卡片存在
        // 总错题数
        let totalCard = app.staticTexts["dashboard_total_items"]
        // 待复习
        let reviewCard = app.staticTexts["dashboard_pending_review"]

        // 至少应该有一些统计信息
        let hasStats = totalCard.waitForExistence(timeout: 3) ||
                       reviewCard.waitForExistence(timeout: 3)

        if hasStats {
            XCTAssertTrue(true, "统计卡片显示正常")
        }
    }

    /// 测试快捷操作
    func testQuickActions() throws {
        takeScreenshot(named: "dashboard_quick_actions")

        // 找到快捷操作按钮
        let quickActionButton = app.buttons.matching(NSPredicate(format: "label CONTAINS '录入' OR label CONTAINS '复习'")).firstMatch

        if quickActionButton.waitForExistence(timeout: 3) {
            XCTAssertTrue(quickActionButton.isEnabled)
            takeScreenshot(named: "dashboard_quick_action_found")
        }
    }

    /// 测试点击开始复习
    func testTapStartReview() throws {
        // 找到开始复习按钮
        let startReviewButton = app.buttons.matching(NSPredicate(format: "label CONTAINS '开始复习'")).firstMatch

        if startReviewButton.waitForExistence(timeout: 3) {
            takeScreenshot(named: "dashboard_before_review")

            startReviewButton.tap()

            takeScreenshot(named: "dashboard_after_tap_review")

            // 验证导航到复习页面
            // 可能会显示复习卡片或空状态
        }
    }

    /// 测试点击添加错题
    func testTapAddItem() throws {
        // 找到添加按钮
        let addButton = app.buttons.matching(NSPredicate(format: "label CONTAINS '录入' OR label CONTAINS '添加'")).firstMatch

        if addButton.waitForExistence(timeout: 3) {
            takeScreenshot(named: "dashboard_before_add")

            addButton.tap()

            takeScreenshot(named: "dashboard_after_tap_add")
        }
    }

    /// 测试下拉刷新
    func testPullToRefresh() throws {
        let scrollView = app.scrollViews.firstMatch
        if scrollView.waitForExistence(timeout: 3) {
            takeScreenshot(named: "dashboard_before_refresh")

            // 下拉刷新
            scrollView.swipeDown()

            takeScreenshot(named: "dashboard_refreshing")

            // 等待刷新完成
            sleep(2)

            takeScreenshot(named: "dashboard_after_refresh")
        }
    }

    /// 测试 Tab Bar 导航
    func testTabBarNavigation() throws {
        // 验证所有 Tab 存在
        let tabBar = app.tabBars.firstMatch
        XCTAssertTrue(tabBar.waitForExistence(timeout: 3))

        takeScreenshot(named: "tabbar_initial")

        // 遍历所有 Tab
        let tabs = ["首页", "复习", "录入", "题库", "我的"]

        for tab in tabs {
            let tabButton = tabBar.buttons[tab]
            if tabButton.exists {
                tabButton.tap()
                takeScreenshot(named: "tab_\(tab)")
            }
        }

        // 返回首页
        tabBar.buttons["首页"].tap()
    }
}

import XCTest

/// Onboarding 流程 UI 测试
///
/// 测试首次启动的引导流程
final class OnboardingUITests: NotBadUITests {

    // MARK: - Tests

    /// 测试完整的 Onboarding 流程
    func testCompleteOnboardingFlow() throws {
        // 启动 App 并重置状态
        app.launchArguments.append("--reset-onboarding")
        app.launch()

        takeScreenshot(named: "01_onboarding_start")

        // 验证欢迎页面显示
        XCTAssertTrue(app.staticTexts["onboarding_welcome_title"].waitForExistence(timeout: 5))

        // 验证区域选择存在
        let chinaOption = app.buttons["onboarding_region_china"]
        let japanOption = app.buttons["onboarding_region_japan"]
        let koreaOption = app.buttons["onboarding_region_korea"]

        XCTAssertTrue(chinaOption.exists, "中国选项应该存在")
        XCTAssertTrue(japanOption.exists, "日本选项应该存在")
        XCTAssertTrue(koreaOption.exists, "韩国选项应该存在")

        // 选择中国
        chinaOption.tap()
        takeScreenshot(named: "02_region_selected")

        // 点击继续按钮
        let continueButton = app.buttons["onboarding_continue"]
        XCTAssertTrue(continueButton.exists)
        XCTAssertTrue(continueButton.isEnabled, "选择区域后继续按钮应该可用")
        continueButton.tap()

        takeScreenshot(named: "03_grade_selection")

        // 验证年级选择页面
        // 等待年级选项加载
        let gradeOption = app.buttons["高一"]
        XCTAssertTrue(gradeOption.waitForExistence(timeout: 3), "年级选项应该存在")

        // 选择年级
        gradeOption.tap()
        takeScreenshot(named: "04_grade_selected")

        // 完成 Onboarding
        let startButton = app.buttons["onboarding_start"]
        XCTAssertTrue(startButton.waitForExistence(timeout: 2))
        startButton.tap()

        takeScreenshot(named: "05_main_screen")

        // 验证进入主界面
        let tabBar = app.tabBars.firstMatch
        XCTAssertTrue(tabBar.waitForExistence(timeout: 5), "应该进入主界面并显示 Tab Bar")
    }

    /// 测试区域切换
    func testRegionSwitching() throws {
        app.launchArguments.append("--reset-onboarding")
        app.launch()

        // 等待 Onboarding 加载
        let chinaOption = app.buttons["onboarding_region_china"]
        XCTAssertTrue(chinaOption.waitForExistence(timeout: 5))

        // 测试选择不同区域
        chinaOption.tap()

        // 切换到日本
        let japanOption = app.buttons["onboarding_region_japan"]
        japanOption.tap()

        // 验证可以继续
        let continueButton = app.buttons["onboarding_continue"]
        XCTAssertTrue(continueButton.isEnabled)

        takeScreenshot(named: "region_switch_test")
    }

    /// 测试未选择区域时继续按钮禁用
    func testContinueButtonDisabledWithoutSelection() throws {
        app.launchArguments.append("--reset-onboarding")
        app.launch()

        // 等待页面加载
        let continueButton = app.buttons["onboarding_continue"]
        XCTAssertTrue(continueButton.waitForExistence(timeout: 5))

        // 验证未选择时按钮状态
        // 注意：按钮可能是 disabled 或者点击后显示提示
        takeScreenshot(named: "continue_button_initial_state")
    }
}

            // 返回列表
            backButton.tap()
        }
    }

    /// 测试滑动删除
    func testSwipeToDelete() throws {
        navigateToTab("题库")

        let listItem = app.cells.firstMatch
        if listItem.waitForExistence(timeout: 3) {
            takeScreenshot(named: "library_before_swipe")

            // 左滑显示删除按钮
            listItem.swipeLeft()

            takeScreenshot(named: "library_swipe_actions")

            // 检查删除按钮
            let deleteButton = app.buttons["Delete"]
            if deleteButton.waitForExistence(timeout: 2) {
                // 不实际删除，只验证按钮存在
                XCTAssertTrue(deleteButton.exists)

                // 取消操作
                listItem.swipeRight()
            }
        }
    }

    /// 测试列表滚动
    func testListScrolling() throws {
        navigateToTab("题库")

        if scrollView.waitForExistence(timeout: 3) {

            // 向上滑动

            takeScreenshot(named: "library_scroll_middle")

            // 继续滑动

            takeScreenshot(named: "library_scroll_bottom")
        }

// FILE PATH: NotBadUITests/NotBadUITests.swift
================================================================================

//
//  NotBadUITests.swift
//  NotBadUITests
//
//  Created for NotBad K12 错题本
//

import XCTest

/// UI 测试基类
///
/// 提供通用的测试辅助方法和配置
class NotBadUITests: XCTestCase {

    // MARK: - Properties

    var app: XCUIApplication!

    // MARK: - Setup & Teardown

    override func setUpWithError() throws {
        continueAfterFailure = false
        app = XCUIApplication()

        // 重置 UserDefaults 以确保干净的测试状态
        app.launchArguments = ["--uitesting", "--reset-state"]

        // 设置测试语言为中文
        app.launchArguments.append(contentsOf: ["-AppleLanguages", "(zh-Hans)"])
        app.launchArguments.append(contentsOf: ["-AppleLocale", "zh_CN"])
    }

    override func tearDownWithError() throws {
        app = nil
    }

    // MARK: - Helper Methods

    /// 等待元素出现
    /// - Parameters:
    ///   - element: 要等待的元素
    ///   - timeout: 超时时间（默认5秒）
    /// - Returns: 元素是否出现
    @discardableResult
    func waitForElement(_ element: XCUIElement, timeout: TimeInterval = 5) -> Bool {
        return element.waitForExistence(timeout: timeout)
    }

    /// 等待元素消失
    /// - Parameters:
    ///   - element: 要等待消失的元素
    ///   - timeout: 超时时间
    /// - Returns: 元素是否消失
    @discardableResult
    func waitForElementToDisappear(_ element: XCUIElement, timeout: TimeInterval = 5) -> Bool {
        let predicate = NSPredicate(format: "exists == false")
        let expectation = XCTNSPredicateExpectation(predicate: predicate, object: element)
        let result = XCTWaiter.wait(for: [expectation], timeout: timeout)
        return result == .completed
    }

    /// 截图并附加到测试报告
    /// - Parameter name: 截图名称
    func takeScreenshot(named name: String) {
        let screenshot = XCUIScreen.main.screenshot()
        let attachment = XCTAttachment(screenshot: screenshot)
        attachment.name = name
        attachment.lifetime = .keepAlways
        add(attachment)
    }

    /// 滑动到元素可见
    /// - Parameters:
    ///   - element: 目标元素
    ///   - scrollView: 滚动视图
    ///   - maxSwipes: 最大滑动次数
    func scrollToElement(_ element: XCUIElement, in scrollView: XCUIElement, maxSwipes: Int = 10) {
        var swipeCount = 0
        while !element.isHittable && swipeCount < maxSwipes {
            scrollView.swipeUp()
            swipeCount += 1
        }
    }

    /// 完成 Onboarding 流程（如果显示）
    func completeOnboardingIfNeeded() {
        // 检查是否在 Onboarding 页面
        let continueButton = app.buttons["onboarding_continue"]
        if continueButton.waitForExistence(timeout: 2) {
            // 选择中国
            let chinaOption = app.buttons["onboarding_region_china"]
            if chinaOption.exists {
                chinaOption.tap()
            }

            // 点击继续
            continueButton.tap()

            // 选择年级（选择高一）
            let gradeOption = app.buttons["高一"]
            if gradeOption.waitForExistence(timeout: 2) {
                gradeOption.tap()
            }

            // 完成 Onboarding
            let startButton = app.buttons["onboarding_start"]
            if startButton.waitForExistence(timeout: 2) {
                startButton.tap()
            }
        }
    }

    /// 导航到指定的 Tab
    /// - Parameter tabName: Tab 名称
    func navigateToTab(_ tabName: String) {
        let tabButton = app.tabBars.buttons[tabName]
        if tabButton.exists {
            tabButton.tap()
        }
    }
}

//
//  AccessibilityUITests.swift
//  NotBadUITests
//
//  Created for NotBad K12 错题本
//

import XCTest

/// 可访问性 UI 测试
///
/// 验证应用符合可访问性标准
final class AccessibilityUITests: NotBadUITests {

    // MARK: - Setup

    override func setUpWithError() throws {
        try super.setUpWithError()
        app.launch()
        completeOnboardingIfNeeded()
    }

    // MARK: - Tests

    /// 测试 Tab Bar 可访问性
    func testTabBarAccessibility() throws {
        let tabBar = app.tabBars.firstMatch
        XCTAssertTrue(tabBar.waitForExistence(timeout: 3))

        // 验证每个 Tab 都有可访问性标签
        for button in tabBar.buttons.allElementsBoundByIndex {
            XCTAssertFalse(button.label.isEmpty, "Tab 按钮应该有可访问性标签")
        }

        takeScreenshot(named: "accessibility_tabbar")
    }

    /// 测试按钮可访问性
    func testButtonAccessibility() throws {
        // 检查首页按钮
        let buttons = app.buttons.allElementsBoundByIndex

        var buttonsWithoutLabels: [String] = []
        for button in buttons.prefix(10) { // 检查前10个按钮
            if button.label.isEmpty && button.identifier.isEmpty {
                buttonsWithoutLabels.append("Button at \(button.frame)")
            }
        }

        if !buttonsWithoutLabels.isEmpty {
            XCTFail("以下按钮缺少可访问性标签: \(buttonsWithoutLabels)")
        }

        takeScreenshot(named: "accessibility_buttons")
    }

    /// 测试图片可访问性
    func testImageAccessibility() throws {
        navigateToTab("录入")

        // 检查图片是否有可访问性描述
        let images = app.images.allElementsBoundByIndex

        for image in images.prefix(5) {
            // 图片应该有 accessibilityLabel 或者被标记为 accessibilityHidden
            // 这里只是记录，不做强制要求
            print("Image label: \(image.label), identifier: \(image.identifier)")
        }

        takeScreenshot(named: "accessibility_images")
    }

    /// 测试文本字段可访问性
    func testTextFieldAccessibility() throws {
        navigateToTab("录入")

        let textFields = app.textFields.allElementsBoundByIndex

        for textField in textFields {
            // 文本字段应该有 placeholder 或 label
            let hasLabel = !textField.label.isEmpty || !textField.placeholderValue!.isEmpty
            XCTAssertTrue(hasLabel, "文本字段应该有可访问性标签或占位符")
        }

        takeScreenshot(named: "accessibility_textfields")
    }

    /// 测试 VoiceOver 标签
    func testVoiceOverLabels() throws {
        // 测试关键元素是否有 VoiceOver 标签

        // 录入页面
        navigateToTab("录入")

        let saveButton = app.buttons["capture_save_to_library"]
        if saveButton.exists {
            XCTAssertFalse(saveButton.label.isEmpty, "保存按钮应该有 VoiceOver 标签")
        }

        takeScreenshot(named: "accessibility_voiceover")
    }

    /// 测试动态字体支持
    func testDynamicTypeSupport() throws {
        // 注意：动态字体测试需要在实际设备上进行
        // 这里只验证基本布局

        takeScreenshot(named: "accessibility_dynamic_type")

        // 验证文本元素存在
        let staticTexts = app.staticTexts.allElementsBoundByIndex
        XCTAssertGreaterThan(staticTexts.count, 0, "应该有文本元素")
    }

    /// 测试颜色对比度（视觉验证）
    func testColorContrast() throws {
        // 截取各个页面的截图供人工验证颜色对比度

        // 首页
        takeScreenshot(named: "contrast_dashboard")

        // 复习
        navigateToTab("复习")
        takeScreenshot(named: "contrast_review")

        // 录入
        navigateToTab("录入")
        takeScreenshot(named: "contrast_capture")

        // 题库
        navigateToTab("题库")
        takeScreenshot(named: "contrast_library")

        // 个人中心
        navigateToTab("我的")
        takeScreenshot(named: "contrast_profile")
    }

    /// 测试触摸目标大小
    func testTouchTargetSize() throws {
        // Apple HIG 建议最小触摸目标为 44x44 点
        let minSize: CGFloat = 44

        navigateToTab("录入")

        let buttons = app.buttons.allElementsBoundByIndex

        var smallButtons: [String] = []
        for button in buttons.prefix(10) {
            let frame = button.frame
            if frame.width < minSize || frame.height < minSize {
                smallButtons.append("\(button.label): \(frame.size)")
            }
        }

        // 记录可能过小的按钮（不强制失败）
        if !smallButtons.isEmpty {
            print("以下按钮可能触摸目标过小: \(smallButtons)")
        }

        takeScreenshot(named: "accessibility_touch_targets")
    }
}
